title: Senior Executive - Digital Analytics
description:
**Key Responsibilities**
Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO):
  
  

* Set up, QA, and launch A/B, multivariate, and split tests using enterprise CRO tools (VWO, Optimizely, Web Trend Optimizer, etc.).
* Perform web analytics audits, user behavior analysis, and heatmapping to identify drop-off points and conversion bottlenecks.
* Collaborate with design and development teams to build experiment variations. This position involves direct interaction with clients, necessitating exceptional interpersonal and presentation skills.

* Implement, maintain, and audit tracking tags via Google Tag Manager (GTM) for web and mobile web environments.

* Support end-to-end execution for ongoing enterprise accounts (including non-profit, retail, and real estate sectors).
* Deliver performance reports and experimentation insights to internal stakeholders and client teams.

* 3–4 years of hands-on experience using CRO platforms such as VWO, Optimizely, or similar engines.
* Proven experience in Google Tag Manager (GTM) setup, Data Layer design, and GA4 integration.
* Strong understanding of HTML, CSS, and basic JavaScript for tag debugging and A/B test variation code setup.
* Familiarity with web analytics tools (Google Analytics 4, Adobe Analytics) and heatmapping tools (Hotjar, Crazy Egg, MS Clarity).

title: Associate, Data Analytics // DevOps
description:

Backed by New Mountain Capital, the firm has grown at over 30% annually since its founding in 2016 and today operates from ten offices across the United States.

Professionals in TPI are involved in live engagements from the outset, contributing to analysis, execution and client deliverables in coordination with colleagues across the firm. The platform is designed to provide meaningful responsibility, direct exposure to senior leadership and long-term growth in a high-performance environment.
  
  
The Data Analytics team serves as a strategic capability across Portage Point, enabling business intelligence, operational reporting, workflow automation, enterprise applications and emerging AI initiatives. This team partners with leaders across the firm to deliver scalable technology solutions that improve decision-making, enhance operational efficiency and support continued growth. Data Analytics team members are responsible for supporting and advancing the firm's data, reporting, automation and application development platforms.
  
  
The Associate, Data Analytics // DevOps represents a unique opportunity to assume a wide range of responsibilities and make a significant impact. This Associate will support the infrastructure, deployment, monitoring and operational reliability of Portage Point's enterprise data and analytics platforms. **Responsibilities**

* Partner with senior team members, application developers, platform engineers and stakeholders across the firm to implement automation solutions that improve platform reliability, operational efficiency, deployment processes and platform stability

* Support administration and monitoring of Snowflake environments

* Administer Power BI gateways, refresh schedules, workspace environments and reporting infrastructure
* Monitor infrastructure health, availability, security and performance
* Support incident management, troubleshooting and root cause analysis activities
* Maintain operational documentation, standards and support procedures
* Contribute to infrastructure modernization and cloud optimization initiatives
* Share and manage best practices as well as lead internal trainings where required
* Support talent acquisition and firm development efforts
* Contribute to creating a high-performing and inclusive culture

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or Mathematics from a top undergraduate program required
* Two plus years of experience in DevOps, platform engineering, cloud engineering or infrastructure operations
* Advanced experience with GitHub, including version control, repository management, branching strategies, pull request reviews, GitHub Actions and collaborative software development practices across application, data and analytics projects
* Comfortable utilizing AI-powered development and operational tools to improve automation, infrastructure management, troubleshooting and engineering efficiency
* Experience supporting both Azure cloud environments and Airflow orchestration environments
* Familiarity with Snowflake administration and platform operations
* Experience supporting dbt deployment processes and CI / CD pipelines
* Experience administering or supporting Power BI environments, enterprise data platforms and analytics environments
* Familiarity with containerized technologies and modern deployment frameworks
* Strong scripting skills using Python, PowerShell and / or Bash
* Understanding of cloud infrastructure, networking, security and monitoring concepts
* Exposure to AI-enabled solutions and automation technologies
* Superior written and verbal communication skills, including executive-ready presentation and reporting skills
* Proven ability to thrive in lean, fast-moving teams
* High attention to detail, responsiveness and ownership mindset
* Track record of success in high-pressure

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Senior Data Analyst
  
  
**Job Description**
Product Data & Analytics Team
  
  
Senior Data Analyst – Product Data & Analytics
  
  
**Overview**
Product Data & Analytics team builds internal analytic partnerships, strengthening focus on the health of the business, portfolio and revenue optimization opportunities, initiative tracking, new product development and Go-To Market strategies.
  
  

* Are you excited about Data Assets and the value they bring to an organization?
* Are you an evangelist for data driven decision making?
* Are you motivated to be part of a Global Analytics team that builds large scale Analytical Capabilities supporting end users across 6 continents?
* Do you want to be the go-to resource for data analytics in the company?

The ideal candidate has a knack for seeing solutions in sprawling data sets and the business mindset to convert insights into strategic opportunities for our company.
  
  
Role & Responsibilities
  
  
Architect, develop, and maintain data engineering, advanced reporting, and data visualization solutions to support analytics and reporting needs across products, markets, and services.
  
  

* Obtain data from multiple sources, collate, analyze, and triangulate information to develop reliable fact bases and actionable insights.
* Leverage large-scale databases and analytical tools to manipulate data and synthesize insights.
* Execute cross-functional projects using advanced modeling and analytical techniques to uncover insights and drive strategic business decisions.
* Build, develop, and maintain data models, reporting systems, dashboards, and performance metrics that support key business outcomes.
* Provide insights, assessments, and recommendations through Tableau, Power BI, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Apply data quality controls, validation, and cleansing processes to ensure the accuracy and reliability of data assets.
* Communicate analytical findings and business impacts to stakeholders across leadership, technology, sales, marketing, and product teams.
* Capture and share intellectual capital, tools, methodologies, and best practices across projects to drive organizational learning.
* Lead, mentor, and guide junior team members to support their growth and development.
* Recruit, train, develop, and supervise data engineering and analyst-level talent.
* Demonstrate passion, curiosity, and expertise to solve complex business challenges and deliver measurable impact.

**All About You**

* Strong experience in data management, data mining, data analytics, reporting, data product development, and quantitative analysis.
* Expertise in building semantic models and self-service BI and analytics solutions.
* Advanced SQL skills with experience optimizing queries for large-scale and big data environments.
* Proficiency with BI and visualization platforms including Tableau, Power BI, QlikView.
* Hands-on experience with Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Cloudera Hadoop, SQL Server, and big data technology stacks.
* Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS and Azure.
* Programming experience with Python, PySpark, Hive, and R.
* Ability to present data findings in a clear, insight-driven format and develop executive-ready presentations and support decks.
* Experience with SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS), SQL Server Analysis Services (SSAS), and SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) is a plus.
* Strong problem-solving, quantitative, and analytical skills.
* Deep technical aptitude with a strong ability to learn and adopt new technologies.
* Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to data quality.
* Effective communicator with strong stakeholder management and requirements gathering skills.
* Collaborative team player who can work effectively across functions and levels of management.
* Ability to exercise sound judgment, navigate ambiguity, and perform in fast-paced team environments.
* Financial services or payments industry experience is a plus.

Education
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in a Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics

Additional Competencies
  
  

* Excellent English, quantitative, technical, and communication (oral/written) skills
* Analytical/Problem Solving
* Strong attention to detail and quality
* Creativity/Innovation
* Self-motivated, operates with a sense of urgency
* Project Management/Risk Mitigation
* Able to prioritize and perform multiple tasks simultaneously

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Business Analyst – (Client Engagement Services)
description:
**What makes Gartner a GREAT fit for you?**
When you join Gartner, you’ll be part of a fast-growing team that helps the world become smarter and more connected. We’re the leader in our industry, achieving double-digit growth by helping clients make the right decisions with business and technology insights they can’t find anywhere else. Our associates enjoy a collaborative work environment, exceptional training and career development — as well as unlimited growth potential. If you like working with a generous, supportive, high-performing team, Gartner is where you want to be.
  
  
**About this role:**
The Global S&O arm of Gartner is currently seeking talented people to join its Client Engagement Service (CES) team in India. As a member of this team you will drive client engagement and service productivity programs across Gartner. You will work towards driving integrated approach across Gartner’s key functions – Business units under Global Service & Delivery (GS&D), Sales, BTI and Products and their leaders with the central goal of improving client retention through high value engagement mechanisms. You will also get an opportunity to work on some of the high impact workstreams to drive key organizational, service associates & team level engagement goals.
  
  
**What you’ll do:**
The
**CES Engagement Campaigns Team**
is responsible for driving client engagement across Gartner offerings, including Gartner research content, conferences, virtual events, and other high-value client programs through targeted outreach campaigns. This role sits at the intersection of campaign operations, analytics, and stakeholder enablement, with a strong focus on delivering meaningful client interactions at scale. The team closely partners with Services, Conferences, Marketing, and Platform teams to develop targeted outreach strategies, improve campaign performance, and deliver actionable insights that help advance CES business priorities with an ultimate focus on increasing client engagement, adoption, and retention.
  
  
**Core Operations**

* Own end-to-end execution of client engagement campaigns across assigned products, practices, and business units.
* Build and deploy targeted email campaigns, including audience selection, content curation, template creation, testing, and launch.
* Partner with stakeholders to define campaign goals, messaging, and target client segments.
* Continuously enhance campaign templates and outreach journeys to improve engagement and conversion.
* Ensure operational excellence through rigorous quality checks and campaign governance.

**Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement**

* Track and analyze campaign performance metrics such as opens, clicks, engagement, and conversion rates.
* Use data and A/B testing to identify opportunities and improve campaign effectiveness.
* Identify engagement trends, uncover gaps, and generate actionable insights to drive client outreach strategies.
* Streamline processes, implement best practices, and leverage automation to improve efficiency and scalability.
* Share performance insights, key learnings, and recommendations during operational review forums.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Enable stakeholders with dashboards, reports, and insights that support engagement tracking and decision-making.
* Act as a trusted partner by managing campaign-related requests, providing analysis, and recommending actions.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and execute initiatives that increase client engagement.
* Communicate campaign outcomes and strategic recommendations to influence stakeholder decisions and priorities.

**What you’ll need:**

* MBA with 0-4 years of work experience
* Strong leadership skills to build capability within the team and collaborate with other team leads to ensure the larger goals are met
* Good command of knowledge related to Information technology, product development and its application to business
* Knowledge/experience on analytical problem solving, analytical tools
* Exposure and understanding of lean six sigma, lean diagnostics, T&M and other process improvement techniques would be a big plus

**Who you are:**

* Developing professionals with strong business acumen, problem solving leadership (qualitative & quantitative).
* High on champion mindset and a quick learner
* Strong orientation towards operational and business excellence
* Strong communication and collaboration skills
* Innovative mindset and inclination to solve business problems
* Analytical thinker with experience deriving business insights from data analytics
* Detail-oriented with high personal standard for quality
* Comfortable in working with cross-functional teams
* Skillful in managing expectations of varying stakeholders (internal & external)

**What we offer:**
In addition to an outstanding work environment with rapid advancement potential, Gartner associates enjoy exceptional compensation and benefits, including:
  
  

* Competitive base salary
* Flexible work environment
* A great work culture

**Who are we?**
At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.
  
  
Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.
  
  
Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.
  
  
**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**
Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.
  
  
We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.
  
  
Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.
  
  
We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.
  
  
**Gartner is the world authority on AI**
At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.
  
  
It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.
  
  
**What do we offer?**
Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.
  
  
In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.
  
  
Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

title: Monitoring and Evaluation Officer, South Asia Hub – Health Systems (Learning and Impact)
description:
PATH current employees - please log in and apply
**Here**
PATH is a global nonprofit dedicated to achieving health equity. With more than 40 years of experience forging multisector partnerships and with expertise in science, economics, technology, advocacy, and dozens of other specialties, PATH develops and scales up innovative solutions to the world’s most pressing health challenges.
  
  
**About The Project**
PATH works with governments and partners to strengthen health systems and improve the availability, quality, and use of data for program planning, implementation, and decision-making. Across its health systems portfolio, PATH supports monitoring, evaluation, learning, assessments, digital data systems, analytics, and evidence generation to improve program performance and health outcomes.
  
  
The Monitoring & Evaluation function supports project teams to establish practical measurement systems, strengthen data quality, track progress against agreed indicators, generate actionable insights, and document learning. The M&E Officer will contribute to these efforts across assigned projects and work closely with program, technical, digital, research, and implementation teams.
  
  

* Strengthen routine monitoring systems, indicator tracking, and data quality across projects.
* Support assessments, analysis, visualization, reporting, and evidence generation for program improvement.
* Promote the use of data and learning for adaptive management and decision-making.

**About The Position**
PATH is seeking a Monitoring & Evaluation Officer to support monitoring, evaluation, learning, and data-use activities across health systems projects. Reporting to the Lead - Learning and Impact, the M&E Officer will support the design and implementation of M&E frameworks, data-collection systems, assessments, data-quality processes, analysis, visualization, reporting, and documentation of learning. The position will work closely with project teams and partners to ensure that timely, reliable, and actionable evidence is available for program management and decision-making.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Support the Lead – Learning and Impact in developing and updating the project’s results framework, logframe, MEL plan, indicator reference sheets, data management plans, data dictionaries, and M&E standard operating procedures, with clear definitions, data sources, frequency, responsibilities, and quality standards.
* Help set baselines and targets for key project indicators and track progress against them on a regular basis.
* Design, test, and update data collection tools such as surveys, facility checklists, and interview guides, including digital forms on platforms such as KoBoToolbox or ODK.
* Train state and city teams, field staff, and partners on data collection tools, sampling, informed consent, and data quality.
* Coordinate routine monitoring and periodic assessments, including baseline, midline, and endline data collection across intervention geographies.
* Carry out regular data quality checks, including spot checks, back-checks, and data verification visits; document errors found and corrections made.
* Ensure project data is stored securely and handled in line with PATH’s data protection and research ethics standards; maintain structured, well-documented, and version-controlled datasets with appropriate metadata and access controls.
* Clean, analyse, triangulate, and interpret quantitative and qualitative data; disaggregate findings as appropriate, conduct trend and gap analyses, and maintain progress trackers and dashboards in Excel, Power BI, or similar tools to generate actionable insights for programme teams.
* Support government counterparts at state, district, and city level in analysing and using routine data from HMIS, AB-HWC, and other national portals for planning and review.
* Draft monthly, quarterly, and annual progress reports, donor reports, and data summaries, clearly separating observed data from estimates and stating data limitations.
* Support the design and management of internal assessments and external evaluations, including development of protocols, sampling approaches, analysis plans, terms of reference, review of tools, ethics-related documentation where applicable, and quality assurance during fieldwork.
* Coordinate with external data-collection, research, or evaluation agencies/consultants, as required, to ensure adherence to agreed methodology, data-quality standards, timelines, and deliverables.
* Help organise review meetings and learning sessions; support the project learning agenda, document lessons learned, case studies, and good practices, and track agreed actions so that monitoring and evaluation findings are used for course correction and programme improvement.
* Prepare technical reports, impactful presentations, and knowledge products for government, donor, and internal audiences.
* Perform other duties as assigned by the supervisor from time to time for the smooth functioning of the program and to achieve program goals.
* Available to travel up to 30-40% of the time.

**Required Experience And Qualifications.**

* Master’s degree in Public Health, Epidemiology, Biostatistics, Statistics, Population Studies, Health Informatics, Social Work, Economics, Development Studies, or a related field.
* At least 3-5 years of professional experience in monitoring and evaluation of public health or development programmes.
* Hands-on experience in designing data collection tools, managing field data collection, implementing data-quality assurance processes, managing datasets, and analysing programme data.
* Working knowledge of at least one statistical package such as Stata, SPSS, or R, with a sound understanding of quantitative analysis; experience with qualitative data analysis is an added advantage.
* Demonstrated understanding of results-based monitoring, indicator design, target setting, sampling, data-quality assessment, and interpretation of routine health information systems.
* Experience with digital data collection platforms such as KoBoToolbox, ODK, or SurveyCTO.
* Experience with INGOs in the health sector and/ or Ministries of Health, government is preferable.
* Familiarity with Indian public health system, health data sources, and flagship initiatives such as NHM, NUHM, Ayushman Bharat Health & Wellness Centers, PM-ABHIM, XV-FC, and HMIS.

**Skills/ Abilities**

* Self-starter and committed to performing their duties with a high degree of autonomy and independence in line with project goals and objectives.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality, accuracy, and research ethics.
* Ability to explain data and findings in simple language to non-technical audiences.
* Ability to translate monitoring, assessment, and evaluation findings into clear recommendations and follow-up actions for technical and programme teams.
* Strong written and oral communication and presentation skills in English and Hindi.
* Direct experience of working with government health functionaries, district level administrators and other development partners on data and reporting.
* Advanced Excel skills; experience with dashboards such as Power BI or Tableau and GIS mapping is desirable. Familiarity with database management or automated data workflows would be an added advantage.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively collaborate in a matrix organizational structure.
* Ability to handle a variety of assignments under pressure of deadlines.

You will translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions using Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, integration tools, APIs, and data services.
  
  
You will own delivery across the full solution lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, monitoring, and production support. You will also contribute to engineering standards, platform governance, data quality, and continuous improvement across the GTM Technology ecosystem.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.

* Design, build, and support solutions for top-of-funnel and marketing operations processes
* Develop and enhance lead capture, lead conversion, routing, qualification, scoring, and lifecycle management capabilities

* Design and support inbound integrations that create, enrich, qualify, and route leads and accounts into Salesforce
* Partner with Marketing Operations, Sales Development, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Data, and Engineering to understand requirements and identify process gaps
* Contribute to documentation, UAT, regression testing, runbooks, monitoring, and user enablement
* Leverage AI-powered engineering tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Agentforce, and GitHub Copilot to improve productivity, analysis, troubleshooting, and documentation while applying sound judgment around security, privacy, and accuracy

**Responsibilities**
Technical Delivery
  
  

* Translate business requirements into scalable marketing technology and Salesforce solutions using declarative configuration, custom development, APIs, and integration platforms.

Marketing Technology Engineering
  
  

* Own and enhance capabilities across:

+ Lead capture, conversion, qualification, and routing
+ Marketing enrichment and data normalization
+ Campaign and campaign member management
+ Account identification, matching, and hierarchy management
+ Territory planning and account assignment
+ Activity and engagement management
+ Outreach and business development workflows
+ Marketing attribution and lifecycle reporting
+ Annual planning and operational planning processes

Integration and System Design
  
  

* Design and support secure, reliable, and observable inbound and outbound integrations across Salesforce, marketing automation, enrichment, outreach, analytics, and enterprise platforms.

Data Quality and Governance
  
  

* Establish reliable data flows and controls that improve completeness, accuracy, consistency, deduplication, consent handling, and governance across lead, contact, account, campaign, and activity data.

Engineering Excellence
  
  

* Maintain high standards for modular design, test coverage, documentation, deployment processes, monitoring, CI/CD, and adherence to shared integration and Salesforce engineering patterns.

Platform Optimization
  
  

* Proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, integration risks, manual processes, technical debt, and opportunities to simplify the marketing technology architecture.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* 6+ years of hands-on Salesforce development or enterprise business systems engineering experience
* Strong experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, SOQL, Salesforce APIs, and platform automation
* Proficiency in scripting and programming languages such as Python and JavaScript, with experience building reusable automation, data transformation, and integration services
* Experience with React or comparable modern front-end frameworks
* Experience with full-stack development, including front-end applications, back-end services, APIs, data models, authentication, testing, deployment, and operational support
* Experience designing and supporting marketing technology, CRM, lead management, or revenue operations solutions
* Experience building and supporting REST or SOAP API integrations and data synchronization processes
* Strong understanding of Salesforce security, data governance, data quality, and scalable implementation practices
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills
* Salesforce Platform Developer I or II certification required

Success Measures
  
  
In 3 Months
  
  
Develop a strong understanding of MongoDB’s marketing technology and Salesforce architecture, top-of-funnel processes, lead lifecycle, campaign operations, integration landscape, and stakeholder environment.
  
  
In 6 Months
  
  
Deliver meaningful enhancements across lead management, marketing integrations, enrichment, campaign management, routing, account management, or related GTM Technology initiatives. Establish yourself as a dependable technical contributor and trusted partner to Marketing Operations and Revenue Operations.
  
  
In 12 Months
  
  
Become a trusted subject matter expert for marketing technology and top-of-funnel business systems. title: Associate, Turnaround & Restructuring Services
description:

The firm delivers integrated financial and operational solutions across Transaction Advisory Services, Transaction Execution Services, Office of the CFO, Valuations, Performance Improvement, Turnaround & Restructuring and Investment Banking. Engagement teams are lean and execution-oriented, working directly with senior stakeholders to navigate complex transitions and transformations.
  
  
Triple P India (TPI) is a strategic extension of the firm’s platform, established to build a high-quality team that operates as an integrated part of U.S.-based teams. Professionals in TPI are involved in live engagements from the outset, contributing to analysis, execution and client deliverables in coordination with colleagues across the firm. The platform is designed to provide meaningful responsibility, direct exposure to senior leadership and long-term growth in a high-performance environment.
  
  
The Associate, Turnaround Restructuring Services (TRS) role at Portage Point represents a unique opportunity to drive meaningful impact on complex, high-stakes client challenges. As a key contributor within our TRS practice, this Associate will support the full spectrum of restructuring, distressed advisory and operational transformation work – from situational assessment and stabilization initiatives, restructuring strategy development and overall financial and operational value creation plan execution. This Associate, TRS will report to the local TRS Director and will execute discrete workstreams on client engagements, contribute to proposal development and collaborate with cross-functional partners in Office of the CFO, Transaction Execution Services, Investment Banking and Transaction Advisory Services teams. If you thrive in a high-performance culture and want to help build the future of a rapidly growing consultancy, this is the right role for you.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Partner with senior team members and clients to support complex operational and financial challenges across the business lifecycle including formulating business plan and liquidity assessments and implementing cost reduction, value creation, business transformation and performance improvement plans, and if necessary, contingency planning and Chapter 11 bankruptcy preparation / execution
* Analyze financial statements and key operational data; build models such as three-statement forecasts, thirteen-week cash flows (TWCFs), and value creation scenarios
* Contribute to restructuring workstreams including DIP sizing, Chapter 11 filing prep, vendor analysis, SOAL / SOFAs, MORs, KPI tracking, retention plans, liquidation analyses, headcount forecasts, GL review, footprint rationalization, S&OP, organizational design and go-to-market strategy
* Identify and re-allocate resources to operational, growth, financial and strategic initiatives with highest risk adjusted return
* Develop detailed financial projections and business plans
* Create high-impact deliverables including business plan materials, liquidity projections, analysis of strategic alternatives, KPIs, financial updates and board-ready reporting for executives, investors and creditors
* Contribute to a high-performing, inclusive and values-driven culture

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree from a top undergraduate program required
* Willing to relocate to or be primarily present in Gurgaon
* Three plus years of experience at a top-tier advisory firm serving U.S. clients, with hands-on exposure to business operations and Chapter 11 restructuring
* Proven ability to build three-statement models, TWCFs, dynamic KPI dashboards and complex ad hoc analyses
* Superior written and verbal communication skills, including executive-ready presentation and reporting skills
* Proven ability to thrive in lean, fast-moving teams
* High attention to detail, responsiveness and ownership mindset
* Track record of success in high-pressure, client-facing environments

title: Senior Analyst/Manager - Financial & Regulatory Reporting
company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
We are looking for a highly resourceful, proactive, and detail-oriented individual to join our Financial and Regulatory Reporting (FinR) team as Senior Analyst/ Manager, based out of the firm’s offices in Hyderabad/Gurugram/Bengaluru. The team handles the firm’s investor and legal entity financial reporting for its hedge fund and private fund vehicles within the Financial Operations group. The role offers the opportunity to join a collegial and dynamic working environment as part of a highly skilled team, and to work with senior leaders at the firm while assuming considerable responsibility.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY**
:
  
  
In this role, you will prepare, analyze, and review monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements; conduct account and performance analyses; and handle investor management and regulatory reporting for multiple legal entities in global capital markets. You will be responsible for handling change management processes while understanding and analyzing changes in the firm’s businesses and incorporating these changes into the firm’s financial reporting infrastructure. You will stay up to date on all developments taking place in the technical accounting space (primarily U.S. GAAP) to provide accounting guidance at the firm. You will contribute to adopting new accounting standards, preparing, and reviewing various accounting policy memorandums, and updating and maintaining the firm’s accounting policy manual. You will also contribute to the launch of new funds and closure of existing funds, which may require participation in the structuring of complex fund structures and transactions, conducting historical analyses and fielding other bespoke requests from various internal groups (including senior management and technical investing groups). In addition to this, you will have the opportunity to gain a macro view of the firm’s financial activities and learn about complex fund structures and transactions while interacting substantially with our external auditors and other internal departments, including trade accounting, management company accounting, pricing, investor relations, tax, treasury, legal and compliance, and software development groups.
  
  
**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
The ideal candidate should hold-
  
  
Basic qualifications:
  
  

* A Chartered Accountancy qualification (CFA would be an added advantage) with 2-10 years of relevant work experience in financial reporting for global investment or banking entities handling audits and ensuring statutory compliances under U.S. GAAP
* Technical understanding of investment accounting, including fixed income securities, complex/exotic derivative products, tax-lot relief methodologies, amortization, corporate actions, alternative investments, securitizations, and other investment products
* Experience with portfolio accounting and management systems
* Attention to detail, keen analytical skills, proficiency in MS Excel, and excellent written and verbal communication skills to successfully interact with various stakeholders
* Robust project management and critical thinking skills with a proactive approach
* The ability to handle all levels of complexity in the respective area of operation while being comfortable functioning in an agile environment with deadlines

Preferred qualification:
  
  

* Prior experience in the hedge fund or investment banking industries including fund accounting and reporting

Interested candidates can apply through our website:
  
  
https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Adv/Link/SnrFinRRepMCAFeb2026
  
  
We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender-neutral return-to-work initiative.

title: Workday Integration Specialist
description:
**About Us**
Dyson is a global technology enterprise. We solve the problems others choose to ignore, with surprising new inventions that defy convention and simply work better. We’re growing fast and our ambition is huge – more categories, more locations and more people.
  
  
Pioneering technology takes more than just inventive engineers. At Dyson, we take a problem-solving approach to everything we do. And across our support teams, we’re proud to be different. And importantly, we support change to maintain our rapid growth
  
  
Digital HRIS function organization provides process and service excellence to support Dyson’s growth ambitions with a goal of innovating and enhancing employee services over time to meet the changing needs of the business.
  
  
**About The Role**
Part of a team of functional managers and specialists, the role is fundamental to supporting and advancing Dyson’s usage of the core Human Capital Management system (Workday). This role will serve as an HR Technology point of contact for HR functional areas and assists HR subject matter experts to identify, plan and implement systems and process improvements. The specialist will have responsibility for the successful implementation, integration, configuration, and support of Workday applications from project initiation to production roll-out.
  
  
To be successful in this role, you will strive to deliver a 'best in class', efficient service and will be a valued member of the wider People and Dyson Business Services communities at Dyson.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Support global business users and HR by troubleshooting system issues, resolving defects, maintaining system data structures, assisting with ad-hoc reporting requests, and administering biannual Workday-related processes.
* Take ownership of queries and actively manage them, providing best-in-class technical solutions and stakeholder support while ensuring compliance with policies and procedures.
* Act as a subject matter expert (SME) with deep knowledge of Workday integrations and modules, including configuration, testing, and implementation across HCM, Reporting & Analytics, Compensation, Talent and Performance, Absence Management, Time Tracking, Recruiting, Security, and related areas.
* Conduct working sessions with stakeholders to gather, understand, and analyze business and technical requirements, recommending solutions based on best practices and feasibility.
* Collaborate with requestors, project managers, business analysts, HR business partners, and QA staff to ensure requirements are fully understood, including reviewing technical designs and testing documentation.
* Configure and implement changes or updates to Workday integrations and modules, managing and promoting these through the appropriate technical (solution) development and change management processes.
* Support delivery of key projects, including Workday integration enhancements, HR system changes, and improvements to stakeholder experience.
* Develop and implement scalable, flexible integration solutions that can adapt to future business needs.
* Advise stakeholders on industry standards and best practices, ensuring clean configuration and streamlined processes.
* Ensure users leverage Workday best practices effectively.
* Maintain up-to-date process documentation and learning materials, including GWIs, FAQs, and training guides.
* Engage in continuous self-learning through Workday Community and other available channels.
* Actively contribute to HR-wide and cross-functional initiatives as required.

**About You**
The successful candidate will demonstrate strong experience in requirements gathering, solution design, delivery, and ongoing support of Workday integration projects. This includes hands-on expertise in tools such as Workday Studio, Core Connectors, EIBs, and APIs, applied across multiple functional areas (e.g., Talent and Performance, Absence Management, Recruiting, etc).
  
  
**Experience**

* Degree in Information Technology / Computer Science/ Business or other related fields
* Minimum 3–5 years of Workday integration experience
* Hands-on involvement in at least one full lifecycle Workday integration and implementation project
* Strong background in Workday Studio, Core Connectors, EIBs, and Workday APIs
* Experience working in a multinational technology organization with complex system landscapes
* Demonstrated ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with maturity
* Knowledge and experience across a range of SaaS HRIS and web-based talent management or HR service delivery tools, with emphasis on system integration and data flows
* Extensive HR systems reporting, HR process, and project management experience
* Familiarity with HCM concepts, HR processes, and a basic understanding of HR policies and procedures (ensure integration design aligns with business requirements)
* Workday Integration certification is a must.

Personal Attributes
  
  

* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with strong attention to detail in technical configurations
* Strong organizational and time management skills, able to react quickly to changing priorities in a fast-paced environment
* A collaborative team player with the ability to work independently and cross-functionally with HR, other stakeholders, and third-party vendor
* Proactive approach to delivering effective technical solutions, troubleshooting, and stakeholder engagement.
* Results-oriented, with awareness of goals and standards, ensuring quality and productivity are consistently met
* Ability to prioritize workload, analyse complex problems, and demonstrate resilience in overcoming technical barriers

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Senior, Tax Services –Tax Technology Consulting – Oracle EBS**
Join Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited and support US-based clients as they modernize and strengthen their tax functions. This role sits within Tax Technology Consulting and focuses on Oracle E-Business Suite and Oracle Financials Cloud capabilities that impact tax. You will help clients improve tax operations through process design, requirements gathering, system assessment, automation, and solution development. This is an opportunity to work on complex tax transformation initiatives in a global environment.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Senior, Tax Services on the Tax Technology Consulting team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Conduct client workshops.
* Gather and document tax requirements for the business and perform system fit-gap analysis.
* Advise clients on tax department strategy and policy, including tax assessment from a people, process, technology, and governance perspective.
* Support process improvement, tax department redesign, and evaluation of automation opportunities.
* Work on the design and development of tax solutions.
* Conduct user acceptance testing to compile test scenarios and identify flaws and improvement opportunities in newly built systems and processes.

**The team**
Tax Technology Consulting (TTC) - Ever expanding regulations and increasing scrutiny on multinational corporations has made it necessary for leading-edge tax departments to serve a critical role in the risk management and overall performance of the enterprise. This has resulted in an opportunity for Deloitte to provide even greater value through our tax services, in helping develop tax departments of the future that are strategic, agile, and focused on creating value for the business.
  
  
Deloitte's TMC group helps our clients’ tax department move forward from their current state to the next generation of tax functions and is dedicated to finding new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations. Deloitte Tax LLP professionals are aligned worldwide to serve our clients’ needs through the TMC group. Deloitte TMC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co-sourcing specialists who can help make the necessary connections between our clients’ global strategies and the many options for carrying them out in the tax function.
  
  
**Location: Bengaluru, Chennai, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Pune**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* Full-time bachelor’s or master’s degree in Engineering, Finance, Accounts, or equivalent from a reputed university.
* MBA or Chartered Accountant with experience in Finance, Accounting, Taxation, and Auditing.
* 4-7 years of experience with Oracle EBS finance modules or Oracle Financials Cloud modules that impact tax.
* Experience with financial consolidation processes and applications, including Hyperion applications.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Access.
* Experience with Oracle modules such as E-Business Tax or Oracle ERP Cloud tax module, Trading Community Architecture, Order Management or iStore, Accounts Receivable, Purchasing or iExpense, Accounts Payable, Supplier Master or iSupplier Portal, Fixed Assets, Project Accounting, General Ledger, or Oracle BI.

Preferred:
  
  

* Knowledge of business and tax processes, creating functional specifications, identifying and developing requirements for new reports, preparing test scripts, and providing user training and support.
* Experience with indirect tax, direct tax, or withholding tax.
* Knowledge of country-specific localization capabilities of Oracle EBS and Oracle Fusion applications.
* Experience with third-party tax software such as Vertex, ONESOURCE, SOVOS (Taxware), or Avalara.
* Knowledge of PL/SQL.

title: Intern - AI/ML
description:
Tower is home to some of the world’s best systematic trading and engineering talent. We empower portfolio managers to build their teams and strategies independently while providing the economies of scale that come from a large, global organization.
  
  
Engineers thrive at Tower while developing electronic trading infrastructure at a world class level. Our engineers solve challenging problems in the realms of low-latency programming, FPGA technology, hardware acceleration and machine learning. Our ongoing investment in top engineering talent and technology ensures our platform remains unmatched in terms of functionality, scalability and performance.
  
  
At Tower, every employee plays a role in our success. Our Business Support teams are essential to building and maintaining the platform that powers everything we do — combining market access, data, compute, and research infrastructure with risk management, compliance, and a full suite of business services. Our Business Support teams enable our trading and engineering teams to perform at their best.
  
  
At Tower, employees will find a stimulating, results-oriented environment where highly intelligent and motivated colleagues inspire each other to reach their greatest potential.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Building and evaluating multi-agent systems, including agent orchestration, tool-calling, and integration with protocols and frameworks such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent skills.
* Implementing agentic coding tools, such as Claude Code, to accelerate development, automate workflows, and build internal tooling.
* Developing and implementing statistical and machine learning algorithms and models to support business and technical requirements.
* Contributing to MLOps practices for deploying, monitoring, and maintaining machine learning models in production environments.
* Analyzing model performance through experiments and testing, while contributing to the optimization and fine-tuning of existing models.

**Qualifications**

* A bachelor’s, master’s, or PhD degree (ongoing or completed), or equivalent qualification, from a top university, with availability to join an in-office internship for six months starting January 2027.
* Expertise in modern agentic AI tooling is required, including agentic coding assistants such as Claude Code (or similar), building multi-agent systems, and integrating with protocols and frameworks such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) or agent skills.
* Experience training, building, and deploying machine learning models using TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar frameworks.
* Familiarity with MLOps practices for model deployment, productionization, and lifecycle management.
* Strong knowledge of Python, with hands-on experience using Linux, SQL, Git, and Bash scripting.
* A background in or experience with the finance domain is a plus.

Tower’s headquarters are in the historic Equitable Building, right in the heart of NYC’s Financial District and our impact is global, with over a dozen offices around the world.
  
  
At Tower, we believe work should be both challenging and enjoyable. That is why we foster a culture where smart, driven people thrive – without the egos. Our open concept workplace, casual dress code, and well-stocked kitchens reflect the value we place on a friendly, collaborative environment where everyone is respected, and great ideas win.
  
  
Our benefits include:
  
  

* Generous paid time off policies
* Savings plans and other financial wellness tools available in each region
* Hybrid working opportunities
* Free breakfast, lunch, and snacks daily
* In-office wellness experiences and reimbursement for select wellness expenses (e.g., gym, personal training and more)
* Company-sponsored sports teams and fitness events (JPM Corporate Challenge, Cycle for Survival, Wall Street Rides FAR and more)
* Volunteer opportunities and charitable giving
* Social events, happy hours, treats, and celebrations throughout the year
* Workshops and continuous learning opportunities

At Tower, you’ll find a collaborative and welcoming culture, a diverse team and a workplace that values both performance and enjoyment. No unnecessary hierarchy. No ego. Just great people doing great work – together.
  
  
Tower Research Capital is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Analyst
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Finance Analyst to manage and oversee key financial operations, including month-end close, financial statement preparation, variance analysis, and global reporting. This role will involve close collaboration with Business Development, Legal, and cross-functional finance teams to ensure financial accuracy and compliance. The ideal candidate should have expertise in financial reporting, accounting operations, and analytical reviews within a multinational environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Month-end close & reporting
  
  
  

* Support month-end close activities and meet reporting timelines.
* Review trial balance movements and validate key P&L and Balance Sheet accounts.
* Prepare monthly P&L results and key drivers for the Local Management Team.
* Submit monthly financial statements in Hyperion with complete and accurate data.

Business coordination & unit counts
  
  
  

* Coordinate with Business Development and Legal to reconcile unit counts and update store trackers.
* Investigate variances and document assumptions and adjustments.
* Share final unit-count outputs with the Local Management Team and the Global External Reporting Team.

Financial analysis & insights
  
  
  

* Assist in preparing the roll-forward schedule.
* Prepare and consolidate monthly Balance Sheet schedules.
* Prepare Balance Sheet roll-forward and variance analysis and submit required Hyperion inputs.
* Prepare monthly P&L variance analysis and management deck commentary (vs. prior month, budget, and forecast).
* Support SSG and SSSG calculations, MD&A, and commentary for the Controller Deck.
* Identify trends and risks and drive process improvements to improve accuracy and timeliness.
* Prepare and deliver the Controller Deck with clear commentary and supporting schedules

**Minimum Requirements**
**Qualifications & Skills:**

* Education: Bachelor’s+ master’s degree in finance, Accounting, or a related field.
* Experience: 2+ years of experience in financial reporting, accounting, and variance analysis.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong knowledge of GAAP/IFRS accounting standards.
* Proficiency in ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, etc.) and Hyperion Financial System.
* Expertise in financial statement preparation, balance sheet reconciliation, and variance analysis.
* Advanced proficiency in MS Excel.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication and coordination skills to work with cross-functional teams and global stakeholders.
* High attention to detail and ability to meet tight deadlines.

title: Senior IT Pillar Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Overview:**
McDermott is seeking an experienced Senior IT Pillar Specialist to support and manage the HR Blizz Cloud Payroll platform utilized across 20+ countries. This role will serve as a key liaison between Payroll Operations, HR, Finance, and IT teams to ensure accurate payroll processing, system stability, issue resolution, and continuous improvement of payroll-related applications.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess strong knowledge of payroll processes, payroll calculations, statutory requirements, ERP payroll systems, and payroll-related data integrations. Experience with HR Blizz Payroll is highly preferred.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Tasks and Responsibilities:**

* Payroll Application Support

+ Provide day-to-day support for the HR Blizz Cloud Payroll application across multiple countries
+ Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve payroll processing and system-related issues
+ Monitor payroll runs and ensure successful execution of payroll cycles
+ Support payroll reconciliations, reporting, and issue resolution during payroll processing periods
+ Coordinate with vendors and internal teams for defect resolution and system enhancements

* Functional & Technical Support

+ Analyze payroll calculations, earnings, deductions, taxes, benefits, retro processing, and statutory calculations
+ Validate payroll configurations, pay elements, formulas, calculations, and system outputs
+ Support payroll-related interfaces, integrations, and data validation activities
+ Participate in application testing, regression testing, UAT, and production deployments

* Stakeholder Collaboration

+ Partner with Payroll, HR, Finance, and regional business teams to understand requirements and resolve issues
+ Provide guidance on payroll system functionality, best practices, and process improvements
+ Assist with audits, compliance activities, and payroll controls

* Continuous Improvement

+ Identify opportunities to automate and streamline payroll processes
+ Develop and maintain support documentation, knowledge articles, and process guides
+ Support global payroll transformation initiatives and new country implementations

**Qualifications**
**Essential Qualifications and Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or related field
* 5+ years of experience supporting payroll applications or payroll operations.
* Experience supporting global or multi-country payroll environments.
* Strong understanding of payroll processing, payroll calculations, statutory requirements, and payroll controls
* Experience with ERP or Cloud payroll systems and Oracle HCM Cloud
* Technical Knowledge:

+ Payroll calculations and processing logic
+ Earnings, deductions, taxes, benefits, and retroactive adjustments
+ Payroll interfaces, integrations, and reporting
+ Data analysis and troubleshooting skills
+ SQL and reporting experience is a plus

**Preferred Qualifications and Education:**

* Experience with HR Blizz Cloud Payroll (highly preferred)
* Experience with Oracle HCM, SAP Payroll, JDE Payroll, ADP, or similar ERP payroll platforms
* Exposure to payroll implementations, upgrades, and country rollouts
* Knowledge of global payroll compliance and statutory regulations
* Key Competencies

+ Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
+ Attention to detail and accuracy
+ Ability to work under payroll processing deadlines
+ Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
+ Ability to manage multiple priorities across global regions
+ Customer-focused mindset and continuous improvement orientation

* Success Measures

+ Timely resolution of payroll-related incidents
+ Accurate payroll processing across 20+ countries
+ Reduced payroll defects and production issues
+ Improved system stability, compliance, and user satisfaction

* Preferred Candidate Profile: Individual with hands-on experience supporting payroll applications, deep understanding of payroll calculations and business processes, and prior experience with HR Blizz Payroll in a global enterprise environment

title: Manager - Supply Planning
description:
**Overview**
Objective & Purpose:
  
  

* Lead end-to-end Supply Planning & Production Scheduling for Potato Chips Category across the North Region, ensuring optimal service levels, inventory health, network efficiency and cost productivity. Drive capacity planning, network optimization, innovation commercialization, and cross-functional alignment with Agro, Manufacturing, Procurement, Category, and Commercial teams to deliver sustainable growth and operational excellence.

Scope:
  
  

* Own supply planning and Production Scheduling for Potato Chips Category across North Region manufacturing network.
* Responsible for Rough Cut Capacity Planning and Detailed Production Planning (DPP)
* Lead Sourcing and network Optimization decision to balance service, cost and capacity utilization
* Drive successful commercialization of NPDs, promotions, pack transitions, SKU rationalization, and changeovers.
* Deliver critical Supply Chain KPIs including Service Levels, MPS Adherence, Demand Compliance, Production Adherence, Inventory Health, Primary Freight Cost, and Productivity.

**Responsibilities**

* Serve as the key supply planning interface across Manufacturing, Category, R&D, Procurement, and Agro teams, facilitating timely decision-making and issue resolution. (Being Informed, Provide consultation)
* Facilitate the S&OE process from supply perspective by ensuring alignment and timely course correction to plan and review all demands - NPD, Innovation etc. (Provide consultation)
* Lead development of monthly, weekly, and detailed line-level production schedules to ensure alignment with demand, capacity, and inventory objectives.
* Accountable for executing all innovations, changeovers, NPDs within stipulated timelines support the innovation agenda for PepsiCo (Decide & Execute)
* Responsible for driving the ESP / JDA modules for Supply Planning and Production Scheduling – Tactical Sourcing, DRP, RP, IO and DPP (Decide, Execute)
* Drive continuous improvement in supply planning through network optimization by leveraging technology tools such as LLamasoft /Lyric (Decide, Execute)
* Drive network productivity YoY by ensuring sourcing through most optimum network and by facilitating decisions for capacity augmentations to support network requirement (Decide)
* Facilitate Capacity Planning for AOP and SBP in collaboration with P&P to ensure new capacities come at the right location and at the right brand, pack mix. (Being Informed, Provide consultation)
* Lead the initiative on E2E cost optimization in planning to support profitable growth agenda for India business in collaboration with Finance, Agro, Manufacturing (Decide, Execute)
* Facilitate the S&OE process from supply perspective by ensuring alignment and timely course correction to plan and review all demands - NPD, Innovation etc. (Provide consultation)
* Ensure optimum stock levels to meet sales demand as stipulated demand compliance levels while driving continuous improvement in working capital levels for for India in collaboration with finance (Being Informed, provide consultation, Execute)
* Custodian of FG write off, RM/PM are kept to a minimum and have constant improvement Year on Year through efficient planning and by collaborating with Sales and Plants (Decide, Provide consultation, Execute)
* Optimize between Freight and Service levels in a constantly changing supply scenario through technology intervention, collaborating with field teams to optimize sourcing to support Primary freight delivery (Decide, provide consultation, Execute)

**Qualifications**

* 6-8 years of Supply Chain/ Logistics Operations with preferred FMCG Experience
* Bachelor’s degree with an MBA preferable in Supply Chain/ Operation management from B School
* Proven Experience in Supply chain Planning, Inventory management and related Jobs.
* Good Process automation knowledge of Planning tool – JDA, OMP, SAP and LLamasoft
* Experience in leading a mature S&OP and S&OE enabled Supply Chain team
* Strong analytics Skills with Proficiency in data analysis tools and techniques
* Excellent communication, influencing and collaborative skills
* Outward looking with a real understanding of the key customer requirements and developments

title: Senior Executive, Project Management
description:
**Job Role – Senior Executive**
**About The Organisation**
You will be joining a global life sciences and pharmaceutical organisation within
**Inizio Ignite**
, working across two highly specialised divisions—
**STEM Healthcare**
and
**Research Partnership**
. Together, these teams deliver strategic insights, benchmarking, market research, and performance acceleration solutions for global pharmaceutical, biotech, and medtech clients.
  
  
With teams operating across Europe, North America, Asia and Emerging Markets, and a rapidly growing operations hub in India, we offer the opportunity to work in a dynamic, fast-paced, multinational environment that:
  
  

* Makes a meaningful impact on human health
* Puts people at the centre
* Celebrates collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning

**Vision, Mission & Values**
**Vision:**
To be an essential partner enabling clients to reach more patients.
  
  
**Mission:**
To accelerate high performance across commercial, medical and operational functions.
  
  
**Core Values:**
Brave | Honest | Performance Driven | Practical | Customer Focused | Caring
  
  
**About the role:**
The role of the Senior Project Executive is to cost and oversee the set up and management of fieldwork and data collection to ensure successful completion within best practices. You will also be expected to contribute to company operations processes; providing proactive ideas and plans about improving the efficiency of the project management function and projects. Core, but not exclusive, responsibilities will include:
  
  

* Responsibility for sourcing, obtaining and negotiating commercially advantageous costs from external suppliers and panel providers for Research Partnership project proposals
* Updating suppliers on the status of their quotes
* Overseeing the smooth running of fieldwork management
* Successful handover of project deliverables to research team:
* Coordination of Data Processing (DP) work and deliverables, based on specs and templates provided by the project team (Quant-only)
* Own, coordinate and update project timelines with internal research and external client and supplier stakeholders
* Take ownership for coordinating project team meetings,
* Responsibility for Pharmacovigilance and Adverse Event reporting
* Coordination of client and supplier Statements of Work (SOWs)
* Client and supplier invoice management (PO numbers, invoicing and liaison with Finance team)
* You will support team initiatives as a member of one of the department’s Pillars (Clients, Suppliers, People, Innovation, Operational Excellence)

**About You…**
**Your skills and experience:**

* More than 4 years of experience in market research project management (quantitative research)
* Experience managing healthcare market research projects
* Knowledge of the fieldwork agency landscape
* Strong project management skills (adhering to agreed timelines, troubleshooting and communication with internal and external stakeholders)
* Ability to multitask
* Collaboration and working as part of a team
* Ability to work under pressure and to tight deadlines
* Excellent numerical skills

**Ideal profile:**

* You are proactive, dedicated and enthusiastic, with a ‘can do’ attitude and approach
* You demonstrate a high level of accuracy and attention to detail, as well as strengths in organisation and prioritisation
* You are a collaborative team player who works well with colleagues
* You communicate ideas and issues in an effective, straightforward fashion
* You are highly motivated and want to seize opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career

**Work Environment**

* Full-time role based in Gurgaon (Inizio Ignite office)
* Hybrid working model

***Artificial Intelligence***
*Inizio may use AI technologies to support certain aspects of our recruitment process, but all hiring decisions are made by our human recruiting team. title: HRIS Business Analyst – AI & Digital Transformation (m/f/d)
description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.
  
  
You will join the People & Organization Digital Transformation team as a bridge between HR and technology — deeply understanding how HR works end to end and translating business challenges into scalable technology, automation and AI solutions.You will work across the hire-to-retire employee lifecycle, partnering with HR teams to challenge existing processes, identify opportunities for improvement and turn business needs into clear functional and technical requirements. You will then help take those solutions from idea through design, build and implementation — using our HR technology landscape, automation platforms and AI.
  
  
The role reports to the Head of Digital Transformation, who is part of the HR Senior Leadership Team, and works closely with the People Enablement Tech stream, FlixTech, IT Security, Data Privacy and HR teams across all regions.
  
  
This role is based in Gurugram or Bangalore (India), with a minimum office presence of 3 days per week. Given the global scope, regular collaboration with colleagues across European, APAC and US time zones is required.
  
  
**About The Role**

* Act as a trusted technology partner to HR teams across the end-to-end employee lifecycle — conduct process and technology gap analyses, challenge existing ways of working, identify improvement and automation opportunities, and translate business needs into functional and technical requirements implemented through HRIS, AI or automation solutions.
* Help build, deploy and maintain Claude-based applications and AI-powered internal tools, working with our cloud and technology teams to ensure appropriate authentication (RBAC/ABAC), governance and HRIS-aligned access controls including MCPs, APIs and custom connectors that securely connect AI applications with the wider HR Tech landscape.
* Design and build AI and automation workflows using technologies such as n8n, UiPath, Python-based automation and GenAI/LLMs, creating scalable solutions with appropriate orchestration, exception handling, monitoring and governance.
* Drive HR Tech initiatives end to end, from requirements engineering and process/solution design through build, SIT/UAT, implementation and go-live across areas such as HR service delivery model, HRIS security model improvements, payroll transformations, HRIS revamp or migration.
* Bring a strong product mindset to HR technology — turning business problems into scalable products and frameworks, including Jira-based HR service desks, Rovo Agents and AI-enabled employee/HR experiences, and continuously improving them based on user needs and business value.

**About You**

* 6+ years of experience as an HR Tech Analyst, HR Business/Process Analyst, AI & Automation Analyst or similar role, with deep, demonstrable HR & Workday domain knowledge across hire-to-retire processes. This is a must-have for the role. A degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, HR Technology, Business Technology or a related field is preferred.
* Strong ability to analyse HR processes, translate business problems into functional and technical requirements, and implement solutions across a complex Workday technology landscape.
* Hands-on experience building AI and automation solutions using technologies such as n8n, Python scripts, UiPath and GenAI/LLM tooling. n8n certification is a plus.
* Experience building and deploying internal applications in cloud environments, including working with APIs, MCPs, custom connectors and integrations to securely move data between enterprise systems.
* Hands-on understanding of Claude/GenAI application deployment and enterprise security, including RBAC/ABAC, authentication, access governance and protection of sensitive HR data.
* Strong working knowledge of Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence, Rovo Agents and BPMN, with the ability to build service desks, portals, workflows, process frameworks and technology-enabled HR services.
* Fluency in English. Mandatory Workday experience is essential; certifications in Workday, business/process analysis, automation or agile delivery (e.g. Six Sigma, SAFe, Scrum, PMP, Archimate) are a plus.
* Comfort working across European, APAC and US time zones, with a primary collaboration focus on a Berlin-based team.

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family.
* Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year.
* Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life.
* Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members.
* Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills.
* Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career
  
  
**Why Join Flix?**
At Flix, you’ll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
  
  
As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.
  
  
If you’re ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!
