title: VisionPlus Technical Business Analyst
description:
****Job Summary****
Synechron is seeking a
**Business Analyst – Technical (VisionPLUS)**
for its Gurgaon, work-from-office team. The role requires
**7+ years of Business Analyst experience**
, with hands-on expertise in VisionPLUS applications and a strong understanding of the cards and payments domain. The successful candidate will gather and translate business requirements into functional solutions, support VisionPLUS and related payment systems, and coordinate delivery across business, development, testing, UAT, and production support teams. This role contributes to business objectives by enabling accurate requirements, effective system enhancements, reliable integrations, and timely delivery of payment-related solutions.
  
  
****Required****
**Software Requirements (Required and Preferred)**

* VisionPLUS: Hands-on experience with CMS, FAS, TRAMS, VMX, or related VisionPLUS modules; experience with the version currently implemented within the assigned environment.
* SQL: Working knowledge of SQL for data analysis, validation, investigation, and requirements support.
* Business Analysis and Documentation Tools: Experience preparing BRDs, FRDs, user stories, process flows, functional specifications, acceptance criteria, and requirements traceability records.
* Defect and Test Management Tools: Experience coordinating UAT, recording and tracking defects, validating fixes, and supporting test execution.
* SDLC and Agile Delivery Tools: Experience working with tools and processes for requirements management, sprint planning, backlog tracking, delivery coordination, and status reporting.
* Data Analysis Tools: Ability to use approved query, reporting, spreadsheet, or data analysis tools to investigate business and system information.

****Preferred****

* API Integration Tools: Exposure to API documentation, request and response analysis, integration testing, and payment system interfaces.
* Digital Payment Platforms: Experience analyzing requirements related to digital payments or related payment channels.
* Process Modeling Tools: Experience creating process flows, functional diagrams, data flows, or system interaction diagrams.
* Banking and Financial Services Applications: Experience supporting banking, cards, payments, or financial services systems.
* Collaboration and Knowledge Management Tools: Experience using tools for stakeholder communication, documentation, meeting records, and delivery coordination.

****Overall Responsibilities****

* Gather, analyze, validate, and document business and functional requirements for VisionPLUS applications and related payment systems.
* Work with business stakeholders, development teams, testing teams, and other delivery participants to clarify requirements and resolve functional questions.
* Analyze VisionPLUS applications and relevant modules, including CMS, FAS, TRAMS, VMX, or related components, to support enhancements, integrations, and system upgrades.
* Prepare and maintain BRDs, FRDs, user stories, process flows, functional specifications, acceptance criteria, and requirements traceability documentation.
* Conduct gap analysis and assess the impact of proposed changes on business processes, systems, data, integrations, and downstream activities.
* Translate business needs into clear, testable, and implementation-ready functional requirements.
* Support solution discussions by explaining business processes, data requirements, system behavior, dependencies, and expected outcomes.
* Coordinate UAT activities, including test planning support, scenario preparation, stakeholder coordination, defect triage, retesting, and sign-off tracking.
* Support defect management by analyzing reported issues, clarifying expected behavior, coordinating with technical teams, and validating resolutions.
* Provide functional support for production incidents and assist with impact analysis, root-cause investigation, communication, and resolution validation.
* Ensure successful delivery of enhancements, integrations, and system upgrades within agreed scope, timelines, quality standards, and governance controls.
* Maintain accurate documentation and consider efficient use of systems, data, and processing resources when defining or improving solutions.

****Technical Skills (By Category)****
**Programming Languages**
****Essential****

* Working knowledge of SQL for data analysis, data validation, reconciliation, and investigation.
* Ability to understand functional logic, data rules, system behavior, and processing flows in VisionPLUS-related applications.

**Frameworks and Libraries**
****Essential****

* VisionPLUS application and module knowledge, including CMS, FAS, TRAMS, VMX, or related modules.
* Understanding of business analysis frameworks and practices for requirements gathering, gap analysis, functional design, testing, and delivery.
* Ability to define functional rules, process flows, data requirements, integration expectations, and acceptance criteria.

****Experience Requirements****

* Minimum 7 years of experience as a Business Analyst or in a comparable technical business analysis role.
* Hands-on experience with VisionPLUS, including CMS, FAS, TRAMS, VMX, or related modules.
* Strong experience in the credit card and payments domain, including relevant business processes, system functionality, and payment-related data.
* Demonstrated experience gathering requirements, conducting gap analysis, preparing functional documentation, and managing stakeholder expectations.
* Experience working with development and testing teams to clarify requirements, support solution delivery, coordinate UAT, and manage defects.
* Experience supporting VisionPLUS applications and related payment systems through enhancements, integrations, system upgrades, and production support.
* Working knowledge of SQL, data analysis, SDLC, and Agile methodologies.
* Experience working with banking or financial services clients is preferred.
* Exposure to API integrations and digital payment platforms is preferred.
* Candidates may qualify through equivalent experience in technical business analysis, cards and payments systems, VisionPLUS support, or related financial services technology roles where they can demonstrate comparable outcomes.

**Day-to-Day Activities**

* Gather and analyze requirements, conduct gap assessments, review VisionPLUS functionality, and prepare BRDs, FRDs, user stories, process flows, and functional specifications.
* Participate in meetings with business stakeholders, development teams, testing teams, and delivery participants to clarify requirements, review solutions, and manage dependencies.
* Coordinate UAT activities, support defect triage and retesting, validate delivered changes, and contribute to enhancement, integration, upgrade, and production support deliverables.
* Make functional recommendations within agreed scope and standards, document decisions and risks, and escalate issues that may affect quality, timelines, system behavior, or business outcomes.

****Qualifications****

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Analysis, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in business analysis, including hands-on VisionPLUS experience and work in the cards and payments domain.
* Relevant training in VisionPLUS, business analysis, requirements engineering, SQL, Agile delivery, testing, or payment systems is preferred.
* Certifications in business analysis, Agile delivery, payments, or related technology areas are preferred but not required unless mandated for a specific assignment.
* Commitment to continuous professional development through relevant training, product updates, industry learning, and evolving cards, payments, and technology practices.

* You’ll be partnering with the Digital business, using data to drive effortless digital customer experiences

title: Grid Research Associate
description:
**Department:**
Research

**Location:**
Gurugram, India

**Description**
**About the role:**
Aurora is seeking an Associate to join our India Grid Research team in Gurugram. This is a quantitative and client-facing role at the intersection of power systems, electricity markets and investment analysis.
  
  
You will play a central role in the continued rollout and development of Aurora’s India Grid product, helping developers, investors and lenders understand how transmission build-out, grid congestion, connectivity and curtailment affect renewable projects and investment decisions.
  
  
You will take ownership of analytical workstreams and the delivery of Grid coverage across individual Indian states and regions. This will include analysing transmission infrastructure and connection queues, developing and quality-assuring forward-looking grid and curtailment analysis, and translating complex technical outputs into clear commercial insights.
  
  
We are looking for someone who combines four core strengths:

* **Engineering and grid understanding**
  – a strong understanding of power systems, transmission networks and the physical drivers of congestion and curtailment.
* **Quantitative modelling**
  – the ability to work confidently with complex datasets and modelling frameworks to develop robust forward-looking analysis.
* **Market understanding**
  – an understanding of how generation, demand, storage, transmission and electricity-market dynamics interact, and what these changes mean commercially.
* **Communication**
  – the ability to turn sophisticated technical analysis into clear, compelling insights for both technical and non-technical audiences.

You will work closely with Aurora’s India Research, Grid modelling and Software teams and have the opportunity to develop deep expertise in India’s rapidly evolving power system.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the rollout and ongoing development of Aurora’s Grid analysis across new and/or existing Indian regions, taking responsibility for analytical delivery, quality assurance and ongoing updates.
* Analyse India’s transmission system, including network build-out, connectivity queues, transmission constraints, project commissioning timelines and grid headroom.
* Develop and quality-assure quantitative analysis of congestion and renewable curtailment, assessing how these evolve as generation, storage, demand and transmission capacity change.
* Work closely with Aurora’s Modelling team to translate engineering, power-system and electricity-market assumptions into robust forward-looking analysis.
* Combine grid modelling with electricity-market fundamentals to understand the commercial implications of transmission constraints and curtailment for renewable and storage assets.
* Analyse large and complex datasets using tools such as Python, SQL and Excel, improving analytical processes and identifying opportunities for automation.
* Translate complex modelling results into clear, commercially relevant conclusions, explaining what is happening, why it is happening and what it means for developers, investors and lenders.
* Communicate Aurora’s analysis confidently through client meetings, subscriber calls, webinars, reports and presentations, adapting technical detail to different audiences.
* Work collaboratively across Research, Modelling and Software teams, clearly communicating assumptions, analytical issues and development priorities.
* Support and review the work of Analysts and interns contributing to infrastructure tracking, data collection and validation.

**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
**Required attributes:**

* 3-5 years relevant professional experience in power systems, electricity markets, transmission, renewable energy, energy modelling or energy consulting.
* A strong university degree, ideally in electrical engineering, power systems, energy systems, economics, mathematics, physics or another quantitative discipline.
* Strong understanding of power systems and grid fundamentals, including the interaction between generation, demand, transmission and system constraints.
* Strong quantitative and modelling capability, with experience working with complex datasets, models and analytical outputs. Experience using Python, SQL, advanced Excel or power-system modelling software.
* Good understanding of electricity-market fundamentals, with the ability to connect physical grid developments with their implications for renewable and storage projects.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical analysis into clear, concise and commercially relevant insights.
* Confidence communicating with both technical and non-technical audiences, including clients and senior stakeholders.
* Ability to structure a clear analytical argument, identify the key drivers behind modelling results and communicate the “so what”, rather than simply reporting outputs.
* Demonstrated ability to independently own complex analytical workstreams and deliver high-quality outputs to deadlines.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to analytical quality and robust quality assurance.
* Self-starting, intellectually curious and comfortable working collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams.

**Desirable attributes:**

* Familiarity with the Indian power sector, including renewable development, transmission infrastructure and electricity-market arrangements.
* Experience working for a transmission or network organisation, renewable developer, power-market consultancy, utility, system operator, IPP or energy analytics firm.
* Understanding of the commercial considerations facing renewable developers, IPPs, lenders and infrastructure investors.
* Experience working with commercial power system software (PSS/E, Powerworld, etc) and/or doing grid connection studies
* Experience analyzing renewable project connectivity and transmission expansion.
* Experience communicating complex quantitative analysis through client presentations, reports, workshops, webinars or other external-facing formats.
* Master’s degree or PhD in electrical engineering, power systems, energy systems or a related quantitative field.

**What we offer**
Some of the benefits we include are:

* Accidental, term life and medical insurance
* Hybrid Work model
* Employee’s Provident Fund Scheme
* Maternity leave
* A fun, informal, collaborative and international work culture
* Access to the Aurora Academy, our training programme offering a range of opportunities to develop your skills within the responsibilities of your role and within the wider context of the industry.
* Access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP), offering a complete support network that offers expert advice and compassionate guidance 24/7/365, covering a wide range of personal and professional aspects

The Company is committed to the principle that no employee or job applicant shall receive unfavorable treatment on grounds of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity.
  
  
To apply, please submit your Résumé / CV, a personal summary, your salary expectations and please inform us of your notice period.
  
  
Unfortunately, we are unable to accept applications via email, telephone, or social media platforms. To be considered for this position, please submit your application using the link provided. Applications submitted through any other channel will not be reviewed.

title: Anaplan Model Builder
description:
**Role purpose:-**

The Anaplan Model Builder will design, build, test, deploy and support scalable Anaplan solutions across Finance and the wider business. Reporting to the Finance Systems Manager (Anaplan), the role will translate business requirements into robust models, workflows, dashboards and data structures, while supporting effective platform operation and continuous improvement.

The role will support Anaplan use cases spanning corporate planning, budgeting and forecasting, client and product profitability, cash flow and liquidity forecasting, funding forecasts, management reporting and scenario analysis.

**Key responsibilities:-**

* **Model design and build:**
  Develop modules, lists, hierarchies, calculations, dashboards and user experiences using scalable, maintainable design principles.
* **Requirements and solution design:**
  Work with Finance and business stakeholders to translate planning and reporting needs into functional requirements, model designs, business rules and acceptance criteria.
* **Data and integration:**
  Build and maintain imports, exports, actions and processes; define source-data requirements; validate and reconcile data; investigate load failures with Technology and data teams.
* **Testing and quality:**
  Complete unit testing and support system, integration, regression and user acceptance testing. Reconcile outputs, resolve defects and retain appropriate evidence.
* **Release and change management:**
  Prepare model changes, impact assessments, release documentation and deployment instructions within the agreed environment and governance framework.
* **Platform support:**
  Provide hands-on support for live models, recurring planning cycles, incidents, data issues and performance problems. Maintain and optimise models and identify technical debt.
* **Controls and governance:**
  Maintain roles, selective access, validation controls, documentation, data dictionaries and calculation definitions. Follow access, segregation-of-duties and audit requirements.
* **Adoption and knowledge transfer:**
  Create intuitive user experiences, guides and training materials; support demonstrations and adoption; capture knowledge from delivery partners and build internal capability.

**Key working relationships:-**

Finance Systems Manager (Anaplan); Finance process owners and users; Finance Systems and Technology teams; data and integration teams; external implementation and managed-service partners.

**Key deliverables:-**

* Robust and scalable Anaplan models aligned with approved requirements and architecture.
* Accurate calculations, planning logic, dashboards, workflows and management outputs.
* Reliable data integrations, imports, exports, validations and reconciliations.
* Complete functional, technical, testing, release and operational documentation.
* Stable support for live models and key planning cycles, with timely defect resolution.
* Effective knowledge transfer and reduced reliance on external delivery resources.

**Skills and experience:-**

**Essential**

* Practical experience designing and building Anaplan models in a business environment.
* Strong knowledge of lists, modules, hierarchies, line items, actions, processes and dashboards.
* Experience translating Finance or business requirements into model designs.
* Understanding of multidimensional modelling, data structures and model performance.
* Experience with data imports, exports, transformation, validation and reconciliation.
* Ability to diagnose calculation, data, model and performance issues.
* Experience supporting testing, deployment and live operational models.
* Understanding of planning, budgeting, forecasting or management reporting.
* Strong analytical, documentation, communication and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred**

* Anaplan Model Builder certification or equivalent demonstrable experience.
* Experience with FP&A, profitability, unit economics, cash flow or liquidity models.
* Experience integrating Anaplan with ERP, data warehouse or reporting platforms.
* Knowledge of Application Lifecycle Management and controlled deployment.
* Experience in Financial Services or another controlled or regulated environment.
* Understanding of Agile delivery, data governance, access controls and audit requirements.
* Experience working with external implementation or managed-service partners.

**Personal attributes**

* Hands-on, structured and delivery-focused, with strong attention to detail.
* Able to simplify complex calculations and challenge unnecessary complexity.
* Collaborative across Finance and Technology, with clear stakeholder communication.
* Proactive in identifying risks, control gaps and improvement opportunities.
* Pragmatic, dependable and committed to sustainable internal capability.

**Success measures**

* Delivery of assigned developments to agreed scope, quality and priorities.
* Accuracy, reliability, usability and performance of models and outputs.
* Adherence to design, documentation, security and governance standards.
* Successful business testing, adoption and support through planning cycles.
* Reduction in manual activity, defects and dependency on external resources.

**Role boundary**

Finance Systems Manager (Anaplan) owns platform strategy, roadmap, delivery governance, stakeholder alignment, supplier management and overall platform outcomes.
**The Anaplan Model Builder**
owns the detailed design, build, testing, documentation, deployment support and maintenance of assigned solutions. Business process owners approve requirements, assumptions, processes and outputs.

title: Revenue Manager
description:
**Role Overview**

We are seeking a
**Revenue Manager with strong OTA management expertise**
to drive revenue growth, optimize occupancy, and improve property performance through dynamic pricing and data-driven strategies.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. OTA Management**

* Manage listings, pricing, inventory, availability, and promotions across Booking.com, Agoda, MakeMyTrip, Goibibo, and other OTA platforms.
* Monitor bookings, conversions, cancellations, and guest reviews to improve visibility and revenue.
* Coordinate with OTA account managers to resolve issues, improve rankings, and optimize commercial terms.

**2. Revenue & Pricing Strategy**

* Implement dynamic pricing based on demand, seasonality, occupancy, and competitor rates.
* Track ADR, RevPAR, occupancy, and overall revenue performance.
* Develop demand forecasts and pricing strategies to maximize revenue and profitability.

**3. Occupancy & Business Growth**

* Drive occupancy and room-night growth across the Gurugram portfolio.
* Analyze booking trends and identify opportunities to increase direct bookings and reduce OTA commission costs.
* Collaborate with Sales, Operations, and Marketing teams to optimize revenue.

**4. Market & Competitor Analysis**

* Monitor competitor pricing, promotions, and market trends.
* Identify demand drivers, local events, and seasonal opportunities to recommend pricing adjustments.

**5. Reporting & Channel Management**

* Prepare regular reports on revenue, occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, and OTA performance.
* Manage room inventory across channels to prevent overbookings and pricing discrepancies.
* Work with PMS, channel managers, and revenue management tools to maintain accurate rates and availability.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Hospitality, Hotel Management, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
* **3+ years of experience in Revenue Management and OTA Management**
  , preferably in hospitality, hotels, serviced apartments, or co-living.
* Hands-on experience with Booking.com, MakeMyTrip, Goibibo, Agoda, or similar platforms.
* Strong understanding of dynamic pricing, forecasting, inventory management, and revenue optimization.
* Proficiency in MS Excel; experience with PMS and channel management systems is preferred.
* Strong analytical, negotiation, and communication skills.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Occupancy and room-night growth.
* ADR, RevPAR, and revenue achievement.
* OTA performance and conversion rates.
* Improved net revenue and reduced commission costs.
* Pricing accuracy, inventory management, and forecasting accuracy.

**Ideal Candidate**

A commercially driven professional with hands-on OTA expertise, strong analytical skills, and the ability to optimize pricing, occupancy, and revenue across multiple properties.

* Scale from day one: products used by millions of customers across India.

title: Associate Manager, Data Delivery & Dashboard
description:
**Job Description**
The Data Delivery & Dashboards team plays a critical role in ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and usability of complex data outputs for our healthcare market research projects. The team is responsible for conducting comprehensive quality checks on large datasets, transforming and standardising data files to meet project and client requirements, and managing delivery through automated and off-the-shelf dashboard solutions. By combining technical precision with a client-focused approach, the team enables timely, insightful, and accessible data visualisation that supports strategic decision-making across our global research initiatives.
  
  
Additionally, they will collaborate closely with the analytics and data management teams, facilitating the smooth flow of data for efficient analysis, reporting, and insights generation.
  
  
**Your primary role:**
The Data Delivery & Dashboards Team Lead role will report into the Sr Manager. The Data Delivery & Dashboards Team lead will be a key member of the India-based Data Management & Delivery Hub, supporting quantitative healthcare market research projects across global markets for STEM. As a Dashboard Developer Team lead, you build and maintain high impact dashboards and data visualizations that transform raw market research data into actionable insights. You’ll collaborate with researchers, analysts, and engineers to ensure data flows seamlessly from collections to visual storytelling. You will also support the team in delivering insightful, user-friendly dashboards through automated tools and off-the-shelf solutions. This is a fantastic opportunity to develop your skills in data management, quality assurance, and data visualisation, while working alongside an experienced team in a dynamic, global environment. Skill Set required
  
  
**STEM Dashboard Discovery Phase**
One of primary responsibilities would be to streamline the overall data collection process and create dashboards
  
  
**Brand Equity tracking support with our in-house platform:**

* Maintain the pipeline for the project data process flow (this includes receival of data into in-hosue Tool, through the data processing stage into the storage mart, through the python utilities into required outputs)
* Maintain and update Power BI Dashboard when required due to changes from the research team
* Manage and rectify when failures occur in the dashboard, liaising with both the data providers, research team and developers on the Pipeline
* Manage the storage mart and data warehouse
* Support team with edits in-house platform

**Data Quality Checks:**
Assist in performing detailed quality control checks on large and complex datasets to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
  
  
**Data Transformation & Standardisation:**
Support the transformation and standardisation of data files to align with internal data structures, project needs, and client-specific formats.
  
  
**Dashboard Support & Maintenance:**
Lead in the creation, population, and maintenance of dashboards using off-the-shelf tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms), ensuring outputs are clear, accurate, and aligned with research objectives.
  
  
**Data Delivery Management:**
Manage and organise the final delivery of data files and dashboards to internal teams and clients, ensuring timely and error-free execution.
  
  
**Collaboration Across Teams:**
Work closely with internal stakeholders including Development team, Data Processing, Scripting, Project Management and Research teams to ensure smooth handovers and integration of deliverables.
  
  
**Documentation & Reporting:**
Maintain clear documentation of processes, data transformation steps, and QC logs to support transparency, reproducibility, and audit-readiness.
  
  
**Continuous Learning & Development:**
Engage in training opportunities to build knowledge in healthcare data, market research workflows, dashboarding tools, and data handling best practices.
  
  
**About You…**
**Your skills and experience:**
**Technical Expertise**

* At least 6+ years expertise in Power BI, Power query , DAX, data modeling, Quality assurance, SQL
* Experience in Building interactive, user-friendly dashboards
* Experience with data warehouses (Snowflake, Azure Synapse, Redshift, etc.)
* Understanding and building of ETL/ELT pipelines.
* Expert level Knowledge of Python
* Proficient in SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL).
* Cloud platform expertise (AWS, Azure, GCP), and building ETL/ELT pipelines is a plus
* Experience in version control system.

**Ideal profile:**

* You are proactive, dedicated and enthusiastic, with a ‘can do’ attitude and approach
* You demonstrate a high level of accuracy and attention to detail, as well as strengths in organisation and prioritisation
* You are a collaborative team player who works well with colleagues
* You communicate ideas and issues in an effective, straightforward fashion
* Logical thinking and ability to troubleshoot errors or discrepancies in tabulated data.
* Ability to interpret tabulation specifications and apply them accurately.
* Problem-solving skills (particularly relating to situations requiring analytical judgement and establishing best practice solutions)
* You are highly motivated and want to seize opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career

**Life at Inizio Ignite**
We love what we do and continuously strive for innovation and creativity. We believe everyone should continuously be learning and provide:
  
  

* A comprehensive training and development programme for all staff, from entry level apprentice to senior management
* Opportunities for international travel and collaboration
* A relaxed and friendly working environment

**About Inizio Advisory:**
Research Partnership is part of Inizio Advisory, a trusted advisor for pharmaceutical and life science companies that turns science into strategy, supporting execution at every stage of the product and patient journey from early commercialization to launch and beyond. Offering market research and insights; strategy; people and transformation consulting; and commercial benchmarking delivered through sector specific connected solutions and intelligence, Inizio Advisory helps create long-term value for clients and their patients.
  
  
*Don't meet every job requirement? That's okay! Our company is dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.*

title: Research Associate / Sr Research Associate (Heat Forecast)
description:
Title: Research Associate / Senior Research Associate (Heat Forecast)
  
  
Location: Delhi, India preferred. Applicants must hold Indian citizenship and valid authorization to work in India. Unfortunately, we are unable to accept applications from OCI (Overseas Citizen of India) cardholders for this role.
  
  
Salary: Salary will be competitive and commensurate with the candidate's skills, experience, and the local labor market in India.
  
  
Position: Full-time
  
  
Application deadline: Nov 10, 2026, at 5 pm IST (applications may be reviewed as they are submitted)
  
  
**About The Role**
Precision Development (PxD) is looking for a Research Associate / Senior Research Associate to join our weather initiative in India. The successful candidate will lead formative research on how AI-based heat forecasts can help agriculture and livestock farmers prepare for and respond to heat. Working closely with PxD and affiliated researchers, they will help define a concrete heat-advisory use case and pilot it with farmers and government partners — testing new ideas and measuring their impact.
  
  
The role calls for someone who is curious about how farmers make decisions under climate risk, comfortable moving between fieldwork and data, and who understands how digital technology is adopted and scaled within government.
  
  
If you're passionate about turning advances in AI weather forecasting into practical, evidence-based services for farmers, and committed to driving positive change in the agricultural sector, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
We're hiring for this role at either the Research Associate or Senior Research Associate level. The specific level will be determined based on the candidate's years of experience, demonstrated seniority, and scope of past responsibilities.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
These will evolve as the role develops; key initial areas are outlined below.
  
  
Formative Research
  
  

* Design and conduct formative research (qualitative interviews, focus group discussions, rapid surveys) with crop and livestock farmers to understand how extreme heat affects their livelihoods, decisions, and coping strategies
* Map farmers' current sources of weather information, the timing and lead time they need, and the actions they could take in response to a heat forecast.
* Engage with government agencies, meteorological departments, extension systems, and livestock/veterinary services to understand existing heat early-warning systems and gaps
* Review literature and existing evidence on heat-stress impacts and heat early-warning interventions in agriculture and livestock
* Synthesize findings into clear research briefs and presentations for internal teams and partners.

Use Case Definition & Design
  
  

* Translate formative research insights into a well-defined use case for AI-based heat forecasts, specifying target users, decisions supported, forecast variables, lead times, and thresholds
* Work with data science and forecasting partners to assess the skill and suitability of AI-based heat forecast products for the target geographies
* Co-design heat advisory content and delivery channels with farmers, agronomists, and livestock experts

Data & Analysis
  
  

* Design and program survey instruments (SurveyCTO/ODK)
* Oversee data collection quality, including field visits, back-checks, and high-frequency checks
* Analyze pilot data on farmer engagement, comprehension, trust, behavior change, and early outcomes
* Clean, merge, and analyze weather, forecast, survey, and administrative data (Stata, R, or Python)
* Assess the relationship between heat exposure and agricultural and livestock outcomes using existing data where available
* Monitor forecast performance against observed weather data and flag issues to technical partners
* Contribute to dashboards and data pipelines supporting PxD's weather initiative, as needed

What You'll Bring
  
  

* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in economics, agricultural economics, public policy, development studies, statistics, environmental/climate science, or a closely related field
* Demonstrated experience conducting field research in LMIC settings, including qualitative methods (interviews, FGDs) and quantitative surveys
* Strong understanding of economics and econometrics, and familiarity with randomized evaluations
* Excellent knowledge of Stata, R, Python, or similar software for data analysis
* Demonstrated experience using SurveyCTO/ODK or a similar program for survey design
* Understanding of research ethics for human subjects in the social sciences
* Interest in climate adaptation, weather and climate services, or digital agriculture; familiarity with weather/forecast data or heat-stress impacts on crops or livestock is a strong plus
* Ability to translate research insights into practical product or service design, working with technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Excellent organizational skills, detail-oriented, and ability to work both independently and collaboratively
* Fluency in English with strong oral and written communication skills; knowledge of Hindi or another Indian language is a plus
* Ability to work under time pressure and solve problems creatively
* Willingness to travel frequently to project sites and conduct fieldwork, including during summer months

How to Apply
  
  
To apply, please visit the PxD website and use the online application form to submit a CV, cover letter, and brief responses to the screening questions. Applications may be reviewed on a rolling basis. The final deadline to apply is 10 November 2026, 5 pm IST.
  
  
In line with our values, we evaluate candidates on merit alone, without regard to gender, gender identity, ethnicity, religion, disability, caste, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. We offer flexible working arrangements to support your wellbeing. Personal data provided is used for recruitment purposes only.
  
  
**About Precision Development (PxD)**
PxD is a rapidly scaling global nonprofit working with governments across Africa and Asia to close the last-mile gap in smallholder farming. We deliver evidence-based information and tools — from timely farming and weather guidance to climate-resilient inputs — that millions of farmers use to improve their lives. In the last 12 months alone, we reached over 60 million farmers at a cost of just $0.47 per farmer per year, with our flagship program in India delivering a benefit-cost ratio of 12:1–19:1.
  
  
Operating in Ethiopia, India, Indonesia, Kenya, Nigeria, and beyond, the majority of our team is based in our program countries, working directly alongside government partners and farming communities toward our goal of improving the lives of 100 million farmers by 2030.

title: Global Digital Marketing Analytics Senior Analyst
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
The Global Digital Marketing Analytics Senior Analyst is a hands-on analytical practitioner who serves as the dedicated analytics resource across BCG's digital marketing channel teams — including email, paid media, web, content, and beyond. This person is embedded in the day-to-day rhythm of channel execution and campaign delivery, providing the analytical support, performance interpretation, and data-driven guidance that helps channel teams make smarter decisions about how they plan, optimize, and evolve their activations.
  
  
This is not a reporting role. The Senior Specialist goes beyond pulling numbers to actively interpreting what channel data means, identifying what is and is not working across the channel mix, and translating those findings into clear, actionable recommendations that channel strategists and campaign managers can act on in real time. This person is a trusted analytical partner to multiple channel teams simultaneously — organized enough to manage a broad portfolio of analytical support needs, and sharp enough to add genuine strategic value to each one.
  
  
**Channel Performance Analysis & Insight**

* Serve as the primary analytics partner across digital marketing channel teams — including email, paid media, web, social, and content — providing hands-on analytical support that helps each team understand and act on their performance data
* Analyze channel performance data on an ongoing basis, going beyond surface metrics to identify trends, anomalies, and patterns that reveal what is driving or limiting channel effectiveness across campaigns and activations
* Translate channel data findings into clear, actionable insight narratives that channel teams can use to make immediate optimization decisions — explaining not just what the numbers show but what they mean and what should change as a result
* Develop a working understanding of how each channel's data behaves — its quirks, its limitations, its attribution challenges, and its most meaningful performance signals — so that analytical conclusions are always grounded in an accurate picture of what the data can and cannot tell you
* Proactively surface channel performance insights to channel leads and campaign managers without waiting to be asked, identifying inflection points, underperformance signals, and optimization opportunities as they emerge

**Campaign & Activation Analytics Support**

* Support the analytics needs of active marketing campaigns across the channel mix — providing pre-campaign audience and benchmarking analysis, in-flight performance monitoring, and post-campaign measurement and insight synthesis
* Build and maintain campaign performance trackers and channel scorecards that give channel and campaign teams clear, current visibility into how activations are performing against goals across all relevant metrics
* Conduct cross-channel campaign analyses that connect the dots between how audiences are engaging across email, paid, web, and other digital touchpoints — identifying patterns in cross-channel behavior that inform how campaigns should be sequenced, optimized, or adjusted mid-flight
* Contribute to post-campaign retrospectives by preparing well-structured performance summaries and insight outputs that capture what worked, what did not, and what the data recommends for future activations

**Channel Strategy Insight & Optimization**

* Partner with channel leads and CX strategists to bring analytical perspective into channel strategy conversations to inform how channels are planned, invested in, and evolved over time
* Conduct deeper analytical investigations when channel performance raises strategic questions
* Identify recurring performance patterns across channels and campaigns that point to systemic optimization opportunities — bringing these findings forward with clear recommendations rather than simply observing them
* Support channel investment and prioritization conversations with data — preparing analytical inputs that help marketing leadership understand where channel spend and effort are generating the strongest return

**Data Pulling, Validation & Reporting**

* Extract, validate, and prepare channel performance data from across BCG's digital marketing technology stack — including Adobe Analytics, Marketo, Sprinklr, SEMRush, Demandbase, ad network platforms, CRM, and other relevant sources — ensuring accuracy and consistency before any analysis or output is produced
* Write SQL queries against the marketing master dataset in Snowflake to access audience and engagement data that supplements platform-level reporting, expanding the analytical picture available for channel insight work
* Build and maintain recurring channel reporting outputs — dashboards, scorecards, and performance summaries — that keep channel teams consistently informed without requiring manual analytical effort for every update
* Apply rigorous data validation habits to all analytical work — checking figures, interrogating unexpected results, and never presenting numbers to stakeholders without confidence in their accuracy

**Enablement & Analytical Standards**

* Develop and maintain channel-specific metric glossaries, reporting templates, and analytical reference guides that help channel teams interpret their own data more independently and consistently
* Contribute to the development of shared analytical standards across the marketing analytics function — ensuring that metrics, definitions, and performance benchmarks are applied consistently across channels and campaigns
* Support the onboarding of channel team members onto analytics tools and reporting outputs, helping new colleagues understand how to read and use the data available to them

What You'll Bring
  
  

* 3–5 years of experience in a digital marketing analytics, channel analytics, or marketing data role, with hands-on experience analyzing performance data across at least two or more digital marketing channels — email, paid media, web, social, or equivalent
* Solid working knowledge of the digital marketing channel landscape — how each channel works, what its key performance metrics are, how attribution and measurement differ across channels, and how audience behavior connects across touchpoints
* Hands-on experience working with marketing analytics platforms including at least several of the following: Adobe Analytics, Marketo, Sprinklr, SEMRush, Demandbase, Google Analytics, paid media ad network reporting platforms, or equivalent
* Solid SQL skills at a querying and analysis level, with the ability to independently access and interrogate marketing datasets in Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse environment
* Proficiency in Tableau or a comparable data visualization platform for building and maintaining channel performance dashboards and analytical outputs
* Strong data validation instincts and attention to detail — you check your own work, interrogate unexpected results, and take accuracy seriously before anything goes to a stakeholder
* Clear, confident communication skills with the ability to present channel performance findings and recommendations to channel leads, campaign managers, and senior marketing stakeholders in a way that is accessible, structured, and actionable
* Experience working in a fast-moving, campaign-driven marketing environment where analytical support needs shift quickly and responsiveness matters
* Familiarity with A/B testing methodology and the ability to interpret test results accurately and communicate findings clearly
* Experience working in an Agile or sprint-based environment preferred
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Data Analytics, Statistics, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Who You'll Work With
  
  
This role sits within BCG's Global Marketing analytics function and operates as a shared analytical resource across the digital marketing channel teams. Day to day, your closest working relationships are with the channel leads, managers, and leads across email, paid media, web, events, and content — the people whose campaign and activation shapes your analytical work is designed to sharpen and inform. You will be present in their planning conversations, their optimization reviews, and their campaign retrospectives, bringing data to the table at the moments when it matters most.
  
  
Within the analytics function, you will work closely with the Senior Manager and Director of Marketing Analytics, contributing channel-level analytical output that feeds into the broader audience and performance insight picture the function produces for senior marketing leadership. You will also collaborate with dashboard and data engineering colleagues when channel reporting needs require new data pipelines or expanded Snowflake access, and with CRM data operations colleagues when audience and contact data underpins channel targeting or segmentation analysis.
  
  
This is a role for someone who genuinely enjoys the variety and pace of working across multiple channels simultaneously — who finds satisfaction in being the person a channel team turns to when the data raises a question they cannot answer on their own, and who takes pride in giving them an answer that actually changes what they do next.
  
  
Additional info
  
  
**YOU'RE GOOD AT**

* Getting into the data quickly and knowing what you are looking for — you have strong analytical instincts developed across enough channel experience that you notice when something looks off, when a trend is significant, and when a number needs to be investigated before it gets presented
* Working across multiple channels and analytical workstreams simultaneously without losing quality or momentum — you are organized, prioritize well, and deliver reliably across a busy and varied portfolio of analytical support needs
* Translating channel performance data into plain language that channel managers and campaign teams can act on — you don't hide behind technical terminology or data caveats, you give people the insight they need to make a decision
* Being a genuine partner to channel teams rather than a report factory — you show up to conversations with a perspective, ask clarifying questions that sharpen the analytical brief, and add value beyond the specific output that was requested
* Moving fluidly across the digital channel landscape — you are comfortable switching from an email performance analysis to a paid media attribution question to a web engagement funnel in the same day, and you bring enough channel-specific knowledge to each that your analysis is grounded and credible
* Knowing the difference between a data issue and a performance issue — you have the technical discipline to validate your data before drawing conclusions, and the intellectual honesty to say when the data is not clean enough to support the insight being requested

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.
  
  
For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
  
  
We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.
  
  
#MarTech
  
  
Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

This role offers the opportunity to work directly with business stakeholders to deliver practical technology solutions that improve productivity, reporting, workflow automation and operational effectiveness.

* Build APIs, integrations and application services that connect internal systems, data platforms and reporting tools
* Integrate applications with Snowflake, Power BI and cloud-based platforms
* Support AI-enabled applications, assistants and automation tools that improve business processes
* Build solutions that improve productivity, enhance user experience and support operational scalability
* Support and maintain existing Power Apps and Power Automate solutions, troubleshooting issues and assisting with enhancements to existing workflows
* Partner with stakeholders and business users to understand requirements, identify improvement opportunities and translate needs into scalable technical solutions
* Ensure Power Platform solutions remain reliable, documented and aligned with broader technology standards
* Participate in testing, deployment, support and continuous improvement activities
* Partner with data engineering and platform engineering teams to support integrated technology solutions
* Maintain technical documentation and contribute to application development standards
* Share and manage best practices as well as lead internal trainings where required
* Support talent acquisition and firm development efforts
* Contribute to creating a high-performing and inclusive culture

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or Mathematics from a top undergraduate program required

title: Assitant Manager Fraud Analytics
description:
Step into the role of Assistant Manager Fraud Analytics at Barclays, where you'll play a pivotal role in shaping the future. In this role, you will be responsible for implementing data quality process and procedures, ensuring that data is reliable and trustworthy, then extract actionable insights from it to help the organisation improve its operation, and optimise resources.
  
  
You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role such as:
  
  
**You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role such as:**

* Expertise in SQL, SAS, Data Analytics and Reporting.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively communicate with stakeholders, build relationships, and present findings.
* Strong analytical skills to interpret complex data quickly and make informed decisions in a fast-paced environment.
* Proficiency in designing and building data pipelines to automate data movement and processing.
* Investigation and analysis of data issues related to quality, lineage, controls, and authoritative source identification

**Desirable Skill Set**

* Effective communication and presentation skills.
* Experience in Data Privacy, Governance, Reporting and Risk Management preferably in a financial services organisation.
* Proficient in MS Office – PPT, Excel, Word & Visio. Preferred – Dashboard visualisation, Tableau/ Power BI.
* Comprehensive understanding of Risk, Governance and Control Frameworks and Processes.
* Understanding of Data Privacy Policies and Standards.
* Ability to analyse, interpret and work robustly with others to identify issues and develop proposed solutions.

You may be assessed on key essential skills relevant for success in role, such as learning and development, leadership and people management, risk and controls, change and transformation, stakeholder management, business acumen, strategic thinking, and data-driven decision making, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
**This role is based out of Gurugram**
**Purpose of the role**
To use innovative data analytics and machine learning techniques to extract valuable insights from the bank's data reserves, leveraging these insights to inform strategic decision-making, improve operational efficiency, and drive innovation across the organisation.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Identification, collection, extraction of data from various sources, including internal and external sources.
* Performing data cleaning, wrangling, and transformation to ensure its quality and suitability for analysis.
* Development and maintenance of efficient data pipelines for automated data acquisition and processing.
* Design and conduct of statistical and machine learning models to analyse patterns, trends, and relationships in the data.
* Development and implementation of predictive models to forecast future outcomes and identify potential risks and opportunities.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to seek out opportunities to add value from data through Data Science.

**Analyst Expectations**

* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Associate, Reporting and Analytics
description:
**COMPANY PROFILE**

Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.

Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefining industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes.

  

The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally. Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.

  

**WHAT MAKES US GREAT PLACE TO WORK**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work. We are currently the #1 ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor's Best Places to Work list and have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list since its founding in 2009.

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don't happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

**Job Summary**

The 
**Reporting & Analytics Associate is a techno functional role**
based in Bain’s GBS Gurugram office and is part of a team which provides business intelligence services (including insights and analytics) on key metrics to global functions (not external clients) at Bain. 
  
 The major responsibilities of the role include supporting recurring and ad-hoc analytics on key metrics as required by Bain's leadership, using automated data processing and visualization tools by:
  
 Building new workflows using Alteryx/Python/SQL/Tableau Prep (or other EDA tools) • Building new dashboards using Tableau/Power BI/Advanced Excel (or other visualization tools) 
  
 Refreshing and maintaining dashboards on Tableau/ Power BI, along with optimization of Alteryx /Tableau Prep workflow 
  
 Developing expertise on key Bain data sources to deliver effective output 
  
 Using basic Generative AI to brainstorm and optimize operational tasks

  

**Principal Accountabilities and % of time**

**Operational Execution**

* Applies and builds technical expertise of Data Visualization and Data Analysis (EDA) tools like Alteryx, Python, SQL ,Tableau, Power BI etc.
* Help with the creation of basic reporting solutions using tools like Alteryx and Tableau, focusing on learning, and supporting the team in routine tasks.
* Assist in automating simple, repetitive tasks in reporting processes using Python and SQL. Focus on gaining experience and understanding basic automation techniques
* Take responsibility for completing small, well-defined tasks within projects. Ensure tasks are completed as instructed by more senior team members.

**Problem solving**

* Assist in collecting and preparing data for analysis and reporting, ensuring data is clean and ready for use in projects.
* Begin learning and applying basic best practices in automation and reporting, focusing on accuracy and consistency in work.
* Participate in team brainstorming sessions and offer ideas for simple improvements or innovations, focusing on learning the creative process.
* Work closely with Senior Associates and Senior Specialists, applying feedback and learning from more experienced team members.
* Build basic understanding of Bain business processes

**Team Activities**

  

* Actively participate in team activities, training sessions, and meetings to build knowledge and understand the team’s processes.
* Assist in the smooth operation of the team’s activities by helping with routine tasks and learning about the team’s culture and processes.

  

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

**Required:**

* Strong problem-solving skills, with a willingness to learn and apply solutions to data and reporting tasks under supervision.
* Ability to contribute to simple tasks within the development of reporting solutions and data analytics projects, with guidance from senior team members.
* Developing communication skills, with a focus on working effectively within a team and understanding basic technical instructions.
* Curiosity and a willingness to learn new skills in data analytics, automation, and AI, with a proactive approach to personal development.
* Understanding of basic data structures and algorithms, with the ability to apply these concepts in simple tasks under supervision.
* Ability to follow instructions and collaborate effectively with team members, contributing to the success of assigned tasks.
* Exposure to working in an agile environment, with a focus on learning how to manage tasks within a fast-paced project setting.

**Preferred:**

* Basic understanding of SQL, with some experience in data management tasks, query optimization, and supporting schema design.
* Knowledge of Python, with an emphasis on automating basic tasks and a growing understanding of data processing.
* Familiarity with basic features of data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) and analytics frameworks (e.g., Pandas, NumPy), with a focus on learning and development.
* Experience in assisting with simple AI model tasks, such as text classification, with direct supervision.

**Experience**

**Required:**

* 2-5 years (graduates) or 0-3 years (post-graduates) of relevant experience in data analytics, business intelligence, and reporting solutions, with exposure to tools like Excel, Alteryx, Tableau and Python
* Basic experience working in a data-focused environment, with an emphasis on supporting routine reporting tasks and learning from more experienced team members.

**Education OR equivalent combination of education, training, and experience**

**Required:**
First class undergraduate/post graduate from leading and reputed colleges 
  
 
  
**Preferred:**
Concentration in a quantitative discipline such as Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, Econometrics, Business Administration, Finance, Business Analytics, or Market Research is strongly preferred 

**Recommended Years of Relevant Experience – 0-2+**

title: Lead Business Analyst (Lead BA)
description:
**Bravura’s Commitment and Mission**
At Bravura Solutions, collaboration, diversity and excellence matter. We value your ideas, giving you room to be curious and innovate in an exciting, fast-paced, and flexible environment. We look for many different skills and abilities, as well as how you can add value to Bravura and our culture.
  
  
As a Global FinTech market leader and ASX listed company, Bravura is a trusted partner to over 350 leading financial services clients, delivering wealth management technology and products. We invest significantly in our technology hubs and innovation labs, which inspire and drive our creative, future-focused mindset. We take pride in developing cutting-edge, digital first technology solutions that support our clients to achieve financial security and prosperity for their customers.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an experienced Lead Business Analyst to join our Product Development team. This is a cross-client, cross-domain and multi-region role, requiring strong business acumen, Solution Design expertise and the ability to work effectively across Australian, UK and South Africa Regions.
  
  
The role will partner with Customers, Service Delivery Managers, Project Managers, Consultants, Product, Development, QA and Architecture teams to shape solutions and drive successful delivery.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead end-to-end Business Analysis and Solution Design for complex product enhancements, client requirements and regulatory/business change.
* Work across multiple clients, domains and regions, rapidly understanding different business processes, regulatory requirements and client-specific needs.
* Perform cross-client, cross-domain and regional impact analysis, identifying dependencies, commonality, differences and opportunities for standardisation and reuse.
* Own high-quality Solution Designs / Business Solution Designs, translating complex business needs into scalable product solutions.
* Act as a key BA interface for Customers, Service Delivery Managers and Project Managers, managing requirements, priorities, scope, risks, dependencies and delivery expectations.
* Lead customer and stakeholder workshops, requirement discussions and solution walkthroughs, clearly communicating complex business and product concepts.
* Hands-on experience leveraging Generative AI/LLM tools across BA and SDLC activities, with the ability to develop effective prompts and reusable AI workflows, validate outputs, identify automation opportunities, and drive measurable improvements in productivity and quality.
* Partner with Product, Development, QA and Architecture teams across the SDLC, from requirements through UAT and release.
* Challenge requirements constructively, identify gaps and ambiguities, and recommend effective business and solution alternatives.
* Drive BA quality, governance, standardisation and continuous improvement across clients and domains.
* Mentor and coach Business Analysts and contribute to BA capability upliftment.
* Identify and implement opportunities for AI, automation and process improvement to improve productivity, reduce effort and maintain/improve quality.

**Unleash your potential**
To be successful in this role, your background and experience will include:
  
  
  

* 8+ years of Business Analysis experience in a software/product development environment.
* Exposure to the any of the Finance industries (Insurance, Investment banking, Capital Markets Superannuation, Pensions or UK wrap) is mandatory.
* Strong expertise in Business Analysis, Solution Design and Impact Assessment.
* Hands on experience in Software Testing/Business Analysis of multi-user software within a financial environment.
* Proven experience working across multiple clients, domains and/or geographical regions.
* Strong stakeholder management experience across Customers, Service Delivery Managers, Project Managers, Consultants and technical teams.
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, influencing and presentation skills.
* Strong understanding of the end-to-end SDLC and Agile delivery.
* Ability to quickly understand new domains, products and business processes and apply knowledge across different contexts.
* Experience mentoring/reviewing other Business Analysts and driving quality standards.
* Strong ownership, decision-making and ability to operate independently.

**Preferred Experience**

* Wealth Management / Portfolio Management / Financial Services.
* APAC and EMEA business and regulatory environments.
* Regulatory/legislative change and complex product ecosystems.
* Data, integrations, interfaces and cross-product impact assessment.
* Experience in leading AI adoption, creating reusable AI assets and coaching teams is highly desirable.
* CBAP certification
* RG 146 or relevant financial services certification is an advantage.

**Work Location**

* Office-based role in accordance with the organisation's current office working policy. This is not a permanent Work From Home position, and no permanent WFH exception is envisaged for this role.

**Working at Bravura**
Our people are the heart of our business. We work hard to provide a rich employee experience and a robust framework for ongoing career development.
  
  
  

* Competitive salary and employee benefits scheme.
* Flexible working hours, we value work-life balance.
* Maternity/ Parental (including secondary) leave policy.
* A cab facility is available in Delhi/NCR.
* Meal facility available
* Free Medical Insurance

**So, what’s next?**
We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion so even if you don’t match every listed skill or tick all the boxes, we’d still love to hear from you.
  
  
Please note that interviews are primarily conducted virtually and if you require any reasonable adjustments or would like to note which pronouns you use, please let us know.
  
  
All final applicants for this position will be asked to consent to a criminal record and background check. Please note that people with criminal records are not automatically barred from applying for this position. Each application will be considered on its merits.

description:
**NPS Prism**
**Title:**
Analyst, Product Operations, Central Ops (Python / Pyspark AND SQL AND Databricks AND Tableau)
  
  
**Reports to:**
Team Manager (in NPS Prism India Hub)
  
  
**Company Profile:**
NPS Prism is a market-leading, cloud-based SaaS business owned by Bain & Company. NPS Prism provides its customers with actionable insights and analysis that guide the creation of game-changing customer experiences. Based on rock-solid sampling, research, and analytic methodology, it lets customers see how they compare to their competitors on overall NPS®, and on every step of the customer journey.
  
  
With NPS Prism you can see where you’re strong, where you lag, and how customers feel about doing business with you and your competitors, in their own words. The result: Prioritize the customer interactions that matter most. NPS Prism customers use our customer experience benchmarks and insights to propel their growth and outpace the competition.
  
  
Launched in 2019, NPS Prism has rapidly grown to a team of over 200, serving dozens of clients around the world. NPS Prism is 100% owned by Bain & Company, one of the top management consulting firms in the world and a company consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally.
  
  
**Position Summary:**
NPS Prism has experienced tremendous growth as a standalone software and data business over the past few years and is making the leap from being a consulting-led business to a technology-led business. title: Executive / Senior Specialist / Assistant Manager - Consumer & Market Insights
description:
**Role:**
Executive / Senior Specialist / Assistant Manager - Consumer & Market Insights
  
  
**About Us**
**:**
Scrubsy is India’s #1 foam-based household cleaner - trusted by thousands of families for kitchen, bathroom, footwear, and all-purpose cleaning. We’re a fast growing D2C brand under BoldChem Science Pvt. Ltd., scaling rapidly across Amazon, our own website, and quick commerce platforms. We are a funded organization. We move fast, we care deeply about quality and we’re building the team that is passionate!
  
  
**Brief:**
Scrubsy is building out a dedicated Consumer & Market Insights function to put the consumer at the centre of everything we launch, from formulations to fragrance to packaging to campaigns.
  
  
As
**Executive / Senior Specialist / Assistant Manager - Consumer and Market Insights**
, you will be a core member of that team, working closely with the Senior Manager - Consumer and Market Insights. You will run the day-to-day research: Coordinating fieldwork with agency partners, Supporting Qualitative and Quantitative studies, Analysing Consumer and Market Data and turning them into clear, well-told and actionable findings.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Support end-to-end research. Help plan and run Qualitative and Quantitative studies from Brief to Final Report.
* Coordinate agency and field partners. Share briefs, discussion guides and questionnaires, track timelines and fieldwork quality, and keep projects moving on schedule.
* Analyse and synthesise. Work through transcripts, verbatims, surveys and market data to pull out trends, themes, need states and clear takeaways.
* Build the story. Prepare clean, insight-led presentations and toplines for the Leadership and cross-functional teams.
* Track the consumer after launch. Monitor reviews, ratings, feedback and repeat signals from our D2C website and marketplaces, and flag what needs attention.
* Do desk research. Scan Category, Competitor and Trend information to support study design and brand, R&D and marketing questions.
* Keep the insights engine organised. Maintain trackers, a library of past studies and learnings, and research budget and timeline records.
* Use modern tools. Use GenAI and analysis tools to speed up synthesis and reporting without losing rigour.

**What We Are Looking For**
**Mandatory Requirement**

* 4 to 7 years of experience in consumer insights or market research, in an agency, a brand or a D2C company.
* Hands-on exposure to Qualitative research and Quantitative research.
* Hands-on knowledge of Research Methodology: you know which approach fits which questions work and can design and run studies accordingly.
* Hands-on data interpretation: You can work through surveys and tracking data and turn them into clear, actionable insights.
* Experience with Consumer interactions and insights, from speaking with consumers to drawing out what matters.
* Qualitative experience, particularly exploratory research (FGDs, IDIs or immersions), and the ability to summarise them into themes.
* Good command of Excel and PowerPoint.
* Graduate or postgraduate degree, ideally MBA / PGDM (Marketing) or equivalent.

**Additional Requirement**

* Exposure to AI-driven insight tools, social listening platforms, or e-commerce/quick-commerce analytics
* Exposure to FMCG (Home care, Personal care) industry.
* Experience supporting NPD launches from exploratory research through to post-launch evaluation.
* Brand health tracking experience.
* Concept testing experience.
* Pre and Post Campaign evaluation experience.
* Familiarity with syndicated data and brand tracking platforms.

**Who You Are**

* Proactive - You don't wait to be told a metric or perception is slipping; before marketing asks "what happened," and you come with the why, not just the what
* Ownership Driven - You own the research question end-to-end — from writing the brief to fieldwork to the final recommendation that actually gets used
* Data Conscious - You validate every insight or "consumer said" claim across segments, methodologies, and sample sizes before it goes to leadership
* Organized - you run a busy, always-on calendar of trackers, ad-hoc studies, and agency deliverables across multiple categories without a wave, deadline, or stakeholder slipping through the cracks.
* Progressive Learner - You understand that Learning is a continuous process and are willing to learn new methodologies and ways of working, while being unafraid to think outside the box and putting across your PoV.
