title: Risk Analyst
description:
We are looking for an experienced Folk with strong Commercial and Small Business Credit Risk expertise to lead client engagements across credit strategy, underwriting, portfolio management and risk analytics. This is a hands-on leadership role. The individual will lead client conversations and delivery teams while remaining sufficiently close to the analytics to independently challenge hypotheses, review methodologies, interrogate data, validate recommendations and, when required, perform hands-on analysis.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial & Small Business Credit Risk Engagement

* Lead problem definition, analytical approach, workplan, quality review and executive-level recommendations.
* Support acquisition and underwriting, credit policy and risk strategy, risk-based pricing, credit limits and exposure management, portfolio monitoring, early-warning strategies, delinquency and collections, and concentration risk.
* Work across commercial/business loans, term loans, working-capital lending, lines of credit, merchant financing and business cards.

2. Drive Analytical Problem Solving

* Translate ambiguous business and credit-risk problems into structured analytical hypotheses.
* Perform or guide portfolio segmentation, vintage/cohort analysis, delinquency and roll-rate analysis, loss analysis and risk-driver assessment.
* Evaluate underwriting criteria using bureau, financial, transaction/cash-flow and alternative data.
* Assess opportunities for automated underwriting and decisioning.
* Develop recommendations around approval rates, losses, profitability and portfolio growth.
* Guide the design of early-warning indicators and portfolio monitoring frameworks.

3. Credit Strategy & Portfolio Management

* Review and optimize eligibility, score cut-offs, exposure limits, pricing and line-assignment strategies.
* Conduct segment, industry and concentration-risk analysis.
* Identify emerging risk patterns and translate findings into policy interventions.
* Balance portfolio growth with credit losses, profitability and risk appetite.
* Develop champion/challenger strategies and structured test-and-learn frameworks.

4. Hands-on Technical Leadership

* Hands on experience with SQL and Python
* Independently conducting exploratory analysis when needed.
* Reviewing model and strategy outputs and identifying analytical gaps.
* Challenging statistical assumptions and business conclusions.
* Developing executive-ready analytical storylines from raw results.
* Providing hands-on support during critical delivery phases.

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or related field; Master’s preferred.
* 4 plus years of relevant experience, with meaningful experience in Commercial, SME or Small Business Credit Risk.
* Experience in banking, financial services, fintech or credit-risk consulting/analytics.
* Demonstrated experience leading credit-risk analytics engagements or major workstreams.
* Strong understanding of commercial/SMB underwriting and portfolio management.

* Ability to collaborate effectively across Commercial, Relationship Management, Billing, Legal, Compliance, Operations, Finance, Risk, and Technology teams in a global virtual environment
* Demonstrated proficiency in artificial intelligence concepts, with hands-on experience using AI tools to streamline workflows and enhance operational efficiency. Proven ability to implement AI-powered solutions to solve business challenges. Demonstrates a growing awareness of AI risk management and a commitment to responsible and ethical AI use
* Experience with Microsoft Power Automate or a similar low-code platform and familiarity with AI-enabled pricing, billing, fee management, or document solutions are preferred

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Information Systems, or a related field

**Responsibilities**

* Manage and enhance pricing applications while advancing responsible AI-enabled workflows across commercial fee management processes and support pricing, fee, and rating-related business applications to ensure reliable day-to-day operation and accurate commercial data
* Identify manual, rules-based, and judgment-intensive workflows that can be improved through automation, AI-assisted guidance, or intelligent agents
* Configure and maintain Salesforce pricing modules, including validations, exception handling, data governance, and AI-assisted workflow enhancements
* Partner with Technology teams to design and implement solutions for fee validation, contract term interpretation, pricing change impact assessment, and related use cases. Validate annual pricing updates and system changes through structured testing, reconciliation, and review of spreadsheets used to implement billing fees and fee descriptions
* Maintain procedures, process flows, templates, and control documentation to support consistent, auditable, and AI-augmented execution models
* Support regulatory, audit, and internal reporting by maintaining data integrity, confidentiality, traceability, and readiness across pricing and fee processes
* Coordinate with Commercial, Relationship Management, Billing, Legal, Compliance, Operations, Finance, Risk, and Technology stakeholders to resolve issues, standardize processes, and implement practical solutions

**About The Team**
Our Commercial Group – Business Application Management team supports the applications, controls, and processes that enable commercial pricing and fee management. By joining the team, you will collaborate with partners across the business to improve application performance, strengthen process consistency, and responsibly expand the use of AI-assisted and agent-driven solutions in a regulated environment
  
  
Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Senior Associate - Value at Risk
description:
Our Market Risk team is responsible for measuring, monitoring and limiting Macquarie’s exposure to adverse market movements. Given the breadth, complexity and global nature of the products Macquarie trades, this role offers a challenging opportunity to contribute to a critical control function that is central to Macquarie’s risk culture and business model.
  
  
We are a global financial services group operating in 30 markets with 57 years of unbroken profitability. At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that is fulfilling and creates value. You will bring your insights and expertise to the task at hand and feel supported as you make your own kind of impact for a better future.
  
  
**What role will you play?**
In this role you will apply your financial markets knowledge to support capital calculations and help ensure appropriate capital is reserved for Macquarie’s global trading business in line with regulatory requirements. This involves calculating and analysing risk metrics, back-testing the model performance, assessing the impact on regulatory capital for new products, businesses and trading strategies, and performing regulatory capital calculations.
  
  
You will work closely with our global market risk analysts and periodically engage with senior leaders across the Risk Management Group, explaining changes and complex data clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders at all levels.
  
  
**What You Offer**

* 0 to 3 years’ experience in a quantitative, statistical, or financial modelling role.
* Degree in a quantitative discipline, engineering, finance, or a related field.
* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to interpret complex data.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a sound understanding of financial markets.
* Exposure to regulatory frameworks (e.g. Basel, FRTB) and experience or interest in Python or similar programming languages will be advantageous.

We love hearing from anyone inspired to build a better future with us, if you're excited about the role or working at Macquarie we encourage you to apply.
  
  
**What We Offer**
**Benefits**
At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that’s rewarding in all the ways that matter most to you. Macquarie employees can access a wide range of benefits which, depending on eligibility criteria, include:
  
  

* 1 wellbeing leave day per year
* 26 weeks’ paid maternity leave or 20 weeks’ paid parental leave for primary caregivers along with 12 days of paid transition leave upon return to work and 6 weeks’ paid leave for secondary caregivers
* Company-subsidised childcare services
* 2 days of paid volunteer leave and donation matching
* Benefits to support your physical, mental and financial wellbeing including comprehensive medical and life insurance cover, the option to join parental medical insurance plan and virtual medical consultations extended to family members
* Access to our Employee Assistance Program, a robust behavioural health network with counselling and coaching services
* Access to a wide range of learning and development opportunities, including reimbursement for professional membership or subscription
* Hybrid and flexible working arrangements, dependent on role
* Reimbursement for work from home equipment

**About the Risk Management Group**
Our Risk Management Group works as an independent, and centralised function, responsible for independent and objective review and challenge, oversight, monitoring and reporting in relation to Macquarie’s material risks. We are a global team that aims to manage the risks of today and anticipate the risks of tomorrow. Our divisions include compliance, credit, financial crime risk, market risk, operational risk, aggregate risk and prudential, and central.
  
  
**Inclusion at Macquarie**
We are committed to providing an inclusive environment for all, where different experiences, skills and perspectives are valued and respected. Macquarie provides access to opportunities for all individuals regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, marital status, gender identity or any other characteristic or circumstance.
  
  
We provide reasonable adjustments to individuals who may need support during the recruitment process and employment. If you require an adjustment, please let us know during the application process.

title: Lead/Principal Data Consultant
description:

Location: Gurugram, full time work from office role

title: Associate Manager- Growth & Strategy
description:
**Role Description**
The Associate Manager – Growth & Strategy is a full-time, on-site role based in Gurugram. This role is about 50% thinking and 50% doing. You will build the analysis, and you will also drive the work that follows from it. This is a high visibility role that will work with the Strategy and Business Leaders to perform competitive analysis, enable GTM for emerging products, build financial models, analyze new markets and opportunities, lead annual business planning and other organization wide strategic initiatives.

**What you'll do**

Growth strategy & new bets

* Break markets into segments and adjacencies, build market maps and sizing views
* Build business cases and financial models for new products, segments, and support pricing or packaging decisions.
* Support go-to-market for new products through ICP definition, target-account research, design-partner pipelines, and positioning inputs.

Competitive & market intelligence

* Track competitors across in target areas, find adjacent players, covering positioning, pricing, product, GTM motion, and disclosures.
* Maintain structured competitive briefs and share periodic updates with leadership.

Strategic programs & execution

* Own execution of one or two cross-functional initiatives at a time: planning, milestones, tracking, flagging risks early, and seeing them through to closure.
* Work with Product, Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Customer Success to unblock execution and follow up on leadership action items.
* Spot inefficiencies in how work gets done and propose practical process improvements.

Business performance & operating rhythm

* Build and maintain dashboards for company- and function-level KPIs and OKRs. Identify trends, deviations, and second-order implications.
* Prepare inputs for annual planning, quarterly business reviews, and leadership reviews.

Synthesis & communication

* Write crisp notes, one-pagers, and presentations for leadership
* Build reusable frameworks and templates so recurring analysis gets faster and more consistent.

**What we’re looking for**

* 2–4 years of relevant experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, a Founder's/CEO's Office, corporate development, or strategy/growth roles at a SaaS or tech company.
* MBA from a reputable institute (preferred not must have)
* A track record of owning workstreams end to end, beyond producing analysis for someone else to act on.
* Strong analytical and financial modeling skills
* Clear written thinking: you can turn messy, incomplete information into a structured recommendation.
* Solid project management skills and the ability to juggle multiple deliverables without dropping follow-through.
* Comfort working with senior stakeholders across functions.
* Advanced Excel/Sheets and PowerPoint skills, plus fluency with AI tools for research and analysis.
* High ownership, a bias for action, and low tolerance for fluff.

Good to have: experience in B2B SaaS or education, and exposure to GTM, pricing, or M&A/diligence work.

**Who we are**

At Meritto we believe in building more than just solutions. We’re redefining the way education connects with technology. As one of India’Largest Vertical SaaS + Embedded Payments platform, we’re on a mission to build the “Digital Backbone of Education Institutions” by simplifying how educational organization runs — from enrollment to lifecycle, advancement to finance, and beyond.

What’s our work culture like? We work from the office in a dynamic, inclusive, and merit-driven space

fueled by the energy of collaboration and creativity coming together.

title: Invoicing Specialist, Operations Support
description:
Concentrix is a technology-enabled global business services company specializing in customer engagement and improving business performance. We partner with ambitious, progressive executives around the world to future-proof their business and stay ahead of the competition and customer expectations.
  
  
**Role And Key Responsibilities**

* Prepare and process invoices, accruals, and run-rate revenue calculations, while owning revenue assurance and variance management to ensure that revenue leakage, billing gaps, and operational exceptions are identified, investigated, and resolved in a timely manner.
* Interpret client contracts and commercial terms, with the ability to translate binding contractual requirements and operational performance metrics into accurate revenue calculations, billing requirements, and invoice preparation.
* Establish and maintain financial and operational controls to improve the accuracy and completeness of invoicing, billing, accruals, reconciliations, and financial reporting.
* Partner with site-level WFM, BI, and Operations POCs to ensure that exceptional and abnormal hours are accurately captured in client dashboards and reflected correctly in the month-end locked-hours dashboard. Validate and incorporate approved exceptional and abnormal hours into final invoices to facilitate timely client approval.
* Maintain clear documentation of processes, assumptions, contractual requirements, and revenue calculation methodologies to ensure consistency, facilitate timely client approvals, and support audit readiness.
* Collect, validate, and reconcile data from multiple tools and sources to perform invoice revenue validation, accruals, reconciliations, variance analysis, and financial reporting.
* Develop and maintain standardized reports and dashboards for senior leadership, highlighting key financial and operational trends, risks, opportunities, and business drivers.
* Identify potential financial risks, revenue leakage, billing gaps, and operational exceptions, and proactively communicate them to relevant stakeholders along with recommended corrective actions.
* Support client and internal business reviews by preparing financial insights, performance trends, variance analysis, and actionable recommendations.

**Key Skills & Knowledge**
Strong focus on data accuracy, integrity, validation, and reconciliation, with a high level of attention to detail.
  
  

* Working Knowledge of revenue recognition principles, accruals, billing, forecasting, run-rate revenue, and financial variance analysis.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including PivotTables, XLOOKUP/INDEX MATCH, SUMIFS, Power Query, Power Pivot, data analysis, and data visualization.
* Strong understanding of WFM and operational deliverables and metrics, including data validation, reconciliation, exception management, and audit requirements.
* Ability to understand and interpret client contracts, commercial terms, service-level requirements, and performance metrics, and translate them into accurate revenue, billing, and invoicing calculations.
* Ability to drive automation and process improvements using advanced Excel, Power Query, Power Pivot, Power BI, and other reporting or analytical tools to reduce manual effort, improve data accuracy, and enhance reporting efficiency.
* Communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to clearly articulate financial insights, explain variances, and present and support data-driven conclusions.

**Desired Skills**

* Ability to build and maintain strong working relationships with global stakeholders across locations and functions.
* Strong ability to prioritize multiple deliverables, manage competing priorities, and consistently meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Self-motivated, proactive, and results-oriented, with a strong work ethic and the ability to independently identify issues, risks, and opportunities and develop insightful solutions.
* Strong project and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple assignments simultaneously and deliver high-quality outputs within agreed timelines.
* Excellent team player with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse, multicultural teams and contribute to a positive working environment.
* Ability to work effectively in a dynamic and continuously changing business environment while maintaining a high level of ownership and accountability.
* Confidence to provide, communicate, and constructively defend a point of view using data, analysis, and sound business rationale.

**Educational Qualification**
Bachelor's Degree

title: Competitive Intelligence - Oncology - Gurgaon-DM
description:
**Company Description**
WNS, part of Capgemini, is an Agentic AI-powered leader in intelligent operations and transformation, serving more than 700 clients across 10 industries, including Banking and Financial Services, Healthcare, Insurance, Shipping and Logistics, and Travel and Hospitality. We bring together deep domain excellence – WNS’ core differentiator – with AI-powered platforms and analytics to help businesses innovate, scale, adapt and build resilience in a world defined by disruption.Our purpose is clear: to enable lasting business value by designing intelligent, human-led solutions that deliver sustainable outcomes and a differentiated impact. With three global headquarters across four continents, operations in 13 countries, 65 delivery centers and more than 66,000 employees, WNS combines scale, expertise and execution to create meaningful, measurable impact.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Total Exp - 4-9 Years.**
To support Global Pharma Franchise (Immuno-Inflammation Derma CVM) Commercial strategy team for various requirements of Competitive Intelligence
  
  

* Have good understanding of Pharmaceutical business from commercial and clinical development perspective; knowledge of global pharmaceutical environment and challenges enabling to provide CI support for early, near to launch and launched medicines
* Hand-on experience on secondary data sources and propriety databases such as Pharma Projects, TrialTrove, Cortellis, PharmaTell, Decision Resources, etc.
* To manage multiple CI projects under tight timelines interfacing with global clientele and prioritize requests based on the criticality and business need as agreed with the stakeholders
* Gain business context about the internal assets, competitor dynamics and monitor competitor activity for a range of KITs/KIQs specific to the medicine/TA
* Deliver in depth, comprehensive, regular CI reports and support ad hoc queries in the areas of indication based pipeline landscapes, competitor company/ asset profile, competitor launch timelines and key event timelines, newsletters etc.
* To engage with various internal and external stakeholders such as Forecasting/Market intelligence/Pricing & Market access/ Market research / Medical teams and able to stick the various intelligence and report the same
* Responsible for continuous process improvement in developing content for various CI deliverables across indications/therapy areas
* Interact as a “partner” with onshore stakeholders, not waiting to be asked to give an opinion and pushing back with respect to scenarios, iterations, analysis, and recommendations
* Demonstrate excellence as an individual contributor with minimal support from peers/team lead, together with the ability to mentor a team of CI offshore analysts, driving high productivity/ efficiency, and creating appropriate performance reviews and capability development plans
* Strong written and oral communication/presentation skills.

**Qualifications**
M.Pharm / PhD

title: Engagement Manager
description:
**Role Overview**

The role is responsible for leading market research initiatives that generate actionable insights into markets, competitors, customers, and industry trends. The role involves managing end-to-end research projects, analysing and interpreting data, and presenting findings to support strategic decision-making, business growth, and product or market development.

The role will also support clients in evaluating and making informed decisions regarding
**entry into and expansion within the Indian market**
, including assistance with market assessment, organisational setup, and implementation.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Communicate directly with clients, as required, to understand, clarify, and document their business objectives and research requirements.
* Develop research and analysis plans and obtain client alignment and sign-off.
* Conduct in-depth primary research through relevant methodologies, including interviews, surveys, focus groups, and stakeholder interactions.
* Conduct comprehensive research and data analysis using an effective combination of primary and secondary sources.
* Design or assist in the development of questionnaires, discussion guides, and moderator guides to ensure relevant data is collected.

* Assist clients with organisational setup and implementation activities in India, where required.

  .

  in market research, consumer insights, business intelligence, strategy consulting, or a related field.
* Strong understanding of primary and secondary research methodologies.
* Experience in designing surveys, questionnaires, discussion guides, and conducting or supporting focus groups and interviews.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex qualitative and quantitative data.
* Ability to derive meaningful insights and translate research findings into actionable business recommendations.
* Knowledge or experience in market assessment, competitive analysis, and
  **India market entry**
  would be an advantage.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong report-writing and presentation abilities.
* Strong client management and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Strong project management and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities simultaneously.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and other relevant data analysis or research tools.

title: Senior Analyst - Credit Analytics
description:
**About Us**
At OakNorth, we're on a mission to empower the UK's most ambitious businesses. Since 2015, we've lent over $21 billion across the UK and US, helped create more than 58,000 new homes and 36,000 new jobs, and supported hundreds of thousands of personal savers — all while fuelling the UK economy.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Credit Analytics team sits at the heart of OakNorth's lending business, providing rigorous financial analysis and credit assessment across a diverse portfolio of commercial loan opportunities. We work closely with Debt Directors, Risk, and client-facing teams in the UK to ensure every lending decision is underpinned by deep analytical insight and a thorough understanding of the borrower's operating environment.
  
  
**About The Role**
We're looking for a Senior Associate to join our Credit Analytics team, taking ownership of detailed loan analysis across sectors and geographies. You'll build financial models, draft concise and well-structured credit reports, conduct sensitivity and stress testing, and engage directly with clients to discuss data and analytical frameworks. This is a high-impact role for someone who combines strong financial acumen with sharp communication skills and a genuine curiosity for business and markets.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Conduct detailed analysis of loan opportunities across various sectors and geographies, developing a thorough understanding of each borrower's business and operating environment.
* Draft concise, well-structured credit reports with clear key takeaways for Credit and Risk to review and comment on.
* Build detailed financial models covering transaction details, financial statement analysis, projections, ratio analysis, and credit metrics.
* Conduct sensitivity analysis and stress testing on projections to assess loan serviceability under adverse scenarios.
* Identify deal-specific covenants that can serve as early warning signals for loan monitoring purposes.
* Conduct detailed industry and market studies to understand the operating environment of borrowers.
* Interact with clients to discuss data gaps, inconsistencies, and analytical frameworks; liaise with Debt Directors and other UK stakeholders throughout the credit process.

**YOU'LL BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU HAVE…**

* 1-3 years of relevant experience in credit analysis, financial analysis, or a related role within financial services.
* Strong financial analysis skills with a thorough understanding of accounting and financial concepts, including the ability to build and interrogate detailed financial models.
* Proven ability to draft clear, concise, and well-reasoned credit reports for senior stakeholders.
* Strong communication skills with confidence interacting with Debt Directors, clients, and other stakeholders across geographies.
* A proactive, results-driven mindset — curious, flexible, hands-on, and comfortable operating at pace in an environment where change is part of daily work.

**Nice to Have**

* MBA, PGDM, CA, or CFA from a reputed institute.
* Experience conducting industry or market studies across multiple sectors.
* Prior exposure to covenant structuring or loan monitoring frameworks.

**What We Offer**

* Health & Protection: Comprehensive medical cover for you, your family, and parents, along with life and accidental insurance cover at a multiple of your salary.
* Wellbeing: Annual health check-ups, online doctor consultations, pharmacy discounts, nutritionist support, and Employee Assistance Program (EAP) services — all sponsored by OakNorth.
* Time Off: Earned leave, casual/sick leave, public holidays, maternity leave, and paternity leave.
* Life Milestones: Financial support for important life events such as marriage, childbirth, and bereavement.
* Flexible Benefits: Tax-efficient allowances for internet, fuel, meals, leave travel, and National Pension System (NPS) contributions.
* Growth & Development: Support for professional certifications, learning and development opportunities, childcare benefits, and paid volunteering days.
* Our Workplace: Modern, centrally located offices, weekly business updates, team events, and great coffee. We work hard to build a culture worth showing up for.

title: Markets Data Management Analyst
description:
Join us as a Markets Data Management Analyst
  
  

* We’re looking for a creative and analytical individual to look for innovative ways to improve our processes
* As a Markets Data Management Analyst, we’ll expect you to act as a point of contact for queries, requests and the facilitation of on-boarding and trade execution for clients
* You’ll be working in partnership with internal and external stakeholders, allowing you to hone your communication skills and gain great exposure for your work
* We're offering this role at senior analyst level

What you'll do
  
  
You’ll be supporting the static setup and maintenance of client and standard settlement instructions, which will facilitate the on-boarding, off-boarding and in-life cycle events of our customers. We’ll look to you to make sure that your stakeholders fully understand the global reference data strategy and agenda. And you’ll be managing the expectations of internal support functions with insight into client requirements and the development of business.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities Will Include**

* Maintaining an understanding of front-to-back client life cycle
* Suggesting areas of improvement for daily processing and escalating these appropriately
* Formulating plans, that are delivered in-line with agreed risk, cost and time requirements
* Acting as a point of contact for static data queries and requests
* Driving the development, implementation and regular review of policies and procedures including AML, know your customer and suitability, ensuring colleagues have adequate awareness and training

The skills you'll need
  
  
We’ll expect you to have experience in the financial services industry, with a specialism in reference data, client on-boarding or client exits. You’ll need to have excellent analytical skills, with a structured and methodical approach when investigating data issues. Crucially, you’ll have the ability to thrive in a fast-paced and rapidly evolving and changing environment.
  
  
**You’ll Also Need**

* Experience of analysing and diagnosing issues and taking ownership of them
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build, maintain and enhance relationships at all levels
* Good Microsoft Office Excel, Word and PowerPoint skills

title: Growth Business Manager- D2C
description:
**About Nory For You:**

Nory For You is a direct-to-consumer brand that sells through its own website, Nory.com. As the business grows, we are looking for a commercially minded professional to own the website as a business and drive profitable, sustainable growth across acquisition, conversion and retention.

**About the Role:**

The D2C Growth Business Manager will own and scale revenue from Nory.com. This is not a pure performance-marketing or website-operations role. You will own the complete website growth funnel, from traffic quality and conversion to average order value, CRM revenue, repeat purchase and overall profitability, working closely with the Performance Marketing Manager and the Creative Strategist.

**Core mandate:**
own Nory.com as a business and continuously identify what is limiting faster, profitable revenue growth.

**What You Will Own**

**Revenue and Profitability**

* Website revenue, growth targets and overall D2C business performance, with monthly and quarterly revenue plans and early flags on gaps.
* Contribution margin and profitable revenue, including the impact of discounts and offers.

**Funnel and Conversion**

* The full funnel: Traffic → PDP → Add to Cart → Checkout → Purchase → Repeat Purchase.
* Conversion-rate optimisation across landing pages, PDPs, cart and checkout, with a structured, prioritised testing roadmap.

**Acquisition Economics**

* Traffic quality analysis by channel, campaign, product and customer segment.
* Guidance to the Performance Marketing Manager on where to scale, reduce or redirect spend, based on CAC, conversion and profitability.

**Average Order Value**

* Bundles, cross-sell, upsell, multi-packs and offer architecture that lift AOV without eroding margin.

**Retention and Lifecycle**

* Email and WhatsApp journeys: abandoned-cart recovery, reactivation, cross-sell and repeat purchase.
* Customer cohorts, repeat rate, LTV and CAC tracking.

**Insight, Collaboration and Reporting**

* Joint work with the Creative Strategist to identify the messages, customer problems and creative concepts that drive high-quality traffic and conversion.
* Weekly reporting on what changed, why it changed and what action should follow, backed by a prioritised experimentation roadmap.

**How Success Will Be Measured**

* Website revenue growth
* Contribution margin / profitable revenue
* Blended CAC
* Website, PDP-to-cart and checkout conversion
* Average Order Value
* CRM revenue and abandoned-cart recovery
* Repeat purchase rate and customer LTV

**What You Bring**

**Must Have**

* 4–8 years in D2C, e-commerce, digital commerce or growth, with experience owning website revenue or an e-commerce funnel.
* Strong analytical and commercial mindset; able to separate vanity metrics from real business performance.
* Sound understanding of paid acquisition economics, even if you do not run campaigns yourself.
* Hands-on experience with CRO, funnel analysis, cohort analysis and experimentation.
* Good grounding in CRM, lifecycle marketing and retention.
* Working command of Shopify, GA4, Meta and Google advertising data, and e-commerce analytics.
* A structured, action-oriented approach: analyse, diagnose, prioritise, execute and measure.

**Good to Have**

* Experience in consumer health, wellness, beauty or other education-led D2C businesses.
* Familiarity with CRM and engagement tools (for example Klaviyo or WebEngage) and A/B testing tools.

**Why This Role**

* End-to-end ownership of a D2C website as a business, not a single channel.
* A clear, measurable mandate with direct impact on revenue and profitability.
* Close collaboration with performance marketing and creative strategy on a shared growth agenda.

title: Revenue Manager
description:
**PURPOSE**

The Revenue Manager is responsible for driving total hotel revenue and profitability through strategic pricing, inventory management, demand forecasting, and market intelligence. The role focuses on maximising revenue across Rooms, Suites, Food & Beverage outlets, Banqueting and Events, and other ancillary revenue streams while preserving unit's luxury positioning and guest experience standards.

The incumbent will lead the hotel’s revenue management strategy by analysing market demand, competitor performance, booking trends, and distribution channels to optimise occupancy, Average Daily Rate (ADR), Revenue per Available Room (RevPAR). Working closely with Sales, Marketing, Reservations, Finance, and Operations, the Revenue Manager will support data-driven commercial decisions that enhance market share, profitability, and long-term business growth.

**KEY ORGANISATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS**

**Reports To:**
Director of Sales & Marketing

**Direct Reports:**
Revenue Executive(s), Reservations Associate

**Interacts With:**

**External**

* Online Travel Agencies (OTAs)
* Corporate Travel Partners
* Revenue Management Consultants
* Market Benchmarking and Distribution Partners (STR, RateGain, etc.)

**Internal**

* General Manager
* Director of Sales & Marketing
* Reservations Team
* Front Office
* Finance
* Food & Beverage
* Banquets & Events
* Marketing
* IT
* Hotel Operations Teams

**Revenue Strategy & Optimisation**

* Develop and execute revenue management strategies to maximise ADR, RevPAR, occupancy and profitability.
* Monitor booking pace, pickup trends, market demand and competitor pricing to implement dynamic pricing strategies.
* Manage room inventory, room category availability, restrictions, controls, and overbooking strategies where appropriate.
* Optimise revenue opportunities across transient, corporate, wholesale, group and MICE segments.
* Collaborate with Sales and Events teams to evaluate group business opportunities and displacement analyses.
* Oversee banquet and event space inventory utilisation to maximise revenue contribution from Meetings, Conferences, Weddings and Social Events.
* Ensure optimal rate positioning across all direct and indirect distribution channels.

**Forecasting, Analytics & Reporting**

* Prepare daily, weekly, monthly and annual revenue forecasts for Rooms and total hotel revenue.
* Produce rolling forecasts by segment, channel to support strategic planning and budgeting.
* Monitor and analyse key performance indicators including ADR, RevPAR, Market Penetration Index (MPI), Revenue Generation Index (RGI) and occupancy performance.
* Provide actionable revenue insights through market trend analysis and business intelligence reporting.
* Support annual budgeting, strategic planning and long-range forecasting processes.
* Utilise STR, RateGain and internal reporting tools to identify opportunities and market risks.

**Distribution & Channel Management**

* Maintain rate parity and inventory accuracy across all distribution channels.
* Monitor OTA performance, direct booking trends, channel costs and contribution margins.
* Manage rate loading, promotions, packages and strategic offers through PMS, CRS and channel management platforms.
* Evaluate distribution partnerships and recommend initiatives to improve revenue and profitability.

**Commercial Collaboration**

* Lead weekly Revenue Strategy Meetings to review pace, forecast accuracy, market demand and business mix.
* Partner with Sales and Marketing teams to align promotional activities with demand forecasts.
* Support commercial decision-making through pricing recommendations and revenue impact assessments.
* Work closely with Operations to ensure revenue strategies are aligned with guest expectations and service standards.

**Leadership & People Development**

* Drive a revenue-focused culture throughout the hotel by promoting commercial awareness across departments.
* Coach and mentor revenue and reservations team members.
* Facilitate training on revenue management principles, forecasting methodologies, Best Available Rate (BAR) strategies, and distribution management.
* Establish performance objectives and development plans for team members.

**Work Experience**

* Minimum 5-7 years of experience in Revenue Management within luxury hotels.
* Prior experience with luxury city hotels, luxury lifestyle hotels, or leading hospitality brands preferred.
* Proven track record in driving ADR, RevPAR and total revenue growth.

**About the Tax Vertical at ICPP**

The Convergence Foundation (TCF) is expanding its work on
**tax policy as a critical lever for India's long-term economic growth**
. To advance this agenda, TCF has incubated a
**Tax Policy Vertical at the ICPP, Ashoka University**
, bringing together Ashoka's academic and interdisciplinary strengths with a strong focus on real-world policy questions.

The Vertical aims to build an independent, long-term research and policy platform focused on
**how India can strengthen tax administration, compliance and institutional design while supporting investment, productivity, formalisation and growth**
. Its work will combine rigorous research, evidence generation, international benchmarking and implementable policy design, with engagement across the policy cycle.

The Vertical will initially focus on
**tax administration and compliance across all taxes**
, while building distinctive datasets, research capacity and institutional partnerships over time. It will serve as a
**research institution, policy sounding board and convening platform**
, with independence and freedom from commercial or success-based advisory work at its core.

**About the Role**

The Tax Policy Vertical at the Indian Council for Public Policy (ICPP), Ashoka University, is establishing India's leading independent centre for research on taxation, tax administration and public finance. The centre aims to generate rigorous evidence, inform policy reforms, strengthen state capacity, and contribute to India's long-term economic growth agenda under
*Viksit Bharat 2047*
.

We are looking for a highly motivated Research Associate with 2–3 years of experience in economics, public policy, public finance, or related fields to support research, policy analysis and stakeholder engagement across direct taxes, indirect taxes, tax administration and institutional reforms.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Research & Policy Analysis**

* Conduct quantitative and qualitative research on taxation, public finance and economic policy.
* Analyse datasets relating to taxation, investment, compliance costs, litigation and economic growth.
* Analyse tax laws, administrative processes and institutional reforms in India and internationally.
* Undertake literature reviews, comparative policy studies and international benchmarking.
* Support development of policy papers, issue briefs, working papers and discussion notes.

**Policy Development**

* Support formulation of evidence-based policy recommendations.
* Assist in developing long-term reform frameworks on tax policy and administration.
* Contribute to research on tax competitiveness, investment climate and ease of doing business.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Support consultations with government officials, academia, industry, multilateral organisations and civil society.
* Prepare background notes, meeting briefs and consultation summaries.
* Assist in organising policy roundtables, workshops and conferences.

**Knowledge & Communication**

* Prepare presentations, policy decks and research summaries for senior policymakers.
* Monitor domestic and global developments in taxation and public finance.
* Contribute to blogs, newsletters and knowledge products.

**Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Economics, Public Policy or related discipline.
* 2–3 years of experience in:
* Public policy research organisations/Think tanks
* Economic/Strategy/public sector consulting
* Excellent analytical and research skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Knowledge of India's federal tax system, fiscal policy and public finance.
* Experience working with government datasets and policy reports.
* Quantitative skills (Excel required; familiarity with Stata, R or Python preferred).
* Excellent writing and presentation skills.
* Ability to synthesise complex evidence into clear policy recommendations.
* Strong project management and stakeholder coordination abilities.

title: Research Analyst

description:
**Purpose**

The CEEW’s sustainable water programme informs policy-making for the sustainable development of water resources and their effective management through research in the areas of: circular water economy for urban resilience; climate risk-informed water security planning; climate-adaptive water governance; and water accounting-based planning.

For its sustainable water programme, CEEW seeks to hire a Research Analyst with a good understanding of India’s water sector. An ideal candidate should have a thorough understanding of urban water management issues and challenges, especially considering the climate variability and change, and the current policy discourse (supply and demand management, and used water treatment, recycling, and reuse) for addressing them. The candidate should have prior experience working in the used water management and circular economy sectors.

Along with a policy research orientation, the candidate should possess strong data analysis skills and support the organisation in accessing various existing secondary data sets, such as those from the Census of India, Urban Local Bodies, Central and State Pollution Control Boards, Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Ministry of Jal Shakti, India WRIS or any other data sets available in the public domain. The candidate should have proficiency in using statistical tools. Hands-on experience with geo-spatial tools and experience of working in projects involving the engagement of urban local bodies will be desirable.

**Research:**

* Undertaking policy and data analysis for mainstreaming treated used water (TUW) reuse in local governance.

* Analyse primary and secondary water-related datasets using statistical tools to estimate the city water balance, assess the existing used water management scenario, and identify TUW reuse avenues.
* Conduct a financial assessment using various budget estimation techniques to assess the financial viability of the proposed city-level treated used water reuse plan

**Education and Experience:**

* Master’s degree in environmental sciences/management/planning, water resources management, urban planning/management, hydrology, public policy or a related field

* Proven evidence of conducting effective stakeholder engagement.
* 1–2 years of work experience

**Skills:**

* Competent in collecting and analysing data
* Good report writing skills
* Good data visualisation skills
* Competent in using MS Office application suite
* Proficiency in RS/GIS will be an added advantage

**Personality:**

* Willingness to learn new skills in research and project management
* Ability to adapt and deliver work under tight deadlines in a professional environment

Competitive compensation – commensurate with the experience and matching the best of standards adopted by industry or other similar organisations for similar roles.

title: Independent Consultant, Market Shaping - Lead Exposure
description:
WJCF is an Indian non-profit organisation committed to saving lives by reducing the burden of disease and strengthening government-owned, high-quality health systems. Since 2007, WJCF has combined data-driven approaches and deep public health expertise with strong government partnerships to design, implement, and scale solutions across India’s national and state health programmes. We work for and at the service of governments — supporting the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare and State Departments of Health to build systems that are strong, sustainable, and led by Indian institutions.
  
  
As an Indian organisation, WJCF brings an unmatched depth of contextual understanding of India’s health system architecture, policy landscape, and implementation realities across diverse geographies and population groups. This local institutional credibility, combined with global technical rigour, is central to WJCF’s effectiveness as a partner to governments and donors.
  
  
Our work is built around four complementary roles as a Trusted Government Partner, co-designing programmes and strengthening health system architecture; as an Operational Partner, translating strategies into effective on-the-ground delivery; as a Market Shaper, improving the availability and affordability of health commodities; and as an Ecosystem Catalyst, convening governments, development partners, academia, and the private sector to drive solutions at scale.
  
  
WJCF’s programme portfolio spans thematic areas like hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis, vector-borne diseases), syphilis, cervical cancer, diabetes, maternal and childhood anaemia, immunisation, under-5 diarrhoea and pneumonia, sexual and reproductive health, Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri - Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY), Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM), hypoxemia and oxygen, safe drinking water, sickle cell disease, presbyopia, lead poisoning, and cross cutting thematic areas like AI and Health, integrated disease surveillance, and climate and health. We currently support programmes across 19 states and union territories, with teams working at national, state, district, and sub-district levels.
  
  
Our people are our greatest asset. WJCF brings together a talented, diverse team of professionals from public health, analytics, consulting, healthcare, the development sector, and academia, all united by a shared commitment to improving health outcomes for the people of India. We are entrepreneurial, action-oriented, and deeply grounded in the communities and systems we work in. Our field teams collectively bring hundreds of years of experience managing public health programmes across the country.
  
  
WJCF collaborates with a range of international and domestic partners and donors to advance its mission, including an affiliation with the Clinton Health Access Initiative (CHAI), a global health organisation with which WJCF shares a common mission and values.
  
  
Programme Overview
  
  
Lead (Pb) exposure is a silent yet devastating global health crisis, particularly in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). Research from UNICEF and other partners estimates that 1 in 2 children in LMICs have elevated blood lead levels, contributing neurological damage, reduced cognitive development, and a variety of health impacts.
  
  
Lead exposure in India arises from multiple sources, with leaded decorative paints and used lead-acid batteries (ULABs) representing the two most significant. Despite a regulatory limit of 90 ppm for lead in decorative paints, widespread non-compliance among SME manufacturers means lead chromate pigments continue to enter the paint supply chain. ULABs are the single largest source of secondary lead in India, with approximately 1.1 million metric tonnes generated annually across the automotive, telecom, inverter, and UPS sectors; informal recycling of spent batteries releases lead into surrounding communities, disproportionately affecting children.
  
  
WJCF has launched a new Lead Exposure Program, building on its proven market shaping capabilities and experience partnering with governments to address large-scale and cross-sectoral health challenges. Program priorities include
  
  

* Devising and implementing strategies to support paint SME manufacturers in transitioning from lead inputs to safer and sustainable alternatives (organic pigments)
* Scoping gaps and intervention areas for market-shaping opportunities across the lead exposure program, spanning diagnostics (pXRF), treatment (chelating agents), and source-side mitigation (plastics, other sources)

The incumbent will support across multiple market shaping workstreams as detailed below.
  
  
Position Details
  
  
We are seeking an analytically rigorous and entrepreneurial individual to support the design, implementation, and monitoring of WJCF’s market shaping interventions. The role involves market assessment, value chain analysis, stakeholder interviews, policy analysis, and financial modelling. It spans government, private sector, and civil society actors, and sits at the intersection of commercial strategy, environmental health, and government engagement.
  
  

* Location New Delhi, with domestic travel to pilot states.
* Duration Up to 6 months, extendable based on performance
* Market Strategies to Transition Paint SMEs to Safer Alternatives

**Transition to Lead-Free Paints**

* Support the scoping and implementation of targeted pilot interventions to enable industry transition to lead-free paints, including addressing SME barriers to transition, supply chain solutions, and related market-shaping measures.

**Pilot Planning & Design**

* Develop detailed pilot blueprints for selected interventions implementation plans, resource requirements, partnerships, budgets, timelines, risk assessments, and mitigation strategies.
* The intervention hypotheses under consideration are

+ Aggregate raw material demand Test the feasibility of aggregating demand from medium-sized paint manufacturers to secure lower-cost lead-free inputs and incentivize greater reformulation of paints to lead-free alternatives.
+ Leverage institutional procurement Identify high-volume institutional paint buyers and work with them to adopt lead-free procurement commitments, creating demand-side pressure for manufacturers to reformulate their products.

* Prepare implementation toolkits and support materials for roll-out as needed.

**Exploring Lead-Free Pigment Transitions in Non-Paint Sources**

* Mapping lead and lead-free pigment supply chains, assess switching barriers, and evaluate the feasibility of lead-free alternatives in other sources (plastics, turmeric)
* Identify opportunities and support concept to proposal writing, including defining and prioritizing intervention areas.
* Market Shaping for Portable XRF (pXRF)

**Accelerate access to affordable pXRF for research and routine government environmental testing**

* Conduct a supplier and distribution landscape of pXRF devices
* Assess device availability and pricing across suppliers
* Map demand with stakeholders, including current pXRF use and unmet needs
* Understand procurement pathways and regulatory frameworks
* Assess end-user needs to evaluate product-market fit
* Market shaping for Chelating Agents

**Enable access to affordable oral chelation therapy**

* Expanding access to chelation drugs through improved sourcing and procurement to reduce costs and enable addition in essential drug lists
* Assessing alternative formulations or delivery approaches that could improve affordability and feasibility in low-resource settings
* Cross-cutting

**Stakeholder Engagement and Reporting**

* Support proposal development, including concept notes, funding proposals, and progress reports.
* Support stakeholder management across donor, government, private sector, and civil society partners.
* Maintain programme tracking tools and contribute to milestone monitoring.
* Scope can potentially evolve basis developing understanding of the above lead exposure program areas
* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, economics, public policy, or a related field; a postgraduate degree is preferred.
* Minimum 3 years of relevant experience with a strong analytical focus, such as market assessment, supply chain analysis, commercial strategy, or policy analysis. Strategy consulting experience is preferred.
* Experience in primary research, such as stakeholder interviews, value chain mapping, or market assessments in complex, multi-stakeholder settings.
* Strong quantitative and qualitative analytical skills, and comfort building unit economics or financial models.
* Strong strategic thinking, with the ability to identify and pursue high-impact opportunities in complex, uncertain, and changing environments.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce high-quality reports, briefs, and presentations for government, donors, and technical audiences.
* An entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to work independently, lead workstreams end-to-end, and to propose and carry out new initiatives.

description:

We are seeking a driven and experienced client services manager to join our business team. This person would be responsible for managing key client relationships, strategically lead the existing businesses, and drive performance of their team, based out of New Delhi.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a
**Podcast Analyst, Strategist & Researcher**
who can help us build better podcast episodes through strong research, audience understanding and content strategy.

Our podcast focuses primarily on
**health, wellness, psychology, lifestyle and human behaviour**
. You don't need to come from a medical background. What matters most is your ability to
**research deeply, think critically, understand information and turn it into interesting content.**

You'll work closely with the content and production team to research topics, analyse podcast performance, identify trends, research guests and develop insights that can make every episode stronger.

**What You'll Do**

**1. Research & Topic Development**

* Deeply research potential podcast topics and identify interesting angles.

* Find relevant studies, reports, expert opinions, statistics, news and credible sources.

* Understand a topic from multiple perspectives instead of relying on a single source.

* Identify myths, misconceptions, interesting facts and unanswered questions.

* Convert research into clear and useful insights for the host and writing team.

* Develop research briefs for upcoming episodes.

**2. Health & Wellness Research**

* Research health-related topics with accuracy and responsibility.

* Learn how to navigate credible health and scientific sources.

* Understand the basics of reading studies and evaluating claims.

* Cross-check important claims before they are used in an episode.

* Clearly distinguish between established evidence, expert opinion, emerging research and speculation.

* You don't need to be a doctor or medical expert.
  **You need to be willing and capable of learning how to research health topics properly.**

**3. Guest Research**

* Research potential guests and understand their background, expertise and work.

* Study their previous interviews, articles, books, research and public conversations.

* Identify interesting stories, opinions and areas that can lead to deeper conversations.

* Prepare detailed guest research documents.

* Develop questions and follow-up questions based on your research.

**4. Podcast Analytics**

* Analyse episode performance across views, CTR, watch time, retention and engagement.

* Identify which topics, guests and formats perform better.

* Study audience drop-offs and understand where attention is being lost.

* Analyse titles, thumbnails, hooks and episode structures.

* Identify patterns across multiple episodes.

* Turn analytics into clear recommendations for future episodes.

**5. Content & Podcast Strategy**

* Identify topics that have strong audience potential.

* Track what audiences are searching for and talking about.

* Study successful podcasts and creators to understand what is working.

* Identify content gaps and opportunities.

* Suggest new formats, recurring themes and episode ideas.

* Help build a long-term podcast content roadmap.

**6. Trend & Audience Research**

* Track emerging conversations around health, wellness, psychology, lifestyle and culture.

* Analyse YouTube, social media, search trends and audience discussions.

* Understand what questions people are asking.

* Identify the gap between what people believe and what research or experts suggest.

* Convert these observations into potential podcast topics.

**7. Fact-Checking & Quality Control**

* Verify important statistics, claims and information before publication.

* Check whether a source actually supports the claim being made.

* Flag weak, exaggerated or misleading claims.

* Maintain organised sources and references for each episode.

* Help ensure that the podcast remains informative without becoming unnecessarily complicated.

**What We're Looking For**

* Excellent research skills.

* Strong curiosity and ability to go down a research rabbit hole.

* Good understanding of YouTube and podcast content.

* Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills.

* Ability to find patterns and insights from information.

* Good writing and communication skills.

* Ability to simplify complex information.

* Strong attention to detail.

* Interest in health, psychology, science, human behaviour, culture and lifestyle.

* Willingness to learn how to research health and scientific topics properly.

* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

**You DON'T Need**

* A medical degree.

* To be a doctor, nutritionist or psychologist.

* Previous experience working specifically on a health podcast.

**If you're a strong researcher and content thinker, we can teach you the domain.**

**Good to Have**

* Previous experience in YouTube, podcasts, journalism, research or content strategy.

* Experience with YouTube Analytics.

* Familiarity with Google Trends, YouTube Search and audience research.

* Basic understanding of research papers and scientific studies.

* Experience researching guests or preparing interview briefs.

* Experience working with health, psychology, science or lifestyle content.

**The Ideal Person**

You're the kind of person who sees a topic and immediately starts asking:

**Why does this happen?**

**Is this actually true?**

**What does the research say?**

**What are people getting wrong about this?**

**What is the interesting story here?**

You don't just collect information.

You
**connect the dots.**

You can take a complicated topic, spend hours researching it, find the important insights and turn

them into something that makes the audience think:

**"Wait, I never thought about it this way."**

Full-Time

EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India, supports state governments in delivering evidence-based public health programs, including safe drinking water initiatives and school and Anganwadi-based National Deworming Day and iron and folic acid supplementation. Operating across 10 states, EAII Advisors provides technical assistance to ministries of health, education, water, and women and child development, reducing health burdens in impoverished communities and improving the long-term wellbeing of children and families.
  
  
For more information, read about our work here:
  
  
**About Evidence Action**
At Evidence Action, we deliver data-driven interventions that transform lives at an unprecedented scale. We identify neglected global health issues and deploy proven solutions, forging healthier futures for generations.
  
  
Our model operationalizes leading academic research (including from Nobel-winning economists). We measure progress and outcomes at every stage to ensure we're making a real impact for people living in poverty and suffering from preventable or treatable health issues. Operating across 11 countries, our team of 900+ has reached over 500 million people, working closely with governments to scale these interventions.
  
  

* Our Deworm the World program has delivered over 2 billion treatments, significantly reducing worm prevalence and generating more than $23 billion in lifetime productivity gains.
* Through Safe Water Now, we've saved the lives of over 15,000 children.
* Our Accelerator explores untapped opportunities in global health, testing low-cost interventions with the greatest potential to save and improve lives.

At Evidence Action, your colleagues are your greatest asset. You'll partner with high-caliber colleagues in an environment blending innovation, autonomy, and teamwork. Our team excels in disruptive thinking and believes in rolling up our sleeves to get things done. If you're looking to work flexibly and with purpose, join a team that delivers measurable change for millions.
  
  
**The Role**
The consultant will examine two related but distinct areas:
  
  
(i) the MVS landscape, including its scale, infrastructure characteristics, operating models and existing water-treatment arrangements; and
  
  
(ii) the electrochlorinator landscape, including technologies, existing deployments, economics and potential use cases across rural water systems
  
  
The goal of this consultancy is two fold:
  
  

* Develop a detailed understanding of the MVS landscape, including its scale, major scheme archetypes, infrastructure and operating characteristics, existing treatment arrangements, and resulting gaps or opportunities for safe-water interventions particularly in Evidence Action's priority states (AP, Bihar, Odisha, Rajasthan)
* Assess the EC market and determine the technical, operational and economic conditions under which ECs could represent a viable rural chlorination solution - addressing ECs' fit within a broader rural chlorination technology option including tablet-based dozers and other chlorination options

The final output should help Evidence Action decide whether, where and how to invest in ECs and/or other technologies to meet the water treatment needs of MVS in rural India. This would include analysis on the minimum technical, operational, financial and institutional conditions required for this type of intervention. Specific workstreams include:
  
  
**Estimating MVS Market Size and Identifying Key Market Segments**

* Conduct landscape analysis to estimate the total rural population served by MVS; verify estimates for EvAc priority states (AP, Bihar, Rajasthan, Odisha) via qualitative interviews and/or field visits as necessary
* Building on the analysis above, analyze the MVS infrastructure landscape to determine major market segments; identify key elements of each market segment that have relevance to water treatment, including system size/capacity, number of villages/population served, source and infrastructure configuration, existing treatment arrangements, and operating/O&M models; estimate the size of major market segments in EvAc priority states

**Analysis of Water Treatment Solutions Relevant to MVS, Including ECs**

* Conduct landscape analysis to map water treatment solutions already in place to serve MVS across rural India; document best practices and key learnings from implementation to date; including functionality, operational and O&M considerations where evidence is available
* Develop a market analysis documenting currently available water treatment solutions that would meet the needs of MVS systems (whether they are being implemented currently or not). While estimates for all of rural India would be useful, a focus on Andhra Pradesh, Bihar, Odisha and Rajasthan is a priority
* Develop a comparison model to assess key attributes of each water treatment solution, including cost, consumable requirements, maintenance requirements and implementation track record. Separately, develop a deeper analysis of the EC market, documenting currently available and late-stage EC models, suppliers, existing deployments, performance, costs and operational requirements across relevant rural water-system use cases, including but not limited to MVS
* Develop analysis to identify the technical, operational and economic conditions under which ECs are likely to be viable or non-viable across different rural water-system configurations, and identify the use cases where ECs appear most promising

**Recommendations for Strategic Intervention Pathways in EA ISW Priority States**

* Using findings from all analysis areas described above, develop summary recommendations for EvAc on potential opportunities within the MVS landscape and on whether, where and how ECs could expand EA's rural chlorination technology options, including scale-up pathways, with a focus on EA ISW priority geographies. A recommendation to defer, limit, or not pursue ECs will be considered valid if supported by the evidence
* Recommendations should explicitly state which MVS segments and/or EC use cases, geographies, delivery models and risk controls are strategic for further testing or scale-up

**Requirements**

* 15+ years of experience with a focus on strategy, market shaping and/or management consulting; existing experience in the water/WASH sector preferred, but not required
* Experience assessing water-treatment technologies, including technical fit, costs, maintenance and operating requirements; chlorination/EC experience preferred
* Strong relationships or credibility with government, WASH institutions, implementers and sector experts in India
* No existing commercial relationship with any of the EC vendors being evaluated
* Experience communicating technical material to non-technical audiences, including donors, boards, or senior leadership

**Position Location**
**This is a 6-month consultancy engagement,**
with the possibility of extension based on organizational needs.
  
  
We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an Indian employment visa at this time. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in India for roles based in India.
  
  
**Consultancy Fees:**
Competitive and commensurate with the individual's credentials, experience, and previous pay scale.
  
  
**All contracting arrangements will be made through EAII Advisors Private Limited. EAII is an equal opportunity employer. Employment at EAII is based solely on an individual's merit and qualifications directly related to professional competence. EAII does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, caste, creed, colour, religion, gender, origin, disability, marital status, or any other basis protected by law.**

**Meta Ads Operations Manager**

The ideal candidate should have hands-on knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and Meta Business Manager, strong coordination skills, and the ability to troubleshoot operational issues while ensuring compliance with Meta's advertising policies and internal procedures.

**Key Responsibilities**
**1. Ad Account & Asset Management**

* Coordinate with agencies and partners to request new Meta ad accounts, profiles, Pages, and Business Managers.
* Manage account access, permissions, and asset allocation for media buyers.
* Maintain accurate mapping of ad accounts, Pages, Business Managers, and assigned media buyers.
* Ensure proper documentation and tracking of all advertising assets.

**2. Media Buyer Allocation & Coordination**

* Allocate ad accounts to media buyers based on business requirements and approved access.
* Maintain updated records of account assignments, access permissions, and asset ownership.
* Coordinate with media buyers to resolve account-related queries and operational challenges.
* Ensure smooth coordination between media buyers, agencies, and internal teams.

**3. Business Manager Setup & Management**

* Coordinate the setup and configuration of Meta Business Managers.
* Manage approved asset mapping, partner access, and user permissions.
* Monitor account and asset access to ensure appropriate authorization.
* Troubleshoot Business Manager access issues and coordinate resolutions.

**4. Technical Support & Issue Resolution**

* Monitor ad account functionality, ad delivery issues, and website-related technical concerns.
* Investigate operational issues reported by media buyers and coordinate with relevant technical teams.
* Track issues and ensure resolution within defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Escalate critical issues to the appropriate stakeholders when required.

**5. Account Suspension & Policy Compliance**

* Monitor and maintain records of suspended or restricted ad accounts and Pages.
* Coordinate legitimate appeals and follow up on account reviews through official Meta channels.
* Track the status of appeals, restrictions, and reinstatement requests.
* Ensure all operational activities comply with Meta advertising policies and applicable platform rules.
* Support the use of alternative eligible advertising assets only where permitted by Meta's policies.

**6. Payment & Advertising Spend Monitoring**

* Coordinate the addition and management of approved payment methods.
* Monitor advertising spend, payment status, billing activity, and account spending limits.
* Identify billing discrepancies, failed payments, and unusual spending patterns.
* Coordinate with the finance team, agencies, and relevant stakeholders to resolve payment-related issues.
* Maintain accurate payment and spend records for reporting and reconciliation.

**7. Advertiser Verification**

* Track advertiser verification and business verification status across relevant accounts.
* Coordinate the collection and submission of required business documents through official channels.
* Follow up on pending verification requests and document-related issues.
* Maintain records of verification progress, approvals, rejections, and pending actions.

**8. Reporting & Documentation**

* Maintain accurate and up-to-date trackers for ad accounts, Business Managers, Pages, media buyer allocation, suspensions, payments, and verification.
* Prepare regular operational reports covering pending issues, account status, spend, and resolution timelines.
* Ensure proper documentation of escalations, follow-ups, and completed actions.
* Provide timely updates to management regarding operational risks and bottlenecks.

**9. Process Improvement & Stakeholder Management**

* Coordinate with agencies, media buyers, finance, technical teams, and management to improve operational efficiency.
* Identify recurring issues and recommend process improvements.
* Establish consistent tracking and follow-up practices for account provisioning and issue resolution.
* Ensure adherence to internal processes, access-control requirements, and Meta policies.

* Hands-on knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and Meta Business Manager.

* Experience handling ad account restrictions, suspension tracking, appeals, and advertiser verification.
* Understanding of advertising billing, payment methods, spend monitoring, and reconciliation.
* Proficiency in Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, reporting, and documentation skills.
* Excellent coordination, communication, and follow-up abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple accounts and operational tasks simultaneously.
* Strong attention to detail and a process-oriented approach.
* Understanding of Meta advertising policies and platform compliance requirements.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Digital Marketing, or a related field is preferred.
* Relevant experience in Meta Ads operations, digital advertising support, Business Manager management, or advertising account operations is preferred.
* Practical experience coordinating with media buyers, agencies, and internal teams will be an advantage.
* Candidates with strong operational knowledge and hands-on experience managing Meta advertising assets are encouraged to apply.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be evaluated based on the following parameters:

* Timely provisioning of ad accounts and allocation to media buyers.
* Compliance with defined SLAs for issue resolution and escalation.

You will work closely with partner teams in Analytics, FP&A, Accounting, Cloud Billing, and Sales Operations to not only drive alignment on business performance narratives, but also to drive company wide transparency and data democratization for company key metrics.
  
  
Data pipelines, visualizations, root cause analyses, and deep dives generated by this team routinely empower MongoDB’s executive team to make data-informed decisions. This is a high visibility role that offers exposure to senior leadership via the team’s support of the office of the CFO.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Deep dive on performance metrics from across the company to surface drivers of business growth to enable data-driven decision making at the executive level
* Produce insights to answer requests ahead of critical reporting periods, including earnings and investor days
* Partner with the rest of the team to own the end-to-end delivery of recurring consumption and revenue reports (weekly, monthly, and quarterly) ensuring they're accurate, timely, and trusted by stakeholders
* Proactively identify and fix data quality issues, broken pipelines, or reporting discrepancies
* Document metric definitions, report logic, and data lineage

Skills & Attributes
  
  

* The ideal candidate excels equally in data wrangling, pipelining, and storytelling, and shares a passion for automation and continuous process improvement
* 4+ years in an analyst, data, or BI role with meaningful ownership of key business metrics reporting
* Strong SQL skills; comfortable writing and optimizing queries against large-scale warehouses (Trino, BigQuery, or similar)
* Working proficiency in Python for data transformation, automation, or analysis
* Hands-on Tableau or similar BI tool experience
* Experience with agent-driven development practices
* Experience working with consumption-based or usage-based revenue data (subscription, metered billing, or usage analytics a strong plus)
* Nice-to-have: exposure to analytics engineering practices (dbt, data modeling, testing frameworks)
* And most importantly, passionate about using data to help guide strategic decision making

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
  
  
MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
  
  
MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.
