title: Associate Vice President - Credit Analytics
description:
**About Us**
At OakNorth, we're on a mission to empower the UK's most ambitious businesses. Since 2015, we've lent over $21 billion across the UK and US, helped create more than 58,000 new homes and 36,000 new jobs, and supported hundreds of thousands of personal savers — all while fuelling the UK economy.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Credit Analytics team sits at the heart of OakNorth's lending business, providing rigorous financial analysis and credit assessment across a diverse portfolio of commercial loan opportunities. We work closely with Debt Directors, Risk, and client-facing teams in the UK to ensure every lending decision is underpinned by deep analytical insight and a thorough understanding of the borrower's operating environment.
  
  
**About The Role**
We're looking for a Senior Associate to join our Credit Analytics team, taking ownership of detailed loan analysis across sectors and geographies. You'll build financial models, draft concise and well-structured credit reports, conduct sensitivity and stress testing, and engage directly with clients to discuss data and analytical frameworks. This is a high-impact role for someone who combines strong financial acumen with sharp communication skills and a genuine curiosity for business and markets.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Conduct detailed analysis of loan opportunities across various sectors and geographies, developing a thorough understanding of each borrower's business and operating environment.
* Draft concise, well-structured credit reports with clear key takeaways for Credit and Risk to review and comment on.
* Build detailed financial models covering transaction details, financial statement analysis, projections, ratio analysis, and credit metrics.
* Conduct sensitivity analysis and stress testing on projections to assess loan serviceability under adverse scenarios.
* Identify deal-specific covenants that can serve as early warning signals for loan monitoring purposes.
* Conduct detailed industry and market studies to understand the operating environment of borrowers.
* Interact with clients to discuss data gaps, inconsistencies, and analytical frameworks; liaise with Debt Directors and other UK stakeholders throughout the credit process.

**YOU'LL BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU HAVE…**

* 5+ years of relevant experience in credit analysis, financial analysis, or a related role within financial services.
* Strong financial analysis skills with a thorough understanding of accounting and financial concepts, including the ability to build and interrogate detailed financial models.
* Proven ability to draft clear, concise, and well-reasoned credit reports for senior stakeholders.
* Strong communication skills with confidence interacting with Debt Directors, clients, and other stakeholders across geographies.
* A proactive, results-driven mindset — curious, flexible, hands-on, and comfortable operating at pace in an environment where change is part of daily work.

**Nice to Have**

* MBA, PGDM, CA, or CFA from a reputed institute.
* Experience conducting industry or market studies across multiple sectors.
* Prior exposure to covenant structuring or loan monitoring frameworks.

**What We Offer**

* Health & Protection: Comprehensive medical cover for you, your family, and parents, along with life and accidental insurance cover at a multiple of your salary.
* Wellbeing: Annual health check-ups, online doctor consultations, pharmacy discounts, nutritionist support, and Employee Assistance Program (EAP) services — all sponsored by OakNorth.
* Time Off: Earned leave, casual/sick leave, public holidays, maternity leave, and paternity leave.
* Life Milestones: Financial support for important life events such as marriage, childbirth, and bereavement.
* Flexible Benefits: Tax-efficient allowances for internet, fuel, meals, leave travel, and National Pension System (NPS) contributions.
* Growth & Development: Support for professional certifications, learning and development opportunities, childcare benefits, and paid volunteering days.
* Our Workplace: Modern, centrally located offices, weekly business updates, team events, and great coffee. We work hard to build a culture worth showing up for.

title: Specialist, Product Management - Data Analytics
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Specialist, Product Management - Data Analytics
  
  
Overview –
  
  
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry, committed to driving innovation and advancing financial inclusion. Within Mastercard, Services provides advanced analytics, consulting, and digital solutions that help businesses, financial institutions, and governments make data-driven decisions.
  
  
Business & Market Insights (B&MI), a key part of Services, empowers organizations with differentiated data assets, analytics solutions, and advisory capabilities that enable confident decision-making and better business outcomes. Through partnerships with financial institutions, merchants, public sector organizations, and other stakeholders, B&MI delivers market intelligence, customer insights, and innovative solutions that accelerate growth.
  
  
The centralized Capabilities & Data (C&D) organization brings together foundational data, analytics, AI, data science, and platform engineering capabilities to accelerate B&MI's Vision. C&D provides the common data, analytical, and platform foundations that enable product teams to develop, scale, and enhance data-driven solutions more efficiently.
  
  
Role –
  
  
As part of Capabilities and Data (C&D) Team, you will support the development and enhancement of B&MI products by delivering analytical insights, data solutions, and operational support. Working closely with Product Management, Data Science, Engineering, and other cross-functional teams, you will help translate business requirements into actionable analytics, support product initiatives, and contribute to the development of scalable data capabilities that drive product innovation and client value.
  
  

* Support the development and enhancement of product features by providing analytical insights aligned to client needs, business objectives, and market trends.
* Analyze transaction, merchant, consumer, and market datasets to generate actionable insights that improve product capabilities and business outcomes.
* Assist in addressing client queries and support product adoption through data-driven recommendations and analytical expertise.
* Collaborate with Product, Data Science, Engineering, Sales, and Consulting teams to execute product initiatives and deliver business value.
* Develop and implement analytical models, statistical solutions, reporting frameworks, and dashboards to address business challenges and support decision-making.
* Support the validation, optimization, deployment, and operationalization of analytical models and data-driven solutions.
* Ensure the accuracy, consistency, reliability, and quality of data assets, analytical outputs, and product deliverables.
* Monitor industry trends, emerging analytical techniques, and competitor offerings to identify opportunities for product innovation and improvement.
* Document analytical methodologies, processes, and best practices to support transparency, scalability, and knowledge sharing.
* Independently execute assigned analytical projects and initiatives, contributing to continuous improvement and the growth of shared data and analytics capabilities across B&MI.

**All About You –**

* Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in technology, data analytics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Analytical Expertise: Proven ability to conduct data analysis to support product strategy, commercial decisions, and business growth.
* Industry Knowledge: Experience in analytics solutions for payments, financial services, or related industries is preferred.
* Technical Skills: Proficiency in SQL, Python, Hadoop, Excel, Tableau, and other analytics tools, with experience handling large datasets. Experience on AI tools is a plus.
* Strategic Problem-Solving: Strong analytical mindset to break down complex and ambiguous problems into actionable insights.
* Project Management: Ability to manage multiple initiatives, prioritize competing tasks, and drive end-to-end execution in a cross-functional environment.
* Collaboration & Communication: Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to clearly articulate problem statements, insights, and opportunities to both internal and external partners.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
The DGM – Analytics leads the analytics function end to end: a team of analysts, the partnership with business and leadership, and the search for where the business can grow next. This is a senior, high-visibility role for someone who can shape strategy at the leadership table and still go deep on the data when needed.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Team leadership**

* Lead, mentor and grow a team of analysts; set clear goals, review work quality and build a strong talent pipeline.
* Define the team's operating rhythm: prioritization, project intake, review standards and documentation.
* Develop analysts' technical depth and business thinking through coaching, feedback and stretch assignments.

**Stakeholder management and leadership partnership**

* Act as the primary analytics partner to business heads and senior leadership, translating business questions into analytical problems.
* Present insights, recommendations and trade-offs to leadership in clear, decision-ready form.
* Manage expectations, timelines and competing priorities across multiple stakeholders.

**Gap identification and business scaling**

* Proactively diagnose gaps in performance, processes, funnels, customer experience and data availability.
* Identify and size opportunities to scale the business, such as new segments, channels, products, pricing levers and efficiency gains.
* Turn findings into prioritized action plans with owners, metrics and expected impact, and track them to closure.

**Analytics strategy and governance**

* Own the analytics roadmap and align it with business goals.
* Establish KPI frameworks, dashboards and single sources of truth for decision-making.
* Drive data quality, governance and adoption of self-serve analytics across the organization.

**Hands-on delivery**

* Work independently on complex analyses, from framing the problem and querying data to modelling and storytelling, without waiting for direction.
* Guide the use of advanced techniques (statistical modelling, forecasting, segmentation, experimentation, ML where it adds value).
* Evaluate and introduce tools, automation and best practices that raise the team's productivity.

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics or a related field; an MBA or master's in a quantitative discipline is preferred.
* 6–8 years of experience in analytics, business intelligence or data science, with a prior experience of leading teams of analysts.
* Proven track record of partnering with senior leadership and influencing business decisions with data.
* Demonstrated impact: examples of growth, revenue, cost or efficiency gains driven by analytics.
* Experience in fintech is an advantage.

**Skills and Competencies**

**Technical**

* Strong command of SQL and at least one analytics language (Python or R); able to build and review hands-on analyses.
* Expertise in BI and visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker or similar).
* Solid grounding in statistics, forecasting, experimentation and predictive modelling.
* Familiarity with data warehouses, cloud platforms and modern data stacks.

title: Transaction Monitoring analytics - AVP
description:
At Barclays, we don’t just adapt to the future – we shape it. Embark on a transformative journey as a Transaction Monitoring analytics - AVP, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our team.
  
  
**To be successful as a Transaction Monitoring analytics - AVP, you should have experience with**
:
  
  
  

* Ability to solve problems logically and/or creatively, demonstrating professional judgment, quality control and adherence to high standards.
* Experience in utilizing analytical tools for data exploration, analysis and visualization, including certain coding ability and experience on SQL, Scala / Spark / Python.
* Databases, structured and unstructured data.
* Some experience in development of data visualizations/dashboards.
* Understanding of Data Management & Model Validation principles and controls.
* Relevant qualifications in data analytics and technical field, with strong organizational skills.
* Understanding with Machine Learning, LLM and preferably GenAI.

**Some Good To Have Skills**

* An appreciation of Financial Crime, AML and Transaction Monitoring/detection and the systems/processes, including an understanding of AML and terrorist financing trends and typologies.
* Knowledge of the UK and Global Financial Crime regulatory framework.

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role is based out of DLF Downtown, Gurgaon.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To enable data-driven strategic and operational decision making through extracting actionable insights from large datasets, performing statistical and advanced analytics to uncover trends and patterns, and presenting findings through clear visualisations and reports.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Investigation and analysis of data issues related to quality, lineage, controls, and authoritative source identification, documenting data sources, methodologies, and quality findings with recommendations for improvement.
* Designing and building data pipelines to automate data movement and processing.
* Apply advanced analytical techniques to large datasets to uncover trends and correlations, develop validated logical data models, and translate insights into actionable business recommendations that drive operational and process improvements, leveraging machine learning/AI.
* Through data-driven analysis, translate analytical findings into actionable business recommendations, identifying opportunities for operational and process improvements.
* Design and create interactive dashboards and visual reports using applicable tools and automate reporting processes for regular and ad-hoc stakeholder needs.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Senior Analyst-Data Analytics
description:
**Job Description**
The UMGEA – Global Analytics team is seeking an Analyst for the Field Analytics team. The Analyst will support the build and rollout of scalable merchant intelligence capabilities that help identify actionable opportunities, enable retention and growth initiatives, and inform Client Management and Marketing treatments across GMNS.
  
  
This role will support work across merchant triggers, retention analytics, trigger arbitration, treatment playbooks, and predictive insights. The Analyst will help translate analytical opportunities into clear business actions, supporting the transition of insights and pilots into governed, production-ready capabilities through platforms. The role requires strong analytical problem-solving, attention to detail, execution discipline, and the ability to turn complex data into practical recommendations that can be activated by field, Client Management, and Marketing partners.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Provide analytic and execution support for merchant retention, trigger arbitration, treatment playbooks, and predictive insights that enable GMNS growth initiatives and CLM priorities.
* Analyze merchant performance, spend, engagement, coverage, and behavioral trends to identify early indicators of decline, retention risk, and growth opportunities and support field activation decisions.
* Support the development and scaling of merchant trigger capabilities, including deterministic and predictive triggers that help enable timely, insight-led interventions.
* Help translate analytical pilots and proof-of-concepts into governed, production-ready capabilities through enterprise platforms such as TargetIQ .
* Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to understand business questions, define analytical requirements, and deliver timely, high-quality insights.
* Translate complex data into clear, concise findings, treatment recommendations, and business actions that can be understood and acted upon by partners.
* Support automation and standardization of recurring analytics processes to improve efficiency, reduce operational risk, and increase speed to market.

**Qualifications**

* 2-4 years of relevant experience in analytical domain.
* Intellectual curiosity, attention to detail ability to learn quickly and drive results.
* Ability to drive insights from data, manage multiple projects and drive results in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong collaboration skills with ability to build relationships and challenge the status quo.
* Excellent business writing and presentation skills with the ability to communicate effectively, build relationships and influence at all levels.
* Technical Skills: Familiarity with Google Big Query, SQL, Python, Lumi, PySpark and Tableau.
* Experience in dispute analytics, risk operations, or merchant business preferred.
* Experience in Machine Learning/ Cloud / Gen AI is a plus.

**Academic Background**

* Bachelors in Statistics/Mathematics/Economics/ Engineering/Data Science with relevant experience.
* Post Graduation in Statistics/Mathematics/ Economics/Engineering/Management is a plus.

**About Us**
At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
  
  
As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:
  
  

* Competitive base salaries

* Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need

title: Oliver Wyman - Lead Business Analyst (SQL & Excel) - Hyderabad or Gurugram
description:
**Oliver Wyman's Data and Analytics team is looking to hire a Lead Business Analyst for our Hyderabad or Gurugram office.**
**OW DNA Overview**
The Oliver Wyman DNA is a distinguished center of excellence for business analytics and data analytics within Oliver Wyman. This group leverages data and information to provide business insights to Oliver Wyman consulting teams driving positive outcomes and tangible impact for Oliver Wyman’s clients. The group combines cutting edge data science expertise with core consulting expertise to augment engagement teams with analytical firepower to deliver outstanding results.
  
  
**Role Summary:**
The Lead Business Analyst will own and manage end-to-end analytical delivery across multiple workstream in a project, working closely with global clients and internal stakeholders. This role requires deep business understanding, exceptional analytical thinking, and expert proficiency in SQL and Excel. The Lead Analyst will interpret financial statements, solve complex commercial and operational problems, and guide a team of Analysts and Senior Analysts through structured execution. They will also ensure high-quality delivery, strong governance, and clear communication to senior stakeholders. This is a highly client-facing and leadership-oriented role suited for someone with an entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to work independently
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Team & Delivery Leadership**

* Lead and oversee multiple analytical workstreams in a project, ensuring clear planning, timely execution, and high-quality outputs
* Guide Analysts and Senior Analysts through requirement breakdown, task planning, execution reviews, and capability development
* Allocate and prioritize tasks effectively to ensure seamless delivery across competing timelines
* Review SQL pipelines, Excel models, and analytical frameworks to ensure accuracy, consistency, and adherence to best practices
* Maintain structured governance, documentation, and information flow across all deliverables

**Business & Financial Problem Solving**

* Interpret full financial statements to uncover insights across revenue, cost, margin, and cash flow performance
* Identify cost leakages, working capital inefficiencies, or commercial optimization opportunities using data-driven analysis
* Estimate effort for workstreams, define analytical approaches, and link outputs to measurable business value
* Build analytical frameworks, templates, and reusable assets to drive long-term efficiency and consistency
* Translate ambiguous business questions into clear, structured analytical pathways and problem statements

**Client & Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for global or senior-level clients or internal stakeholders, ensuring clarity of expectations and solution alignment
* Facilitate discussions with diverse stakeholders to gather requirements, refine problem statements, and align on business outcomes
* Communicate insights in a clear, actionable, and business-oriented manner that supports leadership-level decision-making
* Build strong relationships through transparent communication, consistent updates, and proactive problem resolution

**Technical & Process Excellence**

* Ensure all SQL queries, Excel models, and data transformations follow best practices for scalability, performance, and accuracy
* Identify analytical risks, dependencies, data gaps, and potential bottlenecks—designing appropriate mitigation strategies.
* Drive continuous improvements in analytical processes, reporting standards, and efficiency across all projects
* Support the creation of knowledge assets, documentation, and standardized KPI frameworks for use across teams

**Experience & Skills Requirements:**

* Strong leadership capabilities with the ability to guide a team through structured problem-solving and high-quality project execution
* Deep business understanding and the ability to translate data into meaningful insights tied to financial, commercial, and operational performance.
* Advanced ability to read, interpret, and analyze full financial statements (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow), including revenue drivers, cost structure, margins, working capital, and cash cycles
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage directly with senior and global clients
* 6+ years of hands-on SQL and Excel experience (non-negotiable), including advanced query optimization, data modelling logic, and complex calculations
* Strong domain experience in commercial analytics, pricing, supply chain, or operations analytics—preferably within the manufacturing sector.
* Ability to lead teams, allocate tasks, manage workloads, and ensure timely and flawless delivery
* Entrepreneurial mindset with a proactive approach to identifying improvement opportunities, risks, and new solution pathways
* High ownership, discipline, and the ability to work independently while driving continuous improvement across analytical processes

Oliver Wyman is a business of Marsh (NYSE: MRSH), a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit oliverwyman.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.
  
  
Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, caste, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, gender reassignment, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
**Job Title :: Senior Data Analyst**

**Location :: Gurugram, India (Hybrid - 2 to 3 days onsite in a week)**

**Years of Experience :: Relevant 8+ Years**

**Note :: We are only looking for immediate joiner and local to Gurugram or Noida.**

**Job Description:**

We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst. This role is critical to ensuring historical data is accurately transformed and consolidated according to complex business logic.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Data Extraction & Consolidation: Work with CUO Data team to extract datasets from various systems and consolidate information from multiple databases into a unified framework
* Logic Implementation: Understand and apply complex data transformation logic and coding rules to ensure accurate historical data restamping
* Data Manipulation & Enrichment: Develop and execute data manipulation strategies using Excel and programming tools to:

title: Sr Principal, Analyst (Semiconductor Memory – NAND Flash/DRAM)
description:
**About this Role:**
Analysts create must-have insights for our clients through published research and client interaction. You will meet with clients every day: on the phone, in a videoconference, from the stage at a Gartner event, or face-to-face during a sales support visit. In every interaction, you will help clients overcome their challenges and perform better.
  
  
As part of Gartner’s Emerging Market Dynamics Group, you will equip leaders in the semiconductor memory industry with indispensable insights, advice, and tools to achieve their mission-critical priorities and build the successful organizations of tomorrow. You will own the authoritative quantitative view of the global DRAM, HBM and NAND Flash markets and convert supply, demand, pricing and technology signals into decision-useful market intelligence.
  
  
**What You’ll do:**

* Develop and maintain global DRAM, HBM and NAND supply-demand forecasts, including bit growth, wafer capacity, utilization, yields, inventories and pricing.
* Track supplier capacity, capex, technology transitions and competitive positioning across Samsung, SK hynix, Micron, Kioxia, SanDisk and emerging suppliers.
* Forecast market size, revenue, units/bits, ASPs and supplier market share by major memory segment.
* Quantify demand across AI/data center, enterprise storage, PCs, smartphones, automotive and other major applications.
* Track DRAM technology transitions including DDR5, LPDDR and HBM generations, capacity allocation and HBM production economics.
* Track NAND transitions including layer scaling, TLC/QLC mix, enterprise SSD adoption, client SSD and embedded/mobile applications.
* Analyze memory cycles, inventory corrections, pricing inflections and structural supply-demand changes.
* Maintain quarterly market trackers, forecast models, source databases and scenario analysis.
* Provide evidence-based written responses and support VP/market-intelligence-level client conversations.
* Partner with analysts covering AI accelerators, foundry, advanced packaging and storage to quantify cross-market dependencies.
* Identify early indicators that could invalidate the current forecast and proactively revise assumptions and outlooks.
* Actively participate in appropriate Gartner global research communities for formal and in-formal knowledge sharing sessions.

**Core Quantitative Coverage :**
You are capable of modeling and forecasting:
  
  

* DRAM / HBM: wafer capacity and utilization, bit output and bit growth, die density and technology-node transitions, HBM stacks, capacity and GB/device, DDR/LPDDR/HBM mix, supplier market share, contract and spot pricing, revenue and ASP, and AI-server and accelerator-driven memory demand.
* NAND Flash: wafer capacity and utilization, bits/wafer and layer transitions, TLC/QLC mix, bit supply and demand, supplier market share, pricing and revenue, enterprise/client SSD units and capacity, mobile/embedded NAND, and AI-storage demand including RAG, KV-cache and checkpointing use cases.
* Research Boundaries: This role owns the semiconductor memory-market quantitative truth layer. It does not own broad AI accelerator strategy, semiconductor foundry strategy, advanced packaging market strategy, server/storage-system architecture, or the general semiconductor equipment coverage. However, the analyst must quantify how developments in these adjacent markets affect memory demand, supply and economics.

**Job Requirements :**
**What You Will Need**

* Educational Qualification:
* BE/BTech from Grade A engineering colleges with specialization in Electronics, or Semiconductors, or software engineering.
* Graduate + MBA (Marketing or Ops) from leading A & B-schools is desirable.
* Work experience:
* 7-10+ years minimum experience in semiconductor memory, market intelligence, product planning, business planning, forecasting or industry research.
* Domain knowledge/Business Acumen:
* Deep expertise in DRAM and/or NAND Flash, with the ability to develop credible coverage across both.
* Strong understanding of memory manufacturing economics, technology migration, supplier capacity and pricing cycles.
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain quantitative market models and forecasts.
* Experience with memory suppliers, semiconductor market-research firms, OEMs/hyperscalers or relevant supply-chain organizations preferred.
* Awareness of the major issues across the IT, technology, semiconductor and electronics industry affecting software technologies and competitive landscape, and an eagerness to learn more.
* MS Office Tools:
* Ability to design, develop and maintain large Excel models for market share analysis and forecasting, and strong working knowledge of other MS Office tools such as Word and Power Point for writing and presenting analysis.
* Project management skills:
* Ability to manage time, keep projects on schedule and resolve issues and deliver all client deliverables in a timely manner.
* Communication skills:
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex market data into clear implications.
* Written: A strong writing ability is mandatory. Writing efforts will require stating/staking positions, justifying those positions with facts and providing actionable analysis and recommendations.
* Oral: Skills to converse on telephone, face to face, and on-stage, with the ability to explain complex concepts concisely.
* Problem Solving:
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to think creatively, independently, and efficiently to diagnose and contextualize issues, exhibit critical-thinking and problem-solving capabilities, including working on estimation problems and provide insightful and original analysis.
* Interpersonal skills:

title: Manager, Collections Strategy Delivery (L09)
description:
**Job Title: Manager, Collections Strategy Delivery (L09)**
**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
Credit Team decisions credit actions across the lifecycle of a customer – from acquisition to account management to collections and recover – we work towards managing credit and fraud losses and elevating customer experience through powerful and proprietary insights on customer risk and credit behaviors. The actionable insights are driven by access to numerous alternative data sources, new age technologies, focused strategies, emerging algorithms, and predictive precision. Spread across 10 pillars the credit team in India caters to the entire gamut of decision sciences, from data management to model development to strategy design, and bringing it all to life through technology, and managing within the guardrails of our regulatory requirements. As part of the team, you will have access to some unique product propositions, functional and leadership training, interaction with executive leadership team and a myriad of diverse perspectives.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
The
*Manager , Collections Strategy Delivery Build*
role is responsible for implementation of Collection strategies as they relate to Pre-Delinquent, Delinquent (pre-charge off) & Recovery accounts utilizing SAS, Experian Power Curve (Strategy Manager) and Fiserv Rules. The Analyst leads solution development with build team, direct manager and change requestor for new projects, new clients and Strategy Change Initiatives within Strategy Delivery Team. Analysis of collection strategies and development/ enhancement of Phone and Alternate channel implementation processes are key elements to the success of the Strategy Delivery Team. Participates on multiple initiatives as Build SME for SAS, Strategy Manager application and Fiserv Rules Platform. As a Manager, you are required to be proficient in handing projects and engaging with stakeholders independently.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Implements Collections and Operational Strategy initiatives for all delinquent accounts and Strategy designated Pre-Delinquent & Recovery accounts leveraging leading edge technology to enhance customer experience.
* Partner with collections contact strategy team, collection operations and process owners to determine strategy implementation requirements and develop / ensure streamlined approaches to coding, unit testing and queuing process
* Works independently to provide Level of Effort for scoping and scheduling the change requests
* Project Manager / SME for collections projects involving Alternate channel strategies (SAS) and Phone channel strategies (Strategy manager processes)
* Provides recommendations for process enhancements based upon Design Reviews
* Develop and monitor dashboards including analysis, action plans and identification of process improvements support simplification strategies including life-cycle tools and treatments specific to champion/challenger strategies that include digital channels, and other outbound correspondence
* Partners with process owners in establishing procedures and requirements to ensure accurate and timely delivery with regulatory and compliance standards
* Partners with Collections Data Warehouse team and Enterprise Data Lake teams for issue resolution
* Provide account level research for understanding of Collection processing
* Work independently with minimum to moderate supervision
* Perform other duties and/or special projects as assigned

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor’s degree with 2 + years of experience, or in lieu of a degree 4 + years of relevant work experience
* Minimum 2 + years of hands-on experience with SAS or knowledge of SAS programming
* Minimum 2 + years of experience with design, test and control environments working with large amounts of data
* Minimum 1+ years analytical and decision-making experience.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* 1 year of experience with FISERV/FD Rules/ Strategy Manager Development (batch mode)
* 1 year of Project Management Experience
* Ability to effectively prioritize and manage multiple projects concurrently with commitment to deadlines.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate and present business results to management

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Bachelor’s degree with 2 + years of experience, or in lieu of a degree 4 + years of relevant work experience

**Work Timings: 02:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST**
(WORK TIMINGS: This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.
  
  
**For Internal Applicants**

* Inform your manager and HRM before applying for any role on Workday

* L8+ Employees who have completed 18 months in the organization and 12 months in their current role and level are only eligible

**Role Purpose**
We monitor key events and conduct research to produce thought-provoking reports, data models, and presentations. From asset valuation to corporate reports, from market supply-demand research to price-forecasting, and from the regional to the global, our analysis helps shape our customers’ commercial strategies.
  
  
We also support bespoke consulting projects, diving deeper into our data to answer unique questions. We help our Sales team retain and win new business by spending time with customers and answering questions that matter to them. We work closely with colleagues in our Data and Product functions to maintain the quality of our published data and to deliver content via our
**growing Lens platform**
**.**
Through carrying out primary research, responding to customer questions, and presenting to industry stakeholders, you will build relationships and a network of contacts at key operators, national bodies, and other relevant institutions. Over time you will gain specialist knowledge and develop the skills you require to progress your career at Wood Mackenzie.
  
  
**Main Responsibilities**
We are looking for a Research Associate to join our team and cover Metals and Mining (M&M) research practice within the Commodities Global Analyst Team, based in Gurugram or Mumbai, India. As a member of our Metals and Mining team, you will contribute to our Iron Ore and Steel asset/cost research.
  
  
Your application should showcase your enthusiasm for the sectors we cover and demonstrate your ability in the following areas, which we require daily at Wood Mackenzie.
  
  

* Research and data gathering – we identify and gather intelligence that feeds our industry expertise. We need inquisitive and passionate people with a keen eye for detail. Read and analyse company reports to find mine-level operational and cost datasets.
* Analysis – we provide market-leading research using this data/intelligence and form opinions for and tell stories to our customers. We need people with natural curiosity with the potential to become experts in their field and with the ability to articulate – both verbally and in writing – clear, insightful analysis.
* Internal engagement – we work with global colleagues across the Wood Mackenzie business to deliver a compelling, integrated view of the commodities sector to customers through our cutting-edge products. For this, we need people who are as comfortable working collaboratively as they are independently and who have excellent interpersonal skills.
* External engagement – we proactively connect with our customers and contacts in the industries we serve, adding value and promoting the Wood Mackenzie brand. This requires people with the potential to become industry experts who have intellectual curiosity, passion, and excellent presentation skills.
* Leadership/ Improvement – at Wood Mackenzie, we are committed to transforming the way we power our planet. The energy transition is here, and this impacts our customer base and how we serve them. We need colleagues with a change mindset, who are flexible, growth-orientated and proactive.

**About You**
You are passionate about the dynamics of the metals and mining assets, with a particular interest in iron ore and steel. You bring relevant experience, skills, or knowledge that will allow you to contribute meaningfully from day one. Your curiosity and analytical mindset will help deepen our understanding of iron ore and steel assets and strengthen our global research coverage.
  
  

* Asset Analysis - as someone with an interest in steel and iron ore sector dynamics, you want to understand how these mining assets impact the natural resources industry. You will analyse mine production, reserves, cost and operational outlook trends across global assets. Your insights will contribute to regular research publications and working as part of a global team. This will include conducting asset valuations, updating asset reports, cost curves, cost models, and pricing analysis for iron ore and steel assets.
* Data Interpretation & Insight Generation - You possess an analytical mindset and a keen eye for detail. You are comfortable working with large datasets, interpreting trends, and articulating findings clearly in asset reports. You will contribute to the development and maintenance of datasets, data models, methodologies and other intellectual property supporting our M&M research and products. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint is essential for presenting your analysis in a visually engaging manner.
* Collaboration & Adaptability - You will be expected to operate autonomously while collaborating effectively across geographically dispersed teams. As you develop in the role, you will build deeper expertise across metals & mining assets and markets while strengthening your capabilities in research, data analysis, modelling, market intelligence, written and verbal communication, and client engagement.
* Communication & Client Engagement - The role will also involve supporting client engagement by responding to client enquiries and ad hoc requests, participating in client discussions and presentations, and helping communicate Wood Mackenzie’s views and insights to customers and prospects. Through research trips, industry events and client interactions, you will develop an understanding of the key topics and challenges facing the metals & mining industry and incorporate these perspectives into our research.

**Expectations**

* Growth mindset - taking the initiative to learn new skills, seeking out feedback and actively applying what has been learned in the workplace.
* Change agility - maintaining high performance through disruption and change.
* We are a hybrid working company and the successful applicant will be expected to be physically present in the office at least 2 days per week to foster and contribute to a collaborative environment. This is subject to change per company policy.
* This is a full-time role.

**Preferred Skills & Experience**

* Background in mining, energy, economics, or related disciplines
* Experience with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint
* Prior exposure to commodity markets or consulting environments is advantageous

and we welcome applications from a range of academic or professional backgrounds.

title: Manager - FP&A
description:
Job Purpose

To support the organization's financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis activities. The role will be responsible for generating actionable financial insights, monitoring business performance, evaluating profitability, and supporting management in strategic and operational decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

1. Financial Planning, Budgeting & Forecasting

* Support the preparation and execution of the Annual Operating Plan (AOP), annual budgets, and capital expenditure budgets.
* Prepare and monitor monthly and quarterly financial forecasts.
* Develop financial models and scenario analyses to support business planning and investment decisions.
* Analyze financial performance against budgets and forecasts and identify areas requiring corrective action.

2. Financial Analysis & Business Partnering

* Work closely with business and functional teams to understand financial performance and operational requirements.
* Analyze product, business segment, and cost profitability to identify opportunities for margin improvement.
* Conduct financial feasibility, ROI, and NPV analyses for business initiatives and capital investments.
* Provide financial insights to support business decisions and improve overall financial performance

3. MIS & Management Reporting

* Prepare monthly MIS reports, management dashboards, and financial performance summaries.
* Conduct variance analysis of actual performance against budget and forecasts.
* Track key financial and operational performance indicators.
* Present relevant financial insights and recommendations to management.

4. Process Improvement & Reporting

* Identify opportunities to improve financial reporting, budgeting, and forecasting processes.
* Support automation of reports and enhance data accuracy and reporting efficiency.
* Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to ensure timely availability and accuracy of financial information.

Educational Qualification

* Chartered Accountant (CA) – Mandatory.

Experience

* 3–7 years of relevant experience in FP&A, financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, or financial analysis.
* Prior experience in a
  **manufacturing organization is mandatory**
  .

Technical Skills

* Strong financial modelling and analytical skills.
* Advanced proficiency in MS Excel.
* Working knowledge of SAP and financial planning/reporting tools.
* Experience in MIS reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.
* Strong understanding of financial statements, cost analysis, and profitability metrics.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Candidates currently based in Delhi NCR only.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to work with cross-functional stakeholders and manage multiple priorities.
* A data-driven approach with a strong focus on accuracy and business performance.

title: AVP - CRE- Credit Analytics
description:
OAKNORTH
  
  

* JOB ADVERT

**Associate Vice President – Commercial Real Estate Credit Analysis**
Credit
  
  

* Portfolio Monitoring & Credit Analytics

📍 India | 🕐 Full-time | 🏢 Hybrid | 🎯 Associate Vice President
  
  
**About Us**
At OakNorth, we’re on a mission to empower ambitious businesses and the communities they serve. Since 2015, we’ve lent over $21 billion across the UK and US, helped create more than 58,000 new homes and 36,000 new jobs, and supported hundreds of thousands of personal savers — all while driving economic growth in the markets we serve.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Credit Analytics team sits at the heart of OakNorth’s lending business, delivering rigorous financial and credit analysis across a diverse portfolio of commercial loan opportunities. Our CRE specialists work closely with Debt Directors, Risk, and client-facing teams in the UK and US to ensure every real estate lending decision is underpinned by deep sector knowledge, robust financial modelling, and a thorough understanding of the borrower’s operating environment.
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re looking for an Associate Vice President to join our Credit Analytics team, specialising in Commercial Real Estate lending across the UK and US. You’ll conduct detailed analysis of loan opportunities spanning major property types — Residential, Office, Retail, Industrial, Lodging, and Healthcare — building financial models, drafting credit reports, and engaging directly with clients and stakeholders throughout the credit process. This is a high-impact role for someone who combines deep CRE expertise with strong financial acumen and a sharp, clear communication style.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Conduct detailed analysis of loan opportunities across all major CRE property types — Residential, Office, Retail, Industrial, Lodging, and Healthcare — in the UK and/or US.
* Draft concise, well-structured credit reports with clear key takeaways for Credit and Risk to review and comment on.
* Build detailed financial models covering transaction details, financial statement analysis, projections, ratio analysis, and credit metrics.
* Conduct sensitivity analysis and stress testing on projections to assess loan serviceability under adverse scenarios.
* Identify deal-specific covenants that can serve as early warning signals for loan monitoring purposes.
* Conduct detailed industry and market studies to understand the operating environment of borrowers.
* Review and evaluate third-party reports including property appraisals, valuation reports, and cost budgets; interpret and analyse rent rolls, operating statements, and lease schedules.
* Interact with clients to discuss data gaps, inconsistencies, and analytical frameworks; liaise with Debt Directors and other stakeholders throughout the credit process.

**YOU’LL BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU HAVE…**

* 5–8 years of relevant experience in credit analysis, CRE finance, or a related role within financial services.
* Strong financial analysis skills with a thorough understanding of accounting and financial concepts, including the ability to build and interrogate detailed financial models.
* Strong understanding of Commercial Real Estate, including proficiency in interpreting rent rolls, operating statements, lease schedules, and third-party valuation and appraisal reports.
* Proven ability to draft clear, concise, and well-reasoned credit reports for senior stakeholders.
* Strong communication skills with confidence interacting with Debt Directors, clients, and stakeholders across geographies.
* A proactive, results-driven mindset — curious, flexible, hands-on, and comfortable operating at pace in an environment where change is part of daily work.

**Nice to Have**

* MBA, PGDM, CA, or CFA from a reputed institute.
* Experience across both UK and US CRE markets.
* Prior exposure to covenant structuring or loan monitoring frameworks.
* Familiarity with cost budget review and construction lending analysis.

**What We Offer**

* Health & Protection: Comprehensive medical cover for you, your family, and parents, along with life and accidental insurance cover at a multiple of your salary.
* Wellbeing: Annual health check-ups, online doctor consultations, pharmacy discounts, nutritionist support, and Employee Assistance Program (EAP) services — all sponsored by OakNorth.
* Time Off: Earned leave, casual/sick leave, public holidays, maternity leave, and paternity leave.
* Life Milestones: Financial support for important life events such as marriage, childbirth, and bereavement.
* Flexible Benefits: Tax-efficient allowances for internet, fuel, meals, leave travel, and National Pension System (NPS) contributions.
* Growth & Development: Support for professional certifications, learning and development opportunities, childcare benefits, and paid volunteering days.
* Our Workplace: Modern, centrally located offices, weekly business updates, team events, and great coffee. We work hard to build a culture worth showing up for.

We are seeking a skilled Data Analyst who has a strong foundation in data analytics, experience working with large datasets, and expertise in analysing operational performance and business metrics. A good understanding of analytics, insight and visualization tools and techniques will be preferred to generate key data storytelling and communication to stakeholders. Skills & Experience Essential skills and experience - minimum criteria Education: Bachelor’s degree (any) Experience: 3+ years of experience in data analysis, preferably within a BPM, or voice process environment. Proven experience in analyzing operational metrics Technical Skills: Proficiency in data analytics tools and platforms such as SQL , Excel
  
  

* Experience with scientific analytics tools like Python , R , or SAS for statistical analysis and model development. Competent with data visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI
* Knowledge of statistical techniques, including regression analysis, hypothesis testing, clustering, and machine learning. Familiarity with natural language processing (NLP) techniques and tools for analyzing voice data. Soft Skills: Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills. Ability to communicate complex data insights clearly and effectively to non-technical stakeholders both verbally and through presentations. Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously. Advanced degree or certification in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or related fields is a plus
* Experience and knowhow in the travel industry and/ or a voice environment is a plus
* Responsibilities Data Collection and Analysis: Gather, clean, and analyze data from various sources, including performance metrics, customer satisfaction (CSAT) scores, and operational KPIs. Develop efficient ways of managing and storing large data sets Work with different stakeholders to ensure the data is accurate, accessible, and aligned with business goals. Conduct exploratory data analysis (EDA) to uncover trends, patterns, and insights in voice process operations. Evaluate call volumes, average handling times (AHT), first call resolution (FCR), and other non-voice metrics to identify operational gaps. Familiarity with natural language processing (NLP) techniques and tools for analyzing voice data. Work with predictive models to forecast call volumes, staffing needs, AHTs and potential customer outcomes based on historical data. Optimization: Collaborate with operations managers, SMEs, quality teams, WFM and other stakeholders to implement data-driven strategies for improving processes and enhancing customer service. Use data to drive decisions related to process automation, resource allocation, and quality improvements. Stakeholder Collaboration: Present and communicate complex data findings in a clear, concise and actionable manner to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Craft presentations with clear and powerful messages and cohesive story telling Continuous Improvement: Monitor and track the relevance, impact and feedback of previous insights and continuously refine data models, metrics, and reporting strategies to support ongoing process optimization. title: Vendor Management Operations Analyst
description:
The Vendor Management Office (VMO) is a brand-new function designed to provide oversight of vendors by managing key relationships, ensuring optimal performance, ensuring compliance with contracts, and aligning with AXA XL's strategic goals.
  
  
This role is critical in ensuring that AXA maintains a resilient vendor ecosystem while strategically leveraging vendor partnerships to drive innovation and operational excellence.
  
  
What you’ll be doing
  
  
What will your essential responsibilities include?
  
  

* Collect and consolidate vendor performance data against contractual obligations, service levels, and agreed Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
* Maintain performance trackers, dashboards, action logs, and supporting documentation, ensuring information is accurate and up to date.
* Follow up with internal stakeholders and vendors to obtain missing data, status updates, and evidence required for performance reviews.
* Identify and flag missed targets, recurring issues, overdue actions, and data inconsistencies to the Vendor Manager or relevant contract owner.
* Prepare standard performance reports and meeting materials using agreed templates.
* Record decisions and actions from performance review meetings and track them through to completion.
* Support the maintenance of contract performance records and contribute to periodic reporting for the Vendor Management Office.

You will report to Head of Vendor Management Office.
  
  
What you’ll bring
  
  
We’re looking for someone who has these abilities and skills:
  
  
**Required Skills And Abilities**

* Bachelor’s degree or relevant experience in business, procurement, supply chain, finance, data analysis, or a related field.
* Relevant years of experience, including internships or entry-level work in vendor management, procurement, contract administration, operations, or reporting.
* Basic understanding of contracts and the ability to interpret key terms, obligations, service levels, and performance requirements.
* Good numerical and analytical skills, with attention to detail and the ability to identify gaps or inconsistencies in data.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience with dashboards or reporting tools is an advantage.
* Robust organizational skills and the ability to maintain trackers, documentation, and action logs accurately.

**Desired Skills And Abilities**

* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with confidence following up on information and working with multiple stakeholders.
* Experience using and Capably navigating tools used to track and report KPIs.
* An interest in contract performance, supplier management, and service-level reporting.

What we offer
  
  
**Inclusion**
AXA XL is committed to equal employment opportunity and will consider applicants regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, ethnicity and origins, marital status, religion, disability, or any other protected characteristic. At AXA XL, we know that an inclusive culture and enables business growth and is critical to our success. That’s why we have made a strategic commitment to attract, develop, advance and retain the most inclusive workforce possible, and create a culture where everyone can bring their full selves to work and reach their highest potential.
*It’s about helping one another — and our business — to move forward and succeed.*

* Five Business Resource Groups focused on gender, LGBTQ+, ethnicity and origins, disability and inclusion with 20 Chapters around the globe.
* Robust support for Flexible Working Arrangements
* Enhanced family-friendly leave benefits
* Named to the Diversity Best Practices Index
* Signatory to the UK Women in Finance Charter

Learn more at axaxl.com/about-us/inclusion-and-diversity. AXA XL is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
  
  
**Total Rewards**
AXA XL’s Reward program is designed to take care of what matters most to you, covering the full picture of your health, wellbeing, lifestyle and financial security. It provides competitive compensation and personalized, inclusive benefits that evolve as you do.
  
  
We’re committed to rewarding your contribution for the long term, so you can be your best self today and look forward to the future with confidence.
  
  
**Sustainability**
At AXA XL, Sustainability is integral to our business strategy. In an ever-changing world, AXA XL protects what matters most for our clients and communities. We know that sustainability is at the root of a more resilient future. Our 2023-26 Sustainability strategy, called “Roots of resilience”, focuses on protecting natural ecosystems, addressing climate change, and embedding sustainable practices across our operations.
  
  
**Our Pillars**

* Valuing nature: How we impact nature affects how nature impacts us. Resilient ecosystems - the foundation of a sustainable planet and society – are essential to our future. We’re committed to protecting and restoring nature – from mangrove forests to the bees in our backyard – by increasing biodiversity awareness and inspiring clients and colleagues to put nature at the heart of their plans.
* Addressing climate change: The effects of a changing climate are far-reaching and significant. Unpredictable weather, increasing temperatures, and rising sea levels cause both social inequalities and environmental disruption. We're building a net zero strategy, developing insurance products and services, and mobilizing to advance thought leadership and investment in societal-led solutions.
* Integrating ESG: All companies have a role to play in building a more resilient future. Incorporating ESG considerations into our internal processes and practices builds resilience from the roots of our business. We’re training our colleagues, engaging our external partners, and evolving our sustainability governance and reporting.
* AXA Hearts in Action: We have established volunteering and charitable giving programs to help colleagues support causes that matter most to them, known as AXA XL’s “Hearts in Action” programs. These include our Matching Gifts program, Volunteering Leave, and our annual volunteering day – the Global Day of Giving.

For more information, please see axaxl.com/sustainability.
  
  
Who we are
  
  
AXA XL, the P&C and specialty risk division of AXA, is known for solving complex risks. For mid-sized companies, multinationals and even some inspirational individuals we don’t just provide re/insurance, we reinvent it.
  
  
How? By combining a comprehensive and efficient capital platform, data-driven insights, leading technology, and the best talent in an agile and inclusive workspace, empowered to deliver top client service across all our lines of business − property, casualty, professional, financial lines and specialty.
  
  
With an innovative and flexible approach to risk solutions, we partner with those who move the world forward.
  
  
Learn more at axaxl.com.

Role

* Identify emerging trends, shifting consumer behaviors, and evolving customer needs to inform strategic and creative development.
* Present insights, findings, and recommendations to internal teams and clients in a clear, compelling, and actionable manner.
* Explore emerging tools, methodologies, and data sources to enhance ACD's strategic capabilities and insight development.

**All About You**

* 8+ years of experience in data strategy, consumer insights, or marketing analytics roles within advertising agencies, preferably full-service network agencies.
* Proven ability to translate data, research, and customer insights into strategic recommendations, creative opportunities, and measurable business outcomes.
* Strong understanding of brand, marketing, communications, customer, and campaign effectiveness frameworks.
* Experience working closely with strategy, creative, and client teams to develop insight-led campaigns, experiences, and engagement programs.
* Ability to synthesize complex quantitative and qualitative data into clear, actionable, and compelling narratives.
* Strong storytelling and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate insights effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience using consumer and audience intelligence platforms such as YouGov, GWI, TGI, or similar tools to uncover customer, category, and market insights.

Proficiency in data visualization and analytics platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or equivalent tools.
  
  

* Familiarity with digital, social, CRM, customer, and campaign measurement frameworks, methodologies, and analytics tools.
* Knowledge of AI-powered analytics, audience intelligence, and emerging data capabilities is a plus.
* Strong stakeholder management, collaboration, and consulting skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Professional proficiency in English is required

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Business Strategy Analyst
description:
**Business Strategy Analyst**

**Zavya | Gurugram | Full-Time | Work From Office**

**Experience:**
1–3 years

**Education:**
Premier engineering or management institutes preferred; MBA is an advantage.

**The Role**

**No playbook. No hand-holding. Real problems. Real ownership.**

We're looking for an exceptionally sharp, ambitious, and AI-first problem solver to work directly with the business leadership and co-founders at Zavya.

This is not a conventional business analyst role.

You won't be handed perfectly defined problems, detailed instructions, or established frameworks to follow.

Instead, you'll be expected to identify what needs fixing, question why things work the way they do, develop solutions, and take ownership of getting them implemented.

We're looking for someone who combines
**first-principles thinking, intellectual curiosity, technological fluency, and an exceptional bias for action.**

Someone who can think strategically, move independently, challenge assumptions, and build solutions rather than just recommend them.

**What You'll Be Doing**

**1. Solve Unstructured Business Problems**

* Work directly with leadership to identify business bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and growth opportunities.
* Break down ambiguous problems using first-principles thinking, data, and structured reasoning.
* Move from problem identification to diagnosis, solution design, and execution.

**2. Build an AI-First Business**

* Identify opportunities to apply AI, automation, and emerging technologies across functions.
* Build practical AI-powered workflows, analytical tools, and automations that improve productivity and business outcomes.
* Experiment with tools, prototype solutions, and implement what works.
* Challenge processes that exist simply because
  *that's how they've always been done.*

**3. Drive High-Impact Strategic Initiatives**

* Own special projects spanning revenue growth, profitability, business operations, and customer experience.
* Work cross-functionally to drive initiatives from concept to measurable results.
* Identify opportunities proactively rather than waiting for projects to be assigned.

**4. Turn Data Into Decisions**

* Analyze business performance, identify patterns, and uncover underlying drivers.
* Translate complex data into clear business insights and actionable recommendations.
* Build scalable decision-making frameworks rather than repetitive manual reports.

**Who We're Looking For**

**We care less about how many years you've worked and more about how you think, what you've built, and what you've owned.**

* **Academic foundation:**

  Uses AI extensively to research, analyze, automate, prototype, and execute. Has actually built something useful with AI.
* **High agency:**
  Doesn't wait to be told what to do. Identifies problems, proposes solutions, and drives them forward.
* **Fearless communicator:**
  Comfortable questioning conventional approaches, defending ideas with evidence, and engaging directly with senior leadership.
* **Analytical horsepower:**
  Strong quantitative reasoning, commercial understanding, and comfort working with data.
* **Bias for execution:**
  Values outcomes over presentations, experiments over endless discussions, and progress over perfection.
* **Learning velocity:**
  Can quickly understand unfamiliar industries, tools, and business problems.

**What You'll Get**

* **Direct exposure:**
  Work closely with business leadership and co-founders on consequential business decisions.
* **End-to-end ownership:**
  Take initiatives from problem identification through execution.
* **Freedom to experiment:**
  Challenge traditional processes and build better ways of working.
* **Cross-functional learning:**
  Work across growth, commerce, operations, technology, and strategic initiatives.
* **Accelerated responsibility:**
  Your scope will grow with your ability to deliver, not merely your tenure.

**Before You Apply**

This role is for people who are comfortable being uncomfortable.

You should enjoy solving problems without predefined answers, challenging established thinking, learning new technologies independently, and being accountable for outcomes.

title: Health Informatics Analyst
description:
**Health Informatics Analyst (AI Training)**
**About The Role**
We're looking for experienced Health Informatics Analysts to bring their clinical data expertise to cutting-edge AI development. At Alignerr, we partner with the world's leading AI research labs — and your deep knowledge of EHR systems, healthcare workflows, and data analysis will directly shape how AI understands and navigates the healthcare domain.
  
  
This is a unique opportunity to apply your professional background in a flexible, remote freelance capacity while contributing to AI that could transform how healthcare information is processed and understood.
  
  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

**What You'll Do**

* Analyze and interpret healthcare and EHR data to identify trends, gaps, and opportunities for improvement
* Evaluate AI-generated outputs related to clinical workflows, health information systems, and healthcare data pipelines for accuracy and quality
* Review and assess the correctness of AI responses to health informatics prompts, flagging errors, inconsistencies, or clinically unsafe recommendations
* Prepare structured feedback, ratings, and recommendations to help AI systems learn from real-world healthcare expertise
* Apply your knowledge of clinical and operational workflows to ensure AI outputs reflect accurate, real-world practice

**Who You Are**

* Hands-on experience working with healthcare data, EHR systems, or clinical reporting platforms
* Strong analytical skills including data interpretation, trend analysis, and reporting
* Ability to assess complex health information and communicate findings clearly
* Comfortable working independently and asynchronously on task-based assignments
* Detail-oriented, reliable, and thorough in your evaluations

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with data annotation, data quality review, or evaluation frameworks
* Familiarity with health data standards such as HL7, FHIR, or ICD coding
* Background in clinical informatics, health IT, or population health analytics
* Prior exposure to AI tools or machine learning workflows

**Why Join Us**

* Work on meaningful AI projects with top-tier research labs and teams
* Fully remote and flexible — work on your own schedule, from anywhere
* Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and global collaboration
* Put your specialized healthcare expertise to work in a high-impact, emerging field
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension

description:
