title: AI Benchmark & Red-Teaming Specialist
description:
**About Turing:**
Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

**Role Overview:**

We are seeking an analytical researcher and red-teaming specialist to build evidence-based web-research benchmark tasks that reliably expose weaknesses in state-of-the-art (SOTA) AI models (e.g., Claude Opus 5 Max). In this role, you will discover hard-to-surface facts, build precise research tasks around them, test them directly against leading LLMs, and diagnose the exact failure mechanisms in the model's search and reasoning paths.

Your work will directly shape AI evaluation frameworks, ensuring next-generation frontier models are tested against rigorous, non-trivial real-world research scenarios.

**Job Requirements:**

* **Core Experience:**
  1+ years in investigative research, fact-checking, AI benchmark task authoring, red-teaming, or technical QA review.
* **Benchmark Familiarity:**
  Proven experience authoring, testing, or reviewing tasks for AI benchmarks such as
  **GAIA, BrowseComp, SimpleQA, SWE-bench, Terminal-Bench, or Humanity’s Last Exam (HLE)**
  .
* **Analytical & OSINT Skills:**
  Intermediate-to-advanced web search and Open Source Intelligence (OSINT) skills; ability to navigate academic archives, local records, or obscure databases.
* **Model Trajectory Debugging:**
  Strong analytical capability to inspect model reasoning chains, search logs, and source selection to diagnose root causes of failure.
* **Precision Writing:**
  Ability to author clear, unambiguous benchmark prompts with bulletproof, primary-sourced answer keys.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* **Obscure Fact Discovery:**
  Deeply research niche topics to identify factual ground truths that cannot be surfaced via simple, direct search queries.
* **Source Verification:**
  Rigorously verify facts against primary or highly credible sources, cross-check for contradictory evidence, and document exact source URLs.
* **Task Construction:**
  Draft clear, answerable benchmark tasks designed specifically to expose structural weaknesses in model research strategies.
* **Red-Teaming & Model Testing:**
  Execute tasks against designated SOTA models to confirm they reliably trigger intended model failures.
* **Failure Diagnosis & Debugging:**
  Trace model run logs, search trajectories, and intermediate outputs to pinpoint exactly where and why the model failed (distinguishing genuine model limitations from ambiguous prompts).
* **Pattern Scaling & Review:**
  Apply validated "model-breaking" research patterns across new domains and, for strong performers, review tasks authored by peer trainers.
  **Strong Plus (Preferred Qualifications)**
* Bachelor or higher degree from relevant engineering domain is a must for this position.
* Prior experience specifically designing prompt-injection or reasoning-trap tasks that break SOTA models.
* Advanced OSINT capabilities or published investigative/academic research demonstrating deep source verification.
* Niche domain expertise in areas rich with hard-to-find records (e.g., local government filings, regional sports history, legal archives, historical patents).
* Experience serving as a lead reviewer, benchmark auditor, or quality owner on AI evaluation projects.

**Offer Details:**

* Commitments Required: Upto 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
* Engagement type: Contractor
* Engagement Length: upto 4 weeks

**Evaluation Process:**

* Candidates will be require to submit a
  **Job Interest Form & assessment**
  .
* Talents finalized in assessment will go through assessment, review & will proceed further accordingly.

title: Sr. Executive- MIS Inventory
description:
**Job description**

**Company Name: Krishi Cress**

**About The Company:**

Krishi Cress is a provider of fresh farm produce, including salad greens, seasonal fruits, edible flowers, and everyday veggies, to homes and restaurants in Delhi-NCR. Partnering with farms across North India, Krishi Cress ensures a wide variety of exotic and delicious foods are always available through its online store. Additionally, Krishi Cress offers a range of farm products like freshly-brewed Kombucha and artisanal cheese, aiming to promote local foods and Indian ingredients while supporting farmers with knowledge and technology.

**Job Location: Chhatarpur, New Delhi**

**Job Title: Sr. Executive – MIS Inventory**

**Product Range- F&V/ FMCG**

**Key Responsibilities**

·   Prepare daily, weekly and monthly inventory MIS reports.

·   Maintain accurate records of stock received, issued, transferred, returned and available.

·   Track inward and outward entries and verify inventory data against physical stock and system records.

·   Monitor stock levels, stock movement, wastage, shortages and discrepancies, and report variances promptly.

·   Prepare inventory dashboards and reports on stock availability, ageing and movement.

·   Coordinate with warehouse, operations, purchase and accounts teams for data verification and reconciliation.

·   Ensure timely and accurate data entry in Excel and relevant inventory/ERP systems.

·   Support regular stock audits and reconcile physical inventory with recorded balances.

·   Share timely reports with management and prepare ad-hoc inventory reports as required.

**Required Skills**

·   Strong MS Excel skills – Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, COUNTIFS and related formulas.

·   Good analytical, reporting and data reconciliation skills.

·   Strong attention to detail and accuracy in maintaining records.

·   Good communication and coordination skills.

·   Experience with inventory management software, ERP or warehouse systems will be an advantage.

·   Willingness to work in rotational shifts, including night shifts, as per business requirements.

·   Zoho- Inventory knowledge is plus.

**Candidate Profile**

·   Graduate in any relevant discipline.

·   1–3 years of experience in Inventory MIS, Inventory Coordination, Warehouse Reporting or a similar role.

**Experience: 1–3 years**

**Preferred Industry: Any; experience in warehousing, logistics or inventory operations is preferred.**

**Specific Skills required: Advanced Excel**

**Salary Range: 25000-35000 (As per skills and interview)**

**To Apply:**

Please send your CV and a brief cover letter to hr@krishicress.com with the subject line “Application – MIS Executive – Inventory”.

**Note:**

This JD is indicative and not exhaustive. You may be given additional responsibilities as per business needs and new challenges to enhance your role, which will be appropriately appreciated. Teamwork is an important part of our culture, and it is important to help each other grow together.

title: Manager-Senior Manager Credit Risk - Policy & Cross Sell
description:
**Job Purpose:**

Building X Sell capabilities for the entire portfolio, including partner base X-sell and direct to customer X-sell.

Optimize risk and approvals to achieve organizational business objectives.

Devise and drive different cross-sell programs leveraging the existing digital assets which helps in credit-healthy business

growth.

**Key Accountabilities:**

**Segmentation**

* Perform Qualitative and Quantitative analysis to slice heterogeneous portfolio into homogeneous segments
* Determine Product-Market fitment for designing policy of X sell for Personal Loan, Consumption Loans and Business
* Loans.

**Base Identification**

* Help identify the right base from risk and conversion perspective.
* Work closely with Data Science team for implementing the X Sell model for PL, CL and Business Loan.
* Blend different source of intelligence and propose framework of differential strategies which includes determining right rate of interest, right offer, right product, right channel, right time, etc. to different segments.

**Experimentation**

* Conduct controlled experiments and A/B tests on Cross Sell program.
* Fine-tune cross sell strategy to achieve pointed targets.
* Study Consumer behaviour by performing Price elasticity and various sensitivity analysis.

**Best Practices and Process**

* Set KPIs, introduce analytical framework and best cross-selling practices used in BFSI industry.

**Automation**

* Work closely with Product, technology and Data science teams
* Automate various algorithms and steps in the cross-sell journey to achieve desired scale and efficiency.

**Educational Qualifications**

***Qualifications***

* Minimum Qualification required: Graduate in Engineering or Postgraduate in Finance/Statistics/Management/Quant subjects from A institutes.
* Qualifications preferred: BTech with MBA.

***Work Experience***

* Minimum 4 years with 2 years in credit risk or similar fields.
* Should have a fair understanding of various risk metrics and credit ecosystem.
* Stake holder management skills- Work closely and align with each of the internal functions which includes Business development, Credit and Policy, Data science, Legal, Technology, Operations, Collections, Customer Success team and external stakeholders.
* Hands-on experience to work on large structured and unstructured datasets using different data processing is must, using SQL, Python etc.
* Good communication skills, Data driven, Analytical approach, Team Player.
* Experience in data science, model building, any highly analytical field is preferred.

title: Continuous Replenishment System(CRS)
description: Experience: 2-8 yearsLocation: Pan India (Remote)Job Description: CRS ConsultantDomain: CPG / FMCG | Supply Chain | Distribution & Inventory ManagementJob Summary We are looking for a CRS (Continuous Replenishment System) Consultant with a strong understanding of CPG/FMCG distribution, inventory management, and replenishment processes. The ideal candidate will bridge business requirements and technology solutions, supporting the design and implementation of data-driven replenishment strategies to improve inventory availability, optimize stock levels, and enhance supply chain efficiency. Key Responsibilities● Understand CPG/FMCG distribution processes, inventory management, and replenishment business requirements.● Analyze demand forecasting, inventory optimization, and continuous replenishment processes across distributors and retail channels.● Gather, analyze, and document business requirements, functional specifications, process flows, and user stories.● Define business rules, KPIs, and performance metrics to measure replenishment effectiveness, inventory availability, and supply chain efficiency. ● Collaborate with business stakeholders, product teams, engineering teams, and supply chain experts to translate requirements into functional solutions.● Support the design and enhancement of replenishment solutions using data-driven insights and AI/ML-enabled capabilities.● Understand integration requirements between CRS, Distributor Management Systems (DMS), ERP platforms, and other supply chain applications.● Identify process gaps, recommend improvements, and support solution testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), and implementation.● Analyze business data and operational performance to identify opportunities for improved forecasting accuracy, inventory optimization, and reduced stockouts.● Prepare functional documentation, process maps, solution workflows, and stakeholder presentations. Required Skills & Experience● Strong understanding of CPG/FMCG distribution, inventory management, and replenishment processes.● Experience in business analysis, product management, supply chain consulting, or related solution delivery.● Knowledge of demand forecasting, inventory optimization, stock replenishment strategies, and supply chain planning.● Familiarity with AI/ML concepts and their applications in forecasting and replenishment.● Proficiency in requirement gathering, functional documentation, process mapping, user stories, and KPI definition.● Understanding of DMS/ERP integrations, data flows, and data-driven decision-making.● Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Preferred Qualifications● Experience working with FMCG/CPG organizations, distributors, retailers, or supply chain technology providers.● Exposure to continuous replenishment systems, inventory planning tools, or demand planning solutions.● Familiarity with Agile methodologies, product development life cycles, and UAT.● Experience with data analytics, dashboards, and supply chain performance reporting. Ideal Candidate Profile A business-oriented consultant who understands FMCG distribution and supply chain operations and can translate complex replenishment requirements into clear functional specifications and technology solutions. The candidate should be comfortable working with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, data-driven supply chain capabilities.

title: Programmatic Optimizer
description:
**Position Summary**

The Digital Media Manager - Programmatic will focus on driving media activation and campaign management across agencies and partners. You will build infrastructure and capabilities for an agency and drive media strategy with customers and agencies. You'll act as the liaison between the Campaign Management team and customers regarding current campaign performance and the future programmatic approach. You'll work closely with multiple stakeholders, bridge organisational and structural gaps, and mobilise internal resources to deliver a seamless experience for agencies, partners, and customers on Display and Video 360 (DV360).

**Key Responsibility Areas**

* Creating and presenting strategic digital media plans based on sound analytics, supported by data.
* Using your analytical mindset, you will be responsible for the platform strategy, execution, performance, and reporting of the media campaign across all programmatic buying platforms.
* Create digital media strategy and campaign plans (propose, iterate as needed, and secure approval from clients)
* Be the programmatic expert for the client on campaign performance and optimisation, providing insights into the best strategies and tactics to achieve business objectives
* Deploying appropriate technology platforms to find and engage with key target audience segments
* Build training materials and best practice documentation
* Leverage first-party and third-party data for targeting and insights
* Oversee the work of one specialist, train in technical knowledge, and manage workflow
* Coordinate assets and tags with vendors, and ensure campaigns are delivering against KPI’s and proactively manage campaign execution
* Responsible for overseeing client pacing & performance across the digital media portfolio
* Recommend forward-thinking strategies and innovations
* Proactively working with client services on campaign set-up and optimization strategy
* Work with the data teams to provide analytical insights to the client
* Mentoring the junior team members.
* Manage and engage with client counterparts and internal account teams for key account assignments
* Participate in new business pitches, etc.
* Manage & onboard media publishers
* Lead and manage the budget and client billing process

**Skills**

* 4~ 6 years of experience working in the programmatic digital media buying & planning space with a focus on programmatic strategy and execution
* Demonstrates understanding of media basics and concepts
* Working knowledge of Syndicated tools (GA, GDS, GTM, etc)
* Understanding of optimization platforms & trafficking platforms
* Microsoft Office Software (Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, Word, etc)

title: Specialist
description:
**About the Role**

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented individual to join our Institutional Investor Initiative (I-Cube) team at Invest India. The individual will play a pivotal role in supporting our mission to facilitate and enhance foreign institutional investment in India. This is an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience in the financial sector while collaborating with top global fund managers, foriegn strategic investors, companies, regulators, and internal teams. The ideal candidate will have a strong interest in finance, investment strategies, and the Indian market.

**Responsibilities**

* Assist in conducting market research and analysis on various investment opportunities in India across multiple sectors.
* Support the team in preparing presentations, reports, and investment briefs for stakeholder meetings.
* Engage with fund managers of global institutions to gather insights and feedback on investment trends and challenges.
* Collaborate with internal teams to facilitate communication and streamline processes related to investment facilitation.
* Assist in monitoring and analyzing the performance of existing investments and prepare periodic updates.
* Participate in meetings with regulators and industry stakeholders, taking notes and summarizing key discussions.
* Help organize events, webinars, and workshops aimed at promoting foreign investment in India.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Commerce, or a related field; MBA/CA/CFA or equivalent qualification would be an advantage.
* 1–7 years of relevant professional experience in investment banking, private equity, venture capital, asset management, financial services, corporate finance, investment promotion, consulting, or a related field.

**Required Skills**

* Strong understanding of financial markets, investment strategies, transaction processes, and the Indian investment landscape, with an understanding of foreign/institutional investors preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to analyse companies, investment opportunities, sectors, and financial information, and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with the ability to develop financial analyses, investment teasers, presentations, and management-level reports.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage with senior stakeholders, investors, corporates, government agencies, and other ecosystem participants.
* Ability to independently manage multiple workstreams, take ownership of deliverables, meet timelines, and operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment.
* Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills, including the ability to coordinate across internal teams and external stakeholders.
* Demonstrated interest in foreign investment, institutional capital, cross-border investments, and India’s economic and financial ecosystem.
* Prior experience in investor engagement, deal origination, transaction advisory, business development, investment research, or investment facilitation would be an advantage.
* Strong attention to detail, problem-solving ability, and a proactive, entrepreneurial approach to identifying opportunities and driving outcomes.

**Note :**

* Early joiners preferred.
* Business Development Experience is must.
* We are hiring junior & Mid specialist.

title: Lead Analyst - Global Procurement Analytics and Performance
description:
**Job Description**
Alimentation Couche-Tard Inc. (ACT) is a global Fortune 200 company & a leader in the convenience store & fuel space with over 17,000 stores globally. It has a footprint across 31 countries & territories. At the Circle K Business Centre in India (ACT company), we are #OneTeam, leveraging transformation and operations together to strengthen our global capabilities. Our Global Procurement Centre of Excellence, set up in Gurugram (India), aims to build a world-class team that will focus on solving our global procurement challenges every day, in terms of operations as well as transformation requirements.
  
  
We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Lead Analyst to join our Global Procurement Centre of Excellence (CoE) in Gurugram. The Lead Analyst will partner with Global Procurement stakeholders within GNFR (Goods not for resale) and GFR (Goods for Resale) and support Head of Global Procurement and Directors of Global Procurement by collecting, entering, processing, and analyzing data to ensure appropriate analysis, monitoring, and execution of Supplier Accounts in association with Procurement targets connected to business targets.
  
  
This role requires a detail-oriented and analytical professional with strong hands-on expertise in Power BI and a fair understanding of procurement processes. The ideal candidate should be capable of working with large datasets, developing insightful dashboards, and collaborating with global stakeholders in a dynamic, data-driven environment.
  
  
**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Analytics, Supply Chain, Business, Finance, or a related field (Master’s Degree/Certification in a related field preferred).
* 8-10 years of relevant experience in a quantitative/applied analytics role, preferably with a strong background in global procurement processes or related.
* Hands-on expertise in Power BI including dashboard development, DAX, Power Query, and data modeling using Python, PySpark, R, etc.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel (including advanced formulas, pivot tables, and data analysis).

**Key Skill Requirements**

* Fair understanding of procurement processes, including sourcing, PR/PO lifecycle, vendor management, and contract tracking.
* Working understanding of ERP/procurement systems such as SAP, Ariba, Coupa, Oracle, or similar platforms.
* Knowledge of SQL, Power Automate, or other analytics tools (Tableau, Qlik, Spotfire, Alteryx, etc.) will be an added advantage.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel (including advanced formulas, pivot tables, and data analysis).
* Good to have: Hands-on experience supporting the IGNITE tool.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Support reporting and analytics requirements across GNFR (goods not for resale) procurement categories.
* Analyze, clean, and validate large datasets to ensure data accuracy, integrity, and consistency for reporting and decision-making.
* Identify trends, patterns, and business insights through statistical analysis and ad-hoc reporting to support strategic decisions.
* Design and develop intuitive, user-centric dashboards and analytical solutions using tools like Power BI to improve business visibility and performance.
* Create business and analytics documentation, including functional specifications, use cases, process maps, user stories, and test cases.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, stakeholders, and senior leadership to deliver analytics projects and communicate actionable insights effectively.
* Support business reviews, presentations, and ad-hoc analytical requirements.
* Drive operational excellence by improving data quality processes, automating issue detection, and benchmarking procurement and finance performance.
* Support data governance and provide training, guidance, and documentation to end-users on analytics tools, reporting standards, and dashboard utilization.

**Key Skills**

* Analytical skills, stakeholder engagement, and problem-solving.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.

**Why Join Us?**

* Opportunity to shape the future of our global IT strategy.
* Collaborative and inclusive work environment.
* Professional development and growth opportunities.

title: Supervising Associate - Data Analytics - Global Security
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Senior Associate, Risk Management**
The Supervising Associate within RMS-Global Security team would be required to develop subject matter expertise across the Global Security disciplines. An individual should be able to continuously add value to assigned processes and develop solutions for situations that may not have been previously documented. Working with the team from Gurugram location, networking with Global Security leadership and other RMS leaders at the location and providing long term value to the business.
  
  
**The opportunity**
Working under the direction of Global Security leadership, the Security Data & Insight Analyst will support the Security and Travel Intelligence Center (STIC) by translating alert data into meaningful insights for regions/countries to review their current and upcoming risk environment. Collaborate with discipline leads and technology team to build dashboards for senior leadership. Collect, analyse and interpret intelligence and security related information from internal and external sources. Proficient in building scalable data models across disciplines of Global Security.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Service Delivery**

* Identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and emerging risks through intelligence and data analysis.
* Provide analytical support for investigations, security operations, and leadership decision-making.
* Collect, validate, analyze, and interpret intelligence from internal and external sources.
* Produce intelligence reports for executive briefings, and situation reports.
* Support incident management, crisis response, emergency preparedness, and business continuity teams.
* Contribute to process improvements and operational excellence initiatives across STIC.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 6-8 years of relevant experience in intelligence analysis, threat intelligence, Security Operations Center, business intelligence, risk management.
* Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to translate business requirements into logical user stories to build solutions which meet requirements for internal and external stakeholders.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage confidential information and engage effectively with global stakeholders.
* Knowledge of crisis management, emergency response, and business continuity will add value
* Experience supporting global teams in a 24x7 operating environment.
* Strong MS Excel, Word and PowerPoint
* Strong logical and reasoning skills
* Self-started, enthusiastic, details oriented, are required for this role.
* Master’s degree from a reputed college

**Technologies and Tools**

* Experience in MS office suites like Microsoft 365, Power BI, MS excel, PowerPoint

**What You Can Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* A team which has its foundation in the core values of trust, respect and teaming. The team which focuses on supporting its colleagues to excel in their respective domains and provides avenues to help acquire and demonstrate new skills.
* Opportunities to work with Global Executive risk management teams on strengthening and monitoring compliance framework

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Manager - Data Analytics
description:
**Job Description**
**Manager – Business Performance Analytics, G&L Client Management**
**About The Role**
Global Commercial Services (GCS) provides a broad suite of payment, working capital, and cross-border solutions that help businesses of all sizes manage their payments, financing needs, and commercial relationships.
  
  
The Pricing, Performance & Insights (PPI) team serves as the strategic analytics and business decisioning function for GCS, translating data and business performance into insights, strategies, and actions that accelerate profitable growth.
  
  
The
**Manager – Business Performance Analytics, G&L Client Management (India)**
will be a strategic partner to senior leaders across the Global and U.S. Large Enterprises (G&L) Client Management organization. Working closely with GM, VP, and EVP-level stakeholders, this role will shape portfolio strategy, performance management, business planning, target setting, and growth priorities across the Client Management organization.
  
  
The successful candidate will combine
**strategic thinking, advanced analytics, financial acumen, and strong executive communication**
to identify emerging opportunities, influence business decisions, and translate complex performance dynamics into clear actions for leadership and the field.
  
  
The role is based in India and reports to the
**Director – PPI, G&L Client Management, New York**
.
  
  
The shift generally begins at 1:30 PM IST.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Shape Business and Portfolio Strategy**

* Serve as a strategic thought partner to G&L Client Management leadership, using analytics and commercial insights to shape business priorities, portfolio strategy, and growth plans.
* Develop and evolve client segmentation and portfolio strategies to optimize coverage, resource allocation, client engagement, and growth potential.
* Identify emerging growth opportunities, performance gaps, and structural trends across the portfolio and translate them into actionable business strategies.
* Partner with leadership to advance strategies that accelerate B2B volume growth, strengthen T&E competitiveness, and deepen client relationships.

**Drive Performance Management and Decisioning**

* Define and evolve the performance measurement framework for G&L Client Management, ensuring metrics and scorecards are aligned with strategic and financial priorities.
* Lead analytical assessments of business performance, moving beyond reporting to explain what is happening, why it is happening, and what actions the organization should take.
* Develop forward-looking perspectives on business performance by connecting client, market, financial, and sales trends.
* Champion data-driven decision-making by providing timely recommendations that enable leadership and field teams to respond to opportunities and risks.

**Lead Planning, Target Setting, and Portfolio Optimization**

* Lead cross-functional planning, portfolio strategy, target-setting, and scorecard management processes across G&L Client Management.
* Translate enterprise growth objectives into meaningful portfolio and individual-level performance expectations.
* Apply financial and analytical rigor to business planning and forecasting, identifying key assumptions, sensitivities, opportunities, and risks.
* Build roadmaps and decision frameworks that bring structure and clarity to complex or ambiguous business challenges.

**Influence Senior Stakeholders**

* Build trusted relationships with senior G&L business leaders and serve as a credible advisor on business performance and growth strategy.
* Synthesize complex analyses into clear, compelling executive narratives that connect data, business context, implications, and recommended actions.
* Influence across geographically dispersed teams and stakeholder groups, bringing together diverse perspectives to drive alignment and execution.
* Lead cross-functional initiatives that require coordination across Client Management, Sales, Finance, Product, and other GCS partner organizations.

**Build Analytical and Organizational Capability**

* Raise the analytical bar by developing scalable approaches to performance measurement, client insights, forecasting, and business decisioning.
* Identify opportunities to improve the use of data, automation, and advanced analytics in strategic decision-making.
* Foster a high-performance, intellectually curious culture focused on rigorous problem solving, commercial impact, and continuous improvement.
* Provide leadership and coaching to high-potential talent and contribute to the broader development of analytical capabilities within the organization.

**Leadership Attributes**
**The Ideal Candidate Will Demonstrate**

* Strategic and commercial thinking: Ability to connect analytical findings with broader business objectives, market dynamics, and long-term growth priorities.
* Executive-level storytelling: Ability to distill complex information into concise, persuasive narratives and recommendations for senior leadership.
* Analytical problem solving: Strong ability to structure ambiguous problems, develop hypotheses, synthesize multiple data sources, and identify the insights that matter most.
* Influence and stakeholder leadership: Proven ability to build credibility and drive outcomes across senior, cross-functional, and geographically dispersed stakeholders.
* Financial acumen: Strong understanding of business performance drivers, forecasting, financial modeling, and the economics underlying commercial decisions.
* Leadership through ambiguity: Ability to establish direction, create roadmaps, and mobilize teams when the path forward is not predefined.
* Execution excellence: Strong attention to detail and a demonstrated ability to deliver accurate, high-quality work while managing multiple strategic priorities.

**Qualifications**
**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, Finance, or a related quantitative discipline; advanced degree preferred.
* 5+ years of relevant experience in business analytics, strategy, financial modeling, performance management, planning, corporate finance, or related disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience translating complex data and analysis into strategic recommendations and measurable business outcomes.
* Proven ability to navigate complex organizations and influence stakeholders across functions and levels of seniority.
* Strong experience with large-scale data and analytical environments; proficiency with SQL strongly preferred.
* Experience with tools and technologies such as Python, Hive, Tableau, SAS, VBA, and Cornerstone is valuable, with an emphasis on using technology to enable scalable insights and better business decisions.
* Experience leading, coaching, or developing high-performing talent is preferred.

**What Success Looks Like**
Success in this role means becoming a
**trusted strategic advisor to G&L Client Management leadership**
—bringing together data, financial insights, and commercial judgment to shape where the organization focuses, how performance is measured, and which actions will create the greatest impact.
  
  
The Manager will help shift analytics from retrospective performance reporting toward
**forward-looking business decisioning**
, enabling leadership to anticipate opportunities, make better portfolio choices, and accelerate sustainable growth.
  
  
**About Us**
At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
  
  
As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.
  
  
**About The Team**
We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:
  
  

* Competitive base salaries
* Bonus incentives
* Support for financial-well-being and retirement
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
* Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
* Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
* Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
* Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
* Career development and training opportunities

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.
  
  
Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
Come build at the intersection of AI and fintech. At Ocrolus, we're on a mission to help lenders automate workflows with confidence—streamlining how financial institutions evaluate borrowers and enabling faster, more accurate lending decisions.
  
  
Our AI workflow and analytics platform for lenders is trusted at scale, processing nearly one million credit applications every month across small business, mortgage, and consumer lending. By integrating state-of-the-art open- and closed-source AI models with our human-in-the-loop verification engine, Ocrolus captures data from financial documents with over 99% accuracy. Thanks to our advanced fraud detection and comprehensive cash flow and income analytics, our customers achieve greater efficiency in risk management, and provide expanded access to credit—ultimately creating a more inclusive financial system.
  
  
Trusted by more than 400 customers—including industry leaders like Better Mortgage, Brex, Enova, Nova Credit, PayPal, Plaid, SoFi, and Square—Ocrolus stands at the forefront of AI innovation in fintech. Join us, and help redefine how the world's most innovative lenders do business.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and implement data architecture and data models that optimize data processes and improve efficiency.
* Build and maintain reliable, scalable data pipelines that keep data available and trustworthy in Snowflake or another database or data warehouse.
* Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, manipulate, and analyze large datasets for business insights.
* Use Python to integrate, transform, and automate data workflows.
* Analyze data to find patterns and root causes, and present findings with clear visualizations (Tableau, Sigma, or similar) that support data-driven decisions.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather business requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
* Optimize and streamline existing analytics processes to improve reporting capabilities.
* Manage relationships with key stakeholders, understand their data needs, and deliver timely, actionable insights.

**Required Skills**
**Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.**
**Experience: 4+ years in data analytics, data architecture, and process optimization.**
**Analytical strength: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down ambiguous business questions, find patterns and root causes in large datasets, and back conclusions with data and Visualization.**
**SQL: Expert at writing complex queries, tuning query and database performance, and managing large datasets.**
**Architecture and modeling: Designed scalable data models and platforms (dimensional, star/snowflake schemas) that handle high data volumes, with sound pipeline management.**
**Python: Strong working knowledge for data integration, manipulation, and automation.**
**Stakeholder management: Communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical teams.**
**Preferred (Nice to Have)**

* Experience with Snowflake and ELT/orchestration tools (dbt, Airflow), plus Git/CI-CD for analytics code.
* Data quality, observability, and governance practices, such as validation checks, lineage, and SLAs.
* Snowflake cost and performance tuning (warehouse sizing, clustering, query profiling).
* AI-driven analytics: hands-on use of LLMs and AI tools (for example Snowflake Cortex or Claude) for text-to-SQL, automated insights, or anomaly detection.

**Life at Ocrolus**
We're a team of builders, thinkers, and problem solvers who care deeply about our mission — and each other. As a fast-growing, remote-first company, we offer an environment where you can grow your skills, take ownership of your work, and make a meaningful impact.
  
  
**Our culture is grounded in four core values:**
**Empathy –**
Understand and serve with compassion
  
  
**Curiosity –**
Explore new ideas and question the status quo
  
  
**Humility –**
Listen, be grounded, and remain open-minded
  
  
**Ownership –**
Love what you do, work hard, and deliver excellence
  
  
We believe diverse perspectives drive better outcomes. That's why we're committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone has a seat at the table, regardless of race, gender, gender identity, age, disability, national origin, or any other protected characteristic.
  
  
We look forward to building the future of lending together.

title: Director Business Analytics
description:
Our client is a global SaaS technology company with close to 7000 employees and more than 30,000 customers worldwide, most of them are Fortune 500. They are looking for a strategic, execution focused Business Transformation leader to drive high impact change across Sales, Marketing and enterprise operations.

What you will be doing:

- Develop & Optimize Pricing Strategy: Use advanced analytics, AI-driven modeling, and market intelligence to set, test, and refine pricing for new and existing SKUs across SaaS and related portfolios.

- Lead Analytics & AI Projects: Drive high-impact, cross-functional analytics initiatives, delivering actionable insights and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.

- Build & Scale Analytical Tools: Design, implement, and maintain self-service dashboards, scenario models, and AI-assisted recommendation engines using Python, SQL, Sigma, and other modern analytics platforms.

- Pricing Performance Reviews: Produce concise, data-rich reports on price performance, emerging risks, and growth opportunities for executive stakeholders on a regular cadence.

- Team Leadership & Mentorship: Build, mentor, and inspire a team of analytics professionals, fostering a culture of innovation, rigor, and continuous learning.

- Directly influence revenue growth and profitability through data-driven strategies.

- Enable scalable, automated analytics solutions that empower business stakeholders.

- Champion the use of AI and advanced analytics to solve complex business challenges.

What you will need for this position:

- 14+ years of experience in analytics, data science, or pricing, with a significant track record in B2B SaaS.

- Deep expertise in Python for data analysis, modeling, and automation; advanced proficiency in SQL and data visualization tools (Tableau, Sigma, Power BI, or similar).

- Exceptional communication and storytelling skills, with a proven ability to influence C-suite stakeholders and translate complex data into actionable business narratives.

- Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related); MBA or advanced degree preferred.

- Strategic thinker with a passion for leveraging AI and analytics to drive business impact.

- Demonstrated leadership in building and scaling analytics teams.

- Experience in pricing for SaaS or technology-driven businesses.

- Continuous learner, staying abreast of the latest trends in AI, analytics, and pricing science.

We are looking for a high-ownership, analytical professional to drive business strategy, market-share growth, competitive intelligence, and strategic initiatives for Angel One’s Assisted Business. The role will focus on tracking market performance, benchmarking competitive positioning, identifying growth opportunities across trading segments, and translating data-driven insights into actionable business interventions.

The individual will work closely with Business, Product, Sales, Technology, Marketing, and Operations teams to drive strategic initiatives, improve business performance, strengthen competitive positioning, and deliver measurable growth outcomes.

* **Market Share & Business Performance Analysis:**
  Track and analyse market share, exchange-level turnover, trading volumes, active clients, segment mix, and other relevant business indicators across equity delivery, intraday, futures & options (F&O), and commodity segments.
* **Competitive Intelligence & Benchmarking:**
  Monitor competitor strategies, brokerage and pricing structures, product propositions, trading experience, customer engagement initiatives, and distribution models to assess Angel One’s competitive positioning.
* **Growth Opportunity Identification:**
  Identify market-share gaps, emerging trends, underpenetrated customer and partner segments, and opportunities to improve client activity, turnover, product adoption, and business growth.
* **Business Insights & Strategic Recommendations:**
  Analyse performance trends, anomalies, and underlying drivers of market-share gains or losses. Translate findings into actionable recommendations and business cases for improving segment-level performance.
* **Strategic Initiative Execution:**

* **Performance Monitoring & Reviews:**
  Establish structured performance-review frameworks, dashboards, and scorecards to monitor business metrics, evaluate the effectiveness of interventions, and recommend course corrections.
* **Competitor and Market Deep Dives:**
  Conduct focused analyses of competitor initiatives, market movements, pricing changes, and product developments, assessing their potential impact on Angel One’s business.
* **Stakeholder Collaboration:**
  Partner with Product, Sales, Technology, Marketing, and Business Operations teams to translate insights into business actions and ensure effective execution.
* **Management Reporting:**
  Prepare business reviews, leadership presentations, periodic performance updates, and strategic recommendations to support business planning and decision-making

* 3–7 years of experience in market share, market research, business strategy, growth analytics, competitive intelligence, business analytics, management consulting, broking research, or financial services.
* Strong understanding of equity markets, derivatives, commodities, the Indian stockbroking ecosystem, and broking business models.
* Demonstrated ability to analyse market and business performance data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable business recommendations.
* Strong commercial acumen, structured problem-solving skills, and the ability to connect market movements with business outcomes.
* Advanced Excel skills and strong PowerPoint proficiency. Experience with SQL and BI tools such as Power BI or Tableau will be an advantage.
* Experience working with large datasets, building dashboards and performance scorecards, and presenting insights to senior stakeholders.
* Strong stakeholder-management skills and the ability to drive cross-functional initiatives from analysis to execution.

.

title: Ecommerce Growth Specialist
description:
Marketplace Ecommerce and Expansion Manager

**Company:**
Bluethread Brands Pvt. Ltd.

**Location:**
Gurugram (On-site)

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
3–6 years

About Bluethread

Bluethread Brands Pvt. Ltd. is a fashion company building and scaling a portfolio of contemporary fashion brands, including Dorabi and Aamili with a focus on design, craftsmanship, and inclusive fashion, we are building brands that combine distinctive aesthetics with everyday wearability.

We are looking for a driven, commercially minded
**Marketplace E-commerce & Expansion Manager**
to own and grow our presence across Indian and international marketplaces. This role goes beyond managing existing accounts. You will be responsible for identifying the right platforms for our brands, evaluating new growth opportunities, launching new marketplace channels, and scaling revenue across geographies, particularly the United States.

You should understand how marketplaces work as businesses, how to build a profitable presence on them, and what it takes to take a fashion brand from onboarding to meaningful scale.

Key Responsibilities1. Marketplace Expansion & Strategy

* Identify and evaluate relevant marketplaces across India and international markets, with a particular focus on the
  **US marketplace opportunity**
  .
* Research marketplace models, customer demographics, category demand, competitive positioning, commercial terms, commission structures, fulfilment requirements, and profitability.
* Build a marketplace expansion roadmap, prioritising platforms based on revenue potential, brand fit, operational feasibility, and contribution margins.
* Lead the onboarding and launch process for new marketplaces, from initial research and commercial discussions to catalog setup, integrations, and go-live.
* Explore opportunities across fashion marketplaces, multi-brand retail platforms, and other relevant online distribution channels.
* Develop market-entry strategies for international platforms, particularly the US, considering pricing, assortment, fulfilment, returns, duties, and local customer expectations.
* Build scalable processes for launching and managing multiple marketplaces simultaneously.

2. Marketplace Ownership & Growth

* Own the end-to-end performance of existing marketplace accounts, including Myntra, Nykaa Fashion, and other relevant platforms.
* Drive GMV growth through assortment planning, catalog optimisation, search visibility, conversion improvements, pricing, promotions, and best-seller scaling.
* Plan and execute marketplace campaigns, promotional events, and sale calendars.
* Work with platform account managers to unlock better visibility, marketing opportunities, and commercial growth.
* Identify underperforming products and categories and implement corrective action plans.
* Build strategies to improve sell-through, inventory productivity, repeat sales, and overall marketplace profitability.

3. US Marketplace Expansion

* Demonstrate a strong understanding of the US e-commerce landscape and the operating models of major marketplaces.
* Evaluate opportunities across platforms such as Amazon US, Walmart Marketplace, and relevant fashion-focused marketplaces, based on their suitability for our brands.
* Understand the differences between first-party retail (1P), third-party marketplace selling (3P), and direct-to-consumer models, and recommend the right approach for each opportunity.
* Evaluate fulfilment models such as Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA), seller-fulfilled operations, and third-party logistics providers.
* Assess US-specific requirements around catalog compliance, product listings, sizing, pricing, returns, shipping, taxes, and customer expectations.
* Build a practical launch and scaling plan for the US market, including platform selection, onboarding, assortment strategy, unit economics, and growth milestones.
* Coordinate with external partners, agencies, logistics providers, and platform representatives wherever required to establish and scale international operations.

4. Marketplace Operations & Backend Management

* Own catalog onboarding, product content, imagery, attributes, tagging, pricing, and listing quality.
* Manage inventory availability, stock accuracy, order fulfilment, cancellations, returns, and marketplace reconciliations.
* Use Unicommerce for inventory, order management, and marketplace integrations.
* Work with EasyEcom or similar OMS/WMS platforms wherever required.
* Coordinate with warehouse and logistics teams to improve fulfilment SLAs and minimise cancellations, returns, and operational penalties.
* Establish standard operating procedures to support efficient operations across multiple platforms and geographies.

5. Analytics, Performance & Profitability

* Build and maintain marketplace dashboards tracking GMV, net revenue, conversion rates, returns, sell-through, advertising performance, and contribution margins.
* Analyse product-level performance, customer demand, size-related returns, discount dependency, and inventory ageing.
* Evaluate marketplace commissions, fulfilment costs, advertising expenses, promotional funding, and other channel-specific costs to assess profitability.
* Develop business cases for new marketplace launches, including expected investment, revenue potential, operational requirements, and break-even considerations.
* Translate performance data into clear action plans and regularly report progress against revenue and profitability goals.

6. Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Work closely with design and merchandising teams to plan assortments and prioritise products for different markets.
* Coordinate with marketing teams on marketplace advertising, campaign participation, and brand visibility.
* Collaborate with finance, operations, logistics, and technology teams to ensure seamless execution.
* Ensure consistent brand positioning, pricing discipline, and product presentation across all platforms.

What We're Looking For

* 3–6 years of hands-on experience in marketplace e-commerce, online retail, or marketplace expansion.
* Demonstrated experience managing fashion, lifestyle, beauty, or consumer brands across one or more marketplaces.
* Strong understanding of Myntra and/or Nykaa Fashion, with the ability to independently manage existing accounts.
* **Practical exposure to international marketplaces, particularly the US market, or demonstrable experience building marketplace expansion strategies for international markets.**
* **Understanding of US marketplace models, including 1P versus 3P selling, FBA, seller-fulfilled operations, and marketplace unit economics.**
* **Experience identifying, onboarding, and scaling new sales channels is highly desirable.**
* **Proficiency in Unicommerce is mandatory; familiarity with EasyEcom or similar OMS/WMS platforms is an advantage.**
* **Strong commercial acumen, analytical skills, and an understanding of marketplace profitability.**
* **Ability to manage platform relationships, negotiate opportunities, and work independently without extensive hand-holding.**
* **A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to turn research and strategy into actual marketplace launches and revenue.**

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, E-commerce, or a related field preferred.
* 3–6 years of relevant professional experience.
* Experience working with Indian fashion marketplaces and international e-commerce platforms is strongly preferred.

Why This Role Matters

* **Build new revenue channels:**
  Take ownership of identifying and scaling marketplaces rather than simply maintaining existing accounts.
* **Expand internationally:**
  Play a key role in building Bluethread's presence in the US and other global markets.
* **Own business outcomes:**
  Work directly on marketplace revenue, growth strategy, and profitability.
* **Work with an ambitious fashion portfolio:**
  Help scale brands with distinct identities, established products, and growth potential.
* **Have meaningful ownership:**
  Work in a founder-led environment where decisions are made quickly and your work has a direct impact on the business.
* **The ideal candidate is not just a marketplace account manager. They are a marketplace growth operator who can identify where a brand should sell, build the business case, launch the channel, and scale it profitably.**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times.

They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. You will work continuously with senior leadership to manage team capacity and project work, to deliver in a timely fashion. Attention to detail and analytical skills will be critical to success in this role.  In addition to partnering with and learning from the key leaders in our business you will have access to the unrivalled support and professional development we offer to all members of the Bain team.

title: Associate - Deals Advisory - Deals Strategy
description:
**Job Overview**
This position is for an Associate to be part of a fast-growing Strategy& practice within our Advisory Acceleration Centre.
  
  
Strategy& (S&) is our global strategy consulting business. It is a specialist team within PwC that combines strategy consulting capabilities with leading industry and sector insights and know-how. The team helps clients identify and build the capabilities essential to their advantage, and develop strategies based on these capabilities.
  
  
S& serves four main go-to-market channels: Deal Execution (M&A), Post-Deal Value Creation, Portfolio Companies, Corporate and Public Sector Clients (non-deals) across industries (including Technology, Media, Telco, Consumer Products, Retail, Industrials, Professional Services, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, Pharma).

title: Quantitative Researcher - Experienced Hires (India)
description:
Trexquant is a systematic hedge fund where we use thousands of statistical algorithms to trade equity, futures and other markets globally. Starting with many data sets, we develop large sets of features and use various machine learning methods to discover trading signals and effectively combine them into market-neutral portfolios. We are looking for data scientists, physicists, engineers, economists and programmers to develop the next generation of machine learning strategies that can accurately predict the future movements of liquid financial assets. 

As a Quantitative Researcher you will be involved in developing market-neutral signals, parsing and analyzing large data sets and collaborating with the Data and Strategy Research team to build a diverse set of predictive models. While we are open to researchers in any asset class we are currently focusing on roles in equities, futures, commodities, and event driven research. 

****Responsibilities****

* Design, implement, and optimize various machine learning models aimed at predicting liquid assets using a wide set of financial data and a vast library of trading signals
* Parse and analyze large datasets to identify actionable alpha signals and develop strategies for systematic trading
* Investigate and implement state-of-the-art academic research in the field of quantitative finance
* Continuously innovate and improve existing models by integrating new data sources and advanced techniques to boost performance and scalability
* Collaborate closely with a team of experienced quantitative researchers to conduct experiments, backtest hypotheses, and refine strategies through rigorous simulations and data analysis

**Requirements**

* BS/MS/PhD degree in any stem field
* 2+ years in a systematic trading environment
* Passion for machine learning
* Fluent with programming languages like Python
* Strong problem-solving skills
* Ability to work effectively both as an individual and a team player

**Benefits**

* Competitive salary plus bonus based on individual and company performance
* Collaborative, Casual, and friendly work environment
* Health insurance premiums fully covered for you and your dependents
* Pre-tax commuter benefits
* Weekly company meals

Trexquant is an Equal Opportunity Employer

title: Senior Accounts Receivable and Collections Analyst
description:
**About Teads**
Teads is a leading omnichannel advertising platform building the future of digital advertising where quality content, trusted publishers, ambitious brands, and human creativity can thrive. Operating at true scale - processing 18 billion ad opportunities every single day - we connect global brands with a monthly reach of over 2.2 billion unique users.
  
  
At Teads, we believe
**your impact travels further**
. We are a borderless team of 1,700+ innovators across 30+ countries who favor outcome over tenure, value trusted autonomy, and use predictive AI to amplify human ingenuity rather than replace it. We move at pace, tackle genuinely complex problems, and foster a high-accountability culture that stays genuinely human. If you are looking for room to build and meaningful scope, you belong here. Learn more at www.teads.com.
  
  
**About The Opportunity**
The
**Senior Accounts Receivable & Collections Analyst**
plays a critical role in supporting the company's global financial operations by leading the accounts receivable and collections function across an international customer portfolio. Combining strong operational execution with a proactive, customer-focused approach, this role is responsible for optimizing collections, resolving complex billing and payment issues, and ensuring a seamless customer experience.
  
  
As a subject matter expert for AR systems such as
**NetSuite, SAP, and Salesforce**
, you will drive process improvements, maintain data integrity, and enhance the efficiency of the order-to-cash cycle. You will also produce timely and insightful reporting on accounts receivable performance, debtor balances, cash collections, and bad debt exposure, providing valuable insights to business stakeholders while building strong relationships with customers and cross-functional teams.
  
  
**A day in the life**

* Arrive with a live view of global portfolio aging to identify exactly where pressure points are before the first call of the day.
* Contact customers (agencies, Enterprise, and brand clients) by telephone and email to move collections forward on high-risk accounts.
* Maintain positive relationships with our customers by providing excellent, responsive service.
* Maintain meticulous notes on follow-up and contact within ERP and CRM systems so nothing falls through overnight.
* Handle a non-stop flow of cases, DIY billing queries, and financial requests via a shared inbox and Salesforce with high operational resilience.
* Send monthly statements to customers and resolve discrepancies immediately upon receipt.
* Reduce DSO (Days Sales Outstanding), improve CEI (Collection Effectiveness Index), and minimize bad debt expense of the assigned global portfolio.
* Identify systemic billing or operational issues impacting cash flow and proactively lead cross-functional resolution efforts.
* Act as a key contributor in cash forecasting by providing accurate short- and long-term collection projections based on portfolio trends.
* Communicate real-time account status, risks, and next actions proactively to Sales and Account Managers.
* Oversee daily cash applications in ERP systems and lead investigations into complex unallocated/unapplied cash receipts.
* Issue reminder and legal notices to customers based on the Credit Control policy.
* Collaborate with Internal Sales, AMs, Finance, Legal, and billing teams with an "on-your-toes" urgency to resolve discrepancies and unblock revenue.
* Monitor and report on potential bad debts and portfolio health with a sharp, numerical eye.
* Strengthen internal controls and compliance around AR processes, ensuring audit readiness and policy adherence.
* Determine when accounts should be sent to outside collection agencies when all internal strategic efforts have been exhausted.
* Generate sophisticated monthly and ad-hoc reporting metrics on the performance of the portfolio.
* Lead the setting of credit limits for new and existing customers.
* Manage credit card workflows end-to-end, including charges, refunds, and formally challenging invalid chargebacks with supporting evidence.
* Actively leverage Enterprise AI platforms (Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) to drive process optimization, build automations, and streamline collection workflows.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Minimum 10–12 years’ experience in an Accounts Receivable / Collections role.
* Ability to adjust priorities instantly under pressure to meet non-stop deadlines.
* High stamina and flexibility within a constantly changing, high-volume environment.
* Elite interpersonal and diplomatic negotiation skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills suitable for senior stakeholders.
* Ability to cooperate and lead collaboration effectively with team members.
* Proven track record of reducing DSO and improving cash collections.
* Sharp, proactive attitude – the ability to take immediate initiative to get things done.
* Expert Microsoft Excel (Power Query/Pivot) and IT skills with an exceptional eye for numbers.
* Highly motivated with a continuous eye for process improvement and automation.
* Deep expertise in managing global portfolios across multiple currencies and international markets.
* Deep expertise in Tier-1 ERP and CRM ecosystems (e.g., SAP, NetSuite, Salesforce) with the ability to drive system-related projects.
* AI-savvy and curious about technology; comfort using Enterprise AI tools to automate repetitive tasks.
* Experience of working with advertising/marketing agencies is highly preferred

**Life at Teads**
At Teads, we don’t just offer jobs. We blend creativity, technology, and cutting-edge data to shape the future of media.
  
  
As a Teadster, you’ll work alongside smart humans, collaborate with meaningful brands, and leverage advanced AI and automation to redefine how advertising works in a transparent, privacy-first world.
  
  
We are builders, innovators, and future-thinkers. If you are excited by the evolution of technology and ready to embrace the future of AI-driven media, you belong here.
  
  
**Why Join Us?**

* A New Era of Media: We’ve merged two open internet category leaders, Outbrain and Teads to create a unified omnichannel platform. Together, we drive results from branding to performance across CTV, mobile, and web.
* AI-Powered Innovation: We actively embrace AI and next-gen technology to solve complex industry challenges. We look for curious minds who aren't afraid to experiment, adapt, and lead the charge into the future of digital advertising.
* Growth & High Performance: Our culture is dynamic, global, and built on excellence. We are committed to your success, offering the modern tools, mentorship, and development opportunities you need to thrive.
* Belonging & Impact: We foster a welcoming, diverse environment where approachable, resourceful, and passionate people excel. Through our employee-led Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), you can actively drive change in areas like sustainability, women’s empowerment, charitable initiatives, and DE&I.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
Teads is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion at all stages of recruitment and employment. We celebrate unique perspectives and are dedicated to building a team that reflects the global communities we serve.

title: Growth Analytics Manager
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  
  
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
Haleon India's e-commerce business is a priority growth lever, and the Growth Analytics Manager is the person who turns our platform and market data into decisions. The role owns the business intelligence layer for DCommerce: platform-level dashboards, city-level reporting and daily market share tracking across marketplaces, quick commerce and e-pharma for all brands.
  
  
This is not a reporting/ data analytics role. The Growth Analytics Manager defines what we measure, makes sure the numbers can be trusted, and tells the business what to do next.
  
  
What Will The Person Own
  
  

* Platform dashboards: one consistent, decision-ready dashboard view per platform (offtake units, MRP value, NSV, share, availability, pricing), with brand, subcategory, SKU and NPI cuts built in.
* City-level reporting: city and cluster views of QCom and marketplace performance, so we can see where we are winning or losing, not just how we are doing nationally ; and actionability on pincodes/ RPI with strongly correlated inputs of promos and visibility
* Daily market share view: brand and subcategory share, built from platform & external analytics, tracked daily with clear trend and exception flags.
* Metric definitions and data trust: the single set of KPI definitions for DCom (including multipack and virtual combo treatment, and platform-specific quirks such as Amazon Core, Fresh and Now), and sign-off on every dashboard before it reaches leadership.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Business Intelligence
* Design, platform dashboards in Power BI (or equivalent) on top of the clean data layer provided by the Data Analyst; own the business logic, visuals and usability.
* Build the analytics reporting module within the existing DCom dashboard: platform views, NPI tracking shown separately from base business, multipack and combo views.
* Maintain a dashboard release and QC checklist so that numbers reconcile across offtake, MRP, NSV and platform-reported views.
* City-Level & Market Share Intelligence
* Build city-level views of share, offtake, availability and pricing, using the city and pincode mapping on external data.
* Identify under-indexed cities and clusters by brand and platform, and convert them into specific actions (assortment, availability, visibility, activation).
* Track daily share movements at brand and subcategory level; flag material shifts, competitor moves and root causes within the same week.
* Insight to Action
* Run weekly, monthly and quarterly performance reviews: what happened, why, and what we should do about it, with owners and follow-up on actions.
* Deliver brand and platform deep dives that lead to a decision (for example share erosion in a subcategory, OOS impact on a hero SKU, or a pricing gap versus competition).
* Partner with Digital Shelf to bring shopper research into the business narrative, so reviews combine the numbers with the shopper reasons behind them.
* Promo, Pricing & Growth Analytics
* Own promo effectiveness analytics for e-commerce: uplift, ROI and cannibalisation by platform and brand.
* Manage the promo planning file and its platform-wise splits, so one master plan is adapted and shared correctly with each platform.
* Planning & Strategy Support
* Support the annual and quarterly planning cycle with baselines, scenario models and growth lever sizing by brand, platform and city tier.
* Contribute to channel mix and competitor benchmarking so strategy is anchored on external facts as well as our own data.

**Skillsets Must Have**

* 3-6 years in business analysis, e-commerce analytics, category management or BI, ideally in FMCG or consumer health.
* Strong Power BI (or Tableau) skills: you have built dashboards end to end, including data modelling and DAX or equivalent, not just consumed them.
* Advanced Excel (Power Query, complex modelling) and working SQL; Python is a plus.
* Sound understanding of Indian e-commerce and quick commerce: how offtake, share, availability and pricing behave across platforms.
* A structured storytelling habit: you move from what happened, to why, to what we should do, and you can defend the number in the room.
* Comfortable questioning data: you spot anomalies and push back on numbers that do not reconcile.

**Good to have**

* Experience with digital shelf or market share tools such as Gobblecube, NIQ, Profitero or similar.
* Exposure to promo analytics, pricing or RGM-style analysis.
* City or geo-level analysis experience (pincode, dark store or cluster mapping).
* Prior experience supporting annual planning or QBR cycles.

**Job Posting End Date**
2026-11-16
  
  
**Equal Opportunities**
Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
  
  
During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
  
  
The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.
  
  
**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**
If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.
  
  
**Note to candidates**
The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.
