**Job Description**
The Global Merchant & Network Services (GMNS) organization is responsible for managing relationships with millions of Merchants and Partners around the world that facilitate American Express acceptance and enabling the day-to-day operations of our company’s payment network. The people, processes, and technology that support this vital function are evolving to improve the merchant experience and economics. Within GMNS, the Global Governance, Risk, Remediation, and Operations (GRRO) team’s mission is to deliver a best-in-class premium merchant member experience that will get merchant to not only accept American Express but openly welcome and recommend us to their customers.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Support and drive end-to-end compliance initiatives, from problem definition through implementation and monitoring,
* Ensure adherence to Network and Brand Protection policies, including alignment across Authorization and Submission constructs.
* Manage escalations and support investigations into potential policy breaches or brand risks, with a focus on risk mitigation.
* Collaborate with Partner Managers, Regulatory Compliance, GMNS Policy and Data teams to drive Network policy compliance across Issuers & Acquirers (GMS & GNS)
* Design and operationalize processes and controls to address compliance gaps and support audit readiness.
* Drive Monitoring KRIs and ensure SLA is met.
* Analyze Network Participant performance data to identify trends, risks, and opportunity areas, drive insights to action
* Support development of analytics and automation solutions (e.g., dashboards, monitoring frameworks) to strengthen control effectiveness
* Contribute to governance activities including non-compliance assessments, risk evaluations, and remediation tracking
* Stay informed on regulatory and industry changes impacting Network compliance and policy adherence

**Qualifications**

* Graduate/Postgraduate, additional certification like Business Management, Project Management, Data analytics, Risk/ Compliance, or related fields would be preferred, with 1+ years of relevant experience

**Key Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a structured, logical approach
* Ability to manage initiatives independently and support building processes and controls
* Demonstrates risk and control mindset with focus on mitigation and audit readiness
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

**About Us**
At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
  
  
As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.
  
  
**About The Team**
We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:
  
  

* Competitive base salaries
* Bonus incentives
* Support for financial-well-being and retirement
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
* Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
* Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
* Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
* Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
* Career development and training opportunities

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.
  
  
Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

title: Risk Analytics - Audit Analytics - Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Senior – Audit Analytics**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As a Senior – Audit Analytics, you will support the delivery of data analytics solutions across Internal Audit, risk and controls engagements. You will work with large and complex enterprise datasets to develop, validate and visualize analytics that help identify risk indicators, control exceptions and process improvement opportunities.
  
  
The role requires strong hands-on analytical capabilities and the ability to translate audit and business requirements into scalable analytical solutions using technologies such as SQL, Python, Power BI, ETL tools and modern data platforms including Databricks and Snowflake. You will also have opportunities to contribute to technology-enabled Internal Audit transformation, including automation, Continuous Controls Monitoring (CCM), and AI/GenAI-enabled analytics.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Perform data extraction, transformation, profiling and analysis using SQL, Python and ETL tools/techniques.
* Develop and execute audit analytics, exception testing and risk-based analytical procedures across enterprise processes.
* Build interactive dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI to communicate analytical findings, exceptions and risk insights.
* Work with large and complex datasets across modern data platforms such as Databricks and/or Snowflake.
* Perform data quality checks, reconciliations and validation to ensure the completeness and accuracy of analytical outputs.
* Translate audit, risk and business requirements into analytical logic, data requirements and test scenarios.
* Collaborate with Internal Audit, business, technology and data teams to understand processes, identify relevant data sources and deliver analytics.
* Document data logic, transformation steps, assumptions and analytical procedures to support repeatability and auditability.
* Support technology-enabled Internal Audit transformation initiatives, including analytics, automation and Continuous Controls Monitoring.
* Identify opportunities to leverage AI/GenAI and Large Language Models (LLMs) within analytics, audit and risk management use cases.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong hands-on experience with SQL, including complex queries, joins, aggregations, data profiling and analytical logic.
* Strong hands-on experience with Python for data analysis, transformation, statistical modelling, automation and development of scalable analytical solutions.
* Strong understanding of ETL concepts, data transformation and working with data from multiple source systems.
* Hands-on experience developing dashboards and analytical reporting solutions using Power BI.
* Experience working with data warehousing and modern data platforms such as Databricks and/or Snowflake.
* Strong data analysis, reconciliation and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively with large and complex datasets.
* Ability to understand business, audit and risk requirements and translate them into structured analytical tests and actionable outputs.
* Strong communication and documentation skills, with the ability to explain analytical approaches and findings to business and audit stakeholders.
* Exposure to AI/GenAI solutions and Large Language Models (LLMs) and their application across analytics, audit and risk management.
* Ability to work collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams and manage assigned analytical deliverables.
* Understand common business and technology processes such as Procure-to-Pay (P2P/PTP), Order-to-Cash (O2C/OTC), Travel & Expense (T&E), ITGC and SOX controls.
* Have an understanding of risks, controls, KRIs and exception-based audit testing.
* Have exposure to enterprise systems and datasets such as SAP, Oracle, Workday, expense platforms, GRC tools or other ERP environments.
* Have experience or exposure to Internal Audit transformation initiatives involving analytics, automation or technology-enabled auditing.
* We are looking for a hands-on analytics professional who combines strong technical capabilities with an understanding of risk, controls and Internal Audit. You should be comfortable working with complex enterprise datasets, developing analytical solutions independently and translating technical findings into meaningful risk and business insights.
* You should bring a problem-solving mindset, strong attention to data quality and the ability to collaborate effectively with audit, business, data and technology stakeholders.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply**
: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Analytics Lead – Data, AI & Automation
description:
**Job Title:**
Analytics Lead – Data, AI & Automation

**Location:**
New Delhi, India

**Experience:**
5-8 years

**About MARS Cosmetics:**

MARS Cosmetics is a globally recognized beauty brand that thrives on innovation, diversity, and empowering individuals through high-quality beauty solutions. Headquartered in New Delhi, MARS Cosmetics is committed to offering groundbreaking products that meet the ever-evolving needs of consumers worldwide.

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a technically strong, hands-on
**Analytics Lead**
to build MARS Cosmetics' data intelligence capabilities.

You will be responsible for organising data across business systems, developing automated data pipelines, integrating AI tools and LLMs, and building Python-based systems that proactively generate actionable business insights.

Our objective is to move beyond conventional dashboards towards
**AI-powered, automated and event-driven business intelligence.**

This is a hands-on engineering and analytics role, not a traditional reporting or dashboard management position.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Data Engineering & Architecture**

* Integrate and consolidate data from ERP, marketplaces, Shopify, distributor systems, marketing platforms and internal applications.
* Design and maintain reliable data pipelines, databases and analytical data models.
* Establish data quality, consistency and governance standards.
* Build scalable infrastructure that makes business data easily accessible for analytics and AI applications.

**2. AI & LLM Integration**

* Integrate structured business data with AI tools and LLMs such as OpenAI, Claude and other models through APIs.
* Develop AI-powered analytical workflows that investigate business performance and generate meaningful insights.
* Build natural-language interfaces that allow business teams to query and analyse data.
* Evaluate and implement emerging AI tools to improve analytical capabilities.

**3. Python Automation & Event-Driven Insights**

* Develop Python and SQL-based scripts for automated data processing, analysis and reporting.
* Build systems that proactively detect anomalies, emerging trends and business opportunities.
* Automate root-cause investigations and generate actionable recommendations.
* Create event-driven alerts for situations such as declining SKU sales, unusual inventory movements, margin deterioration and changes in advertising performance.
* Deliver automated insights through email, Teams, dashboards and other business applications.

**4. Business Intelligence & Analytics**

* Develop analytical frameworks covering sales, profitability, marketing, inventory and operations.
* Define standardised KPIs and reusable analytical datasets across business functions.
* Collaborate with business teams to identify high-impact analytical problems and translate them into automated solutions.
* Build dashboards and reporting systems wherever necessary.

**5. Technical Ownership & Leadership**

* Independently design, code, deploy and maintain analytical systems.
* Establish best practices for testing, monitoring, documentation and security.
* Lead and mentor a lean team of data and analytics engineers.
* Prioritise initiatives based on business impact, scalability and execution speed.

**Required Skills:**

* **Python:**
  Advanced proficiency in Pandas, data processing, scripting, automation and API integrations.
* **SQL & Databases:**
  Strong SQL skills, data modelling and experience with relational databases or data warehouses.
* **Data Engineering:**
  Experience building ETL/ELT pipelines and integrating multiple data sources.
* **AI/LLMs:**
  Hands-on experience with LLM APIs, function calling, AI agents or AI-powered analytical workflows.
* **Analytics:**
  Strong statistical reasoning, anomaly detection and business problem-solving capabilities.
* **Automation:**
  Experience developing scheduled and event-driven workflows.
* **Engineering:**
  Experience deploying, monitoring and maintaining production-grade solutions.

**Good to Have:**
Microsoft Fabric, Azure, Power BI, dbt, workflow orchestration tools, and experience in e-commerce, FMCG or retail.

**Ideal Candidate:**

* A
  **hands-on builder**
  , not just a dashboard developer or analytics manager.
* Has independently built end-to-end data and analytical systems.
* Strong in both technical engineering and commercial problem-solving.
* Comfortable working with fragmented data and converting it into reliable, actionable intelligence.
* Curious, resourceful and capable of independently evaluating new tools and technologies.
* Demonstrates ownership, speed of execution and a preference for simple, scalable solutions.

**What Success Looks Like:**

Within the first 90 days, you should have:

* Established reliable data pipelines and structured datasets for priority business functions.
* Developed automated systems to detect significant business anomalies and opportunities.
* Integrated analytical workflows with LLMs to generate evidence-backed insights.
* Deployed at least two automated intelligence workflows delivering actionable insights to business stakeholders.

**Why Join MARS?**

* Opportunity to build an AI-native analytics function from the ground up.
* Work directly on high-impact business problems across multiple functions.
* Significant technical ownership and freedom to evaluate modern technologies.
* Build intelligent systems that influence real business decisions.

title: Market Research Internship
description:
**Company Description**
K12 Hunar is building India’s next-generation education ecosystem by connecting students, schools, educators, parents, industry leaders, and policymakers to reimagine learning beyond the classroom. Through the K12 Hunar Club, the organization partners with schools to create vibrant student leadership communities focused on innovation, collaboration, service, and real-world learning. Students gain access to mentorship, competitions, scholarships, and future-ready skill development, while schools receive support in strategic consulting, teacher development, student engagement, and digital growth. K12 Hunar also collaborates with governments, educational institutions, NGOs, and industry partners to drive evidence-based educational reforms and grassroots implementation. The overarching mission is to build a stronger, more inclusive education system across India.
  
**Role Description**
The Market Research Intern role at K12 Hunar is a full-time remote position focused on supporting research initiatives across the education ecosystem. On a day-to-day basis, the intern will collect and analyze data related to schools, students, and education stakeholders, conduct market and competitor analysis, and assist in identifying trends and opportunities in K12 education. The role involves designing and administering surveys, supporting quantitative and qualitative research projects, and preparing concise reports and presentations for internal teams. The intern will collaborate with program, marketing, and strategy teams to translate research findings into actionable insights that inform product development, partnership strategies, and outreach initiatives. This position offers exposure to real-world education policy, school consulting, and student-focused program design.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong Market Research and Market Analysis skills to study education trends, competitor offerings, and stakeholder needs.
* Candidates should possess solid Analytical Skills and Quantitative Research abilities to interpret data, work with spreadsheets, and generate evidence-based insights.
* Candidates should possess clear Communication skills to present findings, prepare reports, and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
* Familiarity with education, social impact, or policy research is beneficial, along with an interest in K12 learning and student development.
* Proficiency in MS Excel or Google Sheets, basic data visualization tools, and survey platforms is an advantage.
* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in fields such as Economics, Statistics, Education, Management, Social Sciences, or related disciplines is preferred.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment, manage time effectively, and maintain attention to detail is essential

🌐 Mode: Remote

Aidentifi is building an AI-native way of running an executive search business, and we’re looking for an unusually organised, commercially curious operator to work closely with the CEO.

This is not a traditional finance or administrative role.

You’ll work across commercial operations, resource utilisation, contracts, workflows, research, presentations and CEO priorities. Importantly, you’ll also become a
**driver and navigator of our internal operating system**
, helping us run the business through it and continuously make it better.

**What you’ll do**

* Run & improve the operating system
* Become a power user and day-to-day operator of Aidentifi’s AI driven internal operating system
* Make sure mandates, priorities, information and follow-ups move through the system properly
* Spot where processes break, information gets lost or people work around the system
* Work with our business and technology teams to improve workflows, automation and AI assistance
* Test new ways of working in the real world and help turn what works into repeatable processes
* Help us answer a simple question:
  **how should an AI-native company actually operate?**

**Business & commercial operations**

* Analyse resource utilisation, client economics and business performance
* Support proposals, contracts, commercial decisions, invoicing and collections
* Build useful dashboards, analyses and management information
* Coordinate across clients, teams and external partners
* Find operational gaps and take ownership of fixing them

**CEO’s Office**

* Help translate priorities into execution
* Keep important decisions, commitments and follow-ups moving
* Prepare presentations, analyses and briefing materials
* Research companies, industries, business ideas and investments
* Get rapidly up to speed on unfamiliar topics and turn messy information into a structured point of view
* Help prioritise what actually deserves attention

And plenty that isn't listed here.

**The breadth is intentional.**

Who we’re looking for

We want someone who is:

* Exceptionally organised and detail-oriented
* Commercially curious and comfortable with numbers
* Good at creating structure from ambiguity
* Strong with Excel and PowerPoint
* Interested in AI, technology and automation
* A clear writer and communicator
* Able to move comfortably between analysis and execution
* Fast at learning unfamiliar subjects
* High-agency and comfortable figuring things out
* The kind of person who notices when something doesn't work and wants to fix it

A
**CA/accounting, finance, consulting or similarly rigorous background**
could be particularly relevant, but this is
**not an accounting position**
. Our accounting and compliance work is handled by external professionals.

We're interested in the discipline those backgrounds can develop: numerical fluency, reliability, structured thinking and attention to detail.

Why this role is different

You'll have an unusual vantage point across the company.

You'll see the commercial side of the business, its numbers, customers, people, systems and decisions. At the same time, you'll help us figure out how
**AI, automation and good operating discipline can change the way a company actually works**
.

You won't just use the operating system.

**You'll help us learn how it should work.**

For someone early in their career who ultimately wants to become a
**BizOps leader, Chief of Staff, general manager, COO or entrepreneur**
, that's a pretty interesting place to sit.

If your reaction to something unfamiliar is:

**“Let me understand it, structure it and figure it out.”**

We'd like to hear from you.

title: E-commerce & Quick Commerce Executive
description:
**ROLE SUMMARY**

The Operations Executive will own day-to-day operations across e-commerce marketplaces, quick commerce platforms, and D2C channel — ensuring products are always listed accurately, in stock, and fulfilled on time. This is a hands-on, detail-driven role suited to someone who thrives on managing multiple platforms simultaneously and wants to be close to the operational engine of a fast-growing beauty and fragrance brand.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Marketplace & D2C Operations**

• Manage day-to-day operations across e-commerce marketplaces (Amazon, Nykaa, Myntra, Flipkart) and the brand's D2C website.

• List, update, and optimize product catalogues — pricing, descriptions, images, and keywords — across all platforms.

• Monitor and resolve listing issues, account health flags, and platform compliance requirements.

**Quick Commerce Operations**

• Own end-to-end operations for quick commerce platforms (Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, BigBasket, and others as onboarded).

• Coordinate inventory allocation and replenishment to dark stores and fulfillment centers to prevent stockouts.

• Track platform-specific visibility, ratings, and promotional slot performance; work with category managers to improve rankings and search placement.

**Order Management & Fulfillment**

• Monitor order flow, fulfillment SLAs, and returns/RTO across all channels. • Coordinate with 3PL and warehouse partners to ensure timely dispatch and accurate inventory sync.

• Troubleshoot order and delivery escalations, liaising directly with platform support and account teams.

**Inventory & Demand Planning**

• Maintain real-time visibility of stock levels across channels; flag low-stock or overstock risks proactively.

• Support demand forecasting ahead of key sale events — platform sale days, festive season, and new product launches.

**Reporting & Analytics**

• Prepare weekly and monthly MIS reports on sales, returns, fill rates, and channel-wise performance.

• Track key operational metrics (OTIF, order defect rate, cancellation rate) and flag deviations to the Operations Manager.

**Cross-functional Coordination**

• Work closely with Marketing on platform promotions, deals, and campaign execution timelines. • Coordinate with Finance on reconciliation of marketplace payouts, commissions, and claims.

• Support onboarding of new platforms and marketplace accounts as the brand's channel footprint expands.

**QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE**

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, or a related field.

• 1–4 years of experience in e-commerce or quick commerce operations, preferably within beauty, personal care, or FMCG.

• Hands-on experience with marketplace seller panels (Amazon Seller Central, Blinkit/Zepto partner dashboards, or similar).

• Strong proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets; comfort with basic data analysis.

• Prior experience coordinating with 3PL or warehouse operations is a plus.

**SKILLS & ATTRIBUTES**

• Highly organized with strong attention to detail.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with shifting priorities.

• Strong communication and platform/vendor relationship management skills.

• Analytical mindset with a bias for data-driven decision-making.

• Able to manage multiple platforms and stakeholders simultaneously without dropping detail.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

• The opportunity to build the e-commerce and quick commerce backbone of a fast-growing luxury fragrance brand.

• Direct exposure to brand strategy, platform partnerships, and category growth.

• A collaborative, entrepreneurial work environment with real ownership from day one.

title: MES Executive – Implementation & Operations
description:
MES Executive – Implementation & Operations
  

**PREWAL Studio Private Limited**

**Location :**
Gurugram, Haryana

**Employment Type :**
Full-time | On-site

**Experience Required:**
0–2 Years

**Reporting to :**
Ojaswi Kumar (Founders Office)

About PREWAL Studio :

PREWAL Studio Private Limited is a garment manufacturing and export company based in Gurugram, India.

As part of our ongoing efforts to strengthen operational efficiency, transparency, and data-driven decision-making, we are implementing a
**Manufacturing Execution System (MES)**
across our organisation.

We are looking for a smart, technically capable, and proactive individual to help us successfully implement, manage, and optimise this system.

About the Role :

We are hiring an
**MES Executive – Implementation & Operations**
who will be responsible for coordinating the implementation, daily management, monitoring, and effective utilisation of our Manufacturing Execution System across different departments.

The selected candidate will work closely with the Founder's Office, department heads, production teams, and external technology partners to ensure the system functions smoothly and is effectively adopted across the organisation.

This is a hands-on role combining
**technology, manufacturing operations, data analysis, troubleshooting, and cross-departmental coordination**
.

**We are not looking for someone who merely enters data into software. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, understands how systems work, identifies problems, and ensures that technology is being used effectively.**

Key Responsibilities:-
  

**1. MES Implementation & System Management**

* Coordinate the implementation and rollout of the company's Manufacturing Execution System.
* Work closely with external technology partners to support system configuration, testing, troubleshooting, and deployment.
* Understand existing manufacturing workflows and help integrate them into the MES.
* Assist in maintaining system master data, user accounts, access permissions, and configuration settings.
* Act as the primary internal point of contact for MES-related coordination and operational issues.

**2. Daily System Operations & Monitoring**

* Oversee the day-to-day functioning of the MES across relevant departments.
* Monitor whether employees are correctly and consistently using the system.
* Identify missing entries, incorrect data, process gaps, and operational discrepancies.
* Coordinate with department heads to ensure timely updates and accurate information.
* Verify that system records are aligned with actual manufacturing operations.

**3. Technical Support & Troubleshooting**

* Provide first-level technical support to employees using the MES.
* Troubleshoot basic software, login, connectivity, and system-related issues.
* Identify recurring technical problems and coordinate with external support teams for resolution.
* Maintain records of system issues, their status, and corrective actions.
* Follow up proactively to ensure that reported issues are resolved.

**4. Data Management, Analysis & Reporting**

* Monitor system dashboards, production data, and operational reports.
* Analyse information to identify discrepancies, delays, and potential operational bottlenecks.
* Prepare regular MIS reports and operational summaries for management.
* Use Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for data verification, reconciliation, and analysis.
* Highlight critical issues and provide actionable insights to improve operational efficiency.

**5. Training & Cross-Departmental Coordination**

* Assist in training employees on the correct usage of the MES.
* Coordinate with teams across production, cutting, sewing, finishing, quality, stores, merchandising, and other relevant departments.
* Ensure employees understand their respective responsibilities within the system.
* Support the adoption of standardised digital workflows.
* Work with department heads to resolve issues affecting system usage and data accuracy.

**6. Process Improvement & System Optimisation**

* Identify opportunities to improve system utilisation and operational workflows.
* Suggest improvements in data collection, reporting, and process efficiency.
* Help develop simple guidelines and documentation for employees.
* Monitor system adoption and recommend corrective actions wherever necessary.
* Support the company's broader digital transformation initiatives.

Required Qualifications & Skills :-
  

* **0–2 years of professional experience.**
  Smart fresh graduates with strong technical aptitude are encouraged to apply.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Applications, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, Operations, or a related field. Candidates with equivalent practical skills will also be considered.
* Strong computer proficiency and ability to quickly understand unfamiliar software applications.
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, filters, lookups, and basic data analysis.
* Strong logical reasoning, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to troubleshoot basic software-related issues independently.
* Good communication, coordination, and follow-up skills.
* Strong attention to detail, organisational ability, and sense of ownership.
* Willingness to work in a manufacturing environment and coordinate regularly with factory-floor employees.

Preferred Qualifications :-
  

The following will be considered significant advantages but are
**not mandatory**
:

* Previous experience or internship exposure in garment manufacturing, apparel exports, textiles, or factory operations.
* Familiarity with Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), or other business management software.
* Basic understanding of garment manufacturing processes, production tracking, inventory, and quality management.
* Experience in software implementation, technical support, or system administration.
* Experience preparing MIS reports, dashboards, or analysing operational data.
* Knowledge of advanced Excel, PivotTables, Power BI, SQL, or similar tools.
* Previous experience coordinating with software vendors or training employees on digital systems.

What We Offer :
  

* **Company-wide exposure:**
  Work on a technology initiative involving multiple business functions.
* **Direct management interaction:**
  Work closely with the Founder's Office and departmental leadership.
* **Hands-on learning:**
  Gain practical exposure to manufacturing operations, business systems, and process digitisation.
* **Meaningful responsibility:**
  Help manage a technology platform critical to the company's daily operations.
* **Professional growth:**
  Build valuable experience in manufacturing technology, operational analytics, and digital transformation.

Who Should Apply?

We are particularly interested in candidates who:

* Are naturally curious about technology and enjoy understanding how software works.
* Can learn new systems quickly and independently.
* Enjoy solving technical and operational problems.
* Are comfortable working with both computers and people.
* Are organised, proactive, and detail-oriented.
* Take responsibility for solving problems rather than simply reporting them.
* Want to build a career combining technology, analytics, and manufacturing operations.

**Prior MES experience is not mandatory. Strong technical aptitude, problem-solving ability, and willingness to learn are far more important.**

Interested candidates can apply through
**LinkedIn Easy Apply**
.

title: Knowledge Analyst - Product Development
description:
**Who You'll Work With**
Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.
  
  
In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.
  
  
When you join us, you will have:
  
  

* Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
* A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
* Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
* World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.

**Your Impact**
You will spend a significant part (~70% to 80%) of your time working onsite as part of consulting teams helping solve complex client problems in product development domain.
  
  
Your work majorly includes (and is not limited to) helping client teams estimate product cost based on clean sheet costing (and hence design a low cost product), rationalizing product design based on competitive teardown analysis and customer insights, working on new product development arena reducing new product development time, cost and quality attributes, carrying on survey to understand improvement aspects of the organization to support an efficient and effective product development and improving thereof to build a sustainable capability for the R&D organization for clients, etc.
  
  
The remaining time (~20% to 30%) will be spent on developing cutting-edge knowledge related to the Product Development (PD) domain and in delivering specialized remote services to clients.
  
  
You will focus on product development & design across industries. You will be expected to work on various product development engagements, provide expert client service by way of clean sheet costing, cost saving ideas/lever identification, and product teardown analysis.
  
  
You will also be required to support development and maintenance of various practice knowledge initiatives (build firm’s knowledge on product development related topics). This is a global role (cross geography, cross industry) and would work well for those who truly envision themselves growing into ‘experts’ within the PD domain.
  
  
**Your Qualifications and Skills**

* Engineering degree (Mechanical, Automobile, Electrical, Production, Electronics). In addition to an Engineering degree, an MBA from a school with a specialization in Operations will be an added advantage
* 1+ years of experience in should costing of parts or systems under procurement / R&D functions at OEM or Tier 1 (systems suppliers); prior experience in a multi-national environment is desirable
* Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills, including the ability to disaggregate complex cost structures, identify root causes and drivers, and propose optimization solutions
* Proven experience building or using bottom-up cost models; familiarity with research-based modeling (e.g., process parameters, cycle times, material utilization, yields) is highly valued
* Proficient in reading engineering drawings and technical specifications
* Knowledge of the manufacturing process of various categories (OEM/Tier1/Tier 2)
* Excellent problem-solving skills, including the ability to disaggregate issues, identify root causes and recommend solutions
* Flexibility, patience and understanding of fluid, demanding, and unstructured environments, where priorities evolve constantly, and methodologies are regularly challenged
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment, interact effectively with members from all levels in McKinsey and client organizations, with strong communication skills
* Good written and verbal communication skills. Fluent in both written and spoken English

title: Project Leader- ENR
description:
**ABOUT US:**

  

Bain & Company is a global consultancy that helps the world’s most ambitious change-makers define the future. Across 65 offices in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition, and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.

In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. Expert Client Delivery (ECD) is an integral unit of BCN. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutions across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence, and Bain intellectual property.

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH:**

This is an opportunity to be a part of Bain’s Energy and Natural Resources (ENR CoE) team, based out of Gurugram office, and specifically support BAIN ENR practice on live cases, client development and proposal support. The ENR CoE consists of 45+ team members, organized into ~10 teams, working across various sectors such as oil and gas, power and utilities, chemicals, mining, fertilizers and agri-business

As the ENR sector personnel, you will get exposed to case delivery and client development activities for our clients in Oil and gas, Power & Utilities, Renewables, Wastewater Recycling, etc. The primarily objective of the sector professionals is to collaborate with practice/ case teams on the development and deployment of industry specific analytical products and topic expertise to answer strategic questions of Bain’s ENR clients.

An Associate works as a team member/contributor on BCN cases, driving the analysis on complex cases with some direction from a Project Leader and occasionally leading simple cases independently. 

In addition, Associates help mentor and coach Analysts by providing regular guidance / feedback. The expectation is to eventually provide significant direction and support to resolve complex issues and effectively manage client and team meetings.

 

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**

 

* Candidate should be currently working in strategy consulting/research-oriented set-up and possess acumen to  solve open-ended problems
* Able to quickly come up to speed on different ENR sub-sectors (Oil & Gas, Power & Utilities, Renewables, Petrochemicals, etc.)
* Proficient in research and analysis, as well as able to provide solid business judgment to derive answers in situations where  data is not easily available or explicitly published
* Able to interface with primary client contact (Bain case teams from ME offices)
* May have first-level team management responsibility, which involves allocating and reviewing work to a small team of  analysts and conducting performance / feedback discussions
* Provide content thought leadership & may manage simple cases independently

 

**ABOUT YOU:**

* Candidate should be an MBA from top-tier College with strong academic records with 3-6 years of experience in consulting for ENR clients.
* Candidates should possess excellent analytical, communication, problem solving and team player skills; ability to handle multiple tasks and work under pressure.
* Should possess strong Excel Modeling and PowerPoint skills.
* Good understanding of any of the ENR subsectors is an added advantage

 

**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the #1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. We are publicly recognized by external parties such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ and parents.

title: Business Analyst Senior
description:
We are the leading provider of professional services to the middle market globally, our purpose is to instill confidence in a world of change, empowering our clients and people to realize their full potential. Our exceptional people are the key to our unrivaled, inclusive culture and talent experience and our ability to be compelling to our clients. You’ll find an environment that inspires and empowers you to thrive both personally and professionally. There’s no one like you and that’s why there’s nowhere like RSM.
  
  
**Job Description**
Business Analyst Senior will work as a liaison among stakeholders to elicit, analyze, communicate, and validate requirements for changes to business processes, policies, and information systems. The business analyst’s primary responsibility is to understand business problems and opportunities in the context of the requirements and recommend solutions that enable the organization to achieve its goals.
  
  
**Essential Duties**

* Requirements Gathering

+ Prepare for and conduct requirements elicitation sessions using a variety of techniques including but not limited to brainstorming, interviews, surveys, requirements workshops, observation, task and workflow analysis, prototyping, storyboarding, document analysis, interface analysis, and focus group sessions.
+ Document elicitation results and validate with project team to ensure stated requirements align with the projects teams understanding of the requirements.

* Requirements Analysis

+ Work with project team to prioritize requirements and agree on assumptions and constraints.
+ Organize, model, and specify requirements with the appropriate level of detail given complexity, risk, and audience.
+ Work with project team to verify and validate requirements through review of requirements.

* Requirements Management & Communication

+ Write requirements specifications according to standard templates, using natural language simply, clearly, unambiguously, and concisely.
+ Decompose high-level business and user requirements into functional and nonfunctional requirements, specified in an appropriate level of detail suitable for use by internal project team members who base their work on the requirements.
+ Represent requirements using alternative views (ex. models/diagrams) where appropriate.
+ Communicate requirements to ensure all project team members have a shared understanding of the solution and secure requirement confirmation/approval from project team members.
+ Manage issues and changes to baselined requirements by identifying business impact of the changes and through effective application of change control processes and tools.
+ Manage traceability of requirements to ensure alignment to project goals and objectives as well as alignment to development and testing plans.
+ Manage requirements documentation for reuse.

* Solution Assessment & Validation

+ Works with project team to ensures proposed solutions align with requirements and maximizes value.
+ Defines requirements for solutions needed to transition from an existing solution to a new one.
+ Define acceptance criteria, perform gap analysis on proposed solutions, and make recommendations.
+ Work with project team to evaluate impact of defects and to develop plans for resolution or other mitigation.

**EDUCATION**

* Bachelor’s degree in related field or equivalent experience.

**Technical Skills**

* Proficient in Microsoft Office products such as Outlook, Word, Excel, and Visio
* Experience with Microsoft Azure DevOps
* Knowledge of defect tracking processes and tools

**Special Requirements Specific To Job**

* Ability to work in a highly collaborative environment and consult effectively with employees at all levels.
* General knowledge of business and IT systems.
* Strong attention to detail, motivation, and ability to take initiative.
* Interviewing skills; talk with various project team members about needs and ask the right questions to surface essential requirements information.
* Listening, observation, and oral communication skills; understand what people say and detect what they might be hesitant to say.
* Analytical skills; critically evaluate the information gathered from multiple sources, reconcile conflicts, decompose high-level information into details, abstract up from low-level information to a more general understanding, distinguish solution ideas from requirements, and distinguish user requests from underlying needs.
* Facilitation skills; lead requirements elicitation workshops.
* Organizational skills; work with the vast array of information gathered during elicitation and analysis and manage rapidly changing information.
* Writing skills; communicate information effectively to all levels of internal and external project team members.
* Interpersonal skills; help negotiate priorities and resolve conflicts among project team members.
* Modeling skills; represent requirements information in graphical forms that augment textual representations.
* Time management skills; manage multiple tasks and responsibilities at once with the ability to quickly pivot and reprioritize accordingly.

**Experience**

* Minimum of 4-6 years of business analysis experience working in a development environment.
* Knowledge of product management concepts and how enterprise software products are positioned and developed.
* Understands project management methodologies.
* Experience with both structured and object-oriented analysis techniques.
* Proven experience in operational business process improvement.
* Knowledge of Agile methodologies and other tools supporting fact-based decisions.

**Preferred Requirements**
Experience required in the following critical areas:
  
  

* Workday Finance
* Workday HCM
* Integrations
* Agile experience in a SAFe environment

title: Senior Business Data Analyst
description:
**About VerbaFlo.ai**

VerbaFlo.ai is a fast-growing AI SaaS startup revolutionizing how businesses leverage AI-powered solutions. As a part of our dynamic team, you’ll work alongside industry leaders and visionaries to drive innovation and execution across multiple functions.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a
**Senior Business Data Analyst**
with strong experience in analytics, SQL, and dashboarding (preferably Metabase) who can independently lead complex analytical initiatives, translate business problems into scalable data solutions, and mentor junior analysts. This role demands someone who can think strategically, operate with high ownership, and ensure the company runs on accurate, timely, and actionable insights.

**Responsibilities**

**Strategic & Cross-Functional Ownership**

* Partner with leadership (Product, Ops, Growth, Finance) to translate business goals into analytical frameworks, KPIs, and measurable outcomes.
* Influence strategic decisions by providing data-driven recommendations, forecasting, and scenario modeling.
* Drive adoption of data-first practices across teams and proactively identify high-impact opportunity areas.

**Analytics & Dashboarding**

* Own end-to-end development of dashboards and analytics systems in Metabase (or similar BI tools).
* Build scalable KPI frameworks, business reports, and automated insights to support day-to-day and long-term decision-making.
* Ensure data availability, accuracy, and reliability across reporting layers.

**Advanced Data Analysis**

* Write, optimize, and review complex SQL queries for deep-dives, cohort analysis, funnel performance, and product/operations diagnostics.
* Conduct root-cause analysis, hypothesis testing, and generate actionable insights with clear recommendations.

**Data Infrastructure Collaboration**

* Work closely with engineering/data teams to define data requirements, improve data models, and support robust pipelines.
* Identify data quality issues, define fixes, and ensure consistency across systems and sources.

**Leadership & Process Excellence**

* Mentor junior analysts, review their work, and establish best practices across analytics.
* Standardize reporting processes, create documentation, and improve analytical efficiency.

title: Consultant – Inclusion and Data Expert, GxD hub
description:
**Consultant – Inclusion and Data Expert, GxD hub**

**Engagement Type:**

Consultancy

**Location: New Delhi**

**LEAD’s**
**Gender x Digital (GxD) hub**
**is seeking a Consultant – Inclusion and Data Expert to support a large-scale government programme focused on digital skilling and AI capability building. The role combines inclusion strategy, data systems, and stakeholder coordination, with a focus on developing and operationalising frameworks, establishing inclusion metrics and monitoring systems, and building a coherent evidence base on programme inclusion.**
**About LEAD at Krea University**

LEAD
is an action-oriented research centre of IFMR Society (a not-for-profit society registered under the Societies Act), leverages the power of research, innovation and co-creation to solve complex and pressing challenges in development. LEAD specialises in developing in-depth granular understanding of socio-economic contexts and harnessing actionable insights that have a wide range of applications in industry, policy, and academia. LEAD is a collaborative hub that brings experts from diverse disciplines and sectors together to develop innovative solutions by harnessing innovation, technology and analytics.

**About GxD hub**

The
Gender x Digital hub (GxD hub)
is a cross-disciplinary platform dedicated to advancing meaningful digital connectivity among women and girls in India. GxD hub is an initiative of LEAD at Krea University (IFMR). Our mission is to address critical intersections between gender and digital through rigorous research, impactful engagement with stakeholders, and ecosystem development. Our work is rooted in a deep commitment to develop gender intentional and overall inclusive digital platforms in the country.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a Consultant – Inclusion and Data Expert to support a large-scale government programme focused on digital skilling and AI capability building. The candidate will sit at the intersection of inclusion strategy, data systems, and stakeholder co-ordination, contributing to the development and operationalisation of frameworks that ensure equitable participation across beneficiary cohorts, with a particular focus on women and underserved groups.

This role combines inclusion expertise with strong data capabilities. The candidate will be responsible for tracking and synthesising progress against inclusion targets, while building the systems and evidence base needed to document and communicate the programme’s equity outcomes across states and implementing partners.

This is a stakeholder-facing role for someone who can navigate government and field contexts while bringing analytical rigour to their work. The ideal candidate is an inclusion practitioner with strong data and research skills, who can synthesise evidence, coordinate with diverse stakeholders, and translate programme insights into clear, actionable outputs. The candidate will be placed within the Ministry that GxD hub is closely working with.

**Key Responsibilities**



**Inclusion Strategy and Implementation**

●     Develop and operationalise an inclusion strategy to ensure equitable participation across beneficiary cohorts, with attention to gender, geography, and socioeconomic status

●     Advise on accessibility standards for training content, digital platforms, and learning delivery mechanisms

●     Conduct periodic reviews and recommend interventions to address participation gaps across regions and demographics

**Monitoring, Data, and Evidence**

●     Establish inclusion metrics, monitoring frameworks, and reporting mechanisms for states and implementing partners

●     Ensure inclusion-related data is systematically collated, structured, and narrated consistently — building a coherent evidence base from the programme's earliest stages

●     Track and monitor progress on women's participation and other inclusion targets, and synthesise findings into regular reports and briefs for internal and external audiences

●     Support secondary data analysis and evidence synthesis to contextualise programme data within the broader landscape of digital inclusion in India

**Government and Stakeholder Coordination**

●     Coordinate with ministries, state governments, NGOs, and community organisations to improve outreach among underserved groups

**Minimum Qualifications**

●     Master's degree in Social Sciences, Gender Studies, Public Policy, Development Studies, Education, or a related field

●     Minimum 8 years of experience in inclusion, gender, accessibility, social development, or large-scale government or development programmes

●     Demonstrated experience working directly with central or state government counterparts in India — including in advisory, coordination, or embedded roles

●     Strong track record in data synthesis, evidence collation, and translating programme data into structured narratives for policy and funder audiences

●     Experience designing or operationalising inclusion monitoring frameworks, with hands-on familiarity with indicator development and reporting systems

**Strongly Desired**

●     Prior experience embedded in or advising large-scale government skilling, digital access.

●     Familiarity with India's digital ecosystem, including digital public infrastructure, and the policy landscape around AI and digital skilling

●     Experience working with government-commissioned research, and multi-stakeholder coordination across central and state bodies

●     Comfort with both qualitative and quantitative research methods, including primary data collection, field assessments, and mixed-method approaches

**Application Instructions**

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled.

**To apply, please email the below documents as a single PDF to**
**hr-lead@ifmr.ac.in**
**:**

●     Curriculum vitae

●     Cover letter (no more than two pages) explaining your interest in the role and writing sample

***Note:***
*Due to the large volume of applications we receive, we are unable to contact each candidate individually regarding the status of their application. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted for interview purposes.*

Founded in 1973, Bain has 58 offices in 37 countries, and its deep expertise and client roster cross every industry and economic sector.
  
  
**Department Overview**
Bain's Product, Practice & Knowledge (PPK) department has played a vital role in harnessing the best of our consulting staffs' individual and collective expertise for over 20 years. Within PPK, each practice supports teams across the globe with deep expertise and knowledge. Our practices play a critical role in Bain's commercial success and are a key strategic priority.
  
  
PPK is continually focused on creating a stronger, more scalable, efficient and effective PPK organization. The PPK Operations team will help achieve this by developing and improving processes, tools, and communications to better support our PPK teams.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
The Senior Analyst is a technical builder on the PPK Operations team. Where the Analyst supports defined analytical workstreams and the Operations Manager owns the simplification agenda end to end, this role sits between the two: it takes ownership of complete solutions from problem definition through build and adoption, working with limited supervision, and is expected to bring the technical depth that makes automation and AI-enabled delivery real.
  
  
The distinguishing expectation of this role is speed of build. We are looking for someone who uses AI tools and low-code platforms to deliver dashboards, automations and analyses in a fraction of the time traditional approaches require, and who can explain and defend the logic behind what they build.
  
  
**Automation and AI-enabled solution build (~40%)**

* Designs and builds automated solutions that remove manual effort from recurring PPK processes, using Power Automate, SharePoint, Excel and scripting as appropriate
* Uses AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT as a core part of the build workflow to accelerate development, generate and debug code and formulas, structure unfamiliar data, and prototype solutions quickly
* Prototypes and deploys AI agents and assistants for defined PPK use cases; identifies where an agentic approach outperforms a conventional one
* Translates business requirements into working logic: data flows, conditional rules, error handling and validation, so solutions hold up in production and not only in demo
* Documents what is built so solutions can be maintained, handed over and reused across practices
* Maintains a healthy skepticism about AI output, validating results before they inform decisions or reach stakeholders

**Operations project delivery (~30%)**

* Owns discrete PPK Operations workstreams from scoping through delivery, with the Operations Manager as thought partner rather than reviewer of every step
* Contributes to the PPK Operations project backlog by identifying candidates, sizing effort and impact, and recommending sequencing
* Engages internal stakeholders directly to gather requirements, clarify scope, secure inputs and drive adoption of what is delivered
* Runs test and learn pilots, captures what worked and what did not, and folds those lessons into the next build
* Proactively flags gaps, dependencies and tradeoffs rather than waiting to be asked

**Analytics and reporting (~20%)**

* Builds and owns Power BI dashboards end to end, covering data modelling, DAX, Power Query and visual design, applying Bain visual standards
* Rebuilds and streamlines existing reporting so recurring outputs run with minimal manual intervention
* Performs quantitative analysis on PPK operational data and derives insights that stand on their own rather than only presenting the numbers
* Triangulates data across multiple systems and stakeholders, resolving inconsistencies and flagging data quality issues at source
* Produces insight-driven output in the right format for the audience, whether a dashboard, a deck, a model or a written recommendation

**Teaming and apprenticeship (10%)**

* Coaches junior analysts on technical craft, including tool selection, prompt design, dashboard structure and automation hygiene
* Reviews the technical quality of work produced by others on the team and raises the standard through direct, constructive feedback
* Shares reusable assets, templates and best practices across PPK so solutions built once are used many times
* Evangelizes the art of the possible to other teams and builds credibility for new ways of working through demonstrated results
* Contributes as a member of the broader PPK community through projects, training and experience sharing

**About You**
**Technical skills: required**

* Practical, daily working fluency with AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT, used to build and ship real deliverables rather than to draft text; you can point to work that was materially faster or better because of how you used them
* Strong Power BI capability including data modelling, DAX and Power Query, with the ability to take a dashboard from raw data to a stakeholder-ready product without handoffs
* Working knowledge of programming, in any language, sufficient that logic building is second nature: you understand data structures, control flow, functions and debugging, and can read, adapt and reason about code even where you do not write production software
* Advanced Excel, including complex formulas, structured data handling and comfort with large or messy datasets
* Strong PowerPoint skills with the ability to structure a clear argument, not only format slides

**Technical skills: preferred**

* Experience across the Microsoft ecosystem, particularly Power Automate, SharePoint lists and libraries, and Power Apps
* Experience building AI agents or assistants, including prompt engineering, tool and API integration, and evaluating agent output
* Process automation experience of any kind, whether scripted, low-code or RPA based, with a track record of removing recurring manual work
* Python or a comparable scripting language for data manipulation, API work and automation
* Familiarity with APIs and how systems exchange data; comfort reading documentation and working out an integration independently
* Exposure to Alteryx, Tableau or comparable analytics and data preparation tools

**Experience And Mindset**

* 4 to 6 years of experience in a professional services, consulting, analytics, knowledge management or operations environment
* Demonstrated ownership of solutions end to end, from ambiguous problem statement through to a working, adopted product
* A self-learner with a genuine desire to figure it out; you pick up new tools quickly and without being taught
* A passion for changing how work gets done by adopting new approaches and new technology, paired with the judgement to know when the traditional approach is still the right one
* Structured problem-solving: you break ambiguous questions into clear hypotheses, analyses and implications
* Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical choices to a non-technical audience and establish credibility with senior stakeholders
* The maturity and integrity to handle confidential information and to use technology, including AI, responsibly
* Ability to operate independently, comfortable with a remote supervisor and wider team, managing competing priorities with minimal supervision
* Known for high-quality work, attentive to detail and well-organized
* Bachelor of Arts, Engineering, Science or equivalent undergraduate degree with strong academic credentials; Statistics, Business, Economics, Computer Science or Analytics concentrations also applicable

title: Roster of International consultant – Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) surveillance and/or laboratory strengthening for AMR
description:
**Contractual Arrangement**
External consultant
  
  
**Job Posting**
Oct 16, 2026, 2:40:59 PM
  
  
**Closing Date**
Nov 14, 2026, 3:59:00 AM
