title: Quality Insights Lead
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
  
  
**The Difference You Will Make**
The Quality Insights Lead (QIL) supports the daily operations of the Quality program, setting a high standard for quality across the Customer Support (CS) organization. Reporting to the Quality Manager, the QIL drives continuous improvement through Quality initiatives, including analysis, business case development, reporting on Quality monitoring, and applying Problem Solving Methodologies. They ensure all assigned tasks are completed on time, collaborate with other CS teams as the Quality representative, and may oversee Quality Partner sites as needed. The QIL also serves as a brand ambassador, upholding exceptional customer service standards.
  
  
**A Typical Day**

* Provide daily support for Quality programs.
* Design and oversee deep-dive projects for regional QIA teams to drive service improvements, managing through to project completion.
* Execute QI and ad-hoc after-action reviews.
* Use transaction monitoring insights to develop targeted continuous improvement initiatives for customer service enhancements.
* Utilize AI-driven conversation intelligence solutions, such as Observe.AI, to oversee and analyze customer interactions at scale, validating model-driven scores and automated evaluations to pinpoint systemic performance gaps.
* Convert machine-generated insights from AI-assisted monitoring into strategic service enhancements and targeted coaching priorities.
* Participate in and lead global calibration sessions with internal and partner teams to standardize Quality monitoring and Problem Solving methodologies.
* Provide feedback on coaching effectiveness for internal and partner Team Leads, fostering a coaching culture.
* Coach CS agents to achieve Quality program standards.
* Act as the Quality representative for other CS teams (e.g., CM, BPI, Training) and contribute to relevant projects.
* Collect, analyze, and propose changes derived from Support Ambassador roundtable insights at internal and partner sites.
* Travel to partner sites to implement, train, and run key QA initiatives (e.g., onboarding workshops, certifications).
* Master CS policies, procedures, and workflows, ensuring timely knowledge updates for regional QIA teams.
* Conduct spot checks on Quality Analysts and report findings to their QA Leads/Managers.
* Recommend actions to improve based on QA dashboard outcomes.
* Upskill in relevant or new service tiers when needed.
* Lead Quality at partner sites if required.

**Your Expertise**

* Technical & Analytical Depth; strong analytical, statistical, and automation background — able to design and build AI-enabled tooling that streamlines review processes while maintaining rigor and high-quality analysis.
* Pursuing Excellence; setting the highest standards for the quality of work produced while holding yourself and others accountable
* Collaborative; skilled working with cross-functional peers/teams
* Presenting and Influencing; ability to develop action plans, business cases and data driven reporting that you would present to all levels of the organization
* Coaching; You objectively analyze performance and provide regular feedback. You modify your approach to suit your audience. Ability to maintain high levels of confidentiality while providing analysis and coaching.Maintain high levels of confidentiality while performing analysis and coaching
* Solving Problems; You quickly identify root causes as well as subtle, hidden issues. You use logic to propose effective solutions to a variety of problems. You dig deeper and utilize all available resources to reach the best possible solution.
* Managing Time Efficiently; You prioritize correctly, focusing your efforts on the things that are most important. You stay organized to ensure successful multitasking.

**Role Requirements**

* 4-6 years of Customer Experience management experience in a rapidly growing partner network
* Experience working in a QA Specialist or related role
* Working knowledge of contact center end to end processes
* Working knowledge of customer service assessment tools, i.e., Net Promoter System
* Working knowledge of google suite, including sheets
* Experience leading, inspiring and motivating others to meet goals and metrics
* Passionate about setting a high bar of exceptional customer service
* Highly-developed analytical and critical-thinking skills
* Ability to spot trends in data and provide recommended actions to drive performance
* Experience with AI automation workflows within contact center Quality environments; includes validating AI-generated outputs, identifying anomalies, and interpreting model-driven trends to formulate actionable service improvements.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to obtain COPC certification
* Bachelor’s degree required
* Travel to partner sites expected up to 20%
* Work with Operations teams in the region to address escalated issues, dips in performance and the roll out of new Quality initiatives to drive performance.

**Prefer To Have**

* Exceptional coaching abilities
* Advanced knowledge of Excel or Google Docs
* Strong knowledge of NPS and Quality tools (e.g. Medallia)
* Hands-on experience utilizing Observe.AI or equivalent AI-driven conversation intelligence solutions, specifically involving speech analytics, automated scoring, and real-time guidance.
* Expertise in market-leading contact center Quality Assurance platforms and global program frameworks.
* Proven ability to operate alongside AI automation workflows; includes assessing AI-facilitated customer interactions, pinpointing model anomalies, and converting machine-generated insights into strategic service enhancements.
* Quality Assurance certification (e.g. COPC)
* Ability to create and deliver presentations to the organization

**Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging**
Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.
  
  
**How We'll Take Care Of You**
Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is inclusive of allowances and is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus or incentives, one or more equity programs, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.
  
  
India Annual Pay Range
  
  
₹1,610,000—₹2,110,000 INR
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodations:**
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.
  
  
**A Note on Recruiting Scams:**
Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

title: Associate Manager, Integrated Modeling Solutions
description:
PFI Innovation Centre India is an exciting new innovation center. We’re building a future that helps people live better lives longer – and we’re looking for bold thinkers and team players to help us do it.
  
  
Here, you’ll tackle complex challenges, collaborate with brilliant minds across the globe, and grow your career while helping millions achieve financial security.
  
  
**a Purpose Driven Company – 150 Years**
While the PFI Innovation Centre brand is new to India, you’ll be a part of the Prudential Financial, Inc. family. Founded in Newark, NJ, we serve 50 million customers across more than 50 countries. With $1.334 trillion in assets, we’re a global leader in institutional asset management. The 2nd largest life insurer in the US and the 9th largest institutional global asset manager.
  
  
At the PFI Innovation Centre India, you’ll find high-performance culture that’s flexible, collaborative, and grounded in respect. We engage with candor, take calibrated risks, and hold ourselves accountable – always focused on delivering for our customers. It’s the standard we choose every day as we grow, perform, and win as one team. We offer valuable leadership, mentoring and learning opportunities, paired with flexibility and support to help you thrive.
  
  
Whether you’re just starting out or ready to take your next step, we’ll help you grow with purpose and do the best work of your career.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
Based in India, the Associate Manager, Integrated Modeling Solutions will develop, test, enhance, and deliver components of Prudential's proprietary PyVal liability engine and Eureka! integrated modeling application. This hands-on role brings together modern software development with actuarial, finance, investment, and risk expertise to support valuation, forecasting, capital management, asset liability management, and strategic decision-making across multiple businesses and jurisdictions.
  
  
**What You Can Expect**

* Develop, configure, test, and maintain Python-based financial and actuarial modeling capabilities within PyVal and Eureka!, translating business requirements into reliable, scalable, and reusable solutions.
* Implement new products, assumptions, methodologies, scenarios, reporting needs, and forecasting capabilities while applying version control, peer review, modular design, coding standards, and disciplined deployment practices.
* Perform unit, integration, regression, sensitivity, and reconciliation testing; investigate model results, data issues, and defects; and drive issues through resolution.
* Maintain clear documentation of model logic, assumptions, data flows, controls, test results, limitations, and change history in line with model governance and risk standards.
* Partner across Actuarial, Finance, Investments, Treasury, Risk, Technology, and business teams, contributing to Agile delivery, reusable standards, automation, and continuous improvement.

**What You Will Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
* Five or more years of relevant experience in actuarial modeling, financial modeling, quantitative analysis, risk, software development, or a related discipline.
* Strong hands-on Python proficiency, including development of well-structured, testable, and maintainable code.
* Experience developing, testing, validating, or operating financial, actuarial, risk, or projection models.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, written, and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated effectiveness across global, cross-functional teams.

**What will set you apart?**

* Progress toward an Associate or Fellow credential from a recognized actuarial body, or toward CFA, FRM, or an equivalent quantitative credential.
* Experience in insurance or reinsurance, including life insurance, annuities, retirement, or institutional products.
* Knowledge of valuation, financial planning and analysis, capital modeling, liquidity risk, economic capital, or asset liability management.
* Exposure to US GAAP, US statutory reporting, Bermuda EBS or BSCR, or other insurance accounting and regulatory frameworks.
* Experience with Git, cloud computing, automated testing, continuous integration, data pipelines, or Agile delivery.
* Experience with Prophet, MoSes, or comparable projection systems.
* \*PFI Innovation Centre India welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply.

title: Manager - Data Steward
description:
Join our team and you will have an opportunity to work in a collaborative and dynamic environment. This newly created role will join a team of data professionals focused on advancing data management capabilities and strengthening data as a strategic asset.
  
  
We are a global financial services group operating in 30 markets with 57 years of unbroken profitability. At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that is fulfilling and creates value. You will bring your insights and expertise to the task at hand and feel supported as you make your own kind of impact for a better future.
  
  
**What role will you play?**
In this role, as a Data Steward, you will play a critical part in ensuring the integrity, quality, and governance of data across the organization for data delivered through Macquarie’s central data warehouse and Data Hub. You will work across business and technology teams to develop a clear understanding of critical data, its business meaning, ownership, source, transformation, lineage, quality, and usage. You will partner with data owners, subject matter experts, data producers, architects, and consumers to maintain trusted data, identify governance gaps, and coordinate practical remediation. You will also support the consistent adoption of data governance standards, metadata management, data lineage, data quality, and ownership practices across FPE data domains. This is an exciting opportunity to work closely with stakeholders across various levels, ensuring compliance with data governance principles and supporting the delivery of best practices in data management.
  
  
**What You Offer**

* 6 to 9 years overall experience, with 5 plus years’ experience in data stewardship, data governance, data quality, metadata management, data lineage, data management along with strong understanding of end-to-end data flows, including data sourcing, transformation, storage, provisioning, reporting, and consumption.
* Bachelors or master’s in finance, Mathematics, Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline or qualified CA, ACCA.
* Ability to document and validate business definitions, data ownership, critical data elements, lineage, metadata, business rules, and transformation logic.
* Strong functional knowledge of financial or enterprise data, with the ability to understand business processes, datasets, calculations, and reporting requirements.
* Experience identifying data quality, lineage, ownership, metadata, and control gaps and coordinating remediation activities.
* Working knowledge of SQL for data analysis, validation, reconciliation, and issue investigation is preferred
* Experience with data governance and metadata tools such as Collibra, along with Jira and Confluence along with familiarity with Power BI, data warehouse concepts, data models, and enterprise data platforms is desirable.
* Strong Stakeholder management skills along with ability to prepare governance reporting and communicate risks and remediation progress
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare governance reporting and communicate risks and remediation progress.
* Ability to coach stakeholders on their data ownership and stewardship responsibilities.

We love hearing from anyone inspired to build a better future with us, if you're excited about the role or working at Macquarie we encourage you to apply.

**Benefits**
At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that’s rewarding in all the ways that matter most to you. Macquarie employees can access a wide range of benefits which, depending on eligibility criteria, include:

description:

* Collaboration & Business Development - Work closely with senior team members in proposal preparation, pitch development and thought leadership initiatives. - Mentor Associates and Analysts, providing guidance on deliverables and consulting best practices. - Contribute to internal knowledge building and development of GCC/GBS frameworks, playbooks and tools.

**Qualifications**

* Education: MBA, CA, CFA, or Master’s degree in Business, Finance or related discipline. 2–5 years of relevant experience in consulting, shared services/GCC/GBS advisory or functional transformation. Prior experience in top-tier consulting firms or Big 4 preferred.
* Technical Skills: - Strong knowledge of GCC/GBS models, operating model design, and process transformation
* Proficiency in financial analysis, Excel modelling and PowerPoint. - Familiarity with automation tools, digital enablement platforms, or analytics solutions is an advantage
* Core Competencies: - Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills. - Ability to independently manage workstreams and interact with senior client stakeholders. - Strong project management and organizational skills with attention to detail
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, global and multicultural environment.

**Your journey at A&M**
We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.

title: Service Quality Specialist III
description:
**About The Role And Team**
Community Operations at Uber is focused on delivering consistent, reliable, and high-quality support experiences. As a
**Service Quality Specialist**
, you will play a key role in driving quality calibration, evaluator alignment, and continuous improvement across our global BPO and COE networks.
  
  
You will work closely with Quality, Operations, Learning & Development, and cross-functional teams to ensure consistent application of Uber's quality standards, identify performance gaps, and translate insights into actionable improvements. Success in this role requires strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and the ability to influence quality outcomes in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Drive Calibration and Alignment: Support site-level calibrations, resolve scoring disputes, and ensure consistent application of Quality@Uber (Q@U) standards across BPO sites.
* Strengthen Audit Accuracy: Conduct Audit-the-Auditor (ATA) reviews, identify scoring inconsistencies, and provide feedback to improve evaluator accuracy and alignment.
* Analyze Quality Performance: Leverage quality dashboards, calibration results, and customer satisfaction metrics to identify trends, scoring variance, and coaching opportunities.
* Generate Actionable Insights: Conduct root cause analysis and recommend targeted interventions to improve quality performance and customer experience.
* Improve Cross-BPO Consistency: Compare quality performance across sites, identify gaps, and drive alignment through focused coaching and calibration.
* Drive Closed-Loop Improvements: Partner with stakeholders to address recurring knowledge base, policy, tooling, and process gaps, ensuring corrective actions are tracked to resolution.
* Maintain Quality Standards: Build and maintain benchmark cases and standardized scoring rationales to reinforce consistent evaluations.
* Communicate Quality Impact: Share calibration trends, performance insights, and improvement outcomes with stakeholders to support data-driven decisions.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 1+ year of experience in quality assurance, customer support, or operational auditing.
* Strong analytical skills with experience interpreting performance data and identifying improvement opportunities.
* Proficiency in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides).
* Strong communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder collaboration skills.
* High school diploma or equivalent experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in quality calibration, audit governance, or performance management within BPO operations.
* Familiarity with Q@U, Observe.AI , or similar quality management platforms.
* Experience conducting root cause analysis, resolving scoring disputes, and driving process improvements.
* Ability to influence stakeholders, manage ambiguity, and work effectively across global teams.
* Understanding of customer satisfaction, quality compliance, and operational performance metrics.

**Ready to Ride?**
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.
  
  
Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.
  
  
Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

title: Senior Manager
description:
**Overview**
Lead the delivery, governance, and continuous improvement of Project Information Management Systems (PIMS), Project Controls, Reporting, Analytics, and Automation solutions that enable effective project execution, operational excellence, and data-driven decision-making across major infrastructure and construction programmes.
  
  
The role will drive digital transformation initiatives, establish enterprise-wide reporting standards, manage PMIS platforms, and lead multidisciplinary teams delivering reporting, analytics, automation, and project controls solutions for business stakeholders and clients.
  
  
Your role
  
  
*PIMS, Platforms & Systems Delivery*

* Configure, deploy, and enhance enterprise PMIS platforms including Primavera P6, Oracle Unifier, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, and Power Platform solutions.
* Manage workflows, integrations, data structures, permissions, user access, and system administration across project environments.
* Standardise digital project information processes to improve consistency, usability, and adoption across projects.
* Lead implementation and integration of the Octave project and construction management technology stack, aligning its tools with project delivery processes, controls, information management, field workflows, and reporting requirements.
* Develop solution roadmaps, implementation plans, integration architecture, adoption models, and support arrangements for connected project and construction management platforms across the full project lifecycle.

*Reporting, Analytics & Business Intelligence*

* Develop Power BI dashboards, automated reports, KPI scorecards, and performance monitoring solutions for schedule, cost, risk, commercial, resource, and portfolio performance.
* Create integrated data models and reporting frameworks that convert project data into actionable insights.
* Improve reporting reliability through standardised metrics, templates, data refresh routines, and information management protocols.
* Lead Microsoft Fabric implementation for enterprise reporting, including data ingestion, lakehouse and warehouse architecture, semantic models, data pipelines, governance, security, and integration with Power BI.
* Design and implement Fabric Apps and role-based analytical experiences that bring together reports, insights, workflows, and operational actions for project and portfolio stakeholders.

*Automation, AI & Digital Solutions*

* Identify and implement automation opportunities using Power Automate, Power Platform, workflow tools, and AI-enabled reporting capabilities.
* Apply predictive analytics, advanced dashboards, and digital workflows to improve efficiency, data quality, and project outcomes.
* Support development of scalable digital solutions aligned with project controls, PMO, and Future of Construction objectives.
* Define and deliver enterprise AI solutions using Model Context Protocol (MCP), AI agents, and action agents to support project management use cases such as schedule and cost intelligence, risk monitoring, progress tracking, document workflows, decision support, and automated follow-up actions.
* Establish responsible-AI controls, human-in-the-loop approvals, secure tool and data access, agent monitoring, and scalable deployment patterns for production AI solutions.

*Project Controls Technology Support*

* Set up digital project controls environments for mobilisation, including PMIS structures, reporting templates, KPI frameworks, resource trackers, and governance workflows.
* Enable planning, cost, forecasting, and performance reporting through consistent use of project controls tools and data standards.
* Support integration of project controls data with dashboards, analytics platforms, and automated reporting solutions.

*Data Governance, Quality & Integration*

* Define data standards, validation checks, access controls, and information management protocols across project systems.
* Improve data integrity, reporting accuracy, audit readiness, and consistency across platforms and dashboards.
* Translate business and project requirements into practical digital, reporting, and data management solutions.

**About You**

* 13+ years of experience in Project Controls, PMIS, Reporting, Analytics, and Digital Delivery.
* Proven experience leading large-scale PMIS implementations and reporting transformation programmes.
* Experience supporting major infrastructure, transportation, buildings, energy, utilities, or data centre projects.
* Strong background in project mobilisation, governance, PMO, and performance reporting.
* Experience managing geographically dispersed and offshore delivery teams.
* Track record of driving automation and digital transformation initiatives.
* Experience implementing Microsoft Fabric reporting platforms and Fabric Apps, enterprise AI and agentic solutions, and integrated project or construction management technology stacks; experience with Octave tools is desirable.

*Technical Skills*

* Oracle Unifier
* Power BI and other Business Intelligence tool
* Microsoft Fabric, including OneLake, Lakehouse/Warehouse, Data Factory pipelines, semantic models, governance, and Fabric Apps
* AI solution implementation: Model Context Protocol (MCP), AI agents, action agents, orchestration, responsible-AI controls, and project-management use cases
* Octave project and construction management technology stack implementation and integration
* Microsoft Power Platforms
* Smartsheet
* Advanced Excel
* PMIS Administration
* Project Controls + Earned Value Management (EVM)
* SQL / Data Modelling (preferred)

*Leadership Skills*

* Stakeholder Management
* Team Development
* Digital Transformation
* Change Management
* Client Relationship Management
* Innovation & Continuous Improvement
* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or related discipline.
* Postgraduate qualification preferred (NICMAR / Project Management / MBA).
* PMP certification preferred.
* Power BI, Oracle Unifier, Primavera P6, PMI-SP, or equivalent certifications desirable.

Rewards & benefits
  
  
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.
  
  
**This Includes**

* Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
* Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
* Generous annual leave balance.
* Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
* Remote work opportunities outside of country.
* Company gratuity scheme.
* Discretionary bonus program.
* Relocation assistance.

Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.
  
  
**About AtkinsRéalis**
We're AtkinsRéalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's'infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.
  
  
Find out more.

title: Associate Manager Product Growth
description:
**Overview**
**How are you creating an impact?**
We are looking for a dynamic and commercially oriented
**Associate**
**Manager**
**Product Growth,**
to drive the strategy, development, positioning, launch, and lifecycle management of products and learning solutions for the
**Higher Education market.**
The role will be responsible for translating market, faculty, student, and institutional needs into compelling product propositions, while partnering closely with Editorial, Sales, Marketing, Technology, Customer Success, and Global Product teams.
  
  
The ideal candidate should be able to combine
**product thinking, market understanding, commercial acumen, digital fluency, and strong execution capability**
to build products that drive adoption, revenue, engagement, and long-term customer value.
  
  
**What will you be doing?**
**Product Lifecycle & Adoption**

* Create structured plans for product launch, adoption, renewal, and lifecycle management.
* Monitor adoption at institutions, faculty, course, and student levels.
* Develop intervention plans for products with low adoption or declining usage.
* Recommend product revision, repositioning, bundling, migration, or discontinuation based on performance.

**Revenue & Commercial Management**

* Own and contribute to product-level revenue and margin targets.
* Develop annual product business plans and revenue forecasts.
* Partner with Sales and Finance on pricing, discounting, commercial models, and profitability.
* Monitor product performance against budget and forecast.
* Identify corrective actions for underperforming products

Identify opportunities for:
  
  

- Institutional contracts
- Digital subscriptions
- Bundling
- Custom publishing
- Licensing
- Institutional solutions
- E-commerce
- Cross-sell and upsell

**Internal Positioning & Messaging**

* Defining and communicating the product’s unique value proposition, positioning, and key differentiators, translating product capabilities into clear, compelling messages that resonate with target audiences.
* Develop product positioning frameworks that clearly articulate the customer problem, product solution, key benefits, differentiators, and business value.
* Translate complex product features, content, and technology into simple, customer-centric benefits and outcomes.
* Develop competitor positioning and differentiation statements to help Sales teams communicate the product’s strengths effectively.
* Partner with Marketing to ensure consistency of product messaging across campaigns, websites, email, social media, webinars, events, and sales collateral.
* Equip Sales and KAM teams with product messaging toolkits, battlecards, pitch decks, talking points, and competitive response guides.
* Ensure that internal stakeholders have a clear understanding of “What the product is, Who it is for, Why it matters, and Why customers should choose it.”

**List Management & Product Data Governance**

* Own and maintain the master list of active products, ensuring completeness, accuracy, consistency, and timely updates.
* Maintain accurate product information including product name, ISBN/SKU, edition, discipline, segment, pricing, status, format, digital availability, and other relevant attributes.
* Establish strong data hygiene and governance processes for product and campaign-related databases.
* Ensure product lists are campaign-ready and sales-ready for Marketing, Sales Enablement, e-commerce, reporting, and business operations.
* Coordinate with relevant teams to ensure new products, revisions, discontinued products, pricing changes, and product status updates are reflected accurately and on time.
* Maintain appropriate product lists for marketing campaigns, sales collateral, CRM, e-commerce, reporting, compliance, and management reviews.

**Sales Enablement & Planning**

* Enable Sales and KAM teams to effectively communicate product value, articulate differentiation, handle objections, and drive customer adoption.
* Develop and maintain sales enablement tools, including product decks, battlecards, pitch documents, FAQs, competitive guides, product comparison sheets, and objection-handling guides.
* Conduct regular product training and sales enablement sessions to ensure teams understand product features, positioning, target customers, use cases, and value propositions.
* Partner with Sales leadership to identify sales process gaps, productivity opportunities, and adoption barriers.
* Support the effective use and optimization of CRM and sales technology platforms to improve sales visibility, productivity, and execution.
* Develop and maintain sales reporting, dashboards, forecasting, and performance tracking to support data-driven decision-making.
* Support territory planning, account prioritization, opportunity management, and pipeline planning in collaboration with Sales and KAM teams.
* Ensure CRM data integrity, completeness, consistency, and governance across relevant product and customer records.
* Analyze sales and customer data to identify product trends, whitespace opportunities, adoption gaps, and revenue opportunities.

**We are looking for someone with:**
**Product Management Expertise**

* Strong understanding of product lifecycle management - ideation, development, launch, adoption, optimization, and retirement.
* Ability to develop product strategy, roadmap, positioning, and value proposition.
* Strong understanding of market research, customer insights, competitor analysis, and portfolio management.
* Ability to translate customer and market needs into product requirements and actionable product initiatives.
* Strong commercial understanding of revenue, pricing, margins, adoption, and profitability.

**Sales Enablement**

* Ability to translate product features into sales propositions and customer benefits.
* Experience developing sales decks, product brochures, battlecards, FAQs, competitor comparisons, objection-handling guides, and product demos.
* Strong understanding of sales processes, pipeline management, account prioritization, and opportunity management.
* Ability to conduct product training and enablement sessions for Sales and KAM teams.
* Strong collaboration skills to bridge Product, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success.

**CRM, Marketing Automation & Technology**

* Strong working knowledge of CRM platforms such as Salesforce/SFDC.
* Experience with marketing automation platforms such as Marketo, HubSpot, or equivalent.
* Understanding of CRM data management, lead management, campaign workflows, and reporting.
* Ability to leverage technology to streamline processes and improve sales and marketing efficiency.
* Familiarity with e-commerce platforms and digital customer journeys is desirable.

**Data & Analytics Expertise**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to interpret sales, marketing, customer, product, and campaign data and convert insights into actions.
* Experience with dashboards, reporting, forecasting, and performance tracking.
* Knowledge of GA4 or similar digital analytics platforms.
* Strong understanding of marketing and product KPIs including conversion, engagement, adoption, retention, renewal, pipeline, and revenue.
* Advanced MS Excel skills; familiarity with Power BI or other visualization tools is an advantage.

**Communication & Stakeholder Management**

* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Ability to communicate complex product concepts in a simple, compelling, customer-focused manner.
* Strong stakeholder management skills across Sales, Marketing, Editorial, Technology, Finance, Operations, and senior leadership.
* Ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.
* Strong facilitation and presentation skills for internal and external audiences.

**Strategic & Commercial Thinking**

* Strong business acumen and commercial orientation.
* Ability to connect product decisions with revenue, margin, customer value, and business objectives.
* Strong strategic thinking combined with a hands-on execution mindset
* Strong understanding of competitive dynamics and ability to develop data-backed recommendations.

**Education / Domain Knowledge**

* Preferred Educational Background: MBA / PGDM in Marketing, Product Management, Business Strategy, or related discipline.
* Bachelor's degree in any relevant discipline.

**Preferred Industry Experience:**

* Higher Education Publishing
* EdTech / Digital Learning
* SaaS / Technology
* Education Services
* Academic Content / Learning Solutions

**Why Work for us?**
The work you do at McGraw Hill will be work that matters. As a leading education partner for millions of educators, learners, and professionals, we are expanding the possibilities of content and technology to make learning better in a connected world.
  
  
This position offers a strong foundation and a clear growth path toward product management for the right candidate. You will gain broad exposure to product, commercial, and operational functions within a globally recognized education business working with real data, real products, and real business decisions from day one.
  
  
McGraw Hill recruiters always use a “@mheducation.com or @careers.mheducation.com” email address and/or from our Applicant Tracking System, iCIMS. Any variation of this email domain should be considered suspicious. Additionally, McGraw Hill recruiters and authorized representatives will never request sensitive information in email.

title: Business Analyst
description:
**Project Role :**
Business Analyst
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Analyze an organization and design its processes and systems, assessing the business model and its integration with technology. Assess current state, identify customer requirements, and define the future state and/or business solution. Research, gather and synthesize information.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
Openlink Endur Functional
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
NA
  
  
**Minimum 7.5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
15 years full time education
  
  
Summary:
  
  
As a Business Analyst, a typical day involves thoroughly examining the structure and operations of an organization to understand how its processes and systems function together. This role requires evaluating the existing business model and how it aligns with technological components. The day includes identifying the needs of customers and stakeholders, envisioning improved future states or solutions, and conducting detailed research to collect and integrate relevant information. Collaboration with various teams to ensure a comprehensive understanding of the business environment and its challenges is also a key part of daily activities.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  
  

* Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform.
* Responsible for team decisions.
* Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
* Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams.
* Facilitate communication between business units and technical teams to ensure alignment of objectives.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives by analyzing business processes and recommending enhancements.
* Support junior team members by providing guidance and sharing knowledge to foster professional growth.

**About The Role**
We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Technical Analyst to support Post-Merger
  
  
Integration (PMI) initiatives. This hybrid role combines strong domain understanding with
  
  
hands-on technical skills to independently discover and validate requirements, design
  
  
clear frameworks, and develop execution plans. A core focus is to analyze the acquired
  
  
company’s technology and process stack, map it to our ecosystem, and recommend the
  
  
best integration approach. They will ensure outcomes are well-defined, feasible,
  
  
measurable, and delivered on time.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* PMI Discovery & Assessment: Rapidly inventory and assess the acquired

company’s product, data, and process stack (applications, data models, APIs,
  
  
integrations, workflows, SLAs), documenting current-state capabilities and
  
  
constraints.
  
  

* Stack Mapping & Alignment: Create detailed mappings from acquired systems to

our platforms and processes, including data entities/attributes, interface
  
  
touchpoints, roles/permissions, and operational handoffs; identify overlaps, gaps,
  
  
and deprecation candidates.
  
  

* Integration Options & Recommendations: Propose integration patterns (e.g.,

consolidate, federate, phase-and-bridge), articulate trade-offs, and recommend
  
  
best-path actions aligned to business outcomes, risk, cost, and timeline.
  
  

* Technical Decomposition: Translate target-state outcomes into epics, user

stories, data contracts, and interface specifications; outline system interactions,
  
  
dependencies, and non-functional requirements (performance, security, scalability,
  
  
compliance).
  
  

* Requirement Gathering & Analysis: Lead structured discovery with stakeholders

to elicit, clarify, and document business needs and success metrics; convert
  
  
ambiguity into clear, testable, and technically feasible requirements.
  
  

* Frameworks & Documentation: Produce PMI-specific artifacts (current/target

state diagrams, sequencing/transition plans, cutover runbooks, decision logs,
  
  
RACI/DACI, prioritization matrices) to drive shared understanding and decisions.
  
  

* Execution Planning: Build and maintain integration plans with scope, milestones,

dependency maps, risks/assumptions, and mitigation strategies; define and track
  
  
measurable outcomes and KPIs.
  
  

* Data Quality & Reconciliation: Partner with data teams to define reconciliation

strategies, data quality checks, and migration validation plans; ensure lineage and
  
  
auditability across systems during transitions.
  
  

* Stakeholder Management: Manage stakeholder communication independently

across both organizations; facilitate workshops, align on scope and phasing, handle
  
  
trade-offs, and maintain a consistent communication cadence.
  
  

* Status Reporting: Provide transparent, timely status updates and executive

summaries highlighting progress, decisions/asks, risks, and blockers.
  
  
Expected Deliverables (PMI)
  
  

* Stack inventory and current-state assessment
* System and data mapping matrix (acquired â acquirer)
* Integration options summary with recommendations and trade

offs
  
  

* BRD/FRD and user stories with acceptance criteria
* Cutover plan and runbook, with risk/rollback considerations
* Reconciliation and validation plan with data quality checks

**Qualifications (Must-Have)**

* 10+ years of overall experience in technology or product environments, including

5+ years as a Technical Analyst (or similar) with hands-on experience in
  
  
integrations, re-platforming, or PMI
  
  

* Demonstrated ability to assess unfamiliar stacks and produce clear mappings to a

target ecosystem
  
  

* Domain-informed decision-making; can recommend integration approaches and

trade-offs during discovery/design
  
  

* Technical fluency: read/write basic SQL; interpret API specs; understand data

models and identity/permission models
  
  

* Strong stakeholder management and communication; facilitates workshops and

executive readouts
  
  

* Proficient with Jira, Confluence, Salesforce, Snowflake, and Lucidchart (or

equivalents)
  
  
Working Style, Tools, and Processes
  
  

* Working style: Independent executor who drives clarity in ambiguous,

fast-changing PMI contexts; concise communicator who surfaces risks early and
  
  
proposes options; collaborative partner balancing business value, user impact, and
  
  
technical feasibility.
  
  

* Tools: Salesforce (CRM), Snowflake (data platform), Jira (delivery), Confluence

(documentation), and Lucidchart (flows/architecture). Also comfortable with
  
  
Google Docs/Slides or Microsoft PowerPoint for presentations, and Sigma
  
  
Computing or comparable lightweight dashboards/BI for metrics.
  
  

* Core practices: Executive-ready status updates, decision logs, RAID registers;

disciplined backlog hygiene, requirements traceability, and version control for
  
  
documentation.

* Develop dashboards, KPI reports, and analytical solutions (F100, ACPU, warranty, quality, and engineering performance metrics) to enable data-driven decision-making.
* Execute projects leveraging Power Apps, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), and automation technologies to improve productivity, quality, and business processes.
* Partners with Product Engineering, Current Product Management, and Manufacturing teams to investigate issues, support in implementing corrective actions, and enhance product reliability.
* Analyze vehicle telemetry and usage data from multiple platforms to identify opportunities for product enhancements, predictive insights, customer support, and service optimization.
* Design and maintain enterprise data solutions, automated workflows, Power Apps, and reporting platforms that integrate diverse data sources and streamline operations.
* Advance analytics, AI/ML capabilities, automation, data governance, and engineering content management practices to increase efficiency, accuracy, and business value.
* Transform complex data into actionable intelligence, enabling fact-based decisions, continuous improvement, and quality excellence across global AG product lines.

**Experience Required**

* Experience in Advanced Analytics, Data Engineering, and Business Intelligence Solutions.
* Experience working with Python, Databricks, SQL, Power BI, Power Query, Excel, Power Apps, and Qlik Sense.
* Support in developing and deploying Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), and Generative AI solutions.
* Experience working with large-scale structured and unstructured datasets, cloud-based data platforms, and data lake environments.
* Strong understanding of KPI management, dashboard development, reporting automation, and data visualization techniques.
* Experience in working on data like telematics, warranty, engineering performance, bill of material or quality.
* Knowledge of Azure DevOps, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Azure databrick, and enterprise reporting ecosystems is preferred.
* Experience supporting digital transformation, automation, and process improvement initiatives.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders.
* 2 to 6 years of prior work experience in data analysis using statistical tools and providing inferences along with recommendations

**Preferred Qualifications**
Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical / Electrical / Computer Science) or similar

We offer dynamic career opportunities across an international landscape. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to delivering value for all our employees and fostering a culture of respect.
  
  
At CNH, we understand that the best solutions come from the diverse experiences and skills of our people. Here, you will be empowered to grow your career, to follow your passion, and help build a better future. To support our employees, we offer regional comprehensive benefits.

title: Customer Insights / Research Manager
description:
**Description**
At the intersection of commerce and creativity, knowing our customers is how we make sure every campaign, every persona, and every product decision actually serves the artists and fans who make Redbubble and TeePublic what they are. This role owns customer research end-to-end: translating business questions into rigorous survey design, running studies from fielding through statistical analysis, and turning findings into recommendations the business acts on.
  
  
This is a one-person research function. This person is the evolution from "we have the data" to "we changed a campaign, a persona, or a business call because of it." Research today is split across people layering it on top of other jobs; this role replaces that with a single, dedicated owner who can run the full research lifecycle independently, identify where new research should happen before anyone asks, collaborate with stakeholders where needed, and scale the practice to match how fast the business moves.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**
Survey Design & Development (30%) - Independently develop, program, and field quantitative surveys in Qualtrics, from writing questions that map to specific business/marketing decisions through logic, sampling, and distribution.
  
  
Statistical Analysis (30%) - Analyze results for statistically significant findings; ensure claims used in decks and personas are backed by real data, not directional guesses.
  
  
Insight-to-Action Translation (25%) - Convert findings into concrete marketing and business recommendations; partner directly with brand, content, and licensing stakeholders
  
  
Program Management & Scale (15%) - Own the research roadmap and survey bank; build repeatable playbooks/templates/operatins so research scales beyond one-off studies; partner with existing survey ops and crosstab/analytics support as the practice matures.
  
  
**Requirements**

* 5+ years hands-on experience in customer insights, consumer research, or market research
* Expert-level Qualtrics proficiency (survey design, logic, distribution, reporting) - non-negotiable
* Operated research program for US business, preferably eccomerce or retail either in-house or with an agency - non negotiable
* Demonstrated experience running research in a scrappy company, ideally as the sole owner
* Strong quantitative skills: statistical significance testing, crosstab analysis, regression
* Ability to translate raw data into narrative-driven, actionable recommendations for non-research stakeholders
* Excellent written and verbal communication; comfortable presenting to leadership

title: Associate Consultant - Technology Strategy
description:
**What makes Gartner Consulting a GREAT fit for you?**
Gartner Consulting is an extension of Gartner’s world-renowned Research. We partner directly with CxOs across industry and government, helping organisations make smarter and faster decisions to achieve their mission-critical priorities.
  
  
Our Consulting team is made up of strategists, innovators, consultants, digital experts, former practitioners, and technologists, delivering 2,100+ strategic consulting engagements annually. We deliver unbiased and independent solutions, helping change conventional thinking and accomplish ground-breaking results for our clients.
  
  
We are a diverse team of strategic thought leaders. As we continue to grow we look for great people to join us on that journey, and grow with us.
  
  
**About Role:**
Gartner Consulting is looking for an Associate Consultant who will work with some of the world’s largest enterprises on their mission-critical priorities. The Associate Consultant will support consulting teams through structured research, quantitative and qualitative analysis, development of insights, and creation of high-quality client deliverables across digital strategy, technology strategy, operating model and enterprise transformation engagements.
  
  
**What you’ll do:**

* Work as a collaborative member of consulting teams serving some of the world’s largest enterprises, supporting engagements focused on digital strategy, technology strategy, operating model, enterprise transformation and other mission-critical priorities.
* Develop broad consulting experience across industries and practice areas, while building foundational capabilities in research, analytics, problem solving, client communication and engagement delivery.
* Develop an understanding of client objectives, industry context and potential obstacles; structure assigned work to support engagement priorities and client deliverables.
* Execute primary research and information-gathering activities, including collecting, organizing and validating client data, conducting market research and using Gartner research and benchmarks.
* Perform clearly structured quantitative, qualitative and technical analyses with guidance, applying relevant Gartner methodologies, frameworks and best practices.
* Test hypotheses using available evidence, identify patterns and anomalies, and translate research and analysis into straightforward insights, conclusions and recommendations with guidance.
* Summarize analyses and observations for specific client deliverables or broader teamwork, clearly distinguishing facts, assumptions and areas requiring further validation.
* Prepare high-quality client outputs, including executive presentations, assessment findings, workshop materials, roadmaps, business cases and written recommendations, using clear storylines and effective data visualization.
* Participate in client interviews, workshops and working sessions; listen actively, ask relevant clarifying questions, document requirements and decisions, and support agreed follow-up actions.
* Manage and prioritize assigned activities effectively, deliver work products within agreed timelines, and proactively communicate progress, dependencies, issues and risks to the engagement team.
* Take ownership of the accuracy and quality of facts, data and analyses presented; conduct self and peer review, flag anomalies or concerns, and incorporate feedback before work is shared.
* Invest in self-development, seek and apply coaching, participate in Gartner learning communities, and contribute to internal knowledge and intellectual capital development when requested.

**What you’ll need:**

* 2–4 years of professional experience in consulting, strategy, research, technology, business transformation or a related field. At least 2 years of Technology strategy consulting experience is highly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to gather, organize and analyze qualitative and quantitative information and convert it into clear observations or insights.
* Strong structured problem-solving skills, including the ability to break down ambiguous questions, test hypotheses, apply strategy consulting frameworks and draw evidence-based conclusions with guidance.
* Strong written, verbal and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate general and technical messages clearly and in plain language.
* Experience developing high-quality presentations, analytical outputs or written deliverables, with strong attention to accuracy, consistency and detail.
* Curiosity about business and technology trends and an interest in how digital, data, cloud, automation and emerging technologies can improve business outcomes.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel; familiarity with data analysis, visualization, research or AI-enabled productivity tools is an advantage.
* Strong collaboration and interpersonal skills, including the ability to work effectively with globally distributed and cross-border teams.
* A curious and inquisitive mindset, openness to feedback and new experiences, and the ability to learn quickly and work effectively in ambiguous environments.
* Bachelor’s degree required in engineering, technology, computer science, mathematics, statistics or a related discipline; an advanced degree in management is preferred.

**Who you are:**

* Self-starter and quick learner who takes ownership of assigned work and demonstrates intellectual curiosity and a commitment to client impact.
* Analytical thinker who approaches problems logically, asks relevant questions and uses evidence to develop sound conclusions.
* Clear communicator who can synthesize complex information into concise, audience-appropriate messages and high-quality deliverables.
* Collaborative team member who builds effective working relationships, responds well to coaching and actively incorporates feedback.
* Organized and dependable, with the ability to manage priorities, meet agreed timelines and proactively raise issues or concerns.
* Client-focused professional who listens actively, understands how assigned work connects to client objectives and takes responsibility for accuracy and quality.
* Committed to continuous learning, including developing awareness of Gartner methodologies, consulting best practices, business trends and the responsible use of approved AI-enabled productivity tools.

**What Gartner Consulting will offer you?**

* A world-class consulting environment.
* The opportunity to work on high-impact digital, technology strategy and enterprise transformation engagements with a tier one client portfolio.
* A competitive salary.
* Structured bonus based on individual and corporate performance.
* Opportunities for promotion with a clearly defined career development structure.
* Opportunity to participate actively in the development and future of Gartner Consulting.
* A dynamic but relaxed and supportive working environment that encourages personal development.

**About Gartner:**
Gartner, Inc. (NYSE: IT) is the world’s leading information technology research and advisory company. We deliver the technology-related insight necessary for our clients to make the right decisions, every day. We work with every client to research, analyze and interpret the business of IT within the context of their individual role. Founded in 1979, Gartner is headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut, U.S.A. – Visit gartner.com to discover more.
  
  
**Who are we?**
At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.
  
  
Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.
  
  
Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.
  
  
**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**
Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.
  
  
We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.
  
  
Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.
  
  
We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.
  
  
**Gartner is the world authority on AI**
At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.
  
  
It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.
  
  
**What do we offer?**
Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.
  
  
In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.
  
  
Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

title: Marketing Lead - Analytics And Attribution
description:
Lead, Marketing Analytics and Attribution

Fintech Cloud Pvt. Ltd. | Delhi NCR | Full-time

Reports to: Chief Marketing Officer

Experience: 6 to 10 years, with at least 3 in performance marketing analytics

Team: Individual contributor initially, building a team as the function scales

ABOUT FINTECH CLOUD

Fintech Cloud is a lending technology and operations platform. We run the origination, underwriting and servicing infrastructure for RBI-registered NBFC partners, and operate the consumer lending brands they lend through. The business is growing quickly, in both partner count and marketing investment.

This role is part of the marketing function being built to support that growth. It reports to the Chief Marketing Officer and is hands-on from day one, with scope to build a team as the function expands.

THE ROLE

We run performance marketing across a portfolio of consumer lending brands, each with its own lending partner and its own systems. This role builds the measurement layer that ties marketing spend to loan outcomes, and owns the commercial numbers the function is judged on. It is a build role rather than a reporting one.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

• The marketing data layer, bringing partner data into a single warehouse with a consistent schema so performance is comparable across brands and lenders.

• Server-side tracking and offline conversion imports, so Google and Meta optimise toward funded loans rather than form fills.

• Cost per disbursal by channel, brand, lender and geography, which is the primary commercial metric for the function.

• Approval rate and repeat-borrower analysis by acquisition source, and the reporting that supports partner-level governance.

• Dashboards that marketing, finance and the credit team all trust and use.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• Deep experience with GA4, server-side GTM, and conversion APIs for Google and Meta.

• SQL fluency and hands-on work with a cloud warehouse such as BigQuery or Snowflake.

• Experience building attribution where the conversion event sits days downstream of the click, ideally in lending, insurance or another considered-purchase category.

• Comfort working with engineering teams to get data out of systems you do not control.

• A dashboard-sceptical mindset, meaning someone who validates numbers rather than reporting them.

NICE TO HAVE

• Lending, NBFC or fintech background, and familiarity with loan funnel stages through to disbursal.

SUCCESS AT SIX MONTHS

• A single source of truth for marketing performance across all brands and lenders.

• Cost per disbursal available by channel and brand, and trusted by finance.

• Conversion data flowing back to the ad platforms, with campaigns optimising to disbursal.

title: Technical Business Analyst – Client Facing | Conversational AI & Integrations
description:
**About the Role**

MyOperator is hiring a
**Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) / Technical Business Analyst**
to bridge the gap between business requirements and production-grade Conversational AI deployments.

In this customer-facing, delivery-focused role, you will work directly with clients to translate real-world business workflows into structured AI bot architectures. You will lead requirement discovery workshops, author detailed solution/BRD documentation, execute system prompt engineering, configure webhooks/APIs, run regression testing, and iterate on live conversational logs until containment and resolution targets are met.

This role is ideal for
**Business Analysts with a Computer Science/IT/Engineering background**
or
**Solutions/Implementation/Product Engineers**
who possess both strong stakeholder management capabilities and the technical depth required to debug payloads, write structured LLM prompts, and trace API integration logs.

**About MyOperator**

MyOperator is a Business AI Operator, a category-leader that unifies WhatsApp, Calls, and AI-powered chat & voice bots into one intelligent business communication platform. Unlike fragmented communication tools, MyOperator combines automation, intelligence, and workflow integration to help businesses run WhatsApp campaigns, manage calls, deploy AI chatbots, and track performance — all from a single, no-code platform. Trusted by 12,000+ brands including Amazon, Domino's, Apollo, and Razorpay, MyOperator enables faster responses, higher resolution rates, and scalable customer engagement — without fragmented tools or increased headcount

**Key Responsibilities & Observable Work Outputs**

**Requirement Discovery & Business Process Mapping**

* Lead discovery workshops with client business and technical teams; translate ambiguous business processes into structured conversational user flows, intent trees, fallback policies, and Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs/BRDs).

**AI Solution Specification & Architecture**

* Convert client use cases into technical specifications, detailing system integration points (CRM, ERP, ticketing), API payload requirements, database parameters, and data security constraints.

**Prompt Engineering & Knowledge Grounding**

* Write, test, and refine system prompts, context instruction sets, guardrails, and tool/function call definitions to enforce deterministic bot behaviour and eliminate hallucinations.

**API Integration & Technical Debugging**

* Configure REST API webhooks between MyOperator's platform and third-party systems (e.g., Salesforce, Zoho, LeadSquared, internal databases); inspect and debug JSON request/response logs to resolve integration breakages.

**Testing, Log Analysis & Containment Iteration**

* Conduct transcript reviews of live bot interactions; build "golden conversation" test sets, run regression cycles, and optimize bot containment and task completion rates post-go-live.

**Cross-Functional Technical Alignment**

* Act as the technical voice of the customer to internal Product and Core Engineering teams—documenting platform feature gaps, API limitations, and core bugs with reproducible logs.

**Must-Have Requirements**

* **Education & Technical Foundation:**
  Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical/STEM discipline (B.E. / B.Tech / BCA / MCA / B.Sc IT).
* **Total Experience:**
  2 to 5 years of experience operating as a
  **Technical Business Analyst**
  ,
  **Forward Deployed Engineer**
  ,
  **Solutions Engineer**
  ,
  **Implementation Consultant**
  , or
  **Technical Product Analyst**
  in a B2B SaaS, software, or IT services firm.
* **Technical Documentation:**
  Demonstrated experience writing technical use-case documents, Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Process Flow Diagrams (Visio/Lucidchart/Miro), or API specification documents.
* **API & Data Literacy:**
  Hands-on ability to read and understand REST APIs, webhooks, JSON structures, and HTTP status codes (must be able to construct and inspect API calls via tools like Postman or cURL).
* **LLM & Conversational AI Concepts:**
  Practical, non-casual understanding of LLM parameters (system prompts, context windows, guardrails, function calling, tool use, temperature) or rule-based/NLU bot flow builders.
* **Customer-Facing Delivery Ownership:**
  Direct experience in client-facing discovery meetings, solution scoping, or delivery management with external business stakeholders.

**Good-to-Have / Preferred Signals**

* Prior hands-on experience configuring or deploying Conversational AI platforms (e.g., Dialogflow, Yellow.ai, Gupshup, Enterprise OpenAI assistants, Rasa) or WhatsApp Business API.
* Scripting or automation skills in Python, JavaScript, or no-code iPaaS tools (Make, Zapier, n8n, Zoho Flow).
* Familiarity with conversational metrics: Containment Rate, Task Completion Rate, Fallback Rate, First Response Time, and CSAT drivers.
* Exposure to CRM platforms (Zoho, Salesforce, LeadSquared) and enterprise knowledge repositories (SharePoint, Notion, SQL databases).

**Explicit Anti-Fit Criteria**

* **Non-Technical / Pure Business Backgrounds:**
  BA candidates without a technical/computer science degree or without demonstrable experience handling technical API/integration specifications.
* **Pure Coding / Internal Engineering Only:**
  Software engineers or developers seeking pure back-end/full-stack coding roles who have no interest or experience in client-facing workshops or requirement gathering.
* **Pure BPO / Non-Technical Support:**
  Candidates coming strictly from voice-process customer service, call centres, or transactional helpdesk without platform implementation experience.
* **Casual AI Users:**
  Candidates who describe standard ChatGPT text generation or copywriting as "Prompt Engineering" without experience building structured system prompts, tool interfaces, or guardrails for software applications.
* **Hands-Off Project Management:**
  Project managers or coordinators who delegate technical configuration and documentation entirely to developers without understanding the underlying technical workflows themselves.

**Target Metrics & Operational KPIs**

* **Implementation Turnaround Time (TAT):**
  % of assigned bot projects taken live within agreed timeline SOWs.
* **First-Time-Right (FTR) Quality:**
  Zero critical post-launch rework or broken workflow redesigns within 30 days of go-live.
* **Bot Performance Metrics:**
  Containment rate and task completion rate on deployed bots
* **Documentation Quality:**
  Assigned projects delivered with fully populated solution architecture diagrams, prompt packs, and API mapping documents.

title: Product Manager / Business Analyst - Digital & AI
description:
**Debound**
· Delhi NCR

You will sit between the engineering teams building our digital platforms and the project directors, client organisations and site teams who use them. Your job is to turn how infrastructure delivery actually works into specifications an engineering team can build against, and to keep what gets built honest to what was asked for.

What you'll own

* **Requirement gathering across a difficult stakeholder set.**
  Project directors, resident engineers, client organisations and site teams each describe the same process differently. You will run the discovery, resolve the contradictions, and write the version everyone signs off on.
* **Specifications and acceptance criteria.**
  Written clearly enough that an engineer can build from them and a reviewer can test against them.
* **Code and delivery review.**
  Not as the approving engineer, but as the person who checks that what shipped matches what was specified, and who catches the edge cases nobody raised in the requirements session.
* **Feasibility judgement on AI features.**
  Deciding what is genuinely deliverable, what is a demo dressed as a product, and how to phase the difference.
* **Translation in both directions.**
  Explaining engineering constraints to non-technical stakeholders, and site realities to engineers who have never been to a project site.

What we're looking for

* **Requirements and elicitation experience.**
  Evidence of specs you have written, acceptance criteria you have defined, and scope you have held. We are more interested in ambiguity you resolved than in features you listed.
* **A technical foundation strong enough to read code.**
  A computer science degree, or several years shipping software before moving into product or analysis. You will not write production code, but you will read pull requests and judge whether an implementation matches its spec.
* **Written and spoken communication of a high standard.**
  You will produce documents that go to senior stakeholders and to client organisations. Send us something you have written.
* **Working literacy in AI and agentic systems.**
  Enough to challenge an estimate, evaluate a vendor claim, and understand why a demo that works on ten documents may not work on ten thousand.
* **Comfort with complex, regulated delivery environments.**
  Structured processes, audit requirements and documentation standards should feel normal rather than obstructive.

Signals that would move you to the top of the list

* Infrastructure, construction, EPC or PMC domain exposure — highways, bridges, railways, urban development, power, or water.
* Experience with government or multilateral clients, and with the documentation and approval cycles they require.
* Having worked on project monitoring, ERP, GIS or field-data-collection platforms.
* Any hands-on work with LLM tooling, workflow automation, or data pipelines, however small.
* Familiarity with BIM, DPR workflows, or construction supervision processes.

What this role is not

It is not a delivery or scrum-master role, and it is not roadmap authorship at a distance from the build. You will be in the detail: in requirement sessions, in the spec, in the pull request, and on site when that is what it takes to understand the problem.

* Equally, it is not an engineering role. If you want to stay hands-on writing code, this will frustrate you.
