Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
  
  
**Description**
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two Hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 4 million Hosts who have welcomed more than 1 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, Hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
  
  
The Analytics Centre of Excellence (ACOE) at Airbnb, based in India, is a hub of knowledge and expertise that aims to provide data-driven decision-making, enabling Airbnb's business goals. The ACOE's vision is to build a world-class analytics organization that provides scalable analytics. We work with various business functions such as payments, trust, digital, customer support, hosting, sales, social, compliance, risk, platforms and partnership & economics.
  
  
The ACOE's delivery framework is designed to provide relevant and contextual insights for data-driven decisions. This includes a one-stop solution for metrics, dashboards driving actionable insights, optimization of performance, measuring pre/post feature impact, sizing the ROI of opportunities, prioritization of opportunities, anomaly-driven alerting mechanisms, root cause analysis of metric deviation, and exploratory hypothesis testing.
  
  
**The Community You Will Join**
**We are looking for a Senior Analyst to serve as an AI Vision Multiplier for the CS organisation — a builder-analyst with a clear mandate to translate Airbnb’s internal AI capabilities into working solutions that make AI-powered analytics accessible, trusted, and actionable across CS.**
The analyst must have functional expertise in building analytical solutions and be a trusted partner to business teams and leaders, through providing insights, recommendations, and enabling data driven decisions. This role will sit under the Advanced Analytics family and support Business leaders within our Community Support organization. You will partner directly with functions and operational leaders across Community Support. This role will be responsible for making CS smarter and faster, and enable self-serve through data. You will be the team’s dedicated AI practitioner, building agentic solutions and intelligent interfaces that elevate the entire organisation toward self-serve.
  
  
**The Difference You Will Make**

* Build agentic analytics pipelines that automate insight generation across all key metrics including contact volume, handle time, and resolution quality — reducing analytical drag across CS.
* Develop reusable skill libraries — composable agent tools (volume lookups, NPS pulls, handle time calculations) callable across workflows and teams.
* Design and govern prompt templates and playbooks — standardised, governed prompts for recurring analytical questions (e.g. “what drove contact volume this week”).
* Build orchestration workflows — multi-step pipelines that chain skills together to produce automated insight narratives and proactive alerts without manual intervention.
* Deploy self-serve interfaces that enable non-technical personas to query certified data independently.
* Ship rapid, prompt-driven dashboards that compress the cycle from business question to live view, serving varied personas without analyst bottleneck.
* Automate business reviews — scheduled, agent-generated summaries of key CS metrics delivered to stakeholders without manual effort.
* Build and maintain evaluation and observability frameworks that monitor agent output quality, detect drift, and ensure outputs stay within governed data boundaries.
* Define, document, and certify metrics within Minerva 2.0 and Midas, ensuring agentic outputs and self-serve interfaces are anchored to a single source of truth across CS.

**A Typical Day**

* Drive the analytics roadmap, prioritization, and delivery of solutions in up to a quarter ahead. Execute projects with regular direction providing constant updates to business stakeholders, analytics management and deliver against agreed timelines.
* Partner with CS operational leaders to translate ambiguous business problems into agentic or automated analytical solutions — independently scoping, building, and iterating end to end.
* Prototype and ship prompt-driven dashboards and apps, compressing the cycle from question to live view for varied CS personas.
* Build and iterate on skill libraries and orchestration workflows, expanding the reusable agent toolkit available to the CS Analytics team.
* Monitor agent output quality via observability frameworks, identifying drift or hallucinations and maintaining governance standards.
* Engage directly with key stakeholders to prioritise the self-serve and automation needs, setting and delivering against a quarterly roadmap.
* Stay at the forefront of applied AI developments, evaluating new tools and frameworks for relevance to CS use cases and embedding them rapidly into workflows.
* Ensure the availability of data quality and integrity for analysis and reporting by blending external and internal data sources, working closely with global operations and India analytics functions.

**Your Expertise**

* 5+ years of experience in analytics/data science with a strong track record of solving ambiguous business problems and driving measurable impact, shipping AI-enabled solutions, not just analyses.
* Proven ability to own end-to-end data projects — from problem scoping and data extraction to analysis, insight generation (including BI tools), and business recommendations
* Advanced SQL and Python at production-grade standard, with experience on large-scale data systems (Presto, Hive, Spark).
* Rapid front-end prototyping — vibe-coded dashboards, apps, or embedded analytics built at speed for non-technical audiences.
* Advanced Tableau proficiency for certified, production-grade BI delivery.
* Metrics governance and certification — ability to define, document, and certify metrics, ensuring agentic outputs are anchored to a single source of truth.
* Production LLM and prompt engineering experience — shipped LLM-integrated workflows, governed prompt libraries, and retrieval-based systems.
* Agentic system and orchestration design — tool chaining, context management, and building reliable pipelines with minimal human-in-the-loop intervention.
* RAG, vector databases, and semantic search — applied to unstructured contact and case data.
* Agent output evaluation and observability — experience monitoring AI pipeline quality and maintaining governance guardrails.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex AI-powered solutions into clear narratives for non-technical business stakeholders.
* Self-starter mindset with high ownership, comfortable operating with quarterly autonomy in a fast-paced environment.

**Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging**
Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.
  
  
**How We'll Take Care Of You**
Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is inclusive of allowances and is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus or incentives, one or more equity programs, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.
  
  
India Annual Pay Range
  
  
₹1,960,000—₹2,800,000 INR
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodations:**
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.
  
  
**A Note on Recruiting Scams:**
Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

title: Senior Quick Commerce Executive
description:
**Position: Senior Quick Commerce Executive**

**Experience: 3-5 years**

**Location: Kirti Nagar, Delhi**

**Department: eCommerce**

**Employment Type: Full-time**

**Company Description**

Sneakare is a New Delhi-based fastest-growing sneaker care brand, built for people who genuinely love what they are wearing on the foot. We market premium, no-nonsense products — cleaning kits, insoles, suede care, and storage solutions — designed to help sneaker fans protect what they paid for and wear what they love, longer. We started small, made it to Shark Tank India, and haven't slowed down since. Our team is young, fast-moving, and obsessed with getting things right — whether that's a product formula, a listing copy, or a customer interaction. We care about quality over shortcuts, ownership over excuses, and learning over ego.

**Role Overview**

As Senior Quick Commerce Executive, you will own Sneakare's presence and performance across q-commerce platforms — Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, and emerging dark-store networks. You will drive cataloguing, availability, visibility, and sell-through while working cross-functionally with supply chain, marketing, and the founder's office to scale this fast-growing channel into a significant revenue engine.

**Key Responsibilities**

1) Platform Ownership: Manage end-to-end operations across Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, and other q-commerce platforms — including onboarding, cataloguing, content hygiene, and store-level availability.

2) Revenue & Growth: Own the q-commerce P&L; set GMV targets, drive week-on-week growth, and execute strategies to maximise share-of-shelf and brand visibility.

3) Inventory Planning: Work closely with the supply chain team to forecast demand, manage FIFO at dark stores, reduce out-of-stock instances, and optimise replenishment cycles.

4) Campaign & Promotions: Plan and execute platform-specific promotions, banner ads, and seasonal campaigns in coordination with the marketing team to improve CTR and conversion.

5) Data & Analytics: Track key metrics (fill rate, return rate, sell-through, SOV, ranking) using platform dashboards and internal tools; present weekly and monthly performance reviews to leadership.

6) Vendor & KAM Relations: Build and maintain strong relationships with Key Account Managers at each platform to secure better placement, promotional slots, and priority listing.

7) New Product Launches: Coordinate go-live of new SKUs across q-commerce channels with accurate catalogue content, pricing, and availability aligned with launch timelines.

8) Pricing & Competitiveness: Monitor competitive pricing and market trends; recommend pricing adjustments to maintain margin while staying competitive.

9) Cross-functional Collaboration: Coordinate with warehouse, logistics, finance, and marketing teams to ensure smooth, scalable q-commerce operations.

10) Process Building: Document SOPs and build scalable processes for catalogue management, inventory alerts, and promotional workflows as the channel grows.

**What We're Looking For**

**Must-Haves**

1. 3-5 years of experience in e-commerce, quick commerce, or category/account management, preferably in a D2C, FMCG, or consumer brand
2. Hands-on experience managing at least one of the major q-commerce platforms (Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart) with a track record of growing GMV
3. Strong analytical skills — comfortable pulling data from Seller Central/platform dashboards and building Excel/Sheets-based performance trackers
4. Proven ability to manage multiple platforms, SKUs, and vendors simultaneously in a fast-paced environment
5. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills for KAM relationships and internal cross-team coordination

title: Pricing Analyst
description: Reimagine access. Reimagine ownership. title: Refinery Planning Economist
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

* Lead local Linear Programming (LP) runs at individual refineries to drive commercial optimization, focusing on generating crude relative values and rankings that inform strategic decisions. Provide inputs and review results of circuit model runs.
* Analyze major constraints impacting asset logistics and unit performance, identifying investment ideas. Challenge existing limits of LP outputs towards achieving ideal baselines.
* Work closely with ATC to integrate Saudi Aramco’s market perspectives into individual asset’s LPs. Assess intermediate feedstocks, blendstocks and component sales opportunities to further improve refinery margins after crude placement cycle.

* Contribute to the development of yearly business plans by providing insights into market trends and refinery operations outlook. Execute short-term optimization opportunities within production months, coordinating efforts across refineries, ATC and the central optimization team.
* Evaluate the strategic and commercial viability of potential investments aimed at enhancing the overall system’s efficiency and profitability. Lead asset’s profit improvement studies.
* Mentor junior economists and modelers in optimization principles and leading practices.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in an Engineering discipline; an MBA is highly desirable.
* Minimum of 12 years in the downstream business, encompassing both manufacturing and commercial aspects. Minimum of 3 years in executing LP models and economic analysis. Prior experience in Refinery-Chemical integration is advantageous.
* In-depth understanding of engineering practices, economic principles and calculation methodology. Proficiency in international business and cross-cultural professional practices is essential. Basic fluency in Mandarin or Korean would be beneficial.

title: Associate, Lead Exposure
description:
WJCF is an Indian non-profit organisation committed to saving lives by reducing the burden of disease and strengthening government-owned, high-quality health systems. Since 2007, WJCF has combined data-driven approaches and deep public health expertise with strong government partnerships to design, implement, and scale solutions across India’s national and state health programmes. We work for and at the service of governments — supporting the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare and State Departments of Health to build systems that are strong, sustainable, and led by Indian institutions.
  
  
As an Indian organisation, WJCF brings an unmatched depth of contextual understanding of India’s health system architecture, policy landscape, and implementation realities across diverse geographies and population groups. This local institutional credibility, combined with global technical rigour, is central to WJCF’s effectiveness as a partner to governments and donors.
  
  
Our work is built around four complementary roles as a Trusted Government Partner, co-designing programmes and strengthening health system architecture; as an Operational Partner, translating strategies into effective on-the-ground delivery; as a Market Shaper, improving the availability and affordability of health commodities; and as an Ecosystem Catalyst, convening governments, development partners, academia, and the private sector to drive solutions at scale.
  
  
WJCF’s programme portfolio spans thematic areas like hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis, vector-borne diseases), syphilis, cervical cancer, diabetes, maternal and childhood anaemia, immunisation, under-5 diarrhoea and pneumonia, sexual and reproductive health, Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri - Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY), Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM), hypoxemia and oxygen, safe drinking water, sickle cell disease, presbyopia, lead poisoning, and cross cutting thematic areas like AI and Health, integrated disease surveillance, and climate and health.
  
  
We currently support programmes across 19 states and union territories, with teams working at national, state, district, and sub-district levels.
  
  
Our people are our greatest asset. WJCF brings together a talented, diverse team of professionals from public health, analytics, consulting, healthcare, the development sector, and academia, all united by a shared commitment to improving health outcomes for the people of India. We are entrepreneurial, action-oriented, and deeply grounded in the communities and systems we work in. Our field teams collectively bring hundreds of years of experience managing public health programmes across the country.
  
  
WJCF collaborates with a range of international and domestic partners and donors to advance its mission, including an affiliation with the Clinton Health Access Initiative (CHAI), a global health organisation with which WJCF shares a common mission and values.
  
  
Programme Overview
  
  
Lead poisoning is one of India's most significant and most solvable public health challenges. India bears the world's highest burden of childhood lead poisoning, with over 275 million children carry blood lead levels above 5 µg/dL; the national average is 6.2 µg/dL and 23 States exceed the threshold (NITI Aayog and CSIR review, 2022). Lead exposure causes irreversible neurological damage in children, contributes to an estimated one million cardiovascular deaths annually in adults (Larsen et al., 2023), and generates compounding intergenerational risks.
  
  
National Center for Disease Control, as the designated national focal agency under MoHFW, is establishing the National Biomonitoring Programme for Chemical Toxicants (NBPCT). WJCF is embedding a Technical Support Unit (TSU) to serve as the coordination backbone for India's lead mitigation response. This embedded model builds directly on WJCF's track record of high-impact TSU engagements across TB, vector-borne diseases, oxygen, surveillance, and health insurance.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
We are seeking a motivated and analytically rigorous individual to serve as a core member of WJCF's embedded TSU. The incumbent will provide day-to-day technical, coordination, and secretariat support to government counterparts translating high-level intent into structured operational workplans, facilitating inter-ministerial coordination, and helping anchor governance architecture that outlasts individual donor cycles.
  
  
The role demands both policy acumen to navigate a complex multi-stakeholder environment and operational discipline to ensure consistent follow-through. The incumbent will report to the TSU Lead and will function under the programmatic guidance of NCDC for TSU activities.
  
  
**Location**
New Delhi (embedded at NCDC / MoHFW)
  
  
**Travel**
Domestic travel to programme states as required
  
  
TSU Secretariat and Programme Operations
  
  

* Provide day-to-day secretariat support to NCDC for the NBPCT, including preparation of meeting agendas, data-backed workplans, activity plans, and meeting charters across surveillance, capacity building, and enforcement priorities.
* Support NCDC's National Lead Technical Working Group through data synthesis, expert inputs, documentation, and follow-up mechanisms that convert deliberations into actionable outcomes.
* Support integration of state and laboratory surveillance data into the Integrated Health Information Platform (IHIP) and contribute to dashboard and visualisation design for NCDC decision-making.
* Strengthen NCDC's capacity for data-backed decision-making in hotspot identification, laboratory and referral infrastructure mapping, and partner coordination.
* Consolidate and disseminate learnings from state-level engagement through regional and national workshops.
* Support the Programme in convening and facilitating inter-ministerial consultations on lead and chemical toxicants across environment, industry, labour, food safety, water, and mines ministries.
* Prepare technical inputs, briefing materials, and correspondence for senior decision-making within the ministry.

Programme Planning and Monitoring
  
  

* Develop and maintain workplan trackers and milestone dashboards to monitor progress against grant commitments and government-agreed deliverables.
* Support development of costed annual workplans and embed these into the programme's operational budgeting cycle.
* Prepare high-quality progress reports, briefing notes, and strategy documents for donors and government counterparts.

State-Level Engagement
  
  

* Lead WJCF's engagement in focal states in coordination with NCDC and state health departments, tailoring activities to each state's readiness and existing ecosystem.
* Support state-level surveillance system strengthening and feed learnings back into the national platform for wider uptake.
* Facilitate alignment between state health and environment departments on lead-related priorities.

Stakeholder and Partner Management
  
  

* Build and maintain relationships with NCDC, MoHFW senior officials, state health departments, CPCB, FSSAI, and development partners including WHO, UNICEF, Pure Earth, Vital Strategies, and others active in the lead ecosystem.
* Support advocacy efforts in collaboration with strategic partners, ensuring technical assistance and policy advocacy are complementary

**Required**

* Postgraduate degree in public health, public policy, environmental science, health management, development studies, or a related field.
* Minimum 4-6 years of relevant experience
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and quantitative modeling skills
* Ability to build collaborative relationship with internal and external stakeholders, including more senior-level individuals
* Ability to drive forward assigned workstreams effectively (e.g., through thoughtful work planning, priority setting, stakeholder engagement, etc.)
* Entrepreneurial mindset, ability to work independently in ambiguous, semi-structured environments.
* High level of proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and Word

**Preferred**

* Experience in environmental health, chemical toxicants, or occupational health programme areas.
* Prior experience in a secretariat or TSU role supporting a government technical programme in public health
* Professional proficiency in Hindi.

To Apply
  
  
Please send your CV and a cover note of not more than one page. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

title: Paid Search Manager

Indian Rupee $116,667 - $166,667 montly

**Paid Search & Shopping Management**

* Independently manage and optimize paid search programs across multiple D2C/e-commerce brands.
* Build, manage, and optimize campaigns across:

+ Google Search
+ Google Shopping
+ Performance Max
+ Demand Gen
+ Microsoft Ads

**Campaign Strategy, Optimization & Performance Analysis**

* Proactively identify performance risks, account issues, testing opportunities, and areas for incremental growth.
* Stay current on Google Ads product updates, automation, AI-driven campaign capabilities, and changes within the paid search landscape.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5-6+ years of hands-on paid search / Google Ads experience, preferably within an agency, multi-brand organization, or D2C/e-commerce business.
* Strong experience independently managing multiple paid search accounts simultaneously.
* Demonstrated experience managing significant paid media budgets and being accountable for revenue and ROAS goals.
* Strong D2C/e-commerce experience with an understanding of how paid search contributes to overall business growth.
* Advanced hands-on knowledge of:

+ Google Search
+ Google Shopping
+ Performance Max
+ Demand Gen
+ Google Merchant Center
+ Microsoft Advertising

title: FP&A Analyst
description:
Reimagine access. Reimagine ownership. Build the future with Cinch.
  
  
Cinch is Southeast Asia’s leading circular tech subscription company, redefining how people and businesses access technology. Instead of adding to the growing e-waste crisis, we enable affordable, sustainable access to devices through subscriptions that maximize reuse and extend their lifecycle. We operate across B2C, B2B, and B2B2C channels, including major partnerships with global leaders like Samsung. Our model sits at the intersection of powerful mega trends — sustainability, embedded finance, and the shift from ownership to access — creating a massive opportunity to reshape the future of tech consumption. At Cinch, we are builders with high standards, a bias for action, and a shared mission to create a generational company that outlasts us. Freshly funded by leading institutional investors and growing rapidly, we’re creating an environment where ambitious people can do the best work of their careers — and where the work has real, lasting impact.
  
  
**The Role**
As our FP&A Analyst you will own Cinch’s budget and forecast. You will build the plan by market, track performance against it every month, and work with stakeholders across the region to keep us on plan. A subscription device business has a lot moving at once: device cost, financing, collections, churn and residual value. Your job is to know which levers matter, show where we are ahead or behind, and drive the actions that close the gap.
  
  
You will work directly with the Corporate Finance Director, the founders, and country and functional leads across our markets. Investors and lenders will see your work.
  
  
**What You'll Own**

* Budget ownership. Build and own the annual budget by market and function. Hold budget holders to it, challenge spend against it, and lead re-forecasts when the plan changes.
* Forecasting and planning. Run a rolling, driver-based forecast by market across revenue, margin, opex and cash. Keep it accurate enough that leadership uses it to make decisions.
* Variance tracking. Track actuals against budget and forecast every month, by market. Explain the drivers in plain English and recommend the actions needed to get back on plan.
* Key levers. Identify and track the operating levers that drive results in each market, such as new subscriptions, yield, churn, collections, device cost and residual value. Build a KPI view that shows leaders early when a lever is off track.
* Regional business partnering. Work with country leads, Growth, Operations and Asset Operations across markets to agree targets, own the numbers together and drive outcomes against the budget.
* Monthly reporting. Produce the monthly management pack with variance analysis against budget and prior periods, and explain the drivers in plain English.
* Unit economics. Track and model contribution margin per device, per subscriber and per channel, including cost of funds, acquisition cost, collections losses and residual value.
* Cash and funding. Maintain the cash flow forecast and support the borrowing base and covenant reporting that lenders require.
* Investor and board reporting. Prepare the financial sections of investor updates and board packs, with the Controller.
* Scenario and business-case modelling. Model new markets, products and partnership deals so decisions are made with numbers on the table.
* Data quality. Work with the Data team and RevOps to make sure the numbers you report tie back to source systems.

**What You Bring**
**Must-have**

* 2 to 4 years in FP&A, finance business partnering, or investment banking / consulting with a finance focus.
* Hands-on experience running a budget and forecast cycle, including variance analysis and re-forecasting.
* Strong stakeholder management. You can hold budget holders to account, push back with data and build trust with teams in different countries.
* Strong financial modelling skills in Excel or Google Sheets: three-statement thinking, driver-based forecasts and sensitivity analysis.
* Solid grasp of accounting fundamentals and how they flow into a P&L, balance sheet and cash flow.
* Clear communicator, able to turn a model into a one-page answer for a non-finance audience.
* Degree in finance, accounting, economics or a related field.

**Nice-to-have**

* Experience in subscription, leasing, lending, fintech or hardware businesses.
* SQL or BI tool experience (for example Looker, Metabase or Power BI).
* Exposure to lender or investor reporting, covenant tracking or borrowing base models.
* Experience in a startup or scale-up where the finance function was being built.
* Experience in a multi-country or regional finance role, ideally across Southeast Asia.
* CFA, ACCA, CPA or progress towards one.

title: Executive Vice President, Evidence
description:
**About Evidence Action**
At Evidence Action, we deliver data-driven interventions that transform lives at an unprecedented scale. We identify neglected global health issues and deploy proven solutions, forging healthier futures for generations.
  
  
Our model operationalizes leading academic research, including from Nobel-winning economists. We measure progress and outcomes at every stage to ensure we are making a real impact for people living in poverty and suffering from preventable or treatable health issues. Operating across 11 countries, our team of 900+ has reached over 500 million people, working closely with governments to scale these interventions.
  
  

* Deworm the World has delivered over 2 billion treatments, significantly reducing worm prevalence and generating more than $23 billion in lifetime productivity gains
* Safe Water Now has saved the lives of over 15,000 children
* Our Accelerator explores untapped opportunities in global health, testing low-cost interventions with the greatest potential to save and improve lives

At Evidence Action, your colleagues are your greatest asset. You will partner with high-caliber colleagues in an environment blending innovation, autonomy, and teamwork. Our team excels in disruptive thinking and believes in rolling up our sleeves to get things done. If you are looking to work flexibly and with purpose, join a team that delivers measurable change for millions.
  
  
**The Role**
Evidence Action was built on the belief that data should drive every decision, from how programs are designed and delivered to how resources are allocated and scaled. Evidence and cost-effectiveness are central to Evidence Action's comparative advantage; they are what makes us credible and distinctive to government partners and donors alike, and this role will shape how that advantage evolves as we grow.
  
  
As the Executive Vice President (EVP), Evidence, you will own the strategic growth and transformation of our Monitoring, Learning, and Evaluation teams, our Cost-Effectiveness arm, and our epidemiology capability at a pivotal organizational moment. You will sit at the intersection of technical rigor, organizational leadership, and external credibility, holding overall accountability for the reliability of the evidence that guides how Evidence Action designs, delivers, and scales its programs. Our recent Dispensers for Safe Water update reflects the transparent, evidence-first culture this role will help lead.
  
  
This is a role with two connected mandates under one leader. You will lead the generation and use of evidence throughout the program lifecycle in close collaboration with programs, while maintaining an independence in your assessment of evidence, surfacing uncomfortable findings when necessary. Bringing these together in one senior role reporting directly to the CEO gives evidence a genuine, empowered voice in our decision-making.
  
  
In this role, you will sit on Evidence Action's Global Leadership Team (GLT), which sets organizational strategy and direction. This is a pivotal opportunity for an executive who can navigate complexity, inspire high-performing teams, and translate evidence into action, driving measurable improvements in millions of lives for years to come.
  
  
**How You Will Make An Impact**
**Lead a holistic evidence function**

* Oversee the technical and strategic aspects of our evidence teams, ensuring MLE, cost-effectiveness modeling, and epidemiology connect into a single, coherent picture that informs day-to-day program improvement and major decisions, rather than separate streams of analysis
* In collaboration with GLT and program leads, set a cross-program evidence strategy, defining the questions Evidence Action is answering across its portfolio, matching the right methodological approaches and connecting evidence to both delivery and organizational learning
* Serve as a technical thought partner to teams across Evidence Action, making evidence more readily visible and actionable across the organization, evolving our cost-effectiveness tooling to enhance visibility into what drives cost-effectiveness and shortening the feedback loop between realized costs and impact and our projected impact.
* Champion evidence across a program's lifecycle, ensuring we're designing the right evidence generation to feed lessons into scaling decisions and evolving our cost-effectiveness tools so organizational leaders understand what drives cost-effectiveness and we can actualize modeled impact
* Institutionalize monitoring and learning (e.g. A/B testing) in programs so performance keeps improving well beyond launch
* Sharpen where Evidence Action's own evidence generation is uniquely valuable versus where other partners are better placed

**Own independent quality assurance**

* Understand how different evidence sources come together across programs to model our impact, and establish and enforce minimum standards for addressing weak evidence, uncertainty, and assumptions in that modeling
* Design and implement the systems that let us review evidence consistently across our portfolio, including program stage gates and structured evidence and programmatic reviews at key decision points
* Own data quality assurance so it is structurally independent from evidence generation, setting methodology standards, commissioning re-surveys and integrity checks, and surfacing issues early and transparently
* Provide evidence-based recommendations that inform program scale-up, ongoing iteration, and wind-down decisions, holding a strong voice in those decisions while partnering with program and regional leaders who bring essential local context

**Strengthen technical capability and relieve program teams**

* Build internal technical management capacity that benefit our programs
* Lead a multi-disciplinary function through consolidation and change, building trust across MLE, cost-effectiveness, and epidemiology teams and bringing our people along through a significant transition
* Identify where AI and modern data tools can strengthen evidence generation and decision-making at scale

**Represent Evidence Action externally**

* Serve as a senior organizational voice on evidence, engaging donors, the board, and technical partners on our evidence philosophy, methodological choices, and standing evaluation arrangements
* Champion a transparent culture that shares learning; including learning from what does not work, both inside the organization and with the relevant external stakeholders

**Who You Are**
We are looking for a leader with rigorous technical training who has spent much of their career as a user and steward of evidence in real implementation settings, not primarily as an academic researcher.
  
  
**Essential**

* The courage to act on evidence. You are willing to surface uncomfortable findings to senior leadership and to recommend a change of course when the evidence calls for it
* Technical leadership and management at scale. You have led similar technical teams, upholding quality assurance, in low- and middle-income country contexts with a grounding in operational rigor
* Program-implementation grounding. You pair academic research expertise with genuine operational experience, so you lead as an insider rather than from a distance.
* Technical credibility and range. A PhD or equivalent quantitative expertise that lets you judge the quality of evidence produced, hold teams to a high technical bar, draw on a range of analytical methods, and speak with authority alongside senior technical staff and external partners. Must have a background in cost-effectiveness or health economics, or the judgment to bring in the right experts
* A strong leader of teams and change. You can conceptualize change management and bring people along, delegate across a large scope, and build trust across teams and cultures

**What this role is not**

* This is not an audit or compliance role. This role is intended to build the systems and structures that reinforce the appropriate generation and application of evidence as programs evolve, so evidence becomes more than just a box we check
* This is not a publication engine. External research is not the primary goal of this work
* This is not a remote or distant role. Field presence and proximity to implementation are design requirements

**Location**
This role location is flexible, though we have a preference for a country where Evidence Action has an office, with India, Kenya, and Nigeria of particular interest.
  
  
This role will require approximately 20% travel nationally and internationally as needed.
  
  
**Benefits**
Evidence Action provides a comprehensive benefits package for employees worldwide.
  
  

* Benefits may differ based on country-specific regulations

Benefits include:
  
  
Comprehensive health insurance
  
  
Pension/ Retirement savings options
  
  
Paid leave
  
  
Avenues for engagement and recognition.
  
  
Compensation is competitive and commensurate with the individual's credentials, experience, and internal pay scale.
  
  
Evidence Action is an Equal Opportunity Employer with a commitment to representation and inclusion. All individuals, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply.

title: Platform Infrastructure Data Analyst
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**I&O Platform Infrastructure Data Analyst**
**The opportunity**
In a plan to strengthen and extend our footprint in EY Enterprise Technology we are looking for a skilled Infrastructure Data Analyst to support and evolve EY's I&O data analytics and reporting capabilities globally. This is a unique role that bridges deep data analysis with practical infrastructure knowledge, enabling the firm to transform operational data from across its data center, compute, network, storage and observability platforms into actionable intelligence.
  
  
A key focus of this role is providing the analytical intelligence layer for the Hyperconverged Service Platform (HCSP) — EY's next-generation infrastructure automation platform built on Kubernetes, Temporal and Terraform. The Data Analyst will own the measurement, reporting and continuous improvement analysis of HCSP's provisioning performance, workflow reliability, SLA attainment, drift detection efficacy and operational impact across EY's global data center estate — directly enabling the platform team to measure success, identify failure patterns and demonstrate value.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
The I&O Platform Infrastructure Data Analyst collects, processes and analyzes operational data from across EY's infrastructure platforms — with a particular focus on HCSP platform telemetry — transforming raw data from workflow orchestration systems, provisioning engines, log aggregation platforms, ITSM tools and capacity management systems into meaningful insights and visualizations.
  
  
The role requires a strong analytical skill set combined with sufficient infrastructure and platform automation awareness to understand the context of the data being analyzed. The analyst will serve as the analytical authority for HCSP KPI reporting — tracking metrics such as provisioning SLA attainment, orchestrator failure rates, manual touchpoint reduction, rollback success rates and catalog drift elimination — and will partner with the HCSP engineering team, I&O leadership and service management to drive a data-informed culture of continuous platform improvement.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong experience designing and delivering data analytics solutions using Power BI, including complex DAX measures, data models and report publishing.
* Proficiency querying and analyzing data from ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Kibana) including KQL query development and Kibana dashboard creation.
* Experience working with large, multi-source operational datasets and transforming them into executive and operational reporting.
* Ability to analyze and report on platform automation data, including:

+ Workflow execution metrics
+ OPA policy evaluation outcomes and policy compliance trends
+ Drift detection signals
+ ServiceNow order intake volumes, ticket correlation

* Good understanding of data center infrastructure technologies including:

+ Windows Server and Linux operating system fundamentals
+ Virtualization platforms — Nutanix AHV, Hyper-V, VMware
+ Kubernetes cluster concepts — pods, namespaces, workloads and resource utilization
+ Network fundamentals — VLANs, DNS, IP management
+ Storage and compute provisioning concepts

* Experience with SQL or KQL for querying structured and semi-structured data sources.
* Experience integrating data from ITSM platforms (ServiceNow or equivalent) into analytical reporting.
* Familiarity with APM and monitoring tooling (Dynatrace, SolarWinds, Prometheus or equivalent) as data sources.
* Experience with ETL/ELT pipelines and data ingestion from multiple infrastructure and platform data sources.
* Scripting capability to automate data extraction and transformation tasks:

+ Python (pandas, NumPy, requests)
+ PowerShell
+ Bash

* Strong written and verbal communication skills — able to present HCSP performance findings and SLA trend analysis to both technical and senior business audiences.
* Strong working knowledge of DevOps, Agile, Kanban, SCRUM and ITIL frameworks.
* Ability to work effectively with global engineering and service management teams across multiple time zones.

**To qualify for the role, you must have experience with**

* Power BI report and dashboard development — 5–7 years.
* Power BI data modelling, DAX development and Power Query (M) transformations — 5–7 years.
* ELK stack data analysis — Elasticsearch queries and Kibana dashboard development — 3–5 years.
* SQL data analysis and querying against operational data stores — 5–7 years.
* KPI definition, metric design and SLA/OLA reporting for platform or infrastructure services.
* Data integration from ITSM platforms (ServiceNow, Remedy or equivalent).
* Working with infrastructure and platform automation monitoring data — metrics, logs, workflow events and traces.
* Building capacity planning and trend analysis reports for infrastructure and automation platforms.
* Kubernetes and container platform telemetry consumption and analysis.
* Workflow orchestration data analysis — Temporal, Argo or equivalent execution logs and metrics.
* OPA policy evaluation data analysis and compliance reporting.
* Drift detection and configuration audit data analysis.
* Windows Server and Linux operating system concepts — sufficient to contextualize infrastructure data.
* Virtualization platform familiarity (Nutanix AHV, Hyper-V, VMware vSphere or Azure Stack HCI).
* Python scripting for data extraction, transformation and automation — 3–5 years.
* PowerShell scripting for Windows infrastructure data collection.
* Executive reporting and stakeholder presentation delivery.
* Azure Monitor, Log Analytics or equivalent cloud observability data sources (preferred).
* Working with CMDB data to enrich infrastructure and platform analytics (preferred).

**Ideally, you'll also have**

* Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) certification (desired).
* Elastic Certified Analyst certification (desired).
* Microsoft Azure Data Fundamentals (DP-900) or Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203) (better to have).
* ITIL v4 Foundation certification (exclusionary).
* Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse Analytics or Databricks (better to have).
* Experience with Grafana or similar open-source visualization platforms.
* Familiarity with OpenTelemetry (OTel) as a telemetry standard for HCSP platform automation data.
* Experience analyzing data from Temporal.io workflow execution APIs or audit logs.
* Experience with Terraform state data and infrastructure drift analysis.
* Experience operating within a managed services or large enterprise shared services environment.

**What We Look For**
A data-driven professional with a genuine curiosity for infrastructure platform operations and a talent for turning complex, multi-source operational data into clear and actionable insight. We are looking for an individual who combines strong analytical and visualization skills with practical infrastructure and platform automation awareness — enabling them to serve as the trusted analytical partner to EY's HCSP engineering team and I&O leadership, measuring the platform's impact, identifying improvement opportunities and demonstrating the value of automation at scale.
  
  
**What We Offer**
We offer a competitive remuneration package where you'll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Continuous learning: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We'll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Marketing Analytics (FP&A)
description:
**About Cvent:**

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,500+

employees and ~30,000 customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999,

Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers human connection.

Headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia, Cvent (formerly NYSE: CVT) was acquired by Blackstone

and Vista for $4.6B in 2023.

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like

entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and

celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.

Cvent is redefining the meetings and events industry through technology that advances human

connection.

**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.

Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn,

iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AIpowered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.

**About the Role:**

We are seeking a strategic, analytically strong Marketing FP&A professional to join our team supporting Marketing mini-CFO, in partnering with Cvent's Global Marketing organization — spanning Brand, Demand Generation, Events, Digital, Product Marketing, and Regional Field Marketing.

This role sits at the intersection of
**Marketing and FP&A**
. You will be supporting Marketing mini-CFO to drive marketing efficiency and ROI analysis, but you must also deeply understand the \*bookings and pipeline world\* — how marketing activity converts into leads, MQLs, SQL, pipeline, and ultimately bookings. You will help Marketing and Finance leaders answer the core questions: “what is working, what is not working, and where should the next marketing dollar go.”

In addition to this, the individual would also be required to drive core planning processes such as annual budgeting, monthly reforecasting, and cost tracking, while building and interpreting the full marketing to- bookings funnel — website traffic, digital conversion, event conversion, leads, cost per lead, lead conversion by tactic, and marketing ROI by LoB. The ideal candidate combines strong financial acumen with genuine fluency in what a B2B marketing function should deliver, and the drive to translate data into clear recommendations for the Marketing organization and senior leaders.

This role involves frequent interaction with senior leaders across Marketing, Sales, and Corporate

Finance teams based in the U.S. and India.

**In This Role, You Will:**

▪ Marketing Finance Partnership & RI (primary focus)

o Act as support to Marketing mini-CFO to support to the Global Marketing organization,

partnering with marketing leadership to translate growth strategies, campaign plans, and

pipeline targets into annual budgets and rolling forecasts.

o Build, own, and continuously improve the Marketing ROI financial model by LoB —

connecting spend, activity and outcomes end to end.

o Develop and track key Marketing efficiency metrics, including:

▪ CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost)

▪ CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value)

▪ Cost per Lead/MQL (by LoB, by tactic)

▪ Lead Conversion Rates (by tactic / channel), CTR

▪ Marketing ROI

o Analyze the full funnel — website traffic, digital conversion, event conversion, leads, and cost per lead — and tie each stage to financial and pipeline outcomes.

o Drive deep-dive analytics on event ROI, digital campaigns, tradeshows, and content marketing performance.

o Deliver a clear point of view on what's working and what's not working across marketing tactics and channels, with concrete, prioritized recommendations for the marketing organization.

o Build and evaluate business cases for marketing initiatives — campaigns, media

investments, Martech, and events — using ROI, CAC, payback to guide spend prioritization.

o Support and advise on resource-allocation decisions across marketing channels and

geographies.

▪ Bookings & Pipeline Fluency

o Understand and work fluently with the sales forecasting and bookings process, connecting

marketing funnel metrics (MQLs, pipeline, bookings influence) to bookings outcomes by LoB.

o Partner on pipeline-trend and funnel analysis — conversion rates, sales cycle length, and

pipeline velocity — to assess how marketing feeds the bookings engine.

o Align marketing investment views with bookings and pipeline targets so finance tells one

consistent growth story.

▪ Stakeholder & Cross-functional Work

o Partner with Sales, Marketing Ops, and Data/Analytics teams to ensure consistent, trusted

measurement frameworks.

o Create executive-level dashboards, presentations, and financial insights to support strategic

initiatives, and present them confidently to non-financial and senior audiences.

o Lead or support ad-hoc strategic projects, including M&A / acquisition integration and cost optimization initiatives.

o Extract and analyze data using tools like Salesforce, Adaptive Insights, Excel, and other

analytics platforms.

**Here's What You Need:**

▪ 7–10 years of experience in FP&A, business finance, or a related field.

▪ Preferred background (either path works): experience in a B2B organization either (a) in

Marketing Data & ROI Analytics, or (b) in Finance partnering with Marketing — with real

exposure to marketing funnel dynamics and bookings/pipeline.

▪ Deep understanding of B2B marketing funnel metrics, digital campaign dynamics,

channel/tactic-level ROI, and a clear view of what a B2B marketing function should bring to the

business.

▪ Solid understanding of the bookings and pipeline world — sales forecasting, funnel/conversion

analysis, and how marketing influences bookings

▪ Strong data-driven mindset and the ability to structure and interpret large, imperfect datasets to

generate insights.

▪ Expertise in financial modeling, forecasting, and metric development — including the ability to

think through a marketing ROI model from first principles.

▪ Hands-on experience with Salesforce CRM, Adaptive Insights or similar tools preferred.

▪ Excellent communication skills with the ability to present insights to non-financial and senior

stakeholders; proven ability to work closely with senior leaders is strongly preferred.

▪ Strong drive, curiosity, and willingness to learn.

▪ MBA or CFA preferred

**Disclaimer:**

Recruitment Scam Notice: Beware of recruitment scams. Legitimate Cvent recruiting

communications will come from accounts formatted as “name@cvent.com” email address. Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent. If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and report the incident at recruitingindia@cvent.com. For more information, visit Cvent’s Recruitment Fraud Notice. https://www.cvent.com/en/noticerecruitment- fraud.

title: Decision Analyst
description:
**Function: Data Analytics, Decision Science & Business Strategy**
**Role Overview**
We are looking for an experienced analytics professional to extract meaningful insights from complex datasets, develop robust quantitative models, and deliver actionable recommendations to support strategic business decisions. The role involves working with multiple internal and external data sources, conducting scenario analysis, monitoring model performance, and implementing data quality and governance controls.
  
  
The successful candidate will collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, influence business decisions, manage complex analytical assignments, and contribute to operational effectiveness, risk mitigation, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Data Analysis & Insights: Identify, extract, and analyze relevant data from multiple internal and external sources to generate meaningful business insights.
* Quantitative Modelling: Develop, implement, and validate quantitative models to support decision-making across various business functions.
* Sensitivity Analysis & Scenario Planning: Conduct sensitivity analysis, forecasting, and scenario modelling to evaluate potential business outcomes and support strategic planning.
* Model Performance & Validation: Monitor existing models, assess their effectiveness, identify performance gaps, and recommend improvements.
* Data Quality & Governance: Establish and implement data quality checks, validation procedures, and control mechanisms to maintain data accuracy, consistency, and reliability.
* Business Decision Support: Translate complex analytical findings into actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders and business leaders.
* Risk Management & Controls: Identify potential risks, strengthen control frameworks, and contribute to the development of policies and procedures supporting governance and compliance.
* Stakeholder Management: Collaborate with business units and specialist teams to address complex problems, align analytical outcomes with business objectives, and influence decision-making.
* Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve analytical methodologies, operational processes, model effectiveness, and overall business performance.

Communication & Reporting: Present complex or sensitive information clearly and effectively to diverse audiences, including senior management.
  
  
**Leadership & Management Expectations**

* Lead complex analytical assignments and guide team members in delivering high-quality outcomes.
* Establish objectives, coach employees, evaluate performance, and support professional development where applicable.
* Provide expert advice on complex issues and support stakeholders in resolving escalated business challenges.
* Drive collaboration across business functions and identify opportunities to combine methodologies and specialist expertise.
* Promote accountability, operational excellence, effective risk management, and a strong control environment.
* For individual contributor roles, lead cross-functional projects, guide colleagues, and recommend new analytical approaches to achieve business outcomes.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong quantitative and analytical problem-solving skills.
* Experience in quantitative modelling, model validation, and performance monitoring.
* Ability to work with complex datasets from multiple sources.
* Knowledge of sensitivity analysis, scenario planning, and data quality management.
* Understanding of risk management, governance, and control frameworks.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills.
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders and communicate complex findings effectively.
* Experience leading projects, mentoring team members, or managing analytical teams, depending on the role structure.
* Strong business acumen and the ability to translate data-driven insights into practical recommendations.

**Key Success Factors**

* Deliver reliable, validated, and decision-oriented quantitative models.
* Improve data quality, analytical accuracy, and model performance.
* Provide actionable insights that support business strategy and operational effectiveness.
* Strengthen governance, risk management, and internal controls.
* Build effective cross-functional relationships and influence business outcomes.

title: Data Specialist
description:
**About The Role**
**Grade Level (for internal use):**
09
  
  
**Role Scope**
Data Steward is an individual contributor role responsible for executing core data stewardship activities that ensure the accuracy, integrity, and governance of enterprise data assets. The Data Steward manages end‑to‑end lineage monitoring, maintains high‑quality metadata, enforces policy and control compliance, and supports UAT for database changes and product distribution. Within the European Gas and Power Data team, the role supports the controlled transition of source data into internal databases and downstream delivery pipelines, ensuring raw data is validated, reconciled, transformed, and quality checked before it is made available to internal SMEs and external clients. The role performs detailed data validation, vendor data reviews, and works closely with Technology and Data Operations teams to resolve issues and maintain consistent data standards across systems.
  
  
Additionally, the Data Steward contributes to process improvement by driving standardization, enhancing documentation, and supporting the adoption of automation and AI‑enabled capabilities to improve data quality, reduce manual effort, and strengthen operational efficiency. We are looking for a process-orientated, methodological thinker with a keen eye for detail. Someone who enjoys dealing with large sets of data and problem solving.
  
  
**What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)**
**Operational Delivery**

* Perform data validation checks, lineage tracking, and metadata updates to maintain data quality, integrity, and traceability.
* Execute data ingestion, validation, and integration activities in alignment with governance and control standards.
* Ensure consistent adherence to enterprise data policies and governance frameworks.
* Execute defined controls and compliance requirements to safeguard data integrity and lineage.
* Support vendor data reviews and onboarding through data quality assessments, validation checks, and issue resolution.
* Maintain data standardization, stewardship documentation, and process artifacts to ensure accuracy and consistency.
* Execute medium‑complexity stewardship and validation tasks under established guidelines, escalating exceptions when required.
* Respond to client data queries, resolving issues and coordinating issue triage with Operations and Client Services teams.
* Collaborate with Technology teams on defect resolution, enhancement requests, and UAT for backend data and dataflow changes.
* Contribute to automation and AI‑enabled improvements that enhance efficiency and strengthen stewardship capabilities.
* Investigate, validate, troubleshoot, and support controlled updates to transformation scripts, data quality rules, and pipeline logic using Python, SQL and PySpark, ensuring automated processes continue to run to schedule producing accurate outputs.
* Support onboarding of new datasets required by SMEs by reviewing source structures, validating expected outputs, identifying data quality risks, and coordinating required pipeline or source data changes within the existing architecture.

**Process Excellence**

* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by validating data, coordinating test execution, and assisting with defect identification and resolution.
* Ensure adherence to governance, data management standards, and operating procedures by following defined controls and compliance requirements.
* Maintain high‑quality documentation by updating process flows, data definitions, data dictionaries, and other stewardship artifacts to ensure audit readiness and operational clarity.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate with Data Operations and Technology teams to support governance activities, quality controls, source amendments, validation outcomes and issue remediation while serving as a key liaison between governance expectations and day‑to‑day execution
* Support Product and Technology teams by assisting with data requirements, validations, and operational coordination throughout change cycles.
* Assist with vendor data reviews by conducting data quality checks, performing validations, and coordinating onboarding processes.

**How Impact Will Be Measured (Success Metrics)**

* Data accuracy and integrity - Maintain high accuracy rates through consistent validation, timely corrections, and adherence to defined quality thresholds.
* SLA and turnaround adherence - Meet or exceed service‑level timelines for data updates, validations, issue resolution, and stakeholder responses.
* Documentation completeness and currency - Keep process documentation, data dictionaries, lineage records, and stewardship artifacts up‑to‑date, audit‑ready, and fully aligned with governance standards.
* Pipeline quality and delivery - Ensure transformation scripts, database workflows, quality checks, and scheduled processes run successfully, with failures investigated, validated, resolved, or coordinated through to closure in line with operational priorities.

**For This Role You'll Need to Have (Skills & Competencies)**
**Technical Skills**

* Intermediate Python scripting skills, including the ability to investigate, maintain, debug, and support controlled updates to transformation logic, automation scripts, and data quality checks.
* Intermediate SQL capability to query, reconcile, transform, validate, and troubleshoot data across relational databases and pipeline outputs.
* Hands-on experience with PySpark or distributed data processing to support investigation, validation, reconciliation, and quality checks across large or complex datasets.
* Working knowledge of Databricks, including notebooks, jobs, clusters, and pipeline monitoring, would be advantageous.
* Understanding of cloud computing, preferably AWS.
* Working knowledge of AI/ML workflows.
* Works with metadata management and lineage tools to maintain data transparency and trace end‑to‑end data flows.
* Possess foundational familiarity with BI tools and dashboards to review outputs and identify data anomalies.

**Functional Skills**

* Possesses solid domain and process understanding
* Understands data governance fundamentals, including data quality controls, stewardship roles, and ownership models.
* Supports data standardization by applying consistent data definitions, formats, and controlled processes.
* Has working knowledge of data ingestion, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and integration workflows, with the ability to investigate pipeline failures, check source-to-target accuracy, support root cause resolution, and coordinate remediation actions.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand their data requirements/issues and generate innovative ideas and solutions.

**Behavioral Skills**

* Demonstrates strong attention to detail, ensuring accuracy in data, documentation, and validation activities, functional teams cause analysis.
* Communicates clearly and collaborates effectively with cross functional teams including Technology, Operations, Product, and Vendor partners.
* Applies analytical mindset, critical thinking & creative problem solving to build solutions for business problems and while investigating data issues and remediation through root cause analysis.
* Demonstrates learning agility, digital acumen, initiative, and ownership in data stewardship activities, adapting to evolving tools and technologies while working effectively through ambiguity to investigate issues, and support timely delivery against operational priorities.

**Preferred Education & Experience**

* 4+ years of relevant experience in data, analytics, operations, or related functions.

**Key Interfaces & Stakeholders**

* Partner with Data Operations and SMEs on data risk, quality checks, and issue resolution.
* Coordinate with Tech teams on data issues, enhancements, and UAT activities.
* Support Product teams with data requirements and validation.
* Ensure alignment with governance and compliance standards.

title: Data Processing Executive
description:
**Job Description - Data Processing Executive**
**About us:**
We invite you to come grow with us.
  
  
Research Partnership (part of Inizio Advisory) is one of the world's largest pharma market research and consulting agencies with over 250 researchers, consultants, project managers and support staff. Our teams are located across the globe, in Europe (London, Lyon), North America (New York, Philadelphia, San Francisco) and Asia (Singapore, India).
  
  
As individuals with diverse backgrounds, as a team with shared values, as professionals ready to reimagine health and life sciences—you can grow with us at a place that:
  
  

* Makes a difference to human health
* Shares values and celebrates progress
* Puts people at the centre of everything

**About the team:**
We have recently established a new Data Processing Team in India, based in Gurgaon. This new hub will be part of our global Operations team, reporting into Operations Director based in the UK office.
  
  
This dedicated team will play a critical role in supporting all our quantitative research studies across the business.
  
  
The primary responsibility of the India team will be to manage and deliver high-quality tabulations—both interim and final—across uncoded and coded datasets. The team will work in close collaboration with our research, project management, and scripting teams to ensure seamless data flow and accurate outputs that meet our clients’ needs.
  
  
By building this centre of excellence, we aim to enhance our data processing capabilities, improve turnaround times, and ensure greater consistency and efficiency across projects. This initiative represents a strategic step in strengthening our operational infrastructure while continuing to uphold the high standards that our clients expect from Research Partnership.
  
  
Additionally, they will collaborate closely with the analytics and data management teams, facilitating the smooth flow of data for efficient analysis, reporting, and insights generation.
  
  
**Your primary role:**
The Data Processing Executive role will report into The Data Processing Manager position. The Data Processing Executive will be a key member of the newly formed India-based Data Processing Hub, supporting quantitative healthcare market research projects across global markets. This role is responsible for the accurate and timely production of tabulations, both interim and final, and requires close collaboration with research, project management, and scripting teams. This will include:
  
  

* Running and validating interim and final tabulations (uncoded and coded) for quantitative research studies using relevant software (e.g., Q, Quantum, SPSS, Excel-based platforms, or proprietary tools).
* Ensuring all tabulations meet internal and client-specific formatting, logic, and output requirements.
* Checking tabulated data for accuracy, completeness, and consistency before delivery.
* Supporting QA processes and documentation to maintaining high data standards across projects.
* Assisting in preparing raw datasets for processing, including basic cleaning, formatting, and consistency checks.
* Working with coded and uncoded datasets, ensuring proper integration into final tabulation outputs.
* Liaising with scripting/programming team to ensure accurate data structure for tabulation.
* Working closely with the research and project management teams to understand project requirements, timelines, and deliverables.
* Providing input and feedback to internal stakeholders to optimise processes and outputs.
* Managing assigned tasks within deadlines and flag any delays or data issues proactively to the manager and wider team.
* Maintaining clear documentation of tabulation processes and version control.
* Supporting in updating project logs and workflow tracking systems.
* Continuously improving knowledge of data processing tools, tabulation best practices, and healthcare market research processes.

**About You…**
**Your skills and experience:**

* More than 2 years of experience in a data processing within a market research agency (ideally healthcare but can be other market research sectors)
* Basic to intermediate proficiency in data tabulation software (preferably Q, but Quantum or similar will be considered as well)
* Exposure to or understanding of survey scripting tools and survey data structures is a plus
* Experience working with survey data formats (e.g., XML, CSV), as well as knowledge of relational databases and data structure management.
* Understanding of quantitative research methodologies, questionnaire structures, and healthcare market research best practices.
* Demonstrable experience of working with senior team members
* Problem-solving skills (particularly relating to situations requiring analytical judgement and establishing best practice solutions)
* Excellent analytical and numerical skills
* Strong communication skills, particularly in the ability to explain technical points to non-technical people in an international environment
* High attention to detail with a strong focus on data accuracy and consistency.
* Logical thinking and ability to troubleshoot errors or discrepancies in tabulated data.
* Ability to interpret tabulation specifications and apply them accurately.

**Ideal profile:**

* You are proactive, dedicated and enthusiastic, with a ‘can do’ attitude and approach
* You demonstrate a high level of accuracy and attention to detail, as well as strengths in organisation and prioritisation
* You are a collaborative team player who works well with colleagues
* You communicate ideas and issues in an effective, straightforward fashion
* You are highly motivated and want to seize opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career

***Artificial Intelligence***
*Inizio may use AI technologies to support certain aspects of our recruitment process, but all hiring decisions are made by our human recruiting team. We are committed to fair, inclusive, and human-led hiring practices. Don't meet every requirement? That's okay! We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.*

If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.*

* Perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard which will impact both the role itself and surrounding roles.
* Likely to have responsibility for specific processes within a team
* They may lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources. They supervise a team, allocate work requirements and coordinate team resources.

The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
