title: Senior Associate, Gen AI & Agentic AI Commercial Excellence COE, BTS - Global Capability Center
description:
**Description**
**About Alvarez & Marsal**
Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity - are why our people love working at A&M.
  
  
**The Team**
The Commercial Excellence CoE is a pivotal function within A&M’s broader global Commercial Excellence practice, serving as the GCC-based hub and Supports Pricing, Sales effectiveness, Customer retention & renewals and other commercial excellence topics working closely with our U.S-based team across both B2C and B2B businesses. Our team plays a critical role in consolidating and scaling A&M’s Commercial Excellence capabilities bringing analytical rigor, commercial insight, and operational know-how to help clients unlock measurable margin improvement. As part of our firm’s continued investment in building out a full spectrum Commercial Excellence offering, the CoE acts as both a capability enabler and innovation engine developing reusable methodologies, diagnostic tools, and accelerators that support pricing transformation initiatives across industries and markets. Joining our team means being at the forefront of Commercial Excellence analytics and strategy, working closely with global teams to deliver high-impact outcomes in an area that is increasingly core to our clients' commercial success.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute**

* Product Development & Innovation (Agentic AI for Commercial Excellence)
* Lead the design and development of agentic AI workflows across key Commercial Excellence levers (pricing, churn, revenue analytics, salesforce effectiveness)
* Translate business problems into AI-enabled solution architectures, including:
* Multi-agent systems for decisioning (e.g., pricing recommendations, churn interventions)
* LLM-powered in sight generation and narrative synthesis
* Conversational AI interfaces for tools (e.g., chatbot-driven analytics navigation)
* Build and scale modular, reusable AI accelerators and assets (e.g., Commercial Excellence AI modules, insight engines, recommendation agents)
* Define product roadmap for the AI-enabled Commercial Excellence platform, including integration with enterprise systems (ERP, CRM, data lakes)
* Partner with engineering teams to ensure scalable, production-grade deployment architectures (APIs, microservices, cloud platforms)
* Continuously optimize systems for performance, scalability, latency, and cost efficiency
* Generative AI & Agentic Systems
* Architect and govern scalable, reusable agentic AI frameworks for enterprise use cases
* Define orchestration and execution patterns for multi-agent systems (event-driven workflows, planning/reflection loops)
* Develop reusable agent templates, blueprints, and context frameworks to accelerate deployment across Commercial Excellence use cases
* Evaluate solution design trade-offs across business value, data readiness, model performance, and cost
* Drive the development of PoCs, MVPs, and production-grade solutions, ensuring smooth transition from experimentation to scaled deployment
* Determine optimal use of LLMs vs traditional ML / rules-based approaches based on use case requirements
* Model Lifecycle, Quality, Cost & Risk Management
* Establish and govern MLOps / LLMOps frameworks, including model development, deployment, monitoring, and iteration
* Define and implement CI/CD pipelines, evaluation frameworks, and retraining workflows
* Optimize key components such as retrieval strategies, embeddings, prompting, grounding, and caching
* Drive improvements in model accuracy, relevance, latency, and cost efficiency, while minimizing hallucinations
* Implement frameworks for model evaluation, explainability, and robustness
* Ensure adherence to Responsible AI principles, including bias mitigation, privacy, security, and regulatory compliance

**Qualifications**

* 3-8 years of experience in consulting, analytics, AI/ML, or product-led environments, ideally with exposure to Commercial Excellence / Revenue Growth / Pricing domains
* Proven experience building and deploying Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions in real world applications
* Strong understanding of Agentic AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, or equivalent
* Experience developing LLM-based applications, including: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG); Insight generation and summarization; Conversational interface
* Proficiency in Python, SQL, and ML/AI libraries (e.g., Pandas, Scikit-learn, PyTorch)
* Experience with API development (FastAPI/Flask) and deploying solutions on cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP)
* Understanding of multi-agent orchestration, tool usage, memory, and planning paradigms
* Familiarity with data pipelines, model deployment, and productizing considerations
* Strong understanding of MLOps / LLMOps, APIs, and cloud-native architectures
* Experience with foundational models and APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Vertex AI, Amazon Bedrock)
* Proven experience delivering AI-powered SaaS or internal platforms to automate workflows and enhance customer experience
* Strong business acumen with the ability to align AI strategy with enterprise goals
* Excellent problem-solving, communication, and leadership skills, with adaptability to the rapidly evolving AI landscap
* Commercial Excellence & Business Acumen - Strong understanding of Commercial Excellence concepts, including, but not limited to: Pricing and margin optimization; Customer segmentation and churn; Revenue analytics and growth strategy; Salesforce effectiveness; Ability to translate business problems into AI-driven solutions
* Experience in data-driven problem solving and executive storytelling
* Experience working with senior stakeholders to shape commercial strategy and drive adoption, including leading workshops, influencing decision-making, and aligning cross functional teams (sales, finance, product)
* Ability to develop clear, compelling executive storylines, distilling complex analyses and AI outputs into concise recommendations for C-suite audiences
* Support managers and senior team members in delivering AI-enabled Commercial Excellence projects across product development, PoCs, demos, and client delivery
* Take ownership of defined work modules, including analysis, data preparation, model testing, workflow configuration, documentation, and output quality checks
* Work comfortably in ambiguous and fast-moving environments, showing curiosity, adaptability, and willingness to learn new AI tools and commercial concepts
* Communicate progress, issues, and findings clearly to internal teams; proactively escalate risks or dependencies where required

**Your journey at A&M**
We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.

title: Associate, Office of the CFO // Controllership Transformation
description:
Portage Point Partners is a Chicago-headquartered advisory, interim management and investment banking firm focused on serving the middle-market. Backed by New Mountain Capital, the firm has grown at over 30% annually since its founding in 2016 and today operates from ten offices across the United States.
  
  
The firm delivers integrated financial and operational solutions across Transaction Advisory Services, Transaction Execution Services, Office of the CFO, Valuations, Performance Improvement, Turnaround & Restructuring and Investment Banking. Engagement teams are lean and execution-oriented, working directly with senior stakeholders to navigate complex transitions and transformations.
  
  
Triple P India (TPI) is a strategic extension of the firm’s platform, established to build a high-quality team that operates as an integrated part of U.S.-based teams. Professionals in TPI are involved in live engagements from the outset, contributing to analysis, execution and client deliverables in coordination with colleagues across the firm. The platform is designed to provide meaningful responsibility, direct exposure to senior leadership and long-term growth in a high-performance environment.

Leveraging backgrounds in accounting, finance, operations, audit, investment banking, investing and consulting, the OCFO team provides holistic perspectives and capabilities to deliver results that are unmatched in the industry.

title: Application Engineer – Video Analytics
description:
**Application Engineer – Video Analytics**

**Company:**
Intozi Tech Pvt. Ltd.

**Location:**
Gurugram, Haryana

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a technically skilled and customer-focused Application Engineer – Video Analytics to support the deployment, integration, commissioning, and troubleshooting of video analytics solutions at customer sites.

The candidate will be responsible for server provisioning, IT infrastructure setup, network integration, application deployment, and ensuring the reliable operation of video analytics systems in real-world environments.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on expertise in networking, Linux, GPU/CPU servers, Docker, storage, databases, IP cameras, and video surveillance technologies. The candidate must be capable of independently resolving complex technical issues, managing customer expectations, and delivering solutions within committed timelines.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Customer Engagement:**
  Understand customer requirements and expectations, address technical queries, and provide timely and effective support.
* **Server and IT Infrastructure Provisioning:**
  Install, configure, and maintain servers, GPUs, storage systems, networking equipment, and other IT hardware.
* **Installation and Commissioning:**
  Deploy and configure video analytics applications, IP cameras, network infrastructure, and supporting services at customer sites.
* **Site Surveys and Technical Assessment:**
  Conduct site surveys, assess infrastructure readiness, identify dependencies, and prepare technical requirements for deployment.
* **Networking and Integration:**
  Configure IP addressing, subnetting, routing, switching, VLANs, firewalls, and local/offline networks while ensuring seamless integration with existing customer infrastructure.
* **Troubleshooting and Support:**
  Diagnose and resolve issues across networking, Linux, Docker, GPU, storage, databases, APIs, and application layers.
* **Video Analytics Calibration:**
  Perform camera positioning, analytics-zone configuration, and on-site validation to ensure optimal analytics accuracy under actual operating conditions.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:**
  Coordinate effectively with customer IT teams, system integrators, electricians, project managers, and internal engineering teams.
* **Product Improvement:**
  Identify product limitations, technical shortcomings, and recurring issues, and proactively recommend improvements to the engineering and product teams.
* **Project Delivery:**
  Manage field-level technical challenges, prioritize critical issues, and ensure deployments are completed within agreed timelines.
* **Documentation and Reporting:**
  Maintain installation records, troubleshooting logs, site observations, technical documentation, and regular project status updates.

**Must-Have Technical Skills**

**1. Networking and Infrastructure**

* Expert-level understanding of IP addressing, subnetting, routing, switching, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, firewalls, and port management.
* Hands-on experience with LAN/WAN networks, routers, managed switches, SSH, RDP, and fibre-optic connectivity.
* Ability to design, configure, and troubleshoot isolated or offline networks and integrate systems into existing customer networks.

**2. Linux Administration and Debugging**

* Strong working knowledge of multiple Linux distributions, including installation, configuration, user and permission management, process monitoring, and service administration.
* Practical experience troubleshooting system, network, resource-utilization, and application issues using Linux command-line tools.
* Ability to diagnose Docker, connectivity, service startup, dependency, and performance-related issues.

**3. GPU/CPU Servers and Hardware**

* Experience deploying applications on GPU- and CPU-based servers.
* Hands-on installation and configuration of NVIDIA drivers, CUDA, and GPU-enabled application environments.
* Ability to troubleshoot GPU detection, driver compatibility, CUDA dependencies, thermal issues, and resource utilization.
* Experience with server hardware provisioning, maintenance, storage configuration, RAID, and ODM/OEM server platforms.

**4. Docker and Distributed Applications**

* Strong practical knowledge of Docker images, containers, volumes, networks, and Docker Compose.
* Experience deploying, managing, and troubleshooting multi-container applications, including GPU-enabled workloads.
* Understanding of distributed application architectures, inter-service communication, dependencies, and service availability.

**5. Application Integration and Web Services**

* Experience integrating and troubleshooting REST APIs.
* Hands-on knowledge of Nginx configuration, reverse proxy, application routing, port mapping, and traffic forwarding.
* Practical experience with PostgreSQL, including database connectivity, configuration, basic administration, and troubleshooting.

**6. Scripting and Development Tools**

* Bash scripting for automation, deployment, system administration, and troubleshooting.
* Working knowledge of Python and Python scripting for deployment utilities and operational tooling.
* Familiarity with Windows Command Prompt, PowerShell, and Git for version control and collaborative development.

**7. IP Cameras and Video Surveillance**

* Strong understanding of IP cameras, VMS/NVR systems, and video surveillance architectures.
* Hands-on experience with camera discovery, configuration, ONVIF integration, and adding or managing multiple camera streams.
* Practical knowledge of RTSP streaming over TCP/UDP, stream connectivity, authentication, and troubleshooting.
* Understanding of H.264/H.265 video codecs, resolution, frame rate, bitrate, and camera stream configuration.

**8. End-to-End Troubleshooting**

* Ability to independently identify root causes and resolve technical issues across network, hardware, operating system, GPU, storage, and application layers.
* Confidence in handling live production environments and resolving field-level issues within agreed service timelines.
* Ability to collect logs, analyze system behavior, implement corrective actions, and escalate complex issues with appropriate technical evidence.

**Field Responsibilities**

* Travel to customer and project sites for installation, commissioning, integration, and maintenance of video analytics solutions.
* Conduct site surveys and assess camera coverage, network readiness, server capacity, storage requirements, and deployment dependencies.
* Install and configure cameras, servers, switches, storage systems, and analytics applications.
* Configure camera parameters, positioning, regions of interest (ROIs), and analytics zones.
* Validate system functionality and analytics accuracy under actual site conditions.
* Troubleshoot and resolve on-site issues involving camera connectivity, video streams, networks, servers, GPUs, and application services.
* Coordinate with customer IT/security teams, system integrators, electricians, and internal engineering teams to ensure smooth execution.
* Work independently at customer sites, manage technical activities, and provide timely progress reports.
* Deliver immediate technical assistance during critical situations and support after-hours or round-the-clock operations when required.

**Key Behavioral and Professional Competencies**

* **Customer-centric approach:**
  Understand customer expectations and provide practical, reliable technical solutions.
* **Ownership and accountability:**
  Take responsibility for assigned tasks and drive issues to resolution.
* **Proactive problem-solving:**
  Identify potential risks, anticipate deployment challenges, and take preventive action before issues escalate.
* **Delivery under pressure:**
  Remain calm and effective while managing tight deadlines, critical incidents, and changing priorities.
* **Flexibility and availability:**
  Be willing to work extended hours, provide emergency support, and accommodate project requirements when necessary.
* **Collaborative mindset:**
  Work effectively with cross-functional teams, customers, and external stakeholders.
* **Effective communication:**
  Explain technical issues clearly, manage customer queries, and provide accurate project updates.
* **Continuous improvement:**
  Identify product shortcomings and recommend enhancements based on field experience and customer feedback.
* **Independent execution:**
  Demonstrate the ability to manage site activities and resolve technical challenges with minimal supervision.
* **Commitment to service quality:**
  Ensure reliable deployments, timely issue resolution, and a positive customer experience.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates can share their CV at
**hr@intozi.io**
.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!
  
  
**Job Description**
LCS BI Analyst
  
  
Noida/Pune - India
  
  
The BI Analyst will be responsible for end-to-end Power BI solution development, including data modelling, report design, performance optimization, and governance. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in ETL, Power BI, data analytics, and SQL based data sources, with the ability to translate business requirements into actionable insights and compelling data-driven stories.
  
  
This role requires a data-first mindset and strong analytical skills. Additionally, it demands hands-on experience in building scalable BI solutions, leveraging Power BI, Power Query, and enterprise data platforms (Azure SQL/SharePoint/Dataverse/Databricks). Knowledge of SAP and Salesforce.
  
  
This role will primarily focus on designing, developing, and supporting Power BI dashboards, data models, and reporting solutions to enable data-driven decision-making across global stakeholders.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**

* Gather and translate business requirements into scalable and impactful BI solutions.

title: AVP - Credit Analytics
description:
**About Us**
At OakNorth, we're on a mission to empower the UK's most ambitious businesses. Since 2015, we've lent over $21 billion across the UK and US, helped create more than 58,000 new homes and 36,000 new jobs, and supported hundreds of thousands of personal savers — all while fuelling the UK economy.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Credit Analytics team sits at the heart of OakNorth's lending business, providing rigorous financial analysis and credit assessment across a diverse portfolio of commercial loan opportunities. We work closely with Debt Directors, Risk, and client-facing teams in the UK to ensure every lending decision is underpinned by deep analytical insight and a thorough understanding of the borrower's operating environment.
  
  
**About The Role**
We're looking for a Senior Associate to join our Credit Analytics team, taking ownership of detailed loan analysis across sectors and geographies. You'll build financial models, draft concise and well-structured credit reports, conduct sensitivity and stress testing, and engage directly with clients to discuss data and analytical frameworks. This is a high-impact role for someone who combines strong financial acumen with sharp communication skills and a genuine curiosity for business and markets.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Conduct detailed analysis of loan opportunities across various sectors and geographies, developing a thorough understanding of each borrower's business and operating environment.
* Draft concise, well-structured credit reports with clear key takeaways for Credit and Risk to review and comment on.
* Build detailed financial models covering transaction details, financial statement analysis, projections, ratio analysis, and credit metrics.
* Conduct sensitivity analysis and stress testing on projections to assess loan serviceability under adverse scenarios.
* Identify deal-specific covenants that can serve as early warning signals for loan monitoring purposes.
* Conduct detailed industry and market studies to understand the operating environment of borrowers.
* Interact with clients to discuss data gaps, inconsistencies, and analytical frameworks; liaise with Debt Directors and other UK stakeholders throughout the credit process.

**YOU'LL BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU HAVE…**

* 5+ years of relevant experience in credit analysis, financial analysis, or a related role within financial services.
* Strong financial analysis skills with a thorough understanding of accounting and financial concepts, including the ability to build and interrogate detailed financial models.
* Proven ability to draft clear, concise, and well-reasoned credit reports for senior stakeholders.
* Strong communication skills with confidence interacting with Debt Directors, clients, and other stakeholders across geographies.
* A proactive, results-driven mindset — curious, flexible, hands-on, and comfortable operating at pace in an environment where change is part of daily work.

**Nice to Have**

* MBA, PGDM, CA, or CFA from a reputed institute.
* Experience conducting industry or market studies across multiple sectors.
* Prior exposure to covenant structuring or loan monitoring frameworks.

**What we offer**

* Health & Protection: Comprehensive medical cover for you, your family, and parents, along with life and accidental insurance cover at a multiple of your salary.
* Wellbeing: Annual health check-ups, online doctor consultations, pharmacy discounts, nutritionist support, and Employee Assistance Program (EAP) services — all sponsored by OakNorth.
* Time Off: Earned leave, casual/sick leave, public holidays, maternity leave, and paternity leave.
* Life Milestones: Financial support for important life events such as marriage, childbirth, and bereavement.
* Flexible Benefits: Tax-efficient allowances for internet, fuel, meals, leave travel, and National Pension System (NPS) contributions.
* Growth & Development: Support for professional certifications, learning and development opportunities, childcare benefits, and paid volunteering days.
* Our Workplace: Modern, centrally located offices, weekly business updates, team events, and great coffee. We work hard to build a culture worth showing up for.

title: Lead Analyst
description:
**Role Purpose**

Plan the right workforce, at the right place and time, at the right cost. The role owns end-to-end resource planning and analytics for operational workforce, turning data into clear, decision-ready insights for leadership. As an individual contributor, the role combines deep planning expertise with hands-on use of Python, SQL and Power BI to build models, automate reporting and solve business problems.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Advanced Excel, SQL, Python and Power BI.
* Forecasting, statistics and scenario modelling.
* Strong analytical thinking and practical problem solving.
* Create SOPs for planning processes and BRDs for automation and system requirements
* Independent ownership, stakeholder management and clear communication.

**Qualification & Experience**

* Graduate in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, Operations Research or Data Science; post-graduation/MBA preferred.
* 3-8 years of experience, including 1-2 years in resource planning, workforce management(preferred) or capacity planning.
* Airline, aviation, logistics or other 24x7 operations experience preferred.

Key Responsibilities

1. Resource Planning, Forecasting & Analytics

* Own and validate planning assumptions, including productivity, attrition, leave, training, and fleet plan.
* Deliver short-, medium- and long-term workforce requirements aligned to the fleet and network plan.
* Monitor capacity and highlight gaps early and recommend workforce actions.
* Review plan versus actuals, explain variances and refine assumptions.
* Build analytical and simulation models to evaluate operational scenarios, cost-benefit trade-offs and improvement opportunities.
* Define and validate data requirements, analyse operational trends and recommend the best operational and financial outcome.
* Document assumptions, methodology and changes to maintain transparency and governance.

2. Technology & Automation

* Use Excel, SQL, Python and Power BI to analyse data, build dashboards and automate recurring processes.
* Improve data quality, planning accuracy and reporting turnaround time.

3. Stakeholder & Decision Support

* Partners with Operations, HR, Finance and other teams to align assumptions and planning requirements.
* Present complex analysis as simple, leadership-ready recommendations and support implementation.

title: Global HR Data Analyst II
description:
At McCormick, we bring our passion for flavor to work each day. We encourage growth, respect everyone's contributions and do what's right for our business, our people, our communities and our planet. Join us on our quest to make every meal and moment better.
  
  
Founded in Baltimore, MD in 1889 in a room and a cellar by 25-year-old Willoughby McCormick with three employees, McCormick is a global leader in flavour. With over 14,000 employees around the world and more than $6 Billion in annual sales, the Company manufactures, markets, and distributes spices, seasoning mixes, condiments and other flavourful products to the entire food industry, retail outlets, food manufactures, food service businesses and consumers.
  
  
While our global headquarters are in the Baltimore, Maryland, USA area, McCormick operates and serves customers from nearly 60 locations in 25 countries and 170 markets in Asia-Pacific, China, Europe, Middle East and Africa, and the Americas, including North, South and Central America
  
  
**Position Overview/Primary Purpose**
The Global HR Data Analyst II is acting as a senior analyst in global HR data management and organizational management (OM) initiatives. This position is responsible for handling medium to complex HR data reporting, large-scale global mass uploads (including global ASR loads), and ensuring compliance with internal and external audit requirements. The Global HR Data Analyst II will execute end-to-end OM data initiatives, including managing the accuracy and consistency of the global organizational hierarchy within SuccessFactors Employee Central (SFEC) and SAP HCM.
  
  
In addition, this role will collaborate with global HR Business Partners and Managers, providing guidance on HR data and OM processes and offering professional executive support through a dedicated communication channel. The Global HR Data Analyst II will be instrumental in contributing to projects, managing cyclical events, and ensuring effective delivery of day-to-day tasks. By identifying key dependencies, this role will proactively enhance the customer service experience for employee inquiries. The Global HR Data Analyst II will also drive process improvements, provide insights for continuous service enhancement.
  
  
Additionally, this role will support junior team members, helping them increase their independence and contributing to the training and onboarding of new employees.
  
  
Accountable for ensuring data quality and consistency, this role will also be responsible for compliance and control measures (including SOX), providing consistent customer service, and ensuring that global HR data standards are met.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Complex Global HR Reporting & Mass Uploads:Lead the creation and execution of medium to complex global HR reports, ensuring high-quality, accurate data delivery to stakeholders. Manage large-scale HR data mass uploads (including ASR loads), ensuring seamless integration and error-free data transmission across global systems.
* Audit Support & Compliance: Serve as senior analyst for internal and external audits, ensuring data compliance with legal and regulatory requirements. Gather HR data for audits and resolve audit findings, ensuring all processes adhere to compliance standards, including SOX regulations.
* Organizational Management (OM) Data: Perform OM data initiatives, including the management of the global organizational hierarchy, position management, and employee data integrity within SFEC and SAP HCM. Ensure data consistency, accuracy, and alignment across systems.
* Reconciliation & Data Accuracy: Perform reconciliation of HR data across global systems, ensuring data accuracy and consistency by proactively comparing and validating data across systems. Identify discrepancies, resolve data issues, and ensure seamless alignment and integration of global HR data.
* Data and Replication Monitoring & Issue Resolution: Support design and implement validation reports to monitor OM data fields, proactively identifying any discrepancies or gaps. Perform corrective actions necessary to resolve OM-related issues, ensuring continuous data quality and governance. Serves as a subject matter expert of SFEC & SAP HCM OM data management. Monitors OM content type replication failures daily. Makes corrections as necessary to resolve errors for successful replication and recommend improvements to prevent recurrences.
* Organizational Design & Strategic Projects: Support large-scale organizational design projects, working closely with Product Owners and business stakeholders to ensure that organizational changes are accurately reflected in HR systems. Provide guidance and support to the business on data impacts and system configurations maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction by providing timely and accurate information.

* System testing: Participate in special projects, including performing configuration testing, integrations & data mapping & ad-hoc report requests and support more junior team members in testing.

**Required Qualifications**
**Level of Education and Discipline**

* College Degree preferred, but not required.

**Experience - Functional/industry/commercial Knowledge, Business Acumen**

* Over 3 years’ experience in data management in a multinational company.
* with experience of high-volume data processing for multiple countries with in-depth experience in SFEC, SAP HCM, Organizational Management (OM), and HR data management including reporting and mass uploads.
* Proven expertise in managing complex global HR reporting, data uploads, and data quality checks, particularly in large-scale HR systems implementations.
* Knowledge of global HR processes, organizational design, and OM-related data management.
* Demonstrated experience in leading audits, ensuring compliance, and resolving audit findings.
* Ability to design and implement proactive reports to monitor data quality and identify issues.
* Strong subject matter expertise in OM data, including troubleshooting within SFEC and SAP HCM.

**Interpersonal Skills - Leadership, Interactions, Communication, Influence**

* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to identify patterns, troubleshoot issues, and provide data-driven recommendations.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage with business stakeholders and provide expert guidance on data management and organizational design.
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage cross-functional projects and prioritize tasks in a dynamic environment.
* Customer service-oriented with a commitment to maintaining high levels of satisfaction and providing expert-level support.
* A mindset of continuous improvement, consistently seeking to refine processes and enhance team and organizational performance.

At McCormick, we have over a 100-year legacy based on our “Power of People” principle. This principle fosters an unusually dedicated workforce requiring a culture of respect, recognition, inclusion and collaboration based on the highest ethical value

title: Analyst-BI & Analytics
description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.
  
  
If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.
  
  
**Skills And Competencies**

* 2 or more years of business experience in a data, analytics, or finance environment. Working knowledge of Power BI, including data modeling, DAX, and report and dashboard development. Familiarity with JIRA for tracking tasks, sprints, and delivery status
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to coordinate between technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Ability to adapt to a changing environment, manage multiple priorities, and meet tight deadlines
* Basic SQL knowledge for data validation and reporting purposes is preferred but not required
* Experience assisting with technical documentation such as Technical Design Documents is preferred but not required
* Basic understanding of artificial intelligence concepts, with curiosity and enthusiasm for learning how AI tools can be used to improve processes and drive efficiency.
* Interest in exploring AI systems and a willingness to develop awareness of responsible AI practices, including risk management and ethical use

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Statistics, or another quantitative field required

**Responsibilities**

* Develops Power BI dashboards and coordinates data engineering delivery to support analytics and reporting needs for the Finance department.
* Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports, including data modeling, DAX measures, and row-level security, to support the business intelligence and analytics needs of the Finance department
* Support data and analytics requests by transforming raw pipeline and project data into clear, production-ready business intelligence reports and visual insights
* Work closely with data engineers and business stakeholders, tracking tasks, dependencies, and blockers in JIRA to keep the delivery pipeline on schedule
* Assist data engineers with project artifacts, including Technical Design Documents, process documentation, and delivery checklists. Maintain the Power BI service including gateways, dataflows, and workspace administration to ensure reliable and repeatable reporting processes
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to investigate and resolve reporting and data quality issues in a timely manner
* Participate in sprint planning and delivery reviews to support continuous improvement of the analytics delivery process

**About The Team**
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today's risks into tomorrow's opportunities. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment with 14,000+ employees across 90 cities, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and innovative workplace. Our Finance Data Engineering team is responsible for delivering accurate data pipelines, business intelligence solutions, and analytics capabilities that support financial decision-making and reporting across Moody's. By joining our team, you will be part of exciting work in data engineering, Power BI development, and process optimization in Gurugram, India, where we are actively integrating AI-powered tools to enhance our analytics workflows and drive smarter, faster insights for the business.
  
  
Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.

description:
The Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet (Global Energy Alliance) The Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet (Global Energy Alliance) works for a world where everyone has access to affordable, reliable, clean electricity and the means to use it to improve their lives. Our Alliance builds transformative public, private, philanthropic partnerships to end energy poverty and accelerate green economic opportunity. Founded in 2021 by The Rockefeller Foundation, IKEA Foundation, and Bezos Earth Fund, we design innovative projects/programs, unlock finance, strengthen institutions and transform markets, delivering progress anchored in deep community engagement. By uniting actors across the value chain, from households to heads of state, we go beyond individual projects to drive lasting systems change. With work in more than 30 countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, our Alliance aims to reach 1 billion people with clean electricity, prevent 4 billion tons of carbon emissions and create or improve 150 million jobs.
  
  
**Contract type: Fulltime, Open ended**
**Reports Directly To**
Direct Reports:
  
  
MD, Country Delivery - India
  
  
None
  
  
**Overview Of The Role**
The Data and Analytics Manager role will support initiatives focused on emerging renewable energy solutions as part of the sustainable energy transition in India. In this mission-driven role, this role will work at the intersection of technical innovation, stakeholder engagement, and data analytics, driving impactful solutions that empower communities and promote clean energy access. The Data and Analytics Manager will work closely with the India Country Delivery team and with the Grids of the Future and Powering Opportunity teams.
  
  
**Accountabilities**
**Data Analysis and Insights:**

* Gather, analyse, and interpret data on renewable energy markets, battery technology, and energy storage applications to inform program strategies.
* Develop and maintain databases and dashboards to track market trends, project performance, and emerging opportunities in the energy sector.
* Support feasibility studies and pilot projects by providing robust data analytics and scenario
* Work closely with the Impact team to meet global requirements for data analytics and reporting.
* Develop and refine financial and operational models for energy storage solutions, including cost-benefit analyses, return on investment, and impact projections.
* Collaborate with the Powering Opportunity and Grids of the Future teams to evaluate the scalability and replicability of projects across different local markets.
* Provide data-driven recommendations for program design and policy advocacy efforts, ensuring alignment with organizational goals.

**Program Support**

* Work closely with program and technical teams to integrate data insights into the design and implementation of renewable energy solutions including distributed renewable energy, battery energy storage solutions, digital grid monitoring systems and utility scale renewable energy.
* Contribute to the documentation of lessons learned and the creation of knowledge-sharing resources.
* Support internal teams in optimizing their data collection and reporting processes to enhance program impact assessment.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Prepare presentations to communicate data-driven insights and business models to internal and external stakeholders, including donors, government agencies, and alliance partners.
* Support engagement with funders by preparing data-driven presentations and reports to secure resources for program growth.
* Collaborate with regional and international stakeholders to represent the organization’s analytical capabilities and contribute to global discussions on renewable energy.

**BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCIES**
**Preferred Attributes**

* Working in Partnership: Learning with, learning from, and learning for our partners, particularly those who are closest to the work on the ground. Balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders and working in partnership wherever possible.
* Directs Work: Being strategic with efforts and generating information that informs decision making and improves impact. Providing direction and removing obstacles to get work done.
* Manages Complexity: Makes sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
* Values Differences: Recognizes the value of different perspectives and commits to inclusion, equity, and diversity in every aspect of work.
* Intellectual Humility: We know that we don’t have all the answer. We strive to be equally comfortable talking about what is not working as we are celebrating our successes. We listen to the voices of those we serve.
* Innovation and Entrepreneurial Spirit: A self-starter who takes initiative to identify areas of improvement and uses an energetic, pragmatic, and creative approach to optimize practice; embodying ‘Start-Up Philosophy.’

**Required Experience**
The ideal candidate would be a self-starter and be willing to “roll up their sleeves” to adapt to working in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Recognising GEAPP’s unique position and its stage of organisational life, the ideal candidate would be interested in contributing to and building a strong, enduring organisation.
  
  
**Essential Qualifications, Skills And Experience Include**

* Qualifications: Degree or post graduate qualifications; data science, engineering or economics subjects preferable;
* Experience: At least 5 years’ experience in the data analysis, business modelling or program development, preferably from a non profit environment or from an energy related field.
* Network: Good network in the non profit or data analytics sectors;
* Communication: Good written and verbal communication skills, excellent numeracy and data analytics skills;
* Market knowledge: Good understanding of the India market and key metrics/measures;
* Organisation and management: Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to multi-task effectively and a willingness to take ownership and responsibility for own work. Strong organisation and prioritisation skills with good attention to detail.

**In Addition, The Following Would Be a Bonus**
  
  

+ Experience of working on energy and infrastructure-related matters including, specifically, climate finance, renewable energy, energy transition and sustainable development; and
+ Experience working on energy and infrastructure related projects in Asia.

 Expert\-level SQL and strong hands\-on experience with BigQuery

 Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills for financial modeling, reporting, and scenario analysis
   

  

 Good understanding of accounting basics, financial statements, revenue, COGS, OpEx, gross margin, contribution margin, and cash flow

 Experience working directly with founders or senior leadership in a fast\-moving business environment

description:
**Job Description**
 Partnering with channel leaders, sales teams, business leadership, and cross\-functional stakeholders, you will develop and implement analytics, artificial intelligence (AI), and business intelligence solutions that enhance channel partner effectiveness, improve inventory health, strengthen market and channel intelligence, and accelerate business growth. Your ability to translate complex channel, customer, inventory, and market data into actionable insights will be critical in identifying growth opportunities, improving partner tiering and performance, enhancing forecast accuracy, optimizing inventory investments, and driving revenue growth. As a subject matter expert in analytics, you will champion data\-driven decision\-making across the organization while coaching and developing other analytics professionals to build a high\-performing analytics capability.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
*Key Responsibilities*
* Develop and implement channel sales analytics strategies, frameworks, and governance processes to support business growth and operational excellence.
* Lead channel partner tiering and segmentation initiatives, leveraging data to identify growth opportunities, optimize partner investments, and improve channel performance.
* Drive inventory analytics and management programs to improve inventory health, minimize excess and obsolete inventory, and support demand planning and forecasting efforts.
* Develop channel intelligence capabilities by integrating sales, market, customer, and competitive data to generate actionable business insights.
* Lead the adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and advanced analytics solutions to improve forecasting accuracy, partner recommendations, anomaly detection, and decision\-making effectiveness.
* Collaborate with Sales, Channel Management, Supply Chain, Finance, and IT teams to identify business requirements and translate them into scalable analytical solutions.
* Design and maintain executive dashboards, KPI scorecards, and reporting frameworks that provide visibility into channel performance, inventory trends, and market opportunities.
* Ensure data quality, accuracy, governance, and consistency across channel sales and inventory data sources.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives by identifying trends, risks, and opportunities through advanced analytics and predictive modeling.
* Stay current with industry trends, best practices, AI technologies, and emerging analytics capabilities to enhance Honeywell's channel analytics strategy.


**Qualifications**
*YOU MUST HAVE*
* 5\+ years of experience in data analytics
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights
* Proficiency in data analytics tools and programming languages (e.g., Python, R, SQL, etc.)
* Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, etc.)


*WE VALUE*
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Data Science, Analytics, Engineering, etc.)
* Strong leadership skills and the ability to effectively influence and coach others
* Proven track record of driving data\-driven decision\-making and delivering measurable business results
* Experience in supply chain analytics or related field
* Knowledge of advanced analytics techniques (e.g., machine learning, predictive modeling, etc.)
* Experience with data governance and data quality initiatives


**About Us**
 Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

description:
**Role Title: AVP, Collections Specialized Strategy (L10\)**
**Company Overview**
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 Credit Team decisions credit actions across the lifecycle of a customer – from acquisition to account management to collections and recover – we work towards managing credit and fraud losses and elevating customer experience through powerful and proprietary insights on customer risk and credit behaviors. The actionable insights are driven by access to numerous alternative data sources, new age technologies, focused strategies, emerging algorithms, and predictive precision. Spread across 10 pillars the credit team in India caters to the entire gamut of decision sciences, from data management to model development to strategy design, and bringing it all to life through technology, and managing within the guardrails of our regulatory requirements. As part of the team, you will have access to some unique product propositions, functional and leadership training, interaction with executive leadership team and a myriad of diverse perspectives.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 This role will be responsible for Collections Strategy analytics to generate insights in strategy development, implementation, and performance monitoring of complex, regulatory\-sensitive loss mitigation programs. The person in this role will participate in the design of challenger (test) strategies including eligibility criteria, opportunity sizing, performance monitoring, and on\-going strategy enhancement. The creation and delivery of presentations to cross functional audiences is essential. In addition, there is on\-going responsibilities for maintaining key performance reporting and strategy documentation.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own loss mitigation program reporting and analytics: Create materials and lead monthly presentation to Collections Leadership. Create required quarterly OCC loss mitigation volume and performance presentation slides. Interpret performance and clearly present findings.
* Drive automation and perform ongoing validation/maintenance of new and existing loss mitigation reports; create automated reports with interactive data visualization intelligence.
* Proactively drive visual and content enhancements to loss mitigation program reporting for volumes and performance (e.g. advanced filters for due stage, channel, client, plan type, plan duration etc.).
* Support strategic initiatives by researching industry best practices, analyzing market trends, and identifying opportunities to strengthen pre\-charge\-off loss mitigation efforts.
* Partner with multiple groups to implement reporting changes and assess post\-implementation execution and performance.
* Proactively communicate and engage across multiple levels, on the status of project progress and analytic priorities
* Lead loss mitigation strategy changes for required maintenance (e.g., NCI/NPI; MISC1 changes; regulatory updates). This includes obtaining Working Group and Tollgate approvals, strategy sheet updates, requests to Strategy Delivery, and tracking pre \& post implementation validations (if applicable).
* Support in transitioning all existing and future loss mitigation strategy test performance monitoring to the Growth team
* Provide Analytics support to build best in class strategies for Loss Mitigation programs
* Evaluate new data elements, sources, industry best practices for collections
* Co\-lead or support cross\-functional project teams to consistently track performance. Perform analytics to understand performance changes and make enhancements to address degradation.
* Support OCC, Audit, NMT accuracy requests, regulatory requirements for all loss mitigation programs and ensure strategy documentation is comprehensive, accurate and up to date (i.e., audit ready).
* Participate in ad\-hoc projects and analyses, as needed, Other duties as assigned.


**Required Skills/Knowledge**
* Bachelor's degree with quantitative underpinning (i.e., Data Science, Computer Science, Risk, Accounting, Business, Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering) with 4\+ years of experience in Programming/Analytics ideally in support of Risk, Credit, Finance, Consumer Lending, or other relevant professional experience; OR in lieu of a degree, 6\+ years of experience in Programming/Analytics ideally in support of Risk, Credit, Finance, Accounting, Consumer Lending, or other relevant professional experience.
* 4\+ years’ experience in SAS, SQL, Excel, Word and PowerPoint
* Excellent interpersonal, analytical, organizational and written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to make decisions and recommendations based on quantitative analysis and creative thinking
* Strong self\-starter balanced with desire to achieve team goals
* Ability to handle sensitive issues with uncompromising integrity and confidentiality


**Desired Skills/Knowledge**
* Prior Collection Strategy Development or Credit Strategy Development/ Risk Management experience and/or prior Collections experience in other functions
* 4\+ years demonstrated success developing and delivering advanced analytics solutions
* Data lake experience and strategies
* Master's degree in Business or in a Quantitative Related Field
* Proven analytical and decision\-making skills
* Experience developing scoring models or decision\-tree segmentations
* Ability to independently manage processes, Self\-motivated, and drive continuous process improvement
* Strong communications, problem solving skills and attention to detail
* Experience presenting to senior leadership teams
* Demonstrated ability to apply strategic thinking toward tactical execution
* Experience working with cross\-functional project teams


**Eligibility Criteria**
* Bachelor's degree with quantitative underpinning (i.e., Data Science, Computer Science, Risk, Accounting, Business, Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering) with 4\+ years of experience in Programming/Analytics ideally in support of Risk, Credit, Finance, Accounting, Consumer Lending, or other relevant professional experience; OR in lieu of a degree, 6\+ years of experience in Programming/Analytics ideally in support of Risk, Credit, Finance, Accounting, Consumer Lending, or other relevant professional experience.

* Supplier intelligence, scorecards and risk assessment
* E\-sourcing and contract intelligence
* AI\-assisted negotiation and price discovery
* Automated, data\-led decision making across categories



  





 The goal is to move from fragmented information and manual decision\-making to a system where
 **the data tells us where the opportunity is and technology helps us act on it.** 




  





 Strategic Sourcing \& P\&L Impact
 



 Own the commercial opportunity across a broad spend universe:
 



**Direct:** 
 Frames, lenses, coatings, accessories, packaging and manufacturing inputs
 



**Indirect:** 
 Store CapEx and OpEx, marketing, technology and corporate spend
 



**Supply Chain:** 
 Logistics, last\-mile, lab\-to\-store, make\-vs\-buy and network optimisation
 



 You will be expected to identify structural opportunities, develop category strategies and deliver measurable YoY P\&L impact through
 **should\-cost, TCO, value engineering and smarter commercial models.** 




  





 Negotiation \& Supplier Strategy
 



 Lead some of Lenskart’s highest\-value commercial negotiations while establishing greater negotiation rigour across the organisation.
 



  





 This includes developing stronger supplier strategies, benchmarking markets, understanding cost structures, defining negotiation playbooks and creating clear walk\-away positions.
 



 The objective is not simply to
 **negotiate harder** 
 , but to fundamentally improve the economics of the relationships we enter into.
 



  





 Business Problem Solving \& Leadership
 



 This role sits at the intersection of multiple parts of the business.
 



 You will work closely with
 **Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Retail, Technology and Marketing** 
 , as well as the founders and senior leadership team, on problems where the answer is not always obvious.
 



  





 You will be expected to:
 


* Break down complex business problems into clear commercial decisions.
* Challenge existing ways of working using data and first\-principles thinking.
* Translate business requirements into technology and AI solutions.
* Take ideas from analysis through implementation and measurable impact.
* Influence stakeholders across functions and drive adoption at scale.



  





 Who We’re Looking For
 



 We are looking for someone who
 **thinks like a business leader, not a functional specialist.** 




 You may come from strategy, consulting, business operations, supply chain, sourcing, procurement, corporate development or a high\-growth operating environment.
 



 What matters is that you have demonstrated:
 


* Strong problem\-solving ability across ambiguous, high\-impact business situations.
* Experience working directly with founders or senior leadership.
* Strong commercial and analytical instincts.
* Exposure to supply chain, sourcing, cost structures or commercial strategy.
* The ability to connect
 **strategy, economics, technology and execution.**
* A track record of taking ownership for outcomes, not just recommendations.
* Curiosity and instinct to use AI and technology to fundamentally improve how work gets done.



 Experience with
 **manufacturing, APAC, China or Middle East supply ecosystems** 
 is a strong advantage.
 



  





 Why This Role
 



**This is not a traditional procurement role.** 




 You will have the opportunity to work on some of the most consequential commercial problems at Lenskart, with visibility into the decisions that shape
 **margin, supply chain, capital allocation and growth.** 




  





 You will work closely with the
 **founders and senior leadership** 
 , operate across the full business and have significant ownership over the direction of the commercial function.
 



 The scale is substantial:
 **2,500\+ stores, hundreds of suppliers, multiple geographies and an increasingly complex manufacturing and supply chain ecosystem.** 




  





 The opportunity is to combine
 **business problem solving, commercial strategy, supply chain thinking and technology** 
 to create a capability that can materially change Lenskart’s economics.

title: Business Administration (MBA) - AI Content Specialist
description:
**About The Role**
 What if your MBA — your hard\-won expertise in corporate finance, market strategy, and business operations — could directly shape how AI advises executives and drives decisions for millions of businesses around the world?
   

  

 We're looking for MBA\-qualified professionals to work with Alignerr, partnering with the world's leading AI research labs to train and evaluate cutting\-edge AI models. You'll stress\-test AI reasoning on the toughest business problems, author gold\-standard solutions, and ensure these models are truly ready to function as sophisticated partners for executive decision\-making.
   

  

 This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. No prior AI experience needed — just deep business expertise and a sharp analytical mind.
   

  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week


**What You'll Do**
* Design Complex Business Challenges — Craft advanced business cases and quantitative problems spanning DCF valuation, market entry strategy, operations bottlenecks, cap table modeling, and more
* Author Ground\-Truth Solutions — Produce rigorous, step\-by\-step responses complete with financial statements, strategic frameworks (4Ps, 5Cs, Porter's Five Forces), and executive\-level rationales that serve as the "golden standard" for AI training
* Audit AI Outputs — Evaluate AI\-generated business plans, financial forecasts, and case study analyses for logical consistency, mathematical accuracy, and professional\-grade quality
* Sharpen AI Reasoning — Identify and document logical flaws in AI reasoning — such as ignoring sunk costs, miscalculating WACC, or failing to account for macroeconomic variables — and provide structured, actionable feedback


**Who You Are**
* Holder of a Master of Business Administration (MBA) from an accredited institution
* Strong foundational knowledge across at least two core business disciplines: Finance, Marketing, Operations, or Strategic Management
* Skilled at synthesizing complex data into clear, executive\-style analysis and recommendations
* Precise and methodical — you catch errors in financial formulas, data interpretation, and business logic
* Comfortable working independently and asynchronously on your own schedule
* No prior AI or data annotation experience required


**Nice to Have**
* Prior experience in management consulting, investment banking, or corporate strategy
* Background in data annotation, data quality, or evaluation systems
* Proficiency in data\-driven tools such as Excel financial modeling, Tableau, or SQL
* Experience producing board\-level or C\-suite communications and deliverables


**Why Join Us**
* Work directly with industry\-leading large language models at the frontier of AI development
* Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you, on your terms
* Freelance autonomy with the structure of meaningful, high\-impact project work
* Apply your business expertise to a domain that is reshaping the global economy
* Potential for ongoing work and contract renewals as new projects launch

description:
**Associate, Data Foundation \& Governance** 




  





**Location:** 
 Gurugram, Haryana, India
 



**Experience:** 
*4\-8 years of relevant experience* 




  





**About the Company** 




 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm built around entrepreneurial, action\-oriented, and results\-focused professionals. The firm takes a hands\-on approach to solving complex client problems and helping organizations reach their potential. A\&M values Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity, creating a collaborative environment for independent thinkers and doers. In 2023, A\&M established a high\-quality Global Capability Center in India to support leadership, business units, and client delivery teams across major markets. The center combines consulting and industry professionals across Consumer \& Retail, Healthcare, Software \& Technology, Automotive \& Industrials, Hospitality \& Leisure, Energy \& Natural Resources, and Financial Services. Unlike traditional back\-office models, the GCC partners with case teams on end\-to\-end delivery and thought leadership. The growing center already has more than 900 members and is designed to scale specialized talent, accelerate delivery, and apply automation and analytics to create measurable business value.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 As Associate, Data Foundation \& Governance, you will strengthen the trusted data foundations that power global People Data Analytics \& Reporting. You will own the consistency, clarity, and quality of HR data across Workday, Jobvite, and connected systems. Your work will establish standardized definitions, maintain the business and metric glossary, govern master data, and document lineage and change controls. You will partner with HRIS, reporting, Finance, and business stakeholders to identify and remediate data issues before they affect reporting, analytics, compliance, or workforce decisions. The role combines hands\-on data stewardship with structured governance, requiring careful analysis, clear documentation, and disciplined follow\-through. You will also help prepare HR data for a future governed data lakehouse, creating scalable foundations for reliable global workforce insight.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own standardized HR data definitions and the business and metric glossary across HR, Finance, and business units, improving consistency and reducing conflicting interpretations in workforce reporting.
* Establish data quality standards, validation checks, and periodic audits across people systems, using documented controls to identify errors early and improve confidence in recurring analytics.
* Support data alignment across Workday, Jobvite, and connected HR systems, resolving inconsistencies in structures, attributes, and records that could distort workforce reporting or downstream analysis.
* Maintain master data governance for positions, organizations, cost centers, and related entities, ensuring approved ownership, definitions, and changes remain aligned with business requirements.
* Document data lineage, definitions, and change controls, creating an accessible evidence base that preserves continuity, supports audits, and makes reporting logic easier to understand and maintain.
* Partner with HRIS on Workday architecture and configuration decisions, assessing how upstream design choices affect data quality, reporting reliability, governance, and future scalability.
* Coordinate stewardship workflows for definition changes, issue escalation, and dispute resolution, helping stakeholders reach documented decisions that protect enterprise\-wide data consistency.
* Contribute to audit, compliance, and secure data\-handling requirements, including GDPR awareness, while preparing governed data foundations for a future data lakehouse migration.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* 3–5 years of hands\-on relevant experience in HR data management, data governance, data stewardship, or master data management, with total experience typically ranging from 4–8 years.
* Practical experience creating and maintaining data definitions, business glossaries, data dictionaries, quality rules, lineage documentation, or change\-control records for HR data across functions.
* Familiarity with Workday data structures and HR domains such as positions, organizations, cost centers, headcount, and reporting hierarchies; exposure to Jobvite or similar systems is valuable.
* Strong Excel and data\-analysis capability, with exposure to Alteryx preferred. You should be able to investigate data issues methodically and translate findings into actionable remediation.
* Working knowledge of data governance, data quality, master data management, secure data handling, and data protection expectations such as GDPR.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to document standards, explain data issues, and collaborate effectively with global, cross\-functional stakeholders.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Experience supporting HRIS, People Analytics, reporting, Finance, or enterprise data teams in environments where definitions and master data must remain consistent across functions.
* Exposure to data lineage tooling, governed data lakehouse preparation, migration readiness, or structured stewardship and approval workflows.
* Experience working in a global organization or consulting environment with distributed stakeholders, multiple geographies, and changing business requirements.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* A Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Information Management, Statistics, Business Analytics, or a related discipline, supported by practical experience working with enterprise or HR data.
* Hands\-on ownership of data governance, data stewardship, or master data management outcomes, rather than only report production. You can define standards, establish controls, and follow issues through resolution.
* Strong attention to detail and a methodical quality mindset. You challenge ambiguous definitions, investigate root causes, document decisions, and protect the reliability of data used for workforce and business decisions.
