title: Regulatory Reporting - Business Analyst & Project Manager
description:
**OVERVIEW** 




  





 KPMG is a global network of professional firms providing Audit, Tax and Advisory services. We operate in 139 countries and have 2,75,000 people working in member firms around the world.
 



 KPMG in India, a professional services firm, is the Indian member firm of KPMG International and was established in September 1993\. Our professionals leverage the global network of firms, providing detailed knowledge of local laws, regulations, markets and competition. KPMG in India provide services to over 4,500 international and national clients, in India. KPMG has offices across India in Delhi, Noida, Gurugram, Chandigarh, Ahmedabad, Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, Pune, Jaipur, Chennai, Bangalore, Kochi, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Vododara and Vijayawada. The Indian firm has access to more than 20,000 Indian and expatriate professionals, many of whom are internationally trained. We strive to provide rapid, performance\-based, industry\-focused and technology\-enabled services, which reflect a shared knowledge of global and local industries and our experience of the Indian business environment.
 



 KPMG Advisory professionals provide advice and assistance to enable companies, intermediaries and public sector bodies to mitigate risk, improve performance, and create value. KPMG firms provide a wide range of Risk Consulting, Management Consulting and Transactions \& Restructuring services that can help clients respond to immediate needs as well as put in place the strategies for the longer term.
 



 With increasing regulatory requirements, the need for greater transparency in operations, and disclosure norms, stakeholders require assurance beyond the traditional critique of numbers. Hence assurance is being increasingly required on industry issues, business risks and key business processes. The Governance, Risk \& Compliance Services practice assists companies and public sector bodies to mitigate risk, improve performance and create value.
 



  





 We assist our clients to effectively manage business and process risks by providing a full spectrum of corporate governance, risk management, and Compliance Services. These services are tailored to meet client’s individual needs and provide effective support to management in meeting the challenges and opportunities presented by today's complex business environment.
 



  





 Our professionals provide the experience to help companies stay on track and deal with risks that could unhinge their business survival. Our services enable clients to effectively co\-ordinate their key growth, quality and operational challenges and working in partnership with us, clients have the benefits of KPMG's experienced, objective, and industry\-grounded viewpoints.
 



  





  





 Role Purpose
 



  





 We are seeking an experienced
 **Regulatory Reporting Business Analyst \& Project Manager** 
 to join the newly established
 **Regulatory Reporting Change Function** 
 , which forms part of the broader Regulatory Change Portfolio.
 



 This hybrid position combines end\-to\-end project delivery leadership with hands\-on business analysis responsibilities. The successful candidate will be accountable for delivering regulatory reporting change initiatives from inception through implementation, ensuring regulatory requirements are translated into practical business, data, operational, and technology solutions.
 



 The role requires a balance of project management and business analysis expertise, with responsibility for managing project governance, requirements definition, solution design, testing, implementation, and business readiness activities. Depending on the complexity and scale of the initiative, the individual may lead projects independently or work collaboratively with other project delivery leads.
 



  





 Key Work Level Accountabilities
 



  




* Accountable for managing and motivating others to ensure quality delivery to customers and stakeholders.
* Provides expert advice and specialist knowledge within the area of responsibility.
* Applies sound judgement to evaluate solutions while considering customer impact, risk, and cost implications.
* Manages and resolves conflicts that may impact delivery outcomes.
* Challenges constructively and influences decision\-making through a strong understanding of delivery requirements and broader organizational objectives.
* Identifies opportunities for continuous improvement in processes, quality, and efficiency.
* Manages resources, risks, and priorities using professional expertise and experience.



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 Project Delivery Leadership
 


* Lead the end\-to\-end delivery of regulatory reporting projects and change initiatives.
* Define project scope, objectives, benefits, resource requirements, and delivery strategies in partnership with sponsors and key stakeholders.
* Develop and manage integrated project plans covering business analysis, design, build, testing, implementation, and business readiness activities.
* Provide matrix leadership across business, technology, data, operations, risk, and compliance teams.
* Manage project delivery within agreed timelines, budgets, scope, quality standards, and risk tolerances.
* Monitor and forecast costs, resource utilization, and project progress while managing change control processes where required.
* Identify, assess, and manage risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies throughout the project lifecycle.
* Respond effectively to regulatory uncertainty and evolving requirements by adjusting plans, priorities, and delivery approaches.
* Prepare and present project status updates, governance materials, and executive reports to sponsors and leadership forums.
* Maintain project governance artifacts including project plans, RACI matrices, RAID logs, decision logs, and mandatory documentation.
* Lead implementation, business transition, benefits realization, and post\-delivery reviews.
* Capture lessons learned and contribute to continuous improvement across the Regulatory Change Portfolio.



  





 Business Analysis, Regulatory Interpretation \& Solution Design
 


* Interpret regulatory reporting requirements and translate them into business, operational, data, control, and technology solutions.
* Conduct regulatory impact assessments to identify affected processes, systems, controls, reporting obligations, and operating model components.
* Analyze regulatory source materials and identify ambiguities, gaps, dependencies, and clarification requirements.
* Document and manage assumptions where requirements are incomplete or evolving.
* Assess current\-state processes and define future\-state operating models and capabilities.
* Gather, analyze, document, and maintain business and functional requirements, including:
* Epics
* User stories
* Acceptance criteria
* Process flows
* Data requirements
* Control requirements
* Ensure traceability between regulatory obligations, requirements, solution design, testing, and implementation outcomes.
* Facilitate workshops and stakeholder discussions across business, technology, operations, risk, compliance, and data teams.
* Act as the critical link between regulatory interpretation and delivery execution.
* Evaluate solution options, identify trade\-offs, and recommend fit\-for\-purpose solutions.
* Review solution designs and completed deliveries against agreed requirements and regulatory expectations.
* Lead testing activities, including test planning, test execution, defect management, business acceptance testing, and readiness assessments.
* Drive business readiness activities, including operational impact assessments, training, communication, procedural updates, and deployment planning.
* Support delivery excellence through coaching, mentoring, and quality assurance activities.



  





 Skills \& Competencies
 



  





 Essential Skills
 


* Strong combined experience in Project Management and Business Analysis.
* Proven ability to transition seamlessly between delivery leadership and detailed analytical responsibilities.
* Strong understanding of project governance, planning, budgeting, resource management, and delivery controls.
* Deep expertise in business analysis practices including impact assessment, requirements engineering, operating model design, process analysis, and solution validation.
* Ability to interpret complex regulatory requirements and convert them into implementable business and technology solutions.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making capabilities.
* Experience managing delivery in environments with evolving or ambiguous regulatory requirements.
* Excellent stakeholder management, facilitation, negotiation, and influencing skills.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, risks, dependencies, and deadlines.
* Strong understanding of testing methodologies, traceability frameworks, defect management, UAT, and operational readiness.
* Experience providing matrix leadership across multidisciplinary teams.
* Working knowledge of Asset Management operating models and supporting data, operational, and technology environments.
* Commitment to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace culture.



  





 Experience Required
 


* Significant experience delivering projects from initiation through implementation and business handover.
* Demonstrated expertise in both Project Management and Senior Business Analysis roles.
* Proven experience delivering regulatory reporting change initiatives, including:
* EMIR
* Transaction Reporting
* AIFMD Annex IV
* Other regulatory reporting frameworks
* Experience conducting impact assessments, requirements analysis, process design, testing, and business readiness activities.
* Strong experience translating regulatory obligations into business, operational, data, and technology requirements.
* Experience working closely with business, risk, compliance, technology, data, and operations functions.
* Proven ability to engage senior stakeholders and lead cross\-functional teams through matrix management.

title: Category Associate
description:
**About Us** 
 : We are making natural living a HABIT little by little. We do so by serving 100% natural self care to our consumers. The products are scientifically formulated, guided by ayurvedic principles \& modern science. They are prepared fresh everyday in our ayurvedic kitchen, out of whole and raw ingredients such as fresh milk, curd, fruit pulps, flowers, herbs, nut \& spices. They are finally tested clinically for efficacy \& safety. This offering of Fresh Ayurveda has made a mark in the Indian personal care industry.
 



  





 Today \~60Lac customers trust us for their personal care needs. The founding team has a strong startup experience, is well funded and backed by tier 1 institutional investors.
 



  





**About the role** 




 Most entry\-level category hires start with a dashboard. This one starts with a phone call. The Category Associate's job is to build the category's understanding of its consumer from the ground up \- through call surveys, focus group discussions (FGDs) and in\-person interactions \- and turn that into insight that shapes what we make, how we sell it, and where we invest next. It's a research\-to\-execution role: you generate the insight, then help ship the decisions that follow from it.
 



  





**Why this starts with a real conversation, not a dashboard** 




 We won't pretend it's the easy part. Calling a stranger, running an FGD, or standing in front of a consumer and asking why she didn't repurchase is harder than pulling a report \- and most people this early in their career would rather stay behind a screen. We're asking you to do it anyway, because it's the one input nobody else in the building has.
 



  





 Secondary data \- sales, ratings, app analytics \- tells you
 *what* 
 happened. A consumer conversation tells you
 *why* 
 , often weeks before it shows up in a number. That gap is where category strategy actually gets built: which claim lands, which price point stings, which product idea is a real gap versus a nice\-to\-know. Skip the conversation and you're strategising on guesses.
 



  





 It's also the fastest route to real say in the business. The Category Associates who move quickest into P\&L ownership are the ones whose point of view the business trusts before the data catches up \- because they built it firsthand, one conversation at a time.
 



  





**What you'll own** 



1. **Consumer insight engine.** 
 Run structured call surveys, FGDs and in\-person consumer interactions (store visits, pop\-ups, cohort meetups) to build a live, ground\-up read of what the category's consumer wants, buys, and drops off on \- a standing system, not a one\-time project.
2. **Insight → action.** 
 Convert raw consumer feedback into structured insight \- need\-gaps, purchase triggers, objections, usage occasions \- that Product, Marketing and Ops can act on, and follow through to make sure it actually gets used.
3. **Category ops execution.** 
 Own the operational backbone of the category \- listings, pricing hygiene, catalog accuracy, promo execution, inventory flags, competitor tracking \- so nothing slips between insight and shelf.
4. **Data and dashboards.** 
 Track category KPIs (sales, conversion, repeat rate, ratings/reviews, NPS) and build or automate the reporting for them. The bar: build a workflow once, don't rebuild a report every week.
5. **Ground\-up category mapping.** 
 Build and maintain the category's core reference material \- competitor landscape, price\-value map, consumer segments, category taxonomy \- as living, reusable assets, not one\-off decks.
6. **Cross\-functional coordination.** 
 Work daily with Marketing, Creative, Ops and Supply to get category initiatives shipped on time.



  





**What great looks like in your first 90 days** 



* You've personally spoken to 50\+ consumers (calls, FGDs, in\-person) and turned it into one clear point of view on a real gap or opportunity in the category.
* You've built, or meaningfully improved, a self\-refreshing dashboard for the category's core KPIs \- no manual pull required.
* You know the category's competitive set cold: pricing, claims, reviews, what's winning and why.
* At least one of your insights has visibly changed a decision \- a listing, a claim, a promo, a launch input.



  





**What you bring** 



* 1\+ years of experience \- freshers welcome; internships or research/analytics projects count.
* You genuinely enjoy talking to consumers \- you'd rather run 10 calls than read 10 secondary reports.
* Strong with data: comfortable in Excel/Sheets at minimum; SQL or basic scripting is a real plus, and you're always looking for what can be automated rather than repeated by hand.
* Business\-first instinct \- you don't stop at "here's what the data says," you push to "here's what we should do about it."
* High ownership of ops execution \- as comfortable in the weeds of listings, pricing sheets and trackers as you are in a deck.
* Bachelor's degree in any discipline \- research, consumer behaviour, business or a quant background all work well here.



  





 Location: Udyog Vihar, Gurgaon
 



 Website: www.nathabit.in
 



 Instagram: www.instagram.com/nathabit.in

 A Senior Category Associate does everything a Category Associate does \- stays close to the consumer, keeps the insight engine running, keeps ops tight \- and then goes one step further: you own the category's P\&L and make the calls. Pricing, mix, promo calendar, launch bets, inventory investment \- the decisions are yours, backed by the ground\-truth you built.
 



  





**Why this stays hands\-on even once you own the P\&L** 




 It would be easy, at this level, to hand the calls and FGDs to someone junior and sit with the dashboard instead. We deliberately don't let that happen. The decisions you're now accountable for \- pricing, assortment, what to launch, what to sunset \- are only as good as the ground\-truth behind them, and that ground\-truth comes from talking to consumers directly, not from a report someone else generated.
 



  





 Secondary data tells you what happened last month. A direct conversation tells you why, early enough to act before it shows up as a dip in the number you own. The Senior Category Associates who make the best calls are the ones who never fully hand over the phone \- they just get faster and sharper at turning what they hear into a decision.
 



  





**What you'll own** 



1. **The full Category Associate scope** 
 \- consumer insight generation (calls, FGDs, in\-person), insight\-to\-action, category ops, KPI dashboards and automation, ground\-up category mapping \- at a higher bar of independence.
2. **Category P\&L.** 
 Own revenue, margin and growth for your category end\-to\-end \- you know the number, you know why it moved, and you're accountable for moving it.
3. **Pricing and promo decisions.** 
 Set and adjust pricing, discounting and the promo calendar for your category based on consumer insight, competitive movement and margin impact.
4. **Portfolio and launch calls.** 
 Decide what's in and out of the category's assortment \- which SKUs to push, fix or sunset \- and drive new launches from consumer insight through to go\-to\-market, owning the business case.
5. **Inventory and investment.** 
 Make the call on stock investment and category spend, balancing growth against working capital.
6. **The "why" behind the plan.** 
 Brief and align Marketing, Creative, Supply and Ops around your category plan \- you're the person who owns the reasoning, not just the numbers.

title: Planning Lead
description:
**About the Role** 




 FNP operates in a high\-velocity, occasion\-driven gifting business where demand can spike 5–10x around key calendar events (Valentine's Day, Rakhi, Diwali, Mother's Day, Anniversaries) and where a large share of the catalog — flowers, cakes, plants — is perishable with a shelf life measured in hours or days. This makes planning the backbone of the business: get it wrong, and the company either loses sales during peak occasions or writes off perishable stock; get it right, and it protects both customer experience and margins.
 



  





 We are looking for a
 **Lead – Planning** 
 who will own the
 **demand plan, inventory plan, and operations manpower plan** 
 as one integrated system rather than three disconnected charts. The role leads
 **three functions** 
 (Demand Planning, Inventory Planning, and Operations Manpower Planning) directly, and is accountable for the quality, alignment, and business impact of what each of them produces. This is a highly cross\-functional role sitting at the intersection of Sales, Category, Supply Chain, Hub Operations, and HR/Workforce teams, and is ideal for someone who enjoys working with data, can operate a level above the day\-to\-day execution, and can translate a demand forecast all the way down.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 1\. Demand Planning
 


* Direct and review the
 **short\-term (weekly/daily) and long\-term (monthly/seasonal) demand forecasts** 
 built by the Demand Planning Manager across categories (flowers, cakes, plants, personalized gifts, combos) and cities/hubs; sign off before they feed downstream planning.
* Set the strategy for
 **event/occasion\-based forecasting** 
 (Valentine's Day, Rakhi, Diwali, Mother's Day, Friendship Day, Anniversaries, Corporate Gifting cycles) and stress\-test the Manager's assumptions against historical trends, growth targets, and market intelligence.
* Represent Planning in discussions with
 **Sales, Category, and Marketing teams** 
 on promotions, new product launches, and campaign spends, ensuring these are correctly reflected in the forecast.
* Own
 **forecast accuracy (MAPE/Bias) as a KPI** 
 for the Demand Planning Manager; chair the monthly/weekly forecast review (S\&OP) and drive accountability on deviations.
* Guide demand segmentation by
 **city, hub, delivery slot, and channel** 
 (app/web/B2B) to ensure it's granular enough for inventory and manpower planning downstream.
* Ensure early\-warning triggers for demand risk (weather impact on flower availability, competitor activity, macro trends) are built and escalated in time.



 2\. Inventory Planning
 


* Review and approve the
 **procurement and inventory plans** 
 the Inventory Planning Manager builds off the demand plan, for both perishable (flowers, cakes) and non\-perishable (vases, add\-on gifts, packaging) categories.
* Set policy for
 **safety stock, reorder points, and shelf\-life\-based replenishment norms** 
 , given the perishability constraints unique to floriculture and bakery items, and hold the Manager accountable to it.
* Own
 **inventory health metrics** 
 — fill rate, wastage/spoilage %, aging stock, stock\-out %, and inventory turns — as KRAs for the Manager, and step in on corrective action plans when metrics slip.
* Escalate and resolve issues with
 **Sourcing/Procurement and Vendor Management** 
 on supplier lead times and MOQs where the Manager needs senior\-level support, especially ahead of peak occasions.
* Sign off on
 **hub\-wise and dark\-store\-wise stock allocation** 
 plans to balance delivery reliability against working capital.
* Set direction for
 **pre\-season and post\-season inventory strategy** 
 — build\-up ahead of peak days and liquidation/markdown planning for residual inventory — and hold the Manager to the plan.



 3\. Operations Manpower Planning
 


* Review and approve the
 **operations workforce plan** 
 the Manager builds off the demand and inventory plan — across florists/decorators, packers, riders/delivery partners, and warehouse staff.
* Approve
 **shift\-wise and day\-wise manpower requirement models** 
 , with particular scrutiny on surge plans for peak occasions where manpower needs can multiply overnight.
* Provide senior\-level backing to the Manager's coordination with
 **HR, Hub Operations, and Third\-Party Logistics/Gig partners** 
 on hiring, temporary staffing, and gig\-workforce deployment ahead of peak seasons.
* Own
 **productivity metrics** 
 (orders processed per FTE, cost per order/delivery, utilization %) as a KRA for the Manager, and sponsor efficiency initiatives that need cross\-functional or budget approval.
* Sign off on the
 **peak season manpower playbook** 
 — sourcing timelines, training plans, and contingency staffing (backup riders/packers) — before each major occasion.
* Hold the Manager accountable for manpower cost against the
 **operations budget and cost\-per\-order targets** 
 .



 4\. Integrated Planning \& Stakeholder Management
 


* Run an
 **integrated S\&OP (Sales \& Operations Planning) process** 
 that connects demand, inventory, and manpower plans into a single peak\-season readiness plan.
* Present
 **weekly/monthly planning reviews** 
 to leadership with clear visibility on forecast accuracy, inventory health, fill rates, and manpower readiness.
* Ensure
 **planning dashboards/MIS** 
 (Excel/Power BI/internal tools) maintained by the three Managers give real\-time visibility during high\-demand periods.
* Act as the
 **single point of accountability** 
 for "will we be ready for \[occasion]?" across product, stock, and people.



 5\. People Management
 


* Lead, mentor, and performance\-manage the
 **Demand Planning Manager, Inventory Planning Manager, and Operations Manpower Planning Manager** 
 , setting clear KRAs and reviewing them regularly.
* **Resolve trade\-offs between the three functions** 
 when priorities conflict — e.g., Inventory pushing to cut safety stock for working capital vs. Demand wanting a buffer for an upcoming occasion, or Manpower flagging a staffing constraint that the demand plan hasn't accounted for.
* Build
 **bench strength and succession** 
 within the planning team; identify capability gaps and drive relevant training (forecasting tools, S\&OP practices, data literacy).
* Foster a
 **culture of data\-driven decision\-making and ownership** 
 across the three teams, and represent the collective planning function to senior leadership as one voice.



  





**Required Qualifications \& Experience** 



* **Education:** 
 MBA / PGDM (Operations, Supply Chain, Analytics) or B.Tech/B.E. with relevant experience; certifications in Supply Chain Planning (CPIM/CSCP) are a plus.
* **Experience:** 
 10–14 years in Demand Planning, Inventory/Supply Chain Planning, or Operations Planning, preferably in
 **e\-commerce, quick\-commerce, FMCG, retail, or perishables** 
 businesses with high demand seasonality, with at least 3–4 years managing managers or leading a multi\-function planning team.
* Demonstrated experience managing
 **peak\-season/event\-driven demand spikes** 
 is highly preferred.
* Prior exposure to
 **workforce/manpower planning** 
 in an operations\-heavy (hub/warehouse/last\-mile) setup is a strong plus.
* Proven track record of
 **leading and developing managers/team leads** 
 , not just individual contributors — this role's success depends on getting the best out of three functional heads, not doing their jobs for them.



**Skills \& Competencies** 



* Strong
 **analytical and quantitative skills** 
 — comfortable with forecasting techniques, statistical models, and large datasets.
* Proficiency in
 **Excel/Google Sheets** 
 (advanced) and working knowledge of
 **Power BI/Tableau** 
 ; exposure to planning tools (SAP APO, Blue Yonder, o9, or similar) is a plus.
* Ability to think in
 **systems** 
 — connecting demand, inventory, and people as one plan rather than three silos.
* Strong
 **people leadership** 
 — able to manage through managers, delegate effectively, and coach rather than take over when a Manager struggles.
* Sound
 **conflict resolution and prioritization** 
 skills to adjudicate between the three functions when their goals pull in different directions.
* Excellent
 **stakeholder management** 
 skills to align Sales, Category, Procurement, Hub Operations, and HR around a single plan.
* Comfortable operating with
 **high ambiguity and tight timelines** 
 , especially in the run\-up to peak gifting occasions.
* Strong
 **communication skills** 
 — ability to present complex planning data simply to leadership.
* A bias for
 **action and ownership** 
 , with the resilience to manage the intensity of a 24\-48 hour peak\-occasion operating window multiple times a year.

title: Manager, Marketplace Accounts Receivable
description:

 You will own the daily financial operations of MongoDB’s cloud marketplace business across AWS, Azure, and GCP. Ensure seamless integration between partner portals and internal finance systems while safeguarding transaction accuracy, revenue integrity, and operational continuity. Proactively identify risks and implement scalable solutions as transaction volumes grow.
   

  

 Based in our Gurugram office, you will sit at the intersection of Finance, Sales Operations, and Cloud Engineering. You aren't just managing a ledger; you are managing the financial health of our most critical growth channel, ensuring that high\-volume marketplace transactions are billed accurately and collected with surgical precision.
   

  

 What You’ll Do (Day\-to\-Day)
   

  

* Marketplace Operations Leadership: Serve as the functional successor in managing MongoDB’s cloud marketplace presence. Oversee the daily flow of transactions through AWS, Azure, and GCP, ensuring seamless integration between partner portals and internal finance systems
* Accounts Receivable Supervision: Maintain rigorous oversight of the AR lifecycle for the marketplace portfolio. This includes supervising the accuracy of invoices, monitoring aging reports, and ensuring that payouts are reconciled daily against recognized revenue


 Lead end\-to\-end AR lifecycle management for the marketplace portfolio: Oversee invoice accuracy and completeness to maintain reliable financial records, monitor aging accounts and drive a proactive collections strategy to optimize cash flow, meet/exceed assigned cash targets on a monthly and quarterly basis \& participate actively in month\-end and close activities, including reporting.
   

  

* Cash Application \& Reconciliation Excellence: Ensure timely and accurate application of marketplace receipts across AWS, Azure, and GCP. Oversee daily reconciliation for incoming cash, minimize unapplied cash, resolve remittance discrepancies, and drive automation to support scale and clean audit trails \& partner cross\-functionally to address root causes.
* Strategic Partner Engagement: Act as the primary Finance liaison for our Cloud Partners which includes maintaining strong relationships to ensure all issues or discrepancies can be resolved timely.

Identify bottlenecks in the marketplace billing cycle and implement automated solutions to manage increasing transaction volumes as we scale along with owning operational readiness in a fast\-paced environment by multitasking effectively and staying highly organized.
* Team Mentorship \& Management: Retain, lead and develop a high\-performing team of AR Specialists in India. Your day will include technical guidance on complex reconciliations, performance reviews, and fostering a culture of "Customer Success" within Finance.

You will act as a strategic bridge between the Finance and Sales teams to ensure contract alignment, billing accuracy, and clear revenue visibility.

title: Ecommerce Manager
description:
**Digital Marketing and E\-Commerce Manager** 




  





**Location:** 
 Gurugram, Haryana, India
 



**Experience:** 
 7\-10 years
 



  





**About the Company** 




 bioQuad Life Sciences is a biotechnology company that manufactures patented, clinically tested supplements built on Bio\-Replenishments®, bioactive molecules the body naturally produces to maintain homeostasis. Published clinical trials support the company’s claims, which is uncommon in this industry. We operate two brands: bioQuad® for people and Boneo Canine® for pets. Both brands sell in the US, Europe and the UAE through Amazon, direct\-to\-consumer Shopify stores, and professional and retail distribution channels. Our products are based on original scientific research and are designed to support the body’s natural systems of regulation, repair, renewal and balance. The company has a growing international presence across the US, Europe, the Middle East and India. We combine scientific rigour, product quality and commercial execution to develop next\-generation solutions for metabolic and broader systemic health. This role reports directly to the Founder and CEO and will help build the paid acquisition function that supports the next stage of growth.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 This role takes charge of our paid advertising and makes it profitable. Amazon US is the priority. Both brands sell well there on their own, but the advertising has been left unmanaged by an outside agency. You will audit the accounts, present a rebuild plan, and then run the campaigns yourself. After Amazon US, you will launch Meta and Google, then paid traffic to our Shopify stores, and then assess Amazon UAE. None of these channels is currently running at full capability. You will work directly in the ad accounts, report to the Founder and CEO, and take responsibility for the numbers. The first ninety days are clear: audit the accounts, relaunch Amazon advertising on an approved structure, restore return on ad spend, and present a plan for the next channels. As the function grows, you will help set creative priorities, review agencies and take part in hiring additional digital team members.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Audit the existing Amazon US campaigns for both brands and present a written, costed rebuild plan before making changes.
* Create the campaign structure across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Display, with sound bidding, match types and negative keyword management.
* Restore return on ad spend to a profitable level and hold it, while ensuring budgets pace evenly through the day and remain within approved limits.
* Maintain account health and respond to policy notifications and listing suppressions within 24 hours. Improve titles, keywords, images and A\+ content before publication.
* Track inventory levels, restock timing and the causes of order cancellations so advertising does not create demand for products that cannot be supplied.
* Develop Meta and Google from dormant accounts into working campaigns across prospecting, retargeting, Search, Shopping and Performance Max, with tracking verified through GA4, Tag Manager and platform pixels.
* Strengthen the path from advertisement to completed Shopify checkout, identify conversion bottlenecks, and create and test campaign landing pages with the creative team.
* Submit a performance report every Monday, covering spend, revenue and return across all channels. Set creative and agency deliverables, verify reported figures, and escalate risks promptly.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Amazon Seller Central, Amazon Advertising and Brand Registry, including Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Display, bidding, match types, negative keywords and account health.
* Meta Ads Manager and Business Manager, Google Ads, Google Search, Shopping and Performance Max, with the ability to launch and manage campaigns yourself.
* Google Analytics 4, Tag Manager, Search Console and platform pixels, including the ability to verify tracking and diagnose gaps in reported performance.
* Shopify administration and analytics, with practical experience improving product pages, landing pages, checkout conversion and the wider e\-commerce funnel.
* Strong command of return on ad spend, ACOS, TACOS, cost per acquisition, conversion rate, budget pacing, revenue forecasting and quarterly spend planning.
* Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, with experience preparing weekly performance reports, forecasts, variance analysis and channel\-level decisions.
* Daily use of AI tools for research, ad copy, creative briefs, keyword analysis and reporting, alongside practical use of Helium 10, Jungle Scout or similar tools.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Background in supplements, nutraceuticals, health or pet products, where product claims, customer education and compliance require care.
* Experience with Amazon UAE or European marketplaces, including the differences in demand, creative, timing and marketplace operations.
* Experience reviewing an external marketing agency, leading a small digital team, or managing advertising budgets substantially larger than the current spend.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* Seven to ten years in performance marketing or e\-commerce growth, still working hands\-on in the advertising accounts.
* A revenue target you carried for a channel and met, with the ability to talk through the numbers and explain what drove the result.
* A channel you launched from nothing and made profitable, including the starting position, the actions taken and the timeline to profitability.
* Hands\-on command of Amazon Advertising and Seller Central. You must be able to diagnose and repair an underperforming account yourself.
* A track record of running Meta or Google advertising profitably for a direct\-to\-consumer brand, preferably in a Western market.
* The ability to prepare a quarterly spend and revenue forecast, not only optimize week to week.
* Fluency in return on ad spend, ACOS, TACOS, cost per acquisition and conversion rate, with the judgment to act when they move.
* Strong written and spoken English, sufficient for clear reporting to senior management. You use AI tools daily and are comfortable working directly with the Founder and CEO.
* You are commercially accountable, organized and willing to build the function rather than wait for a finished team, established process or fully managed account.



  





**Why Join Us** 



* You turn a channel around rather than maintain one. The result of your work is visible and attributable in revenue, return on ad spend and budget performance.
* You report directly to the Founder and CEO, with no layers between you and the decision. Strategy, budget and channel priorities are close to the person accountable for the business.
* The scope grows in a defined order: Amazon US first, then Meta and Google, then Shopify, then Amazon UAE. You will build the system as each channel comes online.
* You help shape and hire the digital team that follows you. This is an opportunity to establish how paid acquisition, creative testing, reporting and agency management are done.



  





**What We Offer** 



* A hands\-on role with direct responsibility for paid advertising across two international health and pet\-care brands.
* Direct reporting to the Founder and CEO, with clear ownership of channel performance, budget control, reporting and the ninety\-day delivery plan.
* A defined path to broaden the role from Amazon US into Meta, Google, Shopify, Amazon UAE and digital team building.
* Full\-time, in\-office work at HQ27, Sector 27, Gurugram, a Grade A building near IFFCO Chowk metro, with a food court and parking.

title: Sr Manager - Decision Intelligence
description:
**Job Description**
**About Busuu**
 Busuu is one of the world's leading language\-learning platforms, part of Chegg. We help over 100 million learners build language skills that change their lives — through apps, web, and now an AI\-first product experience. We operate across consumer (B2C) and business (B2B/enterprise) markets in over 100 countries
   

  

**About Decision Intelligence**
 Decision Intelligence (DI) is the central capability that makes the business measurable, governed, and trusted. It spans data insights and analytics across the organization, operating through three layers: analytics partners embedded in business teams, a central hub that owns standards, metrics architecture, experimentation, and governance, and a platform layer (Data Engineering) that builds the infrastructure.
   

  

 DI does not govern business decisions — it governs the standards that make those decisions trustworthy and evidence\-based. We don't build dashboards on request; we build the foundations teams build on. We work hybrid with team members across India, the UK, and the EU.
   

  

**The Role**
 You are the operational backbone of Busuu's Decision Intelligence function. As Head of Decision Intelligence, you anchor business\-wide strategic intelligence, run the hub day\-to\-day, manage and develop analytics leaders as a player\-coach, and own the methodology behind Busuu's weekly business performance reporting and monthly leadership reviews.
   

  

 You operate as a player\-coach: you lead capability work in the hub, grow direct reports across the organization, and continue to contribute hands\-on to strategic analytics work. You partner with senior analytics stakeholders on metrics architecture and strategy, with the Director on hub direction, and with business leaders on analytics\-driven narratives.
   

  

 The role is the connective tissue of the function — turning measurement into operating decisions across the business. It is also a role with a clear trajectory: the right person grows into broader strategic leadership scope over time as the function scales.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Business\-wide strategic owner — anchor cross\-functional business narrative, deep\-dives, and performance readouts. Be the credible analytics voice in leadership forums and key business meetings.
* Player\-coach for direct reports — Develop 3\-4 analytics leaders on craft, level progression, and strategic partnership capability. Balance coaching and mentorship with your own hands\-on strategic analytics contributions.
* Weekly business performance reporting — design, narrative arc, and analytical integrity of weekly business performance summaries.
* Monthly leadership review architecture — partner with senior analytics stakeholders on monthly business review structure; you own the weekly\-to\-monthly narrative connection.
* Experimentation standards — co\-build testing rigor and best practices across the organization.
* Hub operations — day\-to\-day leadership of the analytics hub as the synthesis layer that makes cross\-functional signals usable for executive decisions.
* Metrics architecture co\-ownership — co\-own metrics definition and architecture with senior analytics partners.
* Business performance deep\-dives — cross\-functional lens, working with your team on methodology and insights.
* Strategic planning and forecasting — the senior analytics voice on business strategy, OKR setting, and opportunity sizing.


**Required**
**What We Are Looking For**
* 10\+ years experience in analytics, business intelligence, strategy, or consulting at meaningful scale — ideally with hands\-on analytical depth and people leadership combined.
* Demonstrated player\-coach experience — managing 3\+ analysts or data scientists while continuing to contribute as a senior individual contributor to strategic work. Comfortable in both leadership and hands\-on analytical work.
* Strong commercial instinct — you understand how analytics maps to business outcomes (revenue, retention, lifetime value, unit economics, conversion).
* Strategic narrative skill — you translate quantitative measurement into executive\-grade communication that drives decisions, not just describes them.
* Senior stakeholder influence — comfortable operating with Directors, VPs, and General Managers. Diplomatic but direct.
* Excellent SQL and fluency with BI tooling (Tableau, Looker, Metabase, or equivalent). Working knowledge of semantic\-layer thinking (dbt, Cube, LookML, or equivalent).
* Experience designing or owning a weekly business performance reporting cadence and a monthly business review architecture.
* Comfort working in a hybrid team across time zones — explicit overlap with London and EU as a known feature of the role.


**Preferred**
* B2C subscription \+ B2B SaaS exposure — comfortable thinking about both segments and weaving them together.
* EdTech context.
* AI and transformation measurement experience.
* Prior team\-building or hiring track record — bringing in talent, growing analysts, and building team\-level capability.
* Demonstrated growth trajectory — you've taken on expanded scope as you've delivered. The function is scaling; the right person will too.
* Familiarity with analytics operating models, data\-driven decision practices, or building analytics functions in fast\-moving environments.


**Competencies Expected at this Level**
* Strategic Thinking — plans strategy for team and projects (3\-9 month horizon); anticipates issues; plans for scalability; contributes to function\-level direction.
* Communication \& Leadership — tactical day\-to\-day team communication; conflict resolution; makes sound talent decisions (hires, performance, promotions); coaches and develops with compassion; fosters collaboration; influences senior stakeholders.
* Critical Thinking — prioritizes given impact and effort; identifies and asks tough questions; coaches reports on data\-driven decision\-making.
* Accountability — drives repeatable results at team and project level; provides clear ownership; knows when to escalate; fully committed to objectives.
* Analytics Architecture and Design — coaches team on measurement design; sets architectural standards; owns system\-level measurement conversations with key stakeholders.
* Cross\-functional Pattern Recognition — drives conversation across teams on shared patterns; coaches team members to identify and surface patterns; weaves signals into coherent narrative.


**How We Work**
 Decision Intelligence is deliberately small and high\-leverage. We are pragmatic about trade\-offs, opinionated about standards, and committed to evidence over opinion. The hub is the connective layer between business teams and Executive Leadership — and as Head of Decision Intelligence, you are the connective tissue of that layer.
   

  

 The function is scaling as part of broader business evolution at Busuu. The right person in this role will grow with it — expanding scope over time as the function matures.
   

  

 We work hybrid across India, the UK, and the EU. The role is India\-based with explicit time\-zone bridging with EU/UK.

title: Senior Enterprise Solutions Manager - Brand & Engagement
description:
**💻 Position: Senior Enterprise Solutions Manager \- Brand \& Engagement** 




**📍Location: Delhi** 




**🗓️ Working Days: Monday to Friday** 




**📌 Experience Required: 4–7 years** 




  





**About the Role** 




 Own the
 **end\-to\-end implementation and growth of FMCG brand campaigns post\-sale** 
 — getting them live, setting up tooling/dashboards, handling SQL, legal/ops, and building solutions when standard processes don’t fit.
 



  





**The Role** 



* You own what happens after a brand signs — and part of what happens just before.
* You take a signed (or near\-signed) enterprise brand and stand up a working, measurable campaign: configuring internal tooling, building the demo/sandbox the brand evaluates, wiring up their analytics dashboards, and clearing the legal and operational steps between contract and go\-live.
* When the standard path doesn't fit a brand's ask, you design one. And you feed every recurring gap back to Product, so the next deployment is faster.
* This is a builder's seat, not a relationship\-management seat. You'll be measured on getting brands live, instrumented and expanding — not on meeting cadence.



  





**What You'll Do** 



* **Demos \& sandboxes:** 
 Build the demo environments and proof\-of\-concept setups brands evaluate, in coordination with the founding team.
* **Solutioning:** 
 Translate a brand's objective into a concrete campaign configuration. Invent workarounds when our defaults don't fit.
* **Customer setup:** 
 Configure and launch new enterprise customers in our internal tools. Own time\-to\-first\-live\-campaign.
* **Analytics:** 
 Stand up and maintain customer\-facing dashboards so every brand can see purchase intent and campaign outcomes without having to ask.
* **Cross\-functional coordination:** 
 Drive legal (MSAs, DPAs, brand \& procurement reviews) and operations (fulfilment, sampling logistics) to unblock go\-live.
* **Account outcomes:** 
 Own the ongoing result — accounts that stay live and grow because they're properly instrumented. Catch risk in the data before it surfaces at renewal, not after.
* **Product partnership:** 
 Surface recurring friction, scope it with Product, and help shape the tooling built specifically for this function.



  





**Requirements** 



* 4–7 years in solutions engineering, implementation / onboarding, technical account management, or enterprise customer success at a B2B SaaS, martech or adtech company.
* Hands\-on data fluency. You build dashboards from raw data, not just read them — hands\-on SQL, plus a BI tool (Metabase, Looker, Power BI, Tableau).
* Ownership in ambiguity. You've run an implementation or a complex onboarding end\-to\-end, not just managed a relationship around one.
* Enterprise stakeholder management. You've sat across from brand / marketing, procurement and legal — ideally in or around FMCG / CPG brand teams or their agencies (WPP, Publicis, Mindshare, Dentsu).
* Communication. Sharp written and verbal; you can run a room of senior client stakeholders.

title: Sr Manager, Strategy & Operations
description:
The Trade Desk is a global technology company and the world’s leading independent platform for digital advertising, with over 3,000 employees across more than 30 offices. Our technology helps advertisers reach the right audiences across the open internet — from streaming TV and podcasts to mobile apps, news, and more.
   

  

 Advertising powers the content people love. By making it more transparent, effective, and responsible, we help support trusted journalism, quality entertainment, and creators worldwide. The world’s brands and agencies rely on us to reach their customers and grow their businesses responsibly.
   

  

 The scale of our platform brings unique technical challenges — from processing massive datasets in real time to building systems that operate reliably on a global scale. When you work here, your impact is worldwide. We welcome diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and build teams that learn from one another. If you’re driven to solve meaningful challenges, we’d love to meet you.
   

  

 The Trade Desk is helping shape the future of digital advertising, and APAC \& EMEA are the most dynamic places to build that future. As APAC \& EMEA Strategy \& Operations (S\&O) resets from ad\-hoc executor to strategic advisor, we are standing up two accountable pillars: RevOps \& Sales Enablement, and Systems \& XFN Enablement to give the region the scalable frameworks and operating discipline it needs for sustained double\-digit growth.
   

  

 We're looking for a hands\-on operator who thrives on turning systems and process chaos into trusted, self\-serve foundations, someone who is as comfortable rolling up their sleeves in Salesforce (or equivalent platforms) as they are coaching a country manager through change. If you're energised by fixing the plumbing so teams can focus on customers, this is where you'll do some of your best work.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 Reporting into the APAC Director, Systems \& XFN Enablement, you'll own the execution layer that turns the region's systems foundation from a source of friction into a source of trust. Today, channel management activities (such as, mapping rework and change requests) pull Business Development \& Client Services managers and sellers off customers; you'll close that gap for good.
   

  

  

* Own Salesforce hygiene end\-to\-end, empowering Sales teams with tools for a frictionless \& efficient experience.
* Support systems transformation at regional and global level.
* Run change management and self\-serve training series with managers, including relationship methodology as well as 1:many governance cadences with the Salesforce champion community.
* Operate governance gates for rev\-group creation and maintain a clean audit trail, partnering with Finance, HR and Deal Desk.
* Support the Top Accounts process and outbound account management logic as part of the broader sales enablement agenda and contribute to the redesign of the Ops rhythm (Weekly Revenue Call, Quarterly \& Annual Planning).
* Track and report against success measures (mapping accuracy, backlog, adoption, meetings/FTE, training completion) to demonstrate ROI and free up selling time for GTM teams.
* Identify and build automation for standard workflows, processes and reporting, in partnership with engineering where needed.


**Who You Are**
* 8\-10 years in Sales Ops, Revenue Ops, Systems/Salesforce administration or Strategy, ideally in ad tech, SaaS or digital media.
* Deep, hands\-on Salesforce or CRM expertise (account/territory mapping, workflow rules, Portfolio Manager App or equivalent tooling); Tableau or Power BI experience is a strong plus.
* A track record of designing durable, self\-serve processes rather than one\-off fixes — you build the reusable rule, not just the one\-time exception.
* Comfortable running change management directly with frontline managers: training, governance cadences, and building trust that the new system works.
* Detail\-obsessed and data\-driven, with the judgement to know when a process needs to flex versus when to hold the governance line.
* A collaborative operator who partners naturally across Finance, HR, Deal Desk, Sales and Engineering to get things done.


**Why this role, why now**
 At TTD, values like Vision, Grit, Agility, Generosity, Openness, and Full\-Heartedness show up in how we work with one another every day. We're building a team that reflects the diversity of the markets we serve, and we warmly welcome people from all backgrounds who are excited to help shape what comes next.
   

  

 As an Equal Opportunity Employer, The Trade Desk is committed to creating an inclusive hiring experience where everyone has the opportunity to thrive.
   

  

 Please reach out to us at accommodations@ thetradedesk. com to request an accommodation or discuss any accessibility needs you may require to access our Company Website or navigate any part of the hiring process.
   

  

 When you contact us, please include your preferred contact details and specify the nature of your accommodation request or questions. Any information you share will be handled confidentially and will not impact our hiring decisions.

title: AVP,  Data Architect (L11)
description:
**Role Title: AVP, Data Architect (L11\)**
**Company Overview:** 
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 Synchrony's Engineering Team is a dynamic and innovative team dedicated to driving technological excellence. As a member of this Team, you'll play a pivotal role in designing and developing cutting\-edge tech stack and solutions that redefine industry standards.
   

  

 The Credit Card that we use every day to purchase our essentials and later settle the bills \- A simple process that we all are used to on a day to day basis. Now, consider the vast complexity hidden behind this seemingly simple process, operating tirelessly for millions of cardholders. The sheer volume of data processed is mind\-boggling. Fortunately, advanced technology stands ready to automate and manage this constant torrent of information, ensuring smooth transactions around the clock, 365 days a year.
   

  

 Our collaborative environment encourages creative problem\-solving and fosters career growth. Join us to work on diverse projects, from fintech to data analytics, and contribute to shaping the future of technology. If you're passionate about engineering and innovation.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 The AVP, Data Architect owns how data is sourced, modeled, governed, and delivered for analytic workloads, reporting/dashboarding and agentic AI solutions. The Data Architect will need to develop intimate knowledge of SYF key data domains (originations, loan activity, collection, etc.) and maintain a holistic view across SYF functions to design performant, resilient and cost\-effective data solutions.
   

  

 This role requires strong hands\-on experience for preparing data for AI data pipelines so agents can reliably access high\-quality, compliant information. The role partners closely with the data engineering team, AI Platform team, the data governance team, data science/analytics teams, and business stakeholder teams to define data architecture, standards, and operating models that enable scalable, secure, and cost\-effective analytics and AI workloads. This leader combines deep data architecture skills, strong understanding of different data model methodology, ETL pipelines, AI/LLM/RAG patterns.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Define logical, physical data model structure, integrate, govern, and store data in the enterprise repositories for supporting analytics/data science workloads, reporting/dashboarding and agentic AI workloads.
* Execute POCs and prototypes in sandbox and lab environments to propose solutions for AWS cloud workloads and AI solutions using data on AWS.
* Document data flow diagrams. Ensure discipline in the creation of Logical Data Models and their later implementation as Physical Data Structures.
* Define the target\-state Data \& AI Foundations architecture supporting agentic AI use cases, enterprise knowledge graph or metadata layer, data products, and AI\-ready datasets.
* Assist in developing the strategy and roadmap for making key enterprise data sources "AI\-ready": curation, quality, metadata, access patterns, latency requirements, and retention.
* Partner with source system owners (core servicing, CRM, collections, risk, fraud, etc.) to define data contracts, SLAs, and integration patterns that support downstream analytics.
* Establish data preparation and curation pipelines for model fine\-tuning, including dataset selection, labeling strategies, quality validation, versioning, and compliance with model risk policies.
* Define and enforce data governance policies for AI: data classification, lineage, access controls, PII handling, retention, and usage logging for AI workloads.
* Partner with AI Governance/Model Risk and InfoSec/AppSec to ensure data usage in prompts, context, and tools adheres to policies, including regulatory, privacy, and model risk requirements.
* Establish data quality and observability practices for AI data: data SLAs, freshness, completeness, drift detection, and business rule validation tied to AI outcomes.
* Drive adoption of metadata and catalog tools so platform and agent teams can discover, understand, and safely consume datasets.
* Define and oversee patterns for integrating external data (third\-party, public, partner data) into AI workflows, including licensing checks, quality assessment, and monitoring.
* Perform other duties and/or special projects as assigned.


**Qualifications/Requirements**
* Minimum 6\+ years of experience across data engineering, data architecture, or analytics platforms, with at least 3\+ years in cloud data platforms and enterprise data leadership roles.
* Strong experience with modern cloud data stacks (e.g., data warehouses like Redshift/Snowflake/BigQuery, relational databases like PostgreSQL, and object storage) and their use in analytics and AI.
* Demonstrated expertise in enabling data readiness for agentic AI from existing data stores in front\-end (OLTP) applications or analytical (OLAP) applications like data lake and warehouses. Strong hands\-on experience on designing data models (star schema, 3NF) for raw, standardized and curated data products for optimal performance and scalability of data applications for AI.
* Strong hands\-on experience in generating semantic layers for the data products that serve multiple consuming applications on AWS.
* Proven experience building data pipelines for AI/ML use cases including ETL/ELT workflows, streaming data integration, and data preparation for model training and fine\-tuning.
* Strong experience with Lakehouse architecture using S3, Apache Iceberg, Glue Data Catalog, Redshift
* Strong Python skills for building data processing, evaluation, and automation pipelines, plus familiarity with DevOps practices (CI/CD, infrastructure as code, environment management).
* Good understanding of identity and data security architecture \- IAM, IAM Identity Center, cross account data access patterns, identity propagation for AI agents and services
* Good understanding of AWS infrastructure concepts (networking, security, storage, compute) and how they apply to data and AI workloads.
* Experience working with ETL/ELT pipelines, streaming data, and integration technologies (e.g., CDC, APIs, event buses) for both batch and real\-time use cases.
* Proven ability to lead multi\-disciplinary teams and influence across platform, AI, data, and business stakeholders.


**Desired Skills/ Knowledge**
* Experience implementing or leveraging knowledge graphs, entity resolution, or semantic search to power AI and RAG use cases.
* Solid understanding of LLM and agentic AI patterns (prompts, tools, RAG, memory) and how data quality and structure impact AI behavior and performance.
* Background in building data products specifically targeted for AI/ML (feature stores, labeled datasets, evaluation datasets, fine\-tuning corpora).
* Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF) as they apply to data and AI.
* Prior experience in financial services, credit, payments, or similar domains where data lineage, explainability, and audit trails are critical.
* Basic AWS solution architecture knowledge including core services, AWS S3, Redshift, Amazon Bedrock, and Bedrock AgentCore so they can collaborate effectively with platform and agent teams.
* Good understanding of enterprise data governance and access controls like AWS Lake Formation, Glue Data catalog and metadata management frameworks.
* Team player, strong engagement, positive attitude and natural curiosity are highly desired.


**Eligibility Criteria**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 6\+ years of experience across data engineering, data architecture, or analytics platforms, with at least 3\+ years in cloud data platforms and enterprise data leadership roles.
* Strong familiarity with streaming through Kafka and other Data Lake technologies and techniques.
* Strong familiarity with data governance, data lineage, data processes, DML, and data architecture control execution
* Strong experience with business analysis \- Requirements analysis and conversion to data models.
* Must be able to develop creative solutions to problems.


**Work Timings: 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST**
 This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.

title: Demand Generation Manager
description:
Working at Infobip means being part of something truly global. With 75\+ offices across six continents, we’re not just building technology — we’re shaping how more than 80% of the world connects and communicates.
   

  

 As employees, we take pride in contributing to the world’s largest and only full\-stack cloud communication platform. But it’s not just what we do, it’s how we do it: with curiosity, passion, and a whole lot of collaboration.
   

  

 We operate with an AI\-first mindset, embedding intelligent tools into our daily workflows to work smarter and more efficiently. Every role here benefits from and contributes to this approach.
   

  

 If you're looking for meaningful work and challenges that grow you in a culture where people show up with purpose, this is your opportunity.
   

  

 Let’s build what’s next, together.
   

  

 We are looking for a data\-driven, strategic, and hands\-on
 **Demand Generation Manager** 
 to lead our customer acquisition, pipeline generation, and account\-based marketing (ABM) strategies. In this role, you will own multi\-channel campaigns designed to create, capture, and convert qualified pipeline for our sales teams.
   

  

 You will bridge the gap between marketing execution and sales velocity, partnering directly with Revenue Operations, Account Executives, and SDR leads to accelerate funnel conversion and maximize lifetime target account value.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Campaign Strategy \& Execution: Design, build, and optimize multi\-channel inbound and outbound marketing campaigns across LinkedIn Ads, Google Search, content syndication, webinars, and automated email sequences.
* Account\-Based Marketing (ABM): Partner closely with sales leads to execute tailored ABM strategies targeting our Target Account List (TAL) to increase enterprise deal velocity and win rates.
* Sales \& SDR Alignment: Build tight hand\-off processes and SLAs with the sales team to ensure rapid lead follow\-up, high conversion rates, and continuous feedback loops on lead quality.
* Funnel Analytics \& Attribution: Track, analyze, and present performance metrics across every stage of the funnel (MQLs, SQLs, CAC, ROAS, sales pipeline generated, and closed\-won revenue).
* MarTech \& Automation: Manage and optimize our core marketing stack (CRM, Marketing Automation, ABM tools) for precise audience segmentation, automated nurture tracks, and lead scoring.
* Experimentation \& Optimization: Continuously test ad creative, landing pages, copy, and audience targeting to lower customer acquisition costs (CAC) while scaling pipeline volume.


**What We're Looking For**
* Experience: 8\-10 years of hands\-on demand generation or growth marketing experience in a B2B SaaS environment.
* Channel Mastery: Proven track record managing significant monthly paid acquisition budgets ($30k\+/month) with verifiable pipeline contribution.
* Tech Stack Proficiency: Strong operational experience with Salesforce/HubSpot, Marketo, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads/GA4, and ABM/sourcing tools (e.g., Demandbase, 6sense, Apollo).
* Sales\-Minded Alignment: Strong empathy for sales workflows with a clear understanding of enterprise sales cycles, deal stages, and ACV dynamics.
* Data\-Driven: Ability to extract actionable insights from raw performance data and communicate key metrics clearly to executive leadership.


**Why you'll love it here**

* Flexible work arrangements \- We combine in\-person collaboration with remote work and flexible working hours, because great ideas happen everywhere \- and not always between 9 and 5\.
* ESOP (Employee Stock Ownership Plan) \- As an Infobip employee, you’ll have the opportunity to share in our company’s success through stock options.
* Work\-life balance and Well\-being  \- We offer time off when you need it, special leave days for life’s big moments, and a flexible hybrid work model tailored to local regulations.
* Career mobility \- Your career is a journey. With internal mobility, upskilling, and mentorship, we help you shape your path.
* Professional development \- Learning never stops. Onboarding, mentorship, and training programs help you grow \- no matter where you start.
* International mobility \- Ready to take your career global? Explore short and long\-term opportunities in our Hubs worldwide.  While some benefits may vary by location, our goal remains the same: to support your growth, well\-being, and success \- wherever you are.  Diversity drives connection


**Infobip is built on diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and talents.** 
 We’re proud to be an equal\-opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace.
   

  

 No matter your race, gender, age, background, or identity — if you have the passion and skills to thrive, there’s a place for you here.

**Organizational Context**
**Key Aspects:**
* Part of the Aditya Birla Financial Service Group (ABFSG), Aditya Birla Housing Finance Limited (ABHFL) is registered with the National Housing Bank as a housing finance company under the National Housing Bank Act, 1987\. The company offers a complete range of housing finance solutions such as home loans, home improvement and home construction loans, balance transfer and top\-up loans, loans against property and construction finance. The company acquired its license on 9 th July 2014 and has aggressive growth plans
* ABHFL operates in the Rs. 11\.4 trillion Indian Housing Finance market, which has grown at a steady rate of 17% CAGR over the last 3 years while reporting good asset quality despite challenges in the operating environment. While the industry is dominated by five large groups, there has been an emergence of newer entrants in niche segments like affordable housing and self\-employed borrowers, given the high potential in these segments. Despite increased focus by banks, HFCs have been able to maintain their share in the mortgage market and has remained stable at \~37% as on December 2015
* The nature of the HFC business (dealing largely with retail customers in the potentially sensitive area of housing/ mortgages), along with the additional regulatory and control mechanisms imposed as a result, means it is imperative that all functions and processes align and comply with sound risk management guidelines and applicable regulations/ controls proactively and judiciously. This is vital for managing risk and protecting interests of both the business as well as the customer


**Job Context**
**Key Aspects:**
* The Risk team provides core underwriting services fundamental to the ABHFL business health, risk management and sustainability. Structured as a dual to the Sales/ Sourcing team, with positions mapped against corresponding Sales roles across the organization, the Risk team is responsible for necessary controls and process checks to ensure business performance and health
* While the core responsibility for this function is to control the business via robust underwriting and risk management, supporting business expansion via joint evaluation of different product/ market growth proposals with the Sales team is also an important contribution
* The Credit Manager plays the role of executing risk and credit operations in line with established guidelines and norms, and securing the organization against diverse risks in local business operations via process measures and checks. This role is responsible for ensuring robust and efficient creditworthiness and risk assessment. He/ She is the “ears on the ground” member of the Risk Team who meets every customer as part of the underwriting process and also visits the property which is being funded. Therefore, he/she needs to have an understanding of the Legal and Valuation framework to be able to perform their role satisfactorily


**Key Challenges**
* While the ABFL Mortgages team also works with retail customers in the property space, the ABHFL business is exposed to the additional Construction Risk, i.e. risk from under construction projects not getting completed as planned. The Risk Team must factor for this when designing and implementing control mechanisms, and evaluating business proposals
* ABHFL is in its inception phase as a company and in the midst of rapid growth. The Risk function must therefore be able to balance priorities of risk management and business growth efficiently, without increasing sub\-prime exposures or impacting business health and sustainability
* The housing space is characterized by state\-wise norms and business practices, as well as varied interpretations of regulatory guidelines by different stakeholders. It is therefore essential for Risk function team members to remain up to date on business practices/ norms in their respective states/ locations and work within regulatory guidelines in a manner that minimizes business risk and also supports growth objectives


****Enabling Skill Sets \& Qualifications****
* Critical skill sets required to meet these challenges include business and commercial acumen, analytical skills, interpersonal and presentation skills, and execution capabilities
* Education \& experience required to fulfil this profile are a CA/ MBA – Finance with minimum 0 – 3 yrs of experience in a bank/ NBFC/ HFC

title: CoE & Control Tower Lead — Logistics & Distribution
description:
About the Role:
 



 The CoE \& Control Tower Lead is the single accountable owner for systems adoption and operational visibility across the Logistics \& Distribution network.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 A. Systems adoption \& network design
 


* Drive end\-to\-end adoption of TMS across all distribution centers and the store network — from go\-live to full usage and reporting.
* Convert manual, DC\-by\-DC processes into system\-run processes, each with a measured before\-and\-after baseline.
* Own network design and periodic network review, with a planned, data\-led approach.
* Collaborate with IT and the SC Transformation Lead on the build, and assume ownership of field adoption, whereby IT delivers the build and this role secures usage.



 B. Control tower, MIS \& reporting
 


* Operate the control tower as the consolidated, authoritative source of operational KPIs across all DCs and lanes.
* Replace fragmented DC\-by\-DC reporting with one consolidated dashboard and MIS suite, published weekly.
* Own operational data quality and one\-version reporting on OTIF, order fill rate, dispatch accuracy, inventory health and cost.



 C. Early warning \& exception management
 


* Identify potential SLA breaches, stock\-out risk and service failures in advance — ideally seven days ahead — rather than after the resulting sales loss has occurred.
* Define escalation paths and drive closure of flagged exceptions with the DC Managers and Supply Planning.
* Replace manual indent follow\-up with system\-driven exception management.



 D. Service, inventory \& damage standards
 


* Set dispatch\-accuracy and perfect\-order standards for the network (in full, damage\-free, documentation right).
* Track inventory accuracy, ageing and perfect\-order fulfilment at line level across all DCs.
* Own damage and shrinkage norms and build recovery into the 3PL contract.



 E. Analytics \& decision support
 


* Provide the underlying data set — freight cost per case, cost versus MRE, vehicle fill and capacity utilization — on which the Capacity \& Sourcing and Cost Control leads base their decisions.
* Support network changes, carrier selection, lane\-rate and capex decisions with control\-tower analytics.
* Track and report the operational benefits delivered through systems adoption.



 F. Automation, AI \& continuous improvement
 


* Apply design\-thinking to examine every manual process through an automation and scale lens, uncovering opportunities to remove effort, error and cost.
* Use AI tools to ideate, create and implement automated workflows across planning, warehousing and distribution.
* Build and priorities a pipeline of automation opportunities and convert them into system\-run processes with measured before\-and\-after impact.



 G. Contingency \& festive readiness
 


* Build and maintain contingency plans for the distribution network — covering DC outages, transporter failures, and vehicle and labor shortages — to safeguard operational continuity.
* Own festive and peak\-season readiness across all DCs and lanes, including capacity ramp\-up, buffer\-stock positioning and surge\-lane planning ahead of demand spikes.
* Define fallback routing and alternate\-3PL arrangements, and run periodic business\-continuity drills, so that service levels are maintained during disruption.
* Coordinate escalation and recovery with DC Managers, Supply Planning and 3PL partners during peak and contingency events.



 Key Relationships
 



 Internal
 


* Head of Logistics \& Distribution (reporting manager); DC Managers; Capacity \& Sourcing Lead; Cost Control \& Budgeting (SC Finance).
* Supply Planning (inventory norms), National S\&OP, SC Transformation Lead and IT (systems build and adoption).



 External
 


* 3PL partners operating the distribution centers; TMS and WMS solution vendors; transporters.



 Qualifications \& Experience
 


* Graduate in Engineering, Supply Chain or Operations; MBA in Supply Chain, Operations or Analytics preferred.
* 3–7 years in supply chain or logistics, with strong exposure to WMS / TMS implementation and control\-tower or analytics roles.
* Proven record of driving systems adoption across a multi\-site distribution network; QSR, FMCG or retail\-distribution experience preferred.
* Hands\-on with SAP (VC / MM), TMS, WMS and BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI.



 Skills \& Competencies
 


* Systems implementation with strong change\- and adoption\-management capability.
* Data analytics, dashboarding and MIS design, including the capability to establish a single, consistent version of reporting.
* Process re\-engineering — converting manual processes to system\-run, with baseline discipline.
* Stakeholder management across IT, Operations, Finance and 3PL partners.
* Control\-tower and exception\-management orientation, with an emphasis on early warning.
* Single\-point ownership and maker\-checker discipline across the function.
* Hands\-on use of AI tools to ideate, create and implement automated workflows.
* Design\-thinking mindset — views every manual process from an automation and scale perspective to uncover opportunities.

The CFO Change team is responsible for overall program/project management, business analysis and requirements, functional design, testing, organization readiness and deployment activities.
