title: Manager- Digital
description:
**About Urban Company :** 




  





 Urban Company is a technology platform offering customers a variety of services at home. Customers use our platform to book services such as beauty treatments, haircuts, massage therapy, cleaning, plumbing, carpentry, appliance repair, painting etc., all delivered in the comfort of their home and at a time of their choosing. We promise our customers a high\-quality, standardized and reliable service experience. To fulfill this promise, we work closely with our hand\-picked service partners, enabling them with technology, training, products, tools, financing, insurance, and brand, helping them succeed and deliver on this promise.
 



  





 Urban Company started out as UrbanClap in Nov 2014, when its founders, Abhiraj, Raghav and Varun realized that the home services industry was predominantly unorganized, fragmented and offline. Customers found it difficult to avail quality services in a convenient manner, and service professionals were struggling to make ends meet, having to rely upon several middlemen, contractors, and local aggregators. The founders felt that the industry was ripe for disruption, and launched Urban Company, with three key principles in mind \-
 


* Customer love: Build a platform that offers truly delightful and differentiated services
* Partner empowerment: Build a deep, full\-stack partnership with service partners, helping improve their earnings and overall livelihood
* Technology first: Bring innovation and technology to an age\-old industry.



  





**About the job :** 




  





 Urban Company is India's largest tech\-enabled home services marketplace — operating at scale across cleaning, beauty, wellness, and home maintenance. We're looking for a performance marketer who lives in the bottom of the funnel: someone obsessed with converting high\-intent users into first\-time customers, squeezing CAC, and scaling what works. This role owns UC's paid acquisition engine across Search and Social — the channels that drive real installs and first bookings.
 



  





**What you'll own** 



* **Paid Social (Meta):** 
 Run performance\-first Meta campaigns — conversion campaigns, app install campaigns, and dynamic product ads — optimising for CPO and install\-to\-booking rate, not just clicks.
* **UAC / App campaigns:** 
 Manage Google UAC and Meta App Campaigns to drive new installs from high\-intent audiences; optimise in\-app event bidding toward first booking as the conversion goal.
* **Paid Search (SEM):** 
 Own Google Search and PMax campaigns end\-to\-end — keyword strategy, match types, bid management, Quality Score optimisation, and ad copy testing — with a relentless focus on driving high\-intent traffic that converts to first bookings.
* **CAC \& efficiency management:** 
 Set and manage CAC targets by channel and category; build spend pacing models to maximise new user volume within efficiency guardrails.
* **Audience \& targeting:** 
 Build high\-intent audience segments using keyword intent signals, platform behavioural data, and first\-party CRM lists; run retargeting flows to recapture drop\-offs in the install\-to\-booking funnel.
* **Landing page \& conversion optimisation:** 
 Partner with product to identify and fix conversion bottlenecks between ad click → app install → first booking; brief and test landing page variants to improve post\-click CVR.
* **Attribution \& MMP management:** 
 Own AppsFlyer/Adjust setup — campaign tagging, event mapping, cohort reporting, and fraud monitoring — to ensure clean, accurate new user attribution across channels.
* **Creative for performance:** 
 Brief and iterate on direct\-response creatives (static, carousel, search copy); run structured A/B tests on offers, CTAs, and formats; kill what doesn't convert fast.
* **Reporting \& forecasting:** 
 Maintain weekly performance dashboards (CPO, ROAS, install\-to\-booking rate, CAC by channel); build forward\-looking acquisition forecasts tied to spend scenarios.



  





**What we're looking for** 



* 3–5 years of hands\-on performance marketing experience at a consumer internet company, D2C brand, or digital agency — with a clear track record of driving new user/customer acquisition through paid Search and Social.
* Deep hands\-on expertise in Google Ads (UAC, Search, PMax) and Meta Ads Manager (conversion campaigns, app installs, dynamic ads).
* Strong command of bottom\-funnel metrics: CAC, CPO, CPI, ROAS, install\-to\-booking rate, first\-order conversion rate, and payback period.
* Experience managing MMP platforms (AppsFlyer or Adjust) — event setup, attribution windows, cohort analysis, and fraud detection.
* Analytically strong: able to build CAC forecasts and channel mix models in Excel/Google Sheets; SQL is a strong plus.
* Bias for action: comfortable making fast, data\-backed decisions on bids, budgets, and creative — without waiting for perfect information.
* Graduation from a Tier 1/2 institute.



  





**Why join Urban Company** 




 This is a high\-ownership role at the sharp end of UC's growth. You'll have real budget, real data, and real accountability for new user numbers — with the cross\-functional support to move fast. If you're a performance marketer who wants to own outcomes rather than manage reports, this is your seat.
 



*Urban Company is committed to equal and fair opportunities in employment and an inclusive, harassment\-free work environment for all.*

 As part of McCain’s digital transformation, we are investing significantly in our data platforms, governance practices, and enterprise information management capabilities. We are seeking an experienced

 This role serves as the enterprise subject matter expert for data retention, archiving, and disposal across McCain’s global technology landscape, with a particular focus on
 **SAP S/4HANA**

**What You’ll Be Doing.**
* Own and evolve McCain’s global data archiving and retention strategy, policies, standards, and operating procedures.

* Collaborate with data platform teams to apply data classifications, retention tags, and access controls using Unity Catalog.
* Design storage tiering and archival strategies that transition inactive data to cost\-effective storage while maintaining recoverability and compliance.
* Serve as the primary escalation point and subject matter expert for enterprise data archiving and retention matters.
* Partner with Legal, Privacy, Compliance, and business stakeholders to translate regulatory requirements into practical governance controls.
* Identify opportunities to reduce unnecessary data accumulation, associated costs, and regulatory risks.
* Maintain data archiving and retention risk registers and communicate priorities, risks, and roadmap updates to senior stakeholders.
* Represent the archiving and retention function in governance forums, steering committees, and cross\-functional initiatives.


**What You’ll Need To Be Successful.**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
* 7\+ years of experience in data management, data governance, enterprise data architecture, or a related discipline with a strong focus on data retention and archiving.
* Deep hands\-on expertise with SAP Information Lifecycle Management (ILM), SAP archiving objects (SARA), residence rules, and destruction rules within large\-scale S/4HANA environments.
* Experience working with SAP RISE with S/4HANA or comparable SAP cloud\-managed service environments.
* Understanding of shared responsibility models associated with SAP cloud services and ILM operations.
* Knowledge of Databricks technologies including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, VACUUM operations, and data lifecycle management concepts.
* Experience developing and operationalizing enterprise\-wide data retention policies across multiple business domains and jurisdictions.
* Knowledge of storage tiering strategies and archival storage solutions.
* Strong understanding of global regulatory and compliance requirements, including GDPR, CCPA, PIPEDA, SOX, tax retention requirements, and related regulations.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills across technical, legal, compliance, and business audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex regulatory requirements into practical governance controls and technical implementations.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Advanced degree in a relevant discipline.
* SAP ILM, data governance, privacy, or information management certifications.
* Certifications such as CDMP, CIPM, SAP certifications, or equivalent.
* Experience within food manufacturing, consumer packaged goods (CPG), or related industries.

title: Insights Analyst
description:
**Insights Analyst** 




**A US\-headquartered product company scaling its India insights team** 




**Location:** 
 Delhi, India — hybrid
 



**The Gap This Role Closes** 




 A US\-headquartered product company is scaling its India insights team and has partnered with Flexiple to hire an analyst who can do more than produce reports — someone who reads a pile of usage data, survey responses, and market research and comes back with an actual point of view on what the business should do next. Flexiple is a managed marketplace that helps global companies build high\-performing teams and GCCs in India.
 



 The company already has data. What it is short of is someone willing to commit to a recommendation instead of handing back a chart and letting the room decide.
 



**What You'll Own** 



* Pull together product usage data, customer research, and competitive signals into a single, coherent view of what is happening and why

**How You'll Operate** 



* Partner with product, marketing, and strategy teams to understand what decision an analysis needs to unblock before you start it
* Build repeatable frameworks for the questions that come up quarter after quarter, instead of starting from zero each time
* Flag when the data does not support a clean answer, rather than forcing one



**What You Bring** 




 2 to 6 years in research, analytics, insights, or strategy, with a track record of turning data into a recommendation someone acted on — not just a deck someone read. Strong analytical instincts, comfort with ambiguity, and the writing skill to make a complex finding land in three sentences. Working knowledge of SQL, Excel or Sheets, and at least one BI tool.
 



**Nice to Have** 



* Experience at a product or SaaS company specifically, rather than pure market\-research or academic research
* Exposure to Python or R for deeper analysis
* A background in consulting, strategy, or a similarly recommendation\-driven role



**What You'll Gain** 



* A seat where your output is a decision, not a dashboard nobody reopens
* Remote\-friendly, pan\-India hiring with long\-term placement
* Direct visibility into how product and leadership actually use research



**How We Hire** 




 HR Screening → Case Study Assignment → Team Round → Culture Fit
 



 One application is considered for this role and any future matched openings, so there is no need to apply twice.

title: Lead - Advanced Analytics, Gurgaon
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
   

  

 Airbnb was born in 2007 when two Hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 4 million Hosts who have welcomed more than 1 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, Hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
   

  

 The Analytics Centre of Excellence (ACOE) at Airbnb, based in India, is a hub of knowledge and expertise that aims to provide data\-driven decision\-making, enabling Airbnb's business goals. The ACOE's vision is to build a world\-class analytics organization that provides scalable, AI\-enabled analytics. We work with various business functions such as payments, trust, digital, customer support, hosting, sales, social, compliance, risk, platforms and partnerships \& economics.
   

  

 The ACOE's delivery framework is designed to provide relevant and contextual insights for data\-driven decisions. This includes a one\-stop solution for metrics, dashboards driving actionable insights, optimization of performance, measuring pre/post feature impact, sizing the ROI of opportunities, prioritization of opportunities, anomaly\-driven alerting mechanisms, root cause analysis of metric deviation, and exploratory hypothesis testing.
   

  

**The Community You Will Join**
 We are looking for a Lead Advanced Analyst in our India Analytics team who works with the Community Support business. The analyst must have deep functional expertise in building and scaling analytical solutions and serve as a strategic thought partner to product teams and business leaders across marketplace teams driving insights, recommendations, and data\-informed decisions at scale. This role will sit under the Advanced Analytics family and support Business leaders within our Strategic Planning \& Operations organization.
   

  

**The Difference You Will Make**
* Serve as the primary data thought partner to product and business leaders across Community Support, providing strategic insights, recommendations, and enabling data\-informed decisions at an organizational level.
* Drive day\-to\-day product analytics and create scalable, reusable data tools and frameworks that elevate the entire team's analytical capability.
* Build and scale advanced analytical capabilities; leverage Airbnb's state\-of\-the\-art machine learning infrastructure and central data science tools to collaborate with engineers, product managers, designers, and operations agents to achieve shared, cross\-functional goals.
* Champion AI\-first analytics practices across the team identifying high\-impact opportunities to integrate LLM\-based tools, AutoML, and advanced AI capabilities into analytical workflows.
* Demonstrate a strong sense of urgency and commitment to Airbnb's mission of belonging.
* Develop a deep understanding of how guests and hosts interact with our Community Support platform and how we can manage risk while meeting regulatory compliance requirements through structured and unstructured data sources.
* Mentor and guide junior analysts, fostering a culture of analytical rigor, curiosity, and continuous skill development.


**A Typical Day**
* Drive the product analytics roadmap, prioritization, and delivery of solutions in the Strategic Planning \& Operations space, operating with minimal direction and planning up to 6 months ahead.
* Lead projects end\-to\-end: building timelines, defining key milestones, providing regular updates to product managers and analytics leadership, and delivering against agreed timelines.
* Work closely with Product Managers and Business leads to design, execute, and evaluate A/B tests; proactively identify and communicate common pitfalls and caveats of experimentation.
* Build credibility and trust with the team by building high\-quality ground truth datasets and dashboards that empower stakeholders to answer data questions quickly and independently.
* Collaborate with Product Engineering to spec out logging and with Analytics Engineering to build scalable data tools for mass consumption within Airbnb.
* Devise business metric frameworks and optimization models to support Airbnb's product, operations, and policy decisions at scale.
* Influence data\-driven decisions across global sites and business verticals via business reviews, self\-serve portals, planning scorecards, and impact analyses.
* Experiment with new Airbnb policy/product features to help deter and mitigate risk; translate findings into actionable recommendations for leadership.
* Lead and influence machine learning model development in partnership with DS/Engineering teams to automate policy enforcement decisions, while routing the most complex cases for manual review.
* Proactively identify opportunities to apply AI\-assisted tools (e.g., LLMs, AutoML, NLP pipelines) to accelerate analytical delivery and unlock new analytical capabilities.
* Ensure the availability of data quality and integrity for analysis and reporting by blending external and internal data sources, working closely with global operations and India analytics functions.


**Your Expertise**
* 8\+ years of industry experience with an advanced degree (Master's or PhD is a plus) in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, Operations Research).
* Expert\-level SQL; complex query optimization, performance tuning, and schema design; strong understanding of ETL/ELT pipelines; working knowledge of data transformation tools.
* Programming \& Statistical Modeling: Advanced proficiency in Python (pandas, numpy, scikit\-learn, statsmodels); ability to build and deploy end\-to\-end analytical models; experience with advanced regression techniques, time\-series analysis, and causal inference.
* Experimentation \& Analytical Frameworks: Expert\-level A/B testing and multivariate testing; advanced experiment design including power analysis, switchback testing, and quasi\-experimental methods (diff\-in\-diff, regression discontinuity); digital funnel and cohort analysis.
* Machine Learning \& AI (Proficient): Proficiency in ML techniques including EDA, hypothesis testing, linear/logistic regression, SVM, ridge/lasso regression, random forest, NLP, KNN, and K\-means; hands\-on experience with LLMs (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude) and applied prompt engineering; ability to independently deploy AI tools to solve analytical problems; awareness of responsible AI, data privacy (GDPR/CCPA), and bias mitigation.
* Experience with forecasting and advanced econometric modeling is a requirement.
* Visualization \& Storytelling: Advanced proficiency in Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent BI platforms; ability to design and build executive\-level dashboards and self\-serve analytics portals; strong data storytelling and presentation skills for senior leadership audiences.
* Data Foundations: Strong working knowledge of Presto, Hive, Teradata, and Spark; experience designing scalable data models for analytical consumption.
* AI tool proficiency: Independently applies AI tools (LLMs, AutoML, NLP pipelines) to solve complex business problems.
* Designs and implements AI\-enhanced analytical workflows that can be adopted team\-wide.
* Evaluates and selects appropriate AI models for specific use cases; understands trade\-offs between model complexity, interpretability, and performance.
* Champions responsible AI principles including bias detection, model fairness, and compliance with data privacy regulations (GDPR/CCPA).
* Contributes to AI\-first culture by sharing best practices, running enablement sessions, and identifying new AI use cases.
* Proven ability to lead and influence cross\-functional teams and senior stakeholders in a cross\-cultural environment without direct authority.
* Exceptional communication skills; able to translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable narratives for both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Proven track record of delivering full\-stack data projects from inception to measurable business impact.
* Strong mentoring and coaching skills; demonstrated ability to develop junior talent.
* Positive, solution\-oriented mindset with the ability to maintain confidentiality and objectivity.
* Exceptional problem\-solving abilities, self\-motivation, and autonomy; strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple high\-priority workstreams and meet deadlines.
* Proficiency in agile project management practices and tools (e.g., Jira/Asana).


**Our Commitment To Inclusion \& Belonging**
 Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively\-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.
   

  

 Please note, this role is based in Gurugram, India and relocation is not offered at this time.
   

  

**How We'll Take Care Of You**
 Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is inclusive of allowances and is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus or incentives, one or more equity programs, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.
   

  

 India Annual Pay Range
   

  

 ₹3,080,000—₹4,400,000 INR
   

  

**Reasonable Accommodations:** 
 We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.
   

  

**A Note on Recruiting Scams:** 
 Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work\-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

title: Senior Associate-RMS Digital RM-Data Analytics
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Career Family Risk Management Services**
**Role Type Senior Associate – Data Analytics**
**Senior Associate, Digital RM – Data Analytics, Risk Management Services**
 Risk Management team at EY plays an important role in managing the internal risks of the firm associated with accepting a new client or an engagement or risks associated with any of our on\-going audit / non audit engagement. Formed in the Year 2007, the Risk Management team is growing rapidly as a Center of Excellence for all standardized quality / compliance related activities that can be efficiently undertaken from Global Delivery Services location.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 The Digital RM team at GDS is pivotal in delivering advanced analytics, business intelligence (BI), and technological enablement support across the Global RM \& \& Risk Management Services (RMS).
   

  

 Deploying advanced analytics and BI tools, complete with dynamic visualizations, to monitor risks in real\-time, streamline RM processes, and drive automation, while also ensuring robust data governance and the protection of data privacy and security.
   

  

 Tech enablement services across a range of RM tools like providing support for the Service Offering Reference Tool (SORT), contributing to global reporting, and offering administrative assistance for the Process for Acceptance of Clients and Engagements (PACE), administrative support for Global Confirmations, Global Engagement Agreement Repository (GEAR), Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) operations, and assist with reporting for Anti\-Money Laundering (AML) tools.
   

  

 This position will be ideal for a mature team player who likes to maintain daily virtual contact with a large number of people around the world. This position is designed for an experienced professional who likes to be challenged and wants to grow in a dynamic, multi\-cultural environment working with modern tools.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 The role of a Data Analyst, in the Global Risk Management function, will have the opportunity to collaborate with teams across the globe and with internal stakeholders, which may require adjusting shift timings to manage calls and tasks effectively. It will directly impact multiple KPIs within Risk Management and drive and support key initiatives. This role will analyse data to optimize existing processes and develop new solutions. Ability to find answers is limited only by one’s creativity in leveraging a vast array of techniques and tools.
   

  

 This role will work virtually with teams across geographies with some opportunities to travel for in\-person collaboration.
   

  

**Technical expertise**
* Synthesize complex information into simple, high impact messages
* Leverage data analytics tools and techniques to identify solutions that improve efficiency and enable in\-depth analysis
* Analyze and clearly present data and other information to identify significant trends or key issues
* Build relevant data insights that drive understanding of results, risk, and influence key business strategies and decisions
* Promote operational excellence by challenging current practices and providing feedback on opportunities to improve within own area of responsibility
* Gather and share data with stakeholders
* Develop analytical deliverables that play an integral role in the strategic planning process and directly support the achievement of RM priorities
* Perform systems analysis and design to define effective data relationships and integrations
* Communicate effectively the purpose of analytical processes and solutions
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand business needs and provide analytical support.
* Ability to work independently and with team members from different backgrounds.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
 A candidate that can be a part of a fast\-paced innovative culture and build enterprise insights and influence results using smarter data analytics. Work on impactful projects by converging mind and machine to leverage data and understand and navigate risk. Create deep insights through an understanding of the business, the data, and the technology used to store and analyze that data. Implement agile analytics to develop timely and interactive reporting and analytics that help the business overall. More than any skill, we are looking for a team player that strives for innovation and perfection.
   

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**
**Essentials:**
* Graduate/Postgraduate with at least 3 to 5 years of experience in a global corporate setting.
* One (1\) to two (2\) years minimum of experience in data analytics, data visualizations, data scripting languages:
* Experience with SQL and Python
* MS Fabric (Data Factory, Power BI with CoPilot, Data Activator, and OneLake) and database integrations
* Expert\-level English communication skills (reading and writing) with the ability to summarize complex concepts into clear, concise language appropriate for senior stakeholders without the requirement of a further review by seniors
* Ability to perform well under pressure and take critical feedback positively, with an aim to improve
* Excellent knowledge of MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, Power Point, SharePoint)
* Ability to work with senior executives of a global brand company in a polished, professional manner with minimum guidance to identify and implement appropriate solutions


**Preferred:**
* Experience with XML, R and SAS
* Data Security knowledge
* Process mining experience
* Creative visualization skill to interpret data in an innovative way
* Ability to drive home the why behind within each data story
* Passion for digitization and automation
* Curiosity and willingness to try new things
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment, and never settle for the status quo


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
 Credible experience working in a fast\-moving, client\-driven environment
   

  

**Technologies and Tools**
 Refer the ‘Essentials’ section above
   

  

**What You Can Look For**
 A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
   

  

 A team which has its foundation in the core values of trust, respect and teaming. The team which focuses on supporting its colleagues to excel in their respective domains and provides avenues to help acquire and demonstrate new skills.
   

  

 Opportunities to work with Global Executive risk management teams on strengthening and monitoring compliance framework
   

  

**What We Offer**

title: Associate Analyst - Customer Insights & Analytics IKC

title: Performance marketeer
description:
**About The Crafture** 




 The Crafture is a Gurugram\-based bespoke furniture studio creating handcrafted, made\-to\-order furniture for homes, hospitality spaces and design\-led businesses. With our own manufacturing setup, we work across solid wood, cane and upholstery to deliver distinctive, durable pieces and complete\-home furniture solutions.
 



**The Role** 




 We are looking for a hands\-on Performance Marketer who can plan, execute and scale paid campaigns across Meta and Google. You will own the complete performance funnel \- from audience strategy and creative testing to tracking, optimisation and lead quality. The role is ideal for someone who is analytical, commercially aware and comfortable working closely with founders, sales and creative teams.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




 Plan, launch and optimise lead\-generation and conversion campaigns across Meta Ads and Google Ads.
 



 Own campaign structure, audience segmentation, keyword strategy, bidding, budgets and daily performance optimisation.
 



 Drive qualified enquiries for full\-home furniture, bespoke furniture, hospitality projects and B2B partnerships across priority cities.
 



 Track and improve core metrics including spend, CTR, CPC, conversion rate, CPL, CAC, ROAS and lead\-to\-sale conversion.
 



 Build a disciplined testing calendar for creative formats, hooks, copy, audiences, offers and landing pages.
 



 Translate campaign data into clear creative briefs and work with the design/content team to produce higher\-performing ads.
 



 Set up and maintain accurate tracking through GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel/CAPI, UTMs and relevant conversion events.
 



 Connect marketing performance with lead quality and sales outcomes using Zoho CRM, WhatsApp and website enquiry data.
 



 Prepare concise weekly reports with insights, learnings, budget recommendations and next actions \- not just metric dumps.
 



 Monitor competitors, platform changes and emerging opportunities without chasing trends that do not support business outcomes.
 



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




 2\-4 years of hands\-on performance marketing experience, preferably with a D2C, e\-commerce, interiors, real\-estate, luxury or premium consumer brand.
 



 Strong working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads, including Search, Display, Performance Max and remarketing.
 



 Demonstrated ability to manage budgets independently and improve ROAS, CAC or CPL through structured optimisation.
 



 Practical understanding of conversion tracking, attribution, GA4, GTM and performance dashboards.
 



 Comfort with numbers, experimentation and making decisions from imperfect data.
 



 Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate with founders, salespeople, designers and content creators.
 



 A portfolio or case studies showing actual campaign budgets, approach and results.
 



  





**Success in This Role Will Be Measured By** 




 Growth in qualified leads and revenue influenced by paid campaigns.
 



 Improvement in CPL, CAC, ROAS and lead\-to\-sale conversion.
 



 Lead quality across retail, complete\-home, hospitality and B2B enquiries.
 



 Speed and quality of testing, learning and budget reallocation.
 



 Accuracy and usefulness of tracking, reporting and actionable insights.
 



  





**Why Join Us** 




 Work directly with the founders and influence growth strategy, not only campaign execution.
 



 Build performance marketing for a design\-led brand with its own manufacturing capability and strong visual content.
 



 Take ownership across the full funnel and see a direct connection between campaigns, leads and sales.
 



  





**How to Apply** 




 Apply with your CV and 2\-3 campaign case studies. Please include the objective, media budget, platforms used, your specific contribution, key results, current and expected CTC, notice period and present location.
 



**Please apply only if you are comfortable working full\-time from our Gurugram office.**

title: Senior Business Solution Owner
description:

 McCormick employees – all 14,000 of us across the world – are what makes this company a great place to work.
   

  

 We are looking to hire an Senior Business Solution Ownerimmediately in a Hybrid (50/50\) capacity at our Gurgaon office.
   

  

**What We Bring To The Table**
 The best people deserve the best rewards. In addition to the benefits you’d expect from a global leader (401k, health insurance, paid time off, etc.) we also offer:
   

  

* Competitive compensation
* Career growth opportunities
* Flexibility and Support for Diverse Life Stages and Choices


**Profile Overview**
 The key purpose of a Sr Business Solution Owner is to support the development and management of our most complex data\-related solutions to deliver value in line with the business’s strategy. This role will support the implementation of product vision and strategy, prioritization of enhancements, and communication of changes.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**

Provide clarity to a well\-defined and inspiring solution that aligns the team and stakeholders with the overall business goals. Support the refinements and plannings of product features in line with business goals.

description:
Wood Mackenzie is the global leader in analytics, insights and proprietary data across the entire energy and natural resources landscape.
   

  

 For over 50 years our work has guided the decisions of the world’s most influential energy producers, utilities companies, financial institutions and governments.
   

  

 Now, with the world’s energy system more complex and interconnected than ever before, sector\-specific views are no longer enough. That’s why we’ve redefined what’s possible with Intelligence Connected.
   

  

 By fusing our unparalleled proprietary data with the sharpest analytical minds, all supercharged by Synoptic AI, we deliver a clear, interconnected view of the entire value chain. Our trusted team of 2,700 experts across 30 countries breaks siloes and connects industries, markets and regions across the globe.
   

  

 This empowers our customers to identify risk sooner, spot opportunities faster and recalibrate strategy with confidence – whether planning days, weeks, months or decades ahead.
   

  

 Wood Mackenzie
   

  

 Intelligence Connected
   

  

**WoodMac.com**
**Wood Mackenzie Brand Video**
**Wood Mackenzie Values**
* Inclusive – we succeed together
* Trusting – we choose to trust each other
* Customer committed – we put customers at the heart of our decisions
* Future Focused – we accelerate change
* Curious – we turn knowledge into action


 We monitor key events and conduct research to produce thought\-provoking reports, data models, and presentations. From asset valuation to corporate reports, from market supply\-demand research to price\-forecasting, and from the regional to the global, our analysis helps shape our customers’ commercial strategies.
   

  

 We also support bespoke consulting projects, diving deeper into our data to answer unique questions. We help our Sales team retain and win new business by spending time with customers and answering questions that matter to them. We work closely with colleagues in our Data and Product functions to maintain the quality of our published data and to deliver content via our
 **growing Lens platform** 
**.**
 Through carrying out primary research, responding to customer questions, and presenting to industry stakeholders, you will build relationships and a network of contacts at key operators, national bodies, and other relevant institutions. Over time you will gain specialist knowledge and develop the skills you require to progress your career at Wood Mackenzie.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
 We are looking for a Research Associate to join our Gas \& LNG research practice within the Commodities Global Analyst Team, based in Gurugram or Mumbai, India. The role will support the development of Wood Mackenzie’s views across global and regional Gas \& LNG markets, with a particular focus on APAC gas markets and global LNG asset developments.
   

  

 You will undertake detailed research and analysis across the Gas \& LNG value chain, including gas and LNG supply and demand, consumption patterns, LNG supply and regasification projects, LNG contracts and shipping, market developments, and relevant macroeconomic trends. You will track and assess industry developments, identify key market drivers and risks, and translate data and industry intelligence into clear, insightful views on current market conditions and future market possibilities.
   

  

 You will contribute to the development and maintenance of datasets, data models, methodologies and other intellectual property supporting our Gas \& LNG research and products. This will include supporting the Global Gas Model, developing scenarios for how gas and LNG markets may evolve, and creating compelling visualizations and analysis to communicate our views.
   

  

 You will contribute to regular research reports, global LNG outlooks, market insights, informs and webinars, working closely with regional analysts and subject matter experts across Gas \& LNG, upstream and other relevant teams. You will be expected to build compelling narratives from researched and available data, articulate supply and demand views, and communicate short\- and long\-term market outlooks clearly to both internal and external audiences.
   

  

 The role will also involve supporting client engagement by responding to client enquiries and ad hoc requests, participating in client discussions and presentations, and helping communicate Wood Mackenzie’s views and insights to customers and prospects. Through research trips, industry events and client interactions, you will develop an understanding of the key topics and challenges facing the Gas \& LNG industry and incorporate these perspectives into our research.
   

  

 You will be expected to operate autonomously while collaborating effectively across geographically dispersed teams. As you develop in the role, you will build deeper expertise across Gas \& LNG markets and assets while strengthening your capabilities in research, data analysis, modelling, market intelligence, written and verbal communication, and client engagement.
   

  

 Your application should showcase your enthusiasm for the Gas \& LNG sectors and demonstrate your ability in the following areas, which we require daily at Wood Mackenzie.
   

  

**General Core Capabilities**
* Research and data gathering – we identify and gather intelligence that feeds our industry expertise. We need inquisitive and passionate people with a keen eye for detail.
* Analysis \- we provide market\-leading research using this data/intelligence and form opinions for, and tell stories to, our customers. We need people with natural curiosity with potential to become experts in their field, and with the ability to articulate – both verbally and in writing – clear, insightful analysis.
* Internal engagement – we work with colleagues across the Wood Mackenzie business to deliver a compelling, integrated view of the natural resources sector to customers through our cutting\-edge products. For this, we need people who are as comfortable working collaboratively as they are independently and who have excellent interpersonal skills.
* External engagement – we proactively connect with our customers and contacts in the industries we serve, adding value and promoting the Wood Mackenzie brand. This requires people with the potential to become industry experts who have intellectual curiosity, passion, and excellent presentation skills.
* Continuous improvement – at Wood Mackenzie, we are committed to transform the way we power our planet. The energy transition is here and this impacts our customer base and how we serve them. We need colleagues with a change mindset, who are flexible, growth\-orientated and proactive.


**Specific Role Requirements**
* Build and develop high\-quality research on the short\-term LNG market, with a focus on demand and shipping.
* Forecast monthly gas and LNG demand for various countries, run complex models and ensure our view remains robust, up\-to\-date, and consistent.
* Participate in the creation of new demand models.
* Run our shipping models and drive enhancements to our methodologies.
* Identify and collect market research and data relating to these datasets, working with the data teams to ensure a high level of automation.
* Compile weekly commentary on LNG demand and LNG shipping. Contribute to our regular internal knowledge shares.
* Work with the broader gas \& LNG teams (for regional and global consistency) or other commodity teams (like power, coal, carbon).
* Create content for the Monthly Outlook, participate to our monthly webinars.
* Take part in regular client engagement, either via email, virtual and F2F interactions


**Diversity is at the core of our business** 
 and we welcome applications from a range of academic or professional backgrounds. Wood Mackenzie has adopted a hybrid approach and we expect people to be present in our offices 2 days per week.
   

  

**About You**
 You have a keen interest in commodity market dynamics, and you want to develop an in\-depth understanding of how these markets underpin the natural resources industry and impact our everyday lives.
   

  

 You have an analytical mindset and an eye for detail, which have been proven in your academic and/or work experience to date. You are comfortable collecting, structuring and interpreting large data sets, articulating your findings in a clear and insightful manner. You are curious and seek to clarify and enhance your knowledge by asking thoughtful questions. You also have a flair for writing and communication and confidence in presenting to an audience.
   

  

 You are a highly adaptive team player and embrace fast\-paced environments with frequent change. You are excited to be part of a team that gives you opportunities to work cross\-functionally on a variety of tasks. You can work independently and as part of a global and regional team, generating ideas you want to share. The way in which you work is productive and driven, striving to be best in class.
   

  

 You have an excellent command of English, both written and spoken. Knowledge of at least one other language would be an advantage. You also have an excellent working knowledge of the Microsoft Office suite, particularly Excel, PowerQuery, and PowerPoint, and some exposure to coding.
   

  

**Equal Opportunities**
 We are an equal opportunities employer. This means we are committed to recruiting the best people regardless of their race, colour, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, disability or protected veteran status. You can find out more about your rights under the law at www.eeoc.gov

title: Project Leader- Data & Insights (Industries) - Consumer Lab
description:
**About Us**
 Bain \& Company is a global consultancy that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 61 offices in 39 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.
   

  

 In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN plays a critical role in supporting Bain's case teams globally to help with analytics and research across all industries, for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.
   

  

**Who You’ll Work With**
 This position is based in BCN's Gurgaon office and is a vital part of the Data and Insights Industries’ Consumer Lab team within CP. The Consumer Lab team plays a critical role in advancing Bain's expertise in the consumer products sector via building, maintaining, and advancing comprehensive Bain IP/Research to capture key trends within the consumer space.
   

  

 With a focus on consumer centricity, Bain Consumer Lab works with CP Practice/Case\-teams to triangulate bespoke qualitative and quantitative research, in\-market testing, third\-party data sets, and the perspectives of our expert network to unearth validated, actionable insights to answer clients' pressing challenges. Our network includes AAG, Innovation \& Design, Pyxis, Net base, FBX and the Bain Advisor Network.
   

  

 By staying ahead of industry trends and leveraging advanced data analytics, the Consumer Lab team supports Bain’s commitment to delivering top\-tier strategic guidance to its clients. Over time, we have developed seamless solutions and utilized powerful, dynamic visualizations and charts on various platforms (e.g., Tableau) to showcase our results and have been venturing towards Gen\-AI\-based tools to drive further value. Our working model features a mix between long\-term research projects as well as short, dynamic engagements with case\-teams supporting them on key analyses.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 As a Project Leader in the CP Consumer Lab team within Data \& Insights Industries, you will play a key role in driving the workstream forward. You will lead the Consumer Lab team in co\-developing Bain’s global IP solutions/insights to pave way for strong Consumer research. The role would involve liaising closely with CP Practice/Case\-team(s) and other 3rd party vendors/associate network teams to identify, manage and drive high\-quality insights for Bain within Consumer space. Operationally, this would entail working under the direct supervision of a Manager/Senior Manager and leading 1\-2 project engagements at any given time, along with guiding analysts/associates to support ad\-hoc data/storyline requests for the case\-teams. This would also involve extensive boundary management with team such as AAG, RDS, Innovation and Design and 3rd party survey vendors to procure and manage the most relevant set of data and associated insights. In time, you’d be expected to drive innovation within the team via helping your supervisor explore and introduce more advanced Tableau and Gen\-AI for Consumer insights from data. Additionally, you will guide and mentor a team of analysts and associates, providing direction and support to enhance team productivity and contribute to the overall success of the Consumer Lab initiatives.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
* Lead the development, maintenance and upgrading of proprietary Bain IP, coordinating efforts with the help of 3\-4 aligned team members (analysts and associates) and ensuring data accuracy and relevance.
* Guide Analysts/Associates on best practices and methodologies for IP creation, ensuring consistency and quality in data collection and reporting.
* Effectively communicate with BCN / end clients and deliver client ready documents containing implementable solutions.
* Provide mentorship and hands\-on support to analysts/associates in data analysis and other ad\-hoc work engagement.
* Set\-up strong standards for data accuracy and quality
* Pressure test insights and perform extensive sense checks
* Be a key thought partner to CP Practice in conceptualizing research, explore innovative solutions and further client engagement for Consumer Lab.
* Stay up to date with the latest consumer products industry trends and incorporate these insights into the insights creation processes.
* Ensure timely delivery of high\-quality outputs by managing workflows and team efforts.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure solutions align with overall business objectives and industry trends.
* Able to quickly come up to speed on different businesses and lead research and analysis engagements across geographies and industries.
* Collaborate with Bain case teams globally and work under direct guidance of senior leadership, to identify client\-specific trends, validate assumptions, and ensure recommendations are aligned with industry.
* Liase with cross\-functional teams to drive value
* Identify and use relevant analytical tools and internal repositories to extract data and analyze information.


**About You**
* Graduate (preferably with degree in engineering / science / commerce / business / economics) with at least 5\-8 years of relevant experience or an MBA/Post\-Graduate with high academic records having 3\-5 years of relevant experience.
* Proven expertise in leading, guiding and mentoring a team of 3\-5 members in the past. Experience of data analysis and project management
* Effective communication skills and ability and deliver clear and professional presentations to senior stakeholders (Bain managers, partners, and clients)
* Expertise in building intellectual proprietary based research reports backed by strong primary and secondary research skills.
* Strong number crunching/Excel modelling skills, with a knack for setting up and meeting high data quality standards
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills to lead the team towards pragmatic solutions.
* Strong expertise in various analytical and reporting / visualization tools such as Excel, PowerPoint, Tableau and Alteryx
* Experience in survey design, coding, deployment, and results creation across various internal/external platforms (Qualtrics, IncQuery etc.)
* Performing advanced survey analytics to back impactful insights for clients
* Any experience with LLM/AI tools would be a bonus.
* Ability to foresee potential bottlenecks, risks and short\-term/long\-term implications and exhibit willingness to change.
* Ability to navigate the above challenges with a professional mindset.
* Ability to handle multiple tasks and work in a team set up.
* Curiosity to continuously groom oneself towards knowing more about consumer products space and wider consumer trends.


**What Makes Us a Great Place To Work**
 We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the \#1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. We are publicly recognized by external parties such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ and parents.

title: Ecommerce Manager
description:
**Job Title: E\-Commerce \& Marketplace Growth Manager** 




  





 We are looking for a highly driven and commercially minded
 **E\-Commerce \& Marketplace Growth Manager** 
 to take ownership of our online sales channels and drive growth across marketplaces, our website, and other digital commerce platforms.
 



  





 This is not a purely operational role. We are looking for someone who can think like a business owner—someone who can identify opportunities, improve sales, optimise profitability, study competitors, develop new product ideas, and build new revenue channels.
 



  





 The ideal candidate will manage and grow our presence across platforms such as
 **Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, our own website, and other relevant marketplaces and aggregator portals** 
 .
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Marketplace Management \& Growth** 



* Manage and grow sales across Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra and other relevant e\-commerce and aggregator platforms.
* Create, optimise and manage product listings, including titles, descriptions, keywords, images and product information.
* Monitor product performance and identify opportunities to improve sales and visibility.
* Plan and execute pricing, discounts, offers, bundles and promotional campaigns.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure inventory availability and minimise stock\-outs.
* Monitor product ratings, reviews, returns and customer feedback.
* Identify underperforming SKUs and develop strategies to improve or discontinue them.
* Identify high\-performing products and opportunities to scale them.



  





**2\. Website Sales \& Digital Commerce Growth** 



* Drive sales and growth through the company website.
* Identify opportunities to improve website conversion rates and customer experience.
* Create product bundles, combo offers, trial packs, family packs, premium packs and other initiatives to increase average order value.
* Develop cross\-selling and upselling opportunities across the product portfolio.
* Work with internal and external teams to improve product pages, offers and customer journeys.
* Develop strategies to increase repeat purchases and customer retention.



  





**3\. Customer Feedback, Testimonials \& Retention** 



* Develop and manage a structured process for collecting customer feedback.
* Conduct customer calls to understand product experience and satisfaction.
* Identify satisfied customers and collect written and video testimonials.
* Build a strong repository of customer reviews, testimonials and user\-generated content for use across digital platforms.
* Follow up with customers to encourage repeat purchases and referrals.
* Analyse customer complaints and feedback to identify opportunities for product and service improvement.



  





**4\. Competitor Research \& Pricing Strategy** 



* Continuously monitor competitors, their products, pricing, offers and promotions.
* Conduct regular market research to identify trending products and emerging opportunities.
* Identify products that competitors are selling successfully and evaluate whether they can be developed, manufactured or sourced in\-house.
* Work with internal teams to identify opportunities for competitive pricing while maintaining healthy margins.
* Prepare regular competitor and market intelligence reports for management.



  





**5\. New Product \& Revenue Opportunities** 



* Identify new product categories and opportunities that can generate additional revenue.
* Research products currently performing well in the market and assess their commercial potential.
* Identify opportunities to manufacture, source or develop products at competitive pricing.
* Work with internal teams to develop new SKUs, variants, sizes, bundles and product extensions.
* Explore high\-margin complementary products and add\-on opportunities.
* Present commercially viable new product and revenue ideas to management on a regular basis.



  





**6\. New Digital Sales Channels** 



* Identify and onboard relevant e\-commerce platforms, aggregator portals and other digital sales channels.
* Explore opportunities for affiliate marketing, referral programs and micro\-influencer partnerships.
* Develop strategies to increase direct\-to\-consumer sales and reduce dependency on any single marketplace.
* Identify potential opportunities in bulk orders, corporate sales, gifting and B2B partnerships where relevant.



  





**7\. Sales, Data \& Profitability** 



* Track daily, weekly and monthly sales performance across all channels.
* Monitor profitability at a product and channel level.
* Analyse the impact of discounts, commissions, returns and promotional campaigns on margins.
* Identify opportunities to reduce costs and improve profitability.
* Prepare regular MIS and growth reports for management.
* Take ownership of assigned revenue and growth targets.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 



* Proven experience in managing e\-commerce marketplaces such as Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra or similar platforms.
* Strong understanding of online product listings, pricing, promotions and marketplace operations.
* Commercial mindset with the ability to identify new sales and revenue opportunities.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to understand product profitability, margins and pricing.
* Experience with website sales and D2C e\-commerce will be an advantage.
* Comfortable speaking with customers and conducting feedback or testimonial calls.
* Ability to conduct competitor and market research.
* Highly proactive, organised and result\-oriented.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of business outcomes.



  





**Preferred Profile** 




 We would prefer someone who:
 


* Has hands\-on experience managing multiple e\-commerce platforms.
* Understands both
 **sales growth and profitability** 
 .
* Can independently identify problems and propose solutions.
* Is comfortable working in a fast\-paced and entrepreneurial environment.
* Has a strong interest in consumer products, digital commerce and new product development.
* Thinks beyond day\-to\-day operations and actively looks for new business opportunities.

description:
**COMPANY PROFILE**





 Bain \& Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.
 





 Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefining industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes.
 





  
 





 The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally. Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.
 





  
 





**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK** 






 We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top\-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the \#1 overall spot a record seven times.
 





 Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
 





  
 





**Job Summary** 






 Bain’s Airlines, Logistics and Transport (ALT) sector is part of the Advanced Manufacturing \& Services (AMS) Practice. The Operations Senior Analyst role sits at the intersection of client relationship management, knowledge management, and AI enablement. You will help sector leadership and account teams improve client engagement, strengthen commercial execution, and scale best practices and IP — and you will build and maintain a growing library of AI\-powered tools, skills, and automations that case teams can pull off the shelf. Working closely with partners, knowledge management, and product teams globally, your mandate is to take routine analytical and administrative work off case teams’ plates so they can focus on higher\-value activities.
 





  
 





**Key Responsibilities** 






  
 





**Client and Account Support** 




* Support the smooth operation of Bain’s CRM tool (“Cortex” on a Salesforce platform) for approximately 30 key accounts, ensuring data integrity and consistent usage.
* Monitor client engagement patterns and surface signals that indicate opportunities for timely partner outreach.


* Build and maintain recurring dashboards and reports (e.g., account status, activity, pipeline signals) to help client heads proactively manage relationships and identify growth opportunities.
* Design and maintain a centralized repository (on Bain approved platforms) for pitch materials, proposals, case examples, and templates; ensure content is searchable, appropriately tagged, and version\-controlled for reuse.
* Partner with Knowledge Management to develop microsites using established frameworks, improving speed and consistency of content access for teams.
* Partner with other sector/practice PPK teams to cross\-pollinate IP.
* Contribute to sector IP development by participating in the creation of new IP as opportunities arise.
* Support IP deployment and commercialization by assisting the Regional Sector Leaders with go\-to\-market planning (timing, channels, and enablement materials).
* Maintain and update sector affiliate and expert lists (in coordination with relevant internal teams) to improve access to expertise when needed.




**AI Enablement** 




* Build and maintain a practice\-level repository of reusable AI assets — including Claude skills (SKILL.md files), artifacts, prompts, and agent configurations — that case teams can pull off the shelf to accelerate recurring analytical and content tasks. Own the taxonomy, documentation, access, and version control of these assets, and drive adoption through onboarding materials and light coaching of case teams.
* Develop purpose\-built AI tools that turn sector data sources into fast, case\-ready outputs — for example, skills that analyze Cirium Diio schedule data or IATA MarketIS booking data to produce quick market sizing, competitive dynamics, route economics, or network\-change analyses on demand for case teams.
* Set up and maintain recurring AI\-driven insight generation pipelines that combine licensed data subscriptions (e.g., Cirium Diio, IATA MarketIS) with public and scraped sources to produce regular sector pulses, trend updates, and proprietary points of view the practice can push to partners and clients.
* Identify routine, repetitive tasks across the practice — administrative, reporting, research, or data\-prep — and design AI automations, freeing up time for client\-facing and judgment\-heavy work. Deploy automations responsibly with appropriate confidentiality, data handling, and access controls.
* Catalogue and maintain the sector’s library of hosted proof\-of\-concept apps built for proposals and pitches — capturing what each app does, the client and proposal context it was built for, where it is hosted, its current status, and the internal owner — so the practice can quickly surface, demo, or repurpose prior POCs in new pitch situations. Coordinate with partners and product teams to retire stale apps and promote proven ones into reusable assets.







  




**Qualifications** 






 Required
 



* 2\-5 years of professional experience, ideally in professional services, consulting, technology, or data\-driven roles.
* Quantitative undergraduate degree (or equivalent analytical training).
* Hands\-on familiarity with Claude and/or other leading GenAI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot). Comfortable designing effective prompts, applying LLMs to real work tasks such as document synthesis, content drafting, and data extraction, and critically evaluating outputs to improve quality. Genuine interest in going beyond day\-to\-day usage to author and share reusable AI assets — prompts, custom GPTs, Claude skills, and artifacts — that other people can pick up and run with.
* Light analytics and data skills, including advanced Excel (pivot tables, lookups, dynamic arrays, chart\-building) and basic SQL or Python for querying, cleaning, and transforming data. Comfortable structuring datasets, performing exploratory analysis, and producing clear, insight\-driven outputs for non\-technical audiences.
* Ability to drive work end\-to\-end with limited direction; strong organization and attention to detail.
* Effective stakeholder management skills, including the ability to steer small working meetings and contribute thoughtfully with senior stakeholders.




 Preferred
 



* Hands\-on experience with Salesforce reporting and dashboarding, including building custom reports, configuring dashboards for different user personas, and working with report types and filters. Strong CRM and data\-quality habits — including ownership of data hygiene routines, deduplication, consistent taxonomy and tagging, and proactive identification of gaps or inconsistencies that could affect downstream reporting.
* Experience with knowledge management tools such as SharePoint, Google Drive, or Confluence, including setting up structured content libraries, applying metadata and tagging schemas to aid discoverability, and managing access and permissions across user groups. Familiarity with basic content governance and versioning practices — including lifecycle management (draft, approved, archived), naming conventions, and periodic content review cycles to ensure materials remain current and reusable.
* Automation experience using tools such as Power Automate, Zapier, or n8n, Salesforce flows and process builders, or light scripting (e.g., Python, JavaScript, Apps Script) to connect systems and streamline repetitive tasks. A track record of shipping reusable AI assets that others have adopted is a strong plus, as is experience identifying high\-friction processes and replacing them with automated solutions that demonstrably freed up time.

title: Consultant - Digital Strategy, Customer Experience & Analytics
description:
**What makes Gartner Consulting a GREAT fit for you?**
 A career at Gartner Consulting will be unlike any other you have experienced. Not only are we passionate about technology and its applications, but we are also committed to attracting the most creative, talented, and self\-driven people to take our well\-regarded Consulting function to a whole new level. When you join Gartner, you will be a part of some of the most innovative business and technology efforts in the marketplace today. We are technology thought leaders for the 21st century. You can expect to connect technology innovations, data\-driven insights and automation to the strategic requirements of an organization and to the commercial needs of a business, all within the context of a rapidly evolving digital economy. Consulting associates enjoy a collaborative work environment, exceptional training, and career development opportunities. If you thrive on solving complex business challenges with technology, Gartner Consulting is the place for you.
   

  

**About Role:**
 Gartner Consulting is looking for a Consultant who will work with some of the world’s largest enterprises to shape digital roadmaps, assess and improve customer experience, design data\-driven performance insights, and implement technology\-enabled transformation priorities. The role will combine digital and technology consulting with hands\-on dashboarding, analytics and automation, leveraging Gartner’s market\-leading research and benchmarks.
   

  

**What you’ll do:**

* Understand client industry issues, exhibit structured problem\-solving ability, and develop insights and recommendations based on in\-depth research, Gartner benchmarks, client interviews, customer and operational data, and relevant market trends.

**What you’ll need:**

* Demonstrated hands\-on ability to design dashboards, scorecards, analytical models and automated reporting solutions using Power BI, Power Platform, Excel, SQL or similar analytics and visualization tools.
* Experience translating business and stakeholder requirements into meaningful KPIs, measurement frameworks, data requirements and executive performance views, with the ability to interpret data and communicate practical implications.
* Demonstrated understanding of digital transformation, customer experience, automation, cloud, data platforms, digital products and enterprise technology platforms, with the ability to translate technology opportunities into practical business and transformation actions.
* Experience using AI\-enabled productivity tools to improve research, synthesis, analysis, ideation, deliverable creation and speed\-to\-insight, with strong attention to accuracy, source validation, client confidentiality and responsible use.
* Passionate about technology; tracks latest trends and their potential use to solve complex business problems, improve customer outcomes, automate processes and strengthen digital capabilities.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills in a global environment, with the ability to collaborate continuously with cross\-border teams and engage business, technology and data stakeholders.
* A curious and inquisitive mind, with openness to new experiences and learning, strong problem\-solving ability, client focus and the versatility to work effectively across strategy, analytics, customer experience and transformation topics.
* Ability to create executive\-ready dashboards and deliverables with clear storyline, data\-backed recommendations, structured logic and practical next steps; Bachelor’s degree required, with an MBA or advanced degree in business, technology, engineering, analytics, computer science or a related field preferred.


**Who you are:**
* Self\-starter and quick learner who demonstrates ownership, intellectual curiosity and a strong commitment to client impact.
* Strong consultative skills and problem\-solving ability, with the confidence to structure ambiguous problems, analyze data and convert insights into actionable recommendations.
* Passionate about technology and helping clients improve customer and business outcomes through digital transformation, analytics, automation and data\-driven decision\-making.
* Comfortable combining hands\-on dashboard and analytical delivery with broader digital and technology consulting, and using AI\-enabled methods responsibly to improve productivity, quality and speed of delivery.
* Able to work effectively with senior stakeholders, engagement managers and globally distributed consulting teams across business, technology, customer experience and data topics.
* High\-performing and versatile team player with strong intercultural communication, collaboration and stakeholder management skills.
* Willing to coach and support junior team members, helping them improve consulting craft, analytical rigor, dashboard development, AI\-enabled productivity and deliverable quality.


**What Gartner Consulting will offer you?**
* A world\-class consulting environment.
* The opportunity to work on cutting\-edge dashboarding, analytics, customer experience, digital transformation and IT strategy engagements with a tier one client portfolio.
* A competitive salary.
* Structured bonus based on individual and corporate performance.
* Opportunities for promotion with a clearly defined career development structure.

* A dynamic but relaxed and supportive working environment that encourages personal development.

description:
